title: Growth Manager
description:
About the Starknet Foundation

The Starknet Foundation is the steward of Starknet, a permissionless validity rollup designed to scale the world’s most important blockchains without compromise. Having pioneered ZK-STARK technology to scale Ethereum, we are now entering a new era as the first network to settle simultaneously on both Bitcoin and Ethereum.

Joining the Starknet Foundation now places you at the epicenter of this pivotal phase and offers a rare, ground-floor opportunity to shape how Starknet's core growth verticals evolve: from BTCFi and privacy to quantum resistance and real-world assets. This is a unique chance to build the infrastructure that turns the world's most secure assets and most sensitive use cases into productive, scalable capital for a billion users, and it requires exceptional talent. We're looking for people who think in systems, operate well in ambiguity, and are motivated by long-term impact over short-term wins. If you want your work to outlast a market cycle and define how decentralized systems actually scale, this is the place to do it.

 

What You’ll Bring

  • Senior generalist with a proven ability to operate cross-functionally across strategy, BD, partnerships, and product development.

  • Crypto and DeFi native with minimum 5+ years of experience.

  • Ideal background in banking, management consulting or legal training, with experience at a Tier one company within the industry.

  • Strong commercial and research skills, including the ability to build clear business cases and financial models.

  • A deep crypto network and a track record of building senior relationships with DeFi protocols, LPs and financial institutions that generated revenue/growth.

What You Need To Succeed

  • Self-starter with high energy, motivation, and ambition.

  • Comfortable defining success for a specific vertical, identifying gaps and reallocating efforts toward the highest-value opportunities.

  • Proven ability to influence senior executives and work effectively with stakeholders across the organisation.

  • Strong deal experience and negotiation skills

What You’ll Do

  • Take ownership of strategy and execution across the Growth team's priority verticals (Privacy, Bitcoin, Quantum, RWA), with the flexibility to shift focus as new opportunities and priorities emerge.

  • Identify, negotiate and manage partnerships end-to-end to extend and strengthen Starknet’s infrastructure stack.

  • Develop commercial proposals that drive growth across the Starknet ecosystem.

  • Work with product, ecosystem and marketing teams to identify and build new solutions that drive partner ecosystem success.

  • Partner with legal, finance, and operations teams to support existing and upcoming partnerships.

  • Represent Starknet at conferences and industry events to enhance visibility and connection to top-tier projects.

Location:

We are a globally dispersed, remote-first organization. However, for this role we are partial to candidates based and with networks in: APAC (Singapore/HK) and NYC.

title: Social Media Marketer
description:
About the Role:

We’re hiring a Social Media Marketer to help Starknet show up consistently, clearly, and credibly across our core social channels - @starknet and @starknetfndn. This role sits within the GTM team and reports directly to our Marketing Lead. The focus is social: developing a strong point of view, finding the right moments to enter conversations, turning Starknet’s technology and ecosystem into compelling content, and building the kind of consistent presence that strengthens brand recognition over time.

What You'll Do:

  • Own and run Starknet's and Starknet Foundation's social channels (X, blog, LinkedIn, Telegram), keeping posting and engagement consistently high quality.

  • Turn marketing strategy, ecosystem narratives, and campaign direction into clear, on-brand content (both long and short form) for crypto-native, technical, and consumer audiences alike.

  • Manage the social content calendar and incoming requests across the organization. This requires real organizational skill and comfort with project-management tools, not just content instincts.

  • Be the go-to point for ecosystem social activity: field requests from partners and decide how and when to spotlight launches, events, and key moments.

  • Build and run channel-specific posting strategies that balance planned content with real-time, reactive engagement.

  • Track conversations, trends, and sentiment across the ecosystem and broader crypto space, and use performance data to continuously sharpen content and strategy.

  • Engage directly with the community: responding, contextualizing, and escalating thoughtfully and credibly.

  • Partner closely with GTM, Growth, Product, and other teams to keep social execution aligned with broader Foundation priorities.

  • Help shape and evolve Starknet's brand voice on social alongside the greater Marketing team.

What You Bring:

  • Deep understanding of Starknet's place in the market: its strengths, trade-offs, and how to talk about them credibly with audiences beyond retail crypto users.

  • Strong, well-informed opinions about what performs on Crypto Twitter and what actually serves the brand - with the judgment to tell the two apart.

  • 3+ years of hands-on social media marketing experience, ideally in crypto/web3.

  • Solid working knowledge of blockchain and DeFi fundamentals (AMMs, staking, governance, lending, the L2 landscape) - enough to engage technical audiences with confidence.

  • A strong, versatile writer who can translate complex ideas into content that lands across a range of audiences.

  • Experience operating social channels in fast-moving environments, including reactive posting and real-time engagement.

  • Comfortable with social analytics and monitoring tools, using data to guide content and channel decisions.

  • A highly reliable, organized operator who can manage multiple threads without losing sight of the details.

  • Confident owning execution independently, while staying collaborative and coordinated with the wider team.

  • Comfortable being a visible presence for the brand - hosting Spaces, replying from the account, and engaging actively on CT.

This role is remote and engaged through our UK entity, Tzolkin Limited.

title: Quant Trader
description:
About Kappa Lab:

Kappa Lab is a digital-assets market maker. We provide continuous, round-the-clock liquidity across 50+ centralised and decentralised exchanges, quoting a wide range of assets. Our proprietary technology and quantitative models let us price consistently and respond quickly across every venue we trade.

About the role:

As a Quantitative Trader you will join a hands-on trading team, taking ownership of live market-making strategies while researching and prototyping new ones. This is a role for someone who enjoys the challenge of achieving high performance and PnL plus the analytical side of markets and the engineering that makes trading work in practice.

What you will do:

  • Own live market-making strategies: tune quoting parameters, spreads, sizing and hedging, and diagnose and improve performance
  • Research, prototype and launch new quantitative strategies across venues and asset classes
  • Analyse execution quality in depth - fill quality, adverse selection, realised spreads, and trading costs
  • Work in our configuration-as-code platform, where strategy parameters are version-controlled, reviewed and deployed like software
  • Monitor live trading and manage risk through volatile market conditions
  • Work closely with engineering on the systems you trade through, and contribute code to them yourself

What we are looking for:

  • Strong quantitative reasoning and real comfort applying statistics to noisy, fast-moving data
  • Production-grade Python: code others can maintain, sensible use of version control, and the ability to debug a live system under pressure
  • Evidence you can turn large market datasets into a decision and clearly explain your reasoning
  • Familiarity with cryptocurrency markets, blockchain technology, and trading concepts
  • Sound judgement about risk: knowing when to size down, hedge or stop
  • A proactive mindset and ability to spot opportunities, move fast, and make things happen

Strongly valued:

  • Experience in market making, high-frequency trading, or systematic execution
  • Proficiency in Rust
  • Familiarity with DeFi and on-chain execution

Location and Working Style:

We have offices in London (UK) and Dubai (UAE) and operate on a hybrid basis.

title: Product Owner Tangem Pay
description:
📈

Product Owner (Tangem Pay)

Tangem is building the world’s most advanced self-custodial financial platform, redefining how people store, grow, and spend digital value at global scale.

Founded in 2017 and headquartered in Zug, Switzerland, Tangem operates globally across North America, Europe, and APAC. The company pioneered hardware-based self-custody by combining secure smartcard technology with a seamless mobile experience, enabling millions of users to hold and use digital assets with instant setup, zero complexity, and institutional-grade security.

Today, Tangem serves customers in over 220 countries, supporting thousands of digital assets through a single, ultra-secure hardware wallet. Setup takes less than one minute, with no seed phrases, no friction, and no compromise on security. This foundation positions Tangem as one of the few companies capable of bringing self-custody to true mass adoption.

Tangem Pay extends this foundation into real-world finance. It transforms the Tangem Wallet into a full self-custodial payment account, allowing users to seamlessly move from storing value to spending it anywhere cards are accepted globally. The product is live, production-ready, and built to scale across regions, currencies, and regulatory environments.

With Tangem Pay, we are not launching “another crypto card.” We are building the spending layer of a new financial system where self-custody, payments, and global usability converge. The infrastructure is live, the partners are in place, and the roadmap is designed for rapid global expansion.

About the Role

The Product Owner will be responsible for all Tangem Pay (TP) related products, including payment flows, internal tooling, financial rails, and monitoring capabilities.

The role focuses on product execution, reliability, and operational scalability, rather than commercial ownership.

We see a potential opportunity for Tangem in the professional wealth and institutional segment, including family offices, HNWs, wealth managers, RIAs, corporate treasuries, and other financial institutions.

Our goal is not to become a regulated custodian, but to explore whether Tangem can serve as a secure self-custody and access-control solution, independently or alongside existing custody infrastructure.

The Role

We are looking for a senior US financial-services professional to lead a focused market research and strategy project.

We do not want to start with a predefined product or business model. The first objective is to understand how professional clients currently manage digital assets, what problems they face, where existing solutions fall short, and whether there is a meaningful commercial opportunity for Tangem.

Based on this research, the person will define who we should target, what we should build, how we should go to market, and how Tangem can monetize the opportunity.

1. Market Research & Customer Discovery

  • Interview family offices, HNWs, RIAs, wealth managers, corporate treasuries, custodians, and other relevant players
  • Understand current digital-asset custody, security, governance, recovery, and reporting processes
  • Map existing solutions and competitors

  • Prioritize the most attractive customer segments, use cases, potential partners, and pilot customers

2. Product & Business Strategy

Based on the findings:

  • Define priority customer segments and use cases
  • Develop Tangem's value proposition and positioning
  • Identify required product capabilities and integrations
  • Recommend an MVP / pilot
  • Define regulatory and operational considerations
  • Build an initial go-to-market strategy

Potential requirements could include multi-user approvals, permissions, transaction controls, audit trails, recovery, reporting, and integrations — but these should be validated through research rather than assumed upfront.

3. Monetization & P&L

  • Identify and validate potential revenue models
  • Define pricing and packaging
  • Assess customer willingness to pay
  • Estimate market and revenue potential
  • Define required product, sales, operational, and support investments
  • Build an initial P&L, including revenue, margins, costs, and break-even scenarios
  • Define commercial KPIs and investment required to launch and scale

Key Deliverables

The project should result in:

  1. Market and customer research with prioritized segments and use cases
  2. Recommended product / MVP and value proposition
  3. Go-to-market and partnership strategy
  4. Monetization and pricing model
  5. Potential pilot customer and partner pipeline
  6. Financial model and P&L
  7. Final go / no-go recommendation and launch roadmap

Ideal Background

We are looking for someone with senior experience in private wealth, family offices, RIAs, institutional digital assets, custody, corporate treasury, private banking, or WealthTech / FinTech.

The ideal candidate should have a strong US industry network, experience in customer discovery and new business development, and the ability to translate market insights into product strategy, commercial model, and P&L.

We are building capability for Tangem customers to trade US equities inside the mobile app (iOS/Android), with an external tech vendor as our partner. The US entity, its licensed officers, and the local regulatory work sit with outsourced specialists and external advisors. Everything those people need in order to do their jobs comes from headquarters — and that is your job. You are not the compliance function and you are not expected to be a securities expert. You are the person at HQ who makes sure the advisors, external tech vendor, and the internal teams have the information they need, and that requests are tracked, followed up and escalated where necessary.

Responsibilities:

  • Assemble and maintain the HQ-side inputs our external advisors need for the broker-dealer application: business and product descriptions, funding and money-flow narratives, technology and vendor schedules, organisational and reporting structure, and whatever else they ask for. You chase the underlying facts inside Tangem AG and turn them into what the advisors actually need.
  • Run the document request list: advisors and counsel will send us long lists with dates on them. You own the tracker, the owners, and the follow-ups, and you flag slippage before it becomes a delay.
  • Support the clearing broker relationship: consolidate our open questions, track their answers, keep a current view of what has been agreed and what is still open across clearing, API coverage, market data, KYC allocation, and commercial terms.
  • Hold external advisors to account as suppliers: read their drafts, catch places where they have misdescribed our product or our funding flow, and get corrections made rather than accepting the first version.
  • Produce revenue and cost estimates for the equities business, and keep them current as the commercial terms with the clearing broker and our vendors firm up.
  • Run competitor and market research on US retail brokerage and crypto-adjacent equities offerings; turn it into short memos that lead with a conclusion.
  • Keep documentation current — process maps, flow diagrams, and internal briefing material that design, engineering, and the US entity team can all work from.
  • Brief marketing and content so external communication describes the product accurately. In a regulated business the cost of a loose claim is higher than usual.

Requirements:

  • 3+ years as a business analyst, project or programme coordinator, consultant, or in an operations role.
  • Background in trading, brokerage, asset management, or financial services more broadly. We would strongly prefer someone who already understands how a brokerage business makes money and where its operational risks sit, rather than someone learning that on the job while coordinating a licence application.
  • Evidence of having assembled material for a regulatory filing, licence application, audit, or major vendor due-diligence process. Any jurisdiction — this is the closest analogue to the work.
  • Comfortable managing external advisors and law firms as suppliers: scoping them, holding dates, and pushing back on a draft that is wrong.
  • Organised under pressure across many parallel threads, with a working style that closes loops without being chased. Much of this role is knowing what is outstanding, from whom, and by when.
  • Precise written English. Specs, memos, and trackers that are short, structured, and unambiguous.
  • Effective across time zones and across a headquarters/subsidiary split, where the people who need information and the people who hold it are rarely in the same room.

Nice to have:

  • Able to read a technical document or an API description well enough to describe a system accurately in writing, and to talk to developers without needing a translator.
  • Securities regulation or fintech licensing exposure; experience supporting a market-entry or new-entity project; SQL or Python for quick data pulls; Figma and MIRO; crypto literacy and self-custody familiarity (relevant later, when tokenised equities enter scope).

What We Offer:

  • Stability, development, participation in the future unicorn's growth.
  • Remote work from anywhere in the world, excluding Russia and Belarus, with a schedule aligned with GMT+3.
  • Competitive salary in EUR/USDT.

title: Senior/Staff Mobile Security Engineer
location: San Francisco, California, US, San Francisco
description:
About the Company:

Tools for Humanity (TFH) designs and builds technology behind World. World is building a real human network designed to accelerate people in the age of AI. As bots and autonomous agents reshape the internet, people, institutions, and applications need a trusted way to confirm who is a real human while preserving privacy. The TFH and World tech stacks make this possible: the Orb verifies real, unique people, World ID proves it privately, and World App puts these capabilities, and more, in people’s hands. Together, they add a human layer to an AI-driven internet.

World is already running at a global scale. More than 17 million people across 160 countries have verified with World ID, and more new Orb verifications take place each week. World App is already among the most used wallets globally. Developers are integrating World ID to build safer online experiences and create spaces where real people can participate, earn, and be recognized in ways AI simply can’t replicate.

Founded in 2019, TFH has more than 400 people across hardware, software, AI, cryptography, mobile engineering, and global operations. Our teams come from OpenAI, Tesla, SpaceX, Apple, Google, Stripe, Meta, Coinbase, Palantir and MIT Media Lab. We’re backed by leading investors, including a16z, Khosla Ventures, Bain Capital Crypto, Blockchain Capital, Variant, Tiger Global, and Coinbase Ventures, as well as prominent operators and founders across fintech and AI.

TFH and World have been featured on the cover of TIME Magazine, highlighted in Fast Company’s Next 5 in Fintech, and explored in a Bloomberg deep dive. The New York Times, Bankless and TechCrunch have all recognized our collective progress in identity, cryptography, AI, and global-scale hardware deployment. Our leadership is also named to the Time AI 100. Learn more about the newest product launches from our Liftoff event.

About the Team

The Security team at Tools for Humanity operates at a level far beyond a regular company. Our objective is not just to secure an organization, but to build the trusted, foundational infrastructure for the world's largest identity and financial network. We are a team of over 15 seasoned engineers who are central to the success of the World protocol. We tackle a unique and complex threat landscape that spans state-of-the-art hardware security for the Orb, advanced cryptography including new zero-knowledge proofs, and the security of a global, distributed cloud and mobile ecosystem. Our work is critical to enabling the protocol to scale to billions of users while upholding an unwavering commitment to fail-safe security and privacy.

About the Opportunity

As a Mobile Security Engineer, you will own the security and integrity of the mobile applications at the core of the World protocol World App on Android and iOS used by millions of people worldwide to verify their identity, authenticate with biometrics, and manage digital assets. This is not a consultative role; you will be a hands-on builder, designing and implementing the systems that ensure our mobile clients are trustworthy, tamper-resistant, and resistant to adversarial attack at global scale.

Our mobile threat model is uniquely challenging: the World App must perform privacy-preserving biometric operations (iris and face authentication) on-device, hold cryptographic keys for identity proofs, and interact with hardware attestation systems all while operating in environments where adversaries range from casual fraud to nation-state-level identity fabrication at scale. You will be the expert who ensures this stack cannot be subverted.

You will:

  • Design, build, and operate mobile device attestation and integrity verification systems across Android and iOS including hardware-backed key attestation (Android KeyStore TEE/StrongBox, Apple App Attest/Secure Enclave), ensuring requests originate from genuine, untampered devices running unmodified app code.

  • Engineer anti-tampering, anti-hooking, and runtime integrity protections for the World App, making the app resilient against reverse engineering, instrumentation frameworks (Frida, Xposed), and repackaging attacks.

  • Own the mobile hardening strategy end-to-end: certificate pinning, secure storage, obfuscation, jailbreak/root detection, debugger detection, and screen capture protection deciding which protections to build in-house and which to source from vendors.

  • Design cryptographic protocols for on-device biometric authentication (Face Auth, selfie verification) that are resistant to replay, relay, and deepfake injection attacks, ensuring the biometric pipeline cannot be manipulated even on a compromised device.

  • Build and maintain the server-side attestation verification infrastructure (our Attestation Gateway) that validates Play Integrity tokens, hardware attestation certificate chains, and Apple App Attest assertions, making trust decisions that gate access to sensitive operations.

  • Lead threat modeling for mobile-specific attack surfaces: biometric bypass, key extraction, device cloning, session hijacking, overlay attacks, accessibility abuse, and automated bot farms using real devices.

  • Embed security into the mobile development lifecycle performing deep code reviews of Android (Kotlin) and iOS (Swift) code, building automated security checks into CI/CD, and establishing secure coding standards for mobile teams.

  • Mature our vulnerability management process for mobile, from triaging mobile-specific bug bounty submissions to driving remediation with mobile engineering teams.

  • Evaluate, integrate, and manage mobile security tooling and vendor relationships (RASP, SAST for mobile, binary analysis tools).

About You

You are a deeply technical mobile security engineer who has spent years protecting high-value mobile applications against sophisticated adversaries. You have a builder's mindset; you don't just find problems, you ship solutions. You've been responsible for the security of mobile apps where the stakes are real: payments, identity, or financial services at scale.

Required:

  • 8+ years of hands-on experience in mobile security engineering, with deep expertise in at least one of Android or iOS (strong in both is ideal).

  • Proven experience designing and operating mobile device attestation systems you understand Android Hardware Key Attestation (KeyMint, TEE, StrongBox, attestation certificate chains, Google root CA verification), Google Play Integrity API (Classic and Standard modes), and/or Apple App Attest (DeviceCheck, attestation/assertion flows, Secure Enclave) at a systems level, not just as an API consumer.

  • Strong background in mobile application hardening: you have implemented or evaluated anti-tampering, anti-hooking, root/jailbreak detection, debugger detection, certificate pinning, and runtime integrity protection in production apps.

  • Experience with mobile reverse engineering and offensive security: you can decompile APKs (jadx, apktool), analyze iOS binaries, use Frida/Objection for dynamic analysis, and think like an attacker to validate your defenses.

  • Proficiency in Kotlin/Java (Android) and/or Swift (iOS) for security-focused code review and building security libraries.

  • Experience securing on-device cryptographic operations: key generation, secure storage (Android KeyStore, iOS Keychain), and protocols that depend on hardware-backed keys.

  • Strong understanding of mobile-specific attack vectors: overlay attacks, accessibility service abuse, screen recording, deepfake injection into camera pipelines, biometric bypass, and app cloning.

Nice to have:

  • Experience building or operating server-side attestation verification services (decrypting Play Integrity JWE/JWS tokens, validating X.509 attestation certificate chains, managing Apple App Attest key lifecycle in a backend).

  • Experience with RASP vendor evaluation and integration (Zimperium, Guardsquare/DexGuard, Promon, Appdome).

  • Background in payment security or PCI-compliant mobile applications (SoftPOS, Tap-to-Pay, EMV).

  • Familiarity with privacy-preserving systems: zero-knowledge proofs, on-device biometric processing, or differential privacy.

  • Experience scaling a Secure SDLC or security champions program for mobile engineering teams.

  • Contributions to mobile security research, conference talks, or open-source security tooling.

  • Rust, Go, or Python experience for backend security tooling and infrastructure.

What we offer

The reasonably estimated salary for this role at Tools for Humanity ranges from $251,000 - $325,000 plus a competitive long-term incentive package. Actual compensation is based on factors such as the candidate's skills, qualifications, and experience. In addition, Tools for Humanity offers a wide range of best-in-class, comprehensive, and inclusive employee benefits for this role, including healthcare, dental, vision, 401(k) plan and match, life insurance, flexible time off, commuter benefits, professional development stipend, and much more.

By submitting your application, you consent to the processing and internal sharing of your CV within the company, in compliance with the GDPR.

If you don't think you meet all of the criteria but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box, and we're looking for someone excited to join the team.

title: Staff UX Motion Designer - MetaMask

description:

Consensys is the leading blockchain and web3 software company. Founded by Joe Lubin, CEO of Consensys and Co-Founder of Ethereum in 2014, Consensys has been at the forefront of innovation, pioneering technological developments within the web3 ecosystem.

The financial system is being rebuilt on open, programmable infrastructure, and Consensys is helping power that transition. From MetaMask, the platform trusted by tens of millions of users worldwide, to Linea, the only 100% proven zkEVM rollup and an emerging home for institutional ETH capital, Consensys builds products and infrastructure that enable users, developers, and institutions to participate in the next generation of the internet.

Our mission is to unlock the collaborative power of communities by making the decentralized web universally easy to access, use, and build on.

Joining Consensys means working with a fully remote, globally distributed team of technologists, designers, cryptographers, product thinkers, and researchers who are building the next layer of the internet. You'll be exposed to new ideas, emerging technologies, and complex challenges that push you to stay at the top of your game while helping scale products and infrastructure used by tens of millions of users and thousands of developers across the web3 ecosystem. You'll join a network of builders that reaches the edge of our ecosystem. Consensys alumni have moved on to become tech entrepreneurs, CEOs, and team leads at tech companies.

About the Design Team

MetaMask's design team aims to establish MetaMask as the premier wallet in fintech, elevating the craft of design and leading the industry as the next phase of decentralized finance unfolds. Our goal is to reduce friction while preserving user trust, so more people can safely explore the world of Web3.

What you’ll do

MetaMask is used by millions of people as their gateway to web3. As the product grows, so does the need for experiences that feel clear, responsive, and human. Motion plays a big role in that.

We’re looking for a Staff Motion Designer to join our Design Systems team. In this role, you’ll shape how motion shows up across MetaMask—from small interaction details to larger moments of expression. A core part of the work is defining a shared motion language and building systems that help teams use it consistently across the product.

This role sits within the design system, but it’s not just about documentation. You’ll be making things—prototyping, exploring, refining—and working closely with designers and engineers to bring motion into the product in a way that scales.

What you’ll work on

  • Use motion to make the product easier to understand—helping people see what’s happening, what changed, and what to do next
  • Define a clear, shared motion language for MetaMask—how things move, respond, and feel across surfaces
  • Build patterns, guidelines, and reusable assets that allow motion to scale across teams and platforms
  • Introduce moments of delight where they add value, without getting in the way
  • Partner with product designers and engineers to bring motion into the product in a way that feels natural and performs well
  • Use prototypes to explore and communicate interaction ideas
  • Contribute to the overall level of craft across the team through feedback and collaboration

Would be great if you brought this to the role

  • You’ve spent 6+ years working with motion in digital products, using animation and interaction to make complex experiences easier to understand
  • You define motion languages and patterns that create consistency across screens, features, and platforms
  • You build scalable systems—guidelines, reusable assets, or components—that help teams apply motion without starting from scratch
  • You work closely with engineers to bring motion into production in ways that feel smooth, perform well, and hold up across platforms
  • You use prototyping to explore and communicate ideas, helping teams align on how things should move and respond
  • You balance clarity and delight, knowing when motion helps guide someone and when it might get in the way
  • You raise the bar for craft, through feedback, collaboration, and hands-on contribution

Don't meet all the requirements? Don't sweat it. We’re passionate about building a diverse team of humans and as such, if you think you've got what it takes for our chaotic-but-fun, remote-friendly, start-up environment—apply anyway, detailing your relevant transferable skills in your cover letter. While we have a pretty good idea of what we need, we're ready for you to challenge our thinking on who needs to be in this role.

It is a requirement of employment in this position that applicants will be required to submit to background checks including but not limited to employment, education and criminal record checks. Further details will be provided to applicants that successfully meet the criteria for the position as determined by the company in its sole discretion. By submitting an application for employment, you are acknowledging and consenting to this requirement.

The salary range listed for this role applies to US-based candidates only. Compensation for candidates based outside the US (including Canada, EMEA, and LATAM) will be determined based on location, experience, and skills during the interview process, and may differ from the listed US range.

US pay range (not including bonus, equity or other benefits)
$146,000—$218,000 USD

In the rapidly evolving Web3 space, we believe that everyone is a builder. This expansive paradigm requires a range of backgrounds, talents, skills, and experiences to influence and shape the future. At Consensys, this diversity fuels our ability to shift control and redefine the realm of possibility. title: Sr. Associate, Corporate Development
description:
At Offchain Labs, we aren’t just building products: we’re leading a movement. 
 
As pioneers in blockchain scalability and security, we're at the forefront of transforming how the world interacts with decentralized applications. We're laying the foundation that will define the next generation of digital commerce, governance, and human interaction. This involves tackling real-world challenges that come with scaling blockchain technology, without compromising on its core principles: decentralization, security and transparency. 
 
At the center of this vision is our people. Our team is made up of thinkers and doers that embrace new challenges and seek solutions that push existing boundaries. If you’re energized by solving unprecedented problems, and believe in the role that decentralized systems will play in creating a more equitable digital future, then we want to hear from you. 
 
Why Offchain Labs?
 
Offchain Labs is setting the pace for the entire Ethereum ecosystem. We built the Arbitrum stack that powers Arbitrum One, the most widely adopted Ethereum scaling solution that exists today.
 
Arbitrum’s ecosystem is undergoing tremendous growth with hundreds of projects and dApps on Arbitrum One today. Over 100 different teams have used Offchain Labs technology to build their own Arbitrum chains. Major players in the space, Robinhood, BlackRock, Ethena Labs, Securitize, Aave, and Apechain are all using the Arbitrum stack.
 
Arbitrum’s thriving ecosystem wouldn’t exist without our advanced technology stack. Arbitrum, Prysm, ZeroDev. These aren’t just product names. These are tools that are actively reshaping what's possible on Ethereum and advancing its core infrastructure.
 
To top it all off? We’re backed by $124 million in funding. We’ve demonstrated consistent execution with billions in secured value, thousands of supported projects, and infrastructure processing millions of transactions seamlessly.

What is the role:

    As the Corporate Development Sr. Associate at Offchain Labs, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the future of blockchain technology by identifying, acquiring, and building blockchain solutions at scale. This role requires a strategic thinker with a hands-on approach to identifying opportunities, evaluating them, and executing transactions that align with Offchain Labs' vision for decentralized infrastructure.

What you'll do:

  • Support M&A and strategic investment activity end to end - screen and evaluate targets, lead market and operating diligence across engineering, product, legal, and finance, build valuation models, write investment memos, and support leadership on deal structuring and negotiation.

  • Own post-merger integration planning and execution - define the integration thesis prior to signing, build the integration plan, and drive the workstreams required to realize deal objectives.

  • Support in fundraising preparedness - maintain diligence-ready materials, data rooms, financial models, and KPI reporting, and manage process timelines and open items during live processes.

  • Develop strategic business cases for new opportunities, including market and competitive analysis, target segments and use cases, deal or partnership economics, and execution roadmap.

  • Be a strategic thinker to the leadership team - bring an informed external view on competitors, market structure, and emerging models into strategic planning, and translate it into clear recommendations.

  • Drive internal strategy communications - synthesize company priorities into clear strategy memos, and support planning and execution tracking against the agreed strategy.

  • Establish scalable processes and develop strategies that enhance Offchain Labs' corporate development capabilities, keeping pace with the rapidly evolving blockchain industry.

  • Build relationships with blockchain founders, and industry leaders while maintaining a robust organic pipeline of opportunities.

What you’ll need:

  • 4–6 years of experience in investment banking, private equity, venture capital, management consulting, or a corporate development or strategic finance function.

  • Direct involvement in at least one M&A or fundraise process from start to close, with real ownership of workstreams rather than adjacent exposure.

  • Genuine fluency in crypto, with crypto-native work experience strongly preferred.

  • Strong financial modeling and market sizing skills, including in segments where public data is limited or inconsistent.

  • Exceptional written and visual communication. You can build an executive-ready deck without hand-holding and write clearly for both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Comfort with ambiguity and a high degree of ownership - small team, wide surface area, and constant movement between long-range strategy work and next-day turnarounds.

  • Bachelor's degree.

Perks:

  • Remote-first global workforce + NY office
  • Professional reimbursement program (facilitates industry conference attendance, certifications, and more)
  • Medical, dental & vision coverage (US + some other countries)
  • 401k retirement plan + company match (US only)
  • Wellness stipend
  • Home office set up / ergonomic equipment program
Attention Offchain Job Seekers:
 
This role cannot be performed in California, or Colorado.
 
Please be advised that there has been a rise in fraudulent recruiter activities, particularly within the Web3 space. If you would like to confirm whether someone is an Offchain employee or the legitimacy of an offer you received, please email jobs@offchainlabs.com
 
At Offchain, we are committed to building a welcoming and supportive workplace for all employees, regardless of their background or identity. We strive to create an environment where everyone feels valued and has an equal opportunity to succeed and thrive. We encourage candidates from all walks of life to apply and join our team.

title: Office Manager
description:
BitGo is the leading infrastructure provider of digital asset solutions, delivering custody, wallets, staking, trading, financing, and settlement services from regulated cold storage. Since our founding in 2013, we have focused on enabling our clients to securely navigate the digital asset space. With a global presence and multiple Trust companies, BitGo serves thousands of institutions, including many of the industry's top brands, exchanges, and platforms, and millions of retail investors worldwide. As the operational backbone of the digital economy, BitGo handles a significant portion of Bitcoin network transactions and is the largest independent digital asset custodian, and staking provider, in the world. For more information, visit www.bitgo.com.

We are seeking an energetic and personable individual to spearhead our New York office operations!

Responsibilities:

  • Manage all administrative and general office needs at our New York office.
  • Oversee the successful management of local vendors and contractors
  • Be the primary contact between the company and building management making sure all facility needs are met
  • Work with Executive Assistant on event planning including regular social events, external events, Holiday parties and offsite retreats in partnership with Internal Events Team
  • Work closely with our HR/People Operations team on local Perks and Benefits programs
  • Greet visitors and providing a warm and pleasant experience
  • Ensure we remain compliant with workplace safety expectations
  • Work closely with our Legal team to assess risks and make informed decisions about Employee Health & Safety
  • Issue key cards for new employees and visitor passes to ensure secure access to the office.
  • Promote a positive office culture by actively encouraging team members to return to the office, fostering engagement and collaboration among staff.

Requirements:

  • You have 3+ years of relevant Operations and Facilities experience
  • Experience with facilities operations, including coordinating office moves.
  • You are an empathetic leader with 2+ years of people management experience
  • Well versed in workplace systems, tools & platforms
  • Have experience working with property management teams
  • Have experience being on call and have managed through emergency situations
  • You have strong customer service and hospitality skills
  • You have strong project management skills
  • You are able to work autonomously, but understand the importance of teamwork
  • You are comfortable communicating with and driving decisions alongside our leadership team
  • You are innovative - you’re looking to create tomorrow and constantly open to new ideas and technologies
  • You are excited to create a world class Workplace Experience!

Why Join BitGo?

Disrupting an industry takes vision, innovation, passion, technical chops, drive to deliver, collaboration, and execution. Join a team of great people who strive for excellence and personify our corporate values of ownership, craftsmanship, and open communication. We are looking for new colleagues who bring innovative ways of thinking and problem solving, and who want risks to be part of the team that changes the world’s financial markets.

Here are some of the benefits* of working at BitGo:

  • Competitive base salary, bonus and stock options
  • 100% company paid health insurance for employee, partner and dependents
  • 401k company match
  • Paid parental leave, paid vacation
  • Free custom lunches, dinners and snacks 
  • Computer equipment and workplace furniture to suit your needs
  • Great colleagues and inspiring startup environment
  • Benefits vary based on location

Cryptocurrencies are the most disruptive change the financial services industry has seen in years. Join us and you’ll be able to look back and say you were part of the team that transformed investing.

Pay Transparency Notice: Depending upon your leveling and location, the compensation for this role averages between $85000- $100,000 USD base salary. Equity, an annual performance bonus and the benefits outlined above are also a part of this role's package.

title: Security Architect
description:
The CoinDCX Journey: Building the Future of Finance:

At CoinDCX, our mission is clear - to make crypto and blockchain accessible
to every Indian and enable them to participate in the future of finance.

As India’s first crypto unicorn valued at $2.45B, we are reshaping the
financial ecosystem by building safe, transparent, and scalable products that
power adoption at scale.

We believe that change starts together. It begins with bold ideas, relentless
execution and people who want to build what’s next.

If you’re driven by purpose and thrive in environments where your work
defines the next chapter of an industry, you’ll feel right at home here.


You’ll Excel in This Role If You:


* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related
technical field.
* 12+ years of experience in Information Security and supporting technologies
*  7+ years designing enterprise IAM architectures.
*  Experience building IAM programs from strategy through implementation.
*  Strong experience in cloud-native environments and identity governance. 
*  Preferred certifications, such as CEH, CISSP,  CCSP or IAM/vendor-specific
certifications such as SailPoint, Saviynt, Okta, CyberArk, AWS or equivalent.
* Strong understanding of Identity and Access Management (IAM) concepts,
including authentication, authorization, identity lifecycle, federation, and
access governance.
* Experience designing and delivering IAM solutions across cloud, SaaS, and
enterprise environments.
* Good understanding of IAM standards and technologies such as SSO, MFA,
SAML, OAuth/OIDC, SCIM, RBAC, and directory services.
* Experience with identity lifecycle management, access governance,
privileged access, and periodic access reviews.
* Exposure to cloud, application, API, machine, and other non-human identity
use cases is desirable.
* Familiarity with leading IAM, IGA, or PAM platforms and experience
participating in technology evaluation, PoCs, or implementations.
* Ability to translate business and security requirements into practical,
scalable IAM solutions.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to
work effectively with both technical and business teams.
* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to manage
multiple priorities and drive initiatives in a fast-paced environment.


What You’ll Do:

As a Software engineer in our team, you'll be working with a lot of
cross-functional partners like Product, Engineering, Security, and Marketing
all the while delivering critical solutions and experiences. You will be
responsible for below tasks:


* IAM Strategy & Architecture: Align and operate enterprise IAM strategy,
target architecture, and operating model inline with  business, security, and
cloud-first objectives.
* Identity Governance & Lifecycle: Run operational processes to maintain
end-to-end identity lifecycle processes covering Joiner-Mover-Leaver (JML),
access requests and approvals, provisioning/deprovisioning, RBAC, role
management, and periodic access reviews.
* Authentication & Access Management: Ensure alignment of operations with
SSO, MFA, Conditional Access, federation, and secure access patterns across
SaaS applications, cloud platforms, and enterprise systems.
* Non-Human & Machine Identities: Govern service accounts, workload
identities, API credentials, automation identities, machine-to-machine access,
and emerging AI/agentic identities.
* Privileged Access Management: Secure operations and monitoring covering
privileged identities, JIT/JEA access, credential management, session controls,
privileged access monitoring, and integration with enterprise PAM solutions.
* Cloud & Endpoint Identity: Design identity solutions across the
organization's cloud and end user environment.
* Technology Evaluation & Implementation: Lead IAM requirements, RFI/RFP,
vendor evaluations, PoCs, technology selection, and implementation planning,
while assessing the evolution of the current JumpCloud-based environment.
* IAM Standards & Governance: Establish IAM policies, standards, reference
architectures, integration patterns, operational processes, and
identity/application ownership models.
* Stakeholder & Compliance Management: Partner with Security, Infrastructure,
Cloud, DevOps, HR, Engineering, Compliance, and Application teams to drive
secure IAM operations.


﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿Perks That Empower You

Our benefits are designed to make a lasting impact on your life, giving you
the freedom to create a work-life balance that truly suits you.﻿﻿


* Design Your Own Benefit: Tailor your perk package to fit your unique needs.
Whether you’re eyeing a new gadget or welcoming a furry friend into your life,
our flexible benefits ensure that you can prioritize what matters most to you.
* Unlimited Wellness Leaves: We believe in the power of well-being. Take the
time you need to recharge, knowing that your health is our priority. With
unlimited wellness leaves, you can return refreshed, ready to build and grow.
* Mental Wellness Support: Your mental health is as important as your
professional growth. Benefit from access to health experts, free counseling
sessions, monthly wellness workshops, and regular team outings, all designed to
help you stay balanced and connected.
* Bi-Weekly Learning Sessions: These sessions are more than just
updates—they’re opportunities to fuel your growth. Stay ahead with the latest
industry knowledge, sharpen your skills, and accelerate your career in an
ever-evolving landscape.

title: Associate Director - Finance
description:
Associate Director – Finance

Location: Mumbai

Team: Finance


About CoinDCX:

At CoinDCX, we are on a mission to lead the change towards a decentralised
world, and we believe our employees are at the heart of it.

Our journey over the past five years has been exhilarating as we have made
significant strides - from becoming a unicorn to being a compliant exchange,
onboarding over 15 million users, to launching an innovative self-custodial
DeFi app called Okto. We are backed by investors such as Pantera, B Capital
Group, Bain Capital Ventures, and Coinbase Ventures, among others.

Building on this momentum, our focus now is on developing cutting-edge
products, addressing accessibility and security challenges, and bridging the
gap between people and Web3 technologies.

Join us at CoinDCX, where CHANGE STARTS TOGETHER, and be part of an exciting
journey to shape the future of the Web3 space. We offer a dynamic and inclusive
work environment, ample opportunities for professional growth, and the chance
to make a meaningful impact in the crypto and Web3 ecosystem.

The Web 3 space is still new and we’re just getting started!


Inside CoinDCX's Finance Team

Bring your unique finance skills into play and help drive our efforts to
innovate and expand the VDA, web3 and blockchain space. As part of our finance
team, you will be responsible for maintaining the financial records of the
firm, regulating cash flow across all departments, handling overseas accounts
while at the same time maintaining focus on Indian clients.

If you’re familiar with financial coding and GST & RBI regulations in
relation to cryptocurrency, you are exactly who we’re looking for!

With 2+ crore Indians trusting us, our ultimate goal is to make VDA
accessible to every Indian and we’re looking for equally talented VDA and web3
enthusiasts to join us in our journey to bring in this change together. Coin
your trust in us as we create magic together!


Who you are:

Even if you don’t know everything about VDA, you love to learn and solve for
it

You take ownership and have a thirst for excellence

You have a result oriented and impact driven mindset

You grow while helping others grow with you

You have an attention to detail and passion for quality

You thrive on change

You’re passionate about everything VDA and Web3.0

You love exploring new ideas to build something useful

You are always curious to learn more


Role Summary

We are looking for an experienced Associate Director – Finance to strengthen
and scale the finance function of a fast-growing, technology-led Web3 and VDA
business.

This is a critical finance leadership role with responsibility across
financial consolidation and reporting, reconciliations, controllership,
treasury and accounts payable, internal controls and finance transformation.
The role will partner closely with the Head of Finance and senior leadership to
strengthen governance, improve reporting quality and build scalable finance
processes.


Key Responsibilities


1) Financial Consolidation & Reporting

Lead the month-end and year-end close, group consolidation and financial
reporting across multiple entities.

Drive intercompany reconciliations, eliminations, consolidation adjustments
and standardisation of accounting and reporting practices.

Oversee critical reconciliations across intercompany balances, VDA/crypto
assets, INR/fiat balances, banks, customer assets and liabilities, exchanges
and other key accounts.

Ensure timely identification, investigation and resolution of reconciliation
breaks, aged items and reporting differences.

Drive automation and process improvements to enable faster closes and
stronger financial insights.


2) Treasury & Accounts Payable Management

Oversee cash and liquidity management, banking operations, fund movements and
payment governance.

Strengthen accounts payable, vendor payments, ageing and payment controls.

Improve cash visibility, forecasting, automation and efficiency across
treasury and payment processes.

Build strong ownership, review mechanisms and controls across treasury and AP
operations.


3) Internal Controls & Finance Process Transformation

Strengthen ICFR, internal controls and governance across key finance
processes.

Identify control gaps, operational risks and process inefficiencies and drive
sustainable remediation.

Drive automation and standardisation across finance systems, reconciliations
and operational processes.

Partner with Technology, Data and business teams on ERP optimisation and
finance transformation initiatives.

Support internal and external audits and ensure timely closure of audit
observations.


4) Strategic Finance & IPO Readiness

Support strategic initiatives including fundraising, M&A, financial due
diligence and new business initiatives.

Partner with senior leadership on complex financial, accounting and business
matters.

Help build finance processes, reporting and governance capabilities aligned
with a larger and more mature organisation.

Exposure to IPO readiness, financial reporting and governance will be an
added advantage.


You'll Excel If You Have


Experience

8–10 years of relevant post-qualification experience in finance,
controllership, accounting, financial reporting or consolidation.

Strong experience in consolidation, financial reporting, reconciliations,
ICFR/internal controls and audit management.

Experience in treasury management and accounts payable oversight will be
preferred.

Experience in a Big 4 and/or high-growth, technology-led or complex business
environment will be an advantage.

Exposure to Fintech, Financial Services, Payments, Crypto/VDA or similar
industries will be preferred.


Education

Chartered Accountant (CA) is mandatory.

An additional MBA or relevant professional qualification will be an advantage.


Systems & Technology

Strong understanding of finance systems, ERP platforms and finance process
automation.

Experience in finance transformation, process improvement or ERP
implementation.

Oracle NetSuite experience will be preferred.

Interest in leveraging automation, analytics and AI to improve finance
processes and controls.


Leadership & Mindset

Strong leadership and people-management capabilities.

Ability to operate both strategically and hands-on in a fast-paced
environment.

Strong analytical, problem-solving and stakeholder management skills.

High ownership, accountability and focus on execution.

A builder mindset with the ability to standardise, scale and continuously
improve finance processes and teams.


You'll Know You're Winning When

Within 12-18 months, you will be expected to:

Strengthen and scale group consolidation, financial reporting and critical
reconciliation processes.

Improve the quality, accuracy and timeliness of financial reporting and
month-end closure.

Build stronger treasury, payment governance and finance controls.

Develop a high-performing finance team with clear ownership and
accountability.

Strengthen finance systems and processes to support the organisation's next
phase of growth.


Hiring Process

Here’s what your journey with us looks like:

Application Review – We assess for skills, alignment, and intent

Recruiter Connect – A short conversation to understand you better

Functional Round(s) – Deep dive into your approach, craft, and problem-solving

Assignment / Simulation Round - Depends on Role

A take-home task or live problem-solving exercise to understand how you think
and execute in real scenarios

Culture & Values Discussion – A conversation to understand our ways of
working and how you thrive best

Founder Conversation (Optional) – For certain roles and senior levels, you
may meet our founders to explore strategic alignment and long-term fit


Where We Work

We believe the best ideas emerge when people build together. Collaboration,
speed and trust come alive when teams share the same space.

With this belief, we operate as a work-from-office organisation. This role is
based out of ourMumbai office, where energy, alignment and innovation move in
real time.


Perks That Empower You

We believe great people deserve great experiences.

Design Your Own Benefits: Flexible perks to match your lifestyle

Unlimited Wellness Leaves: Rest and recharge as you need

Mental Wellness Support: Access to therapy and wellness resources

Learning Sessions: Bi-weekly learning and growth opportunities


Ready to Build What’s Next?

If you’re looking for a role that gives you direct access to high-stakes
decisions, deep impact and a chance to build the future of finance, this is it.

Join CoinDCX and help us make crypto accessible to every Indian, together.

Search is being rewritten in real time. Google is no longer the only front
door – Indians increasingly discover crypto through AI answer engines,
generative search, and app store surfaces before they ever reach a website.
You'll own how millions of them find, trust, and choose CoinDCX across every
one of these surfaces: organic web, the Play Store and App Store, and the
fast-emerging world of AI-driven search (AEO, GEO, and LLM answers).

changing faster than they ever have. You'll set the strategy, build the
systems, and own the programmatic infrastructure that keep us visible and
authoritative as search fragments across traditional engines, app stores, and
large language models.


What You'll Do


* Own end-to-end SEO strategy across technical, on-page, off-page, and
programmatic – driving qualified organic traffic, rankings, and conversions at
scale.
* Lead App Store Optimization (ASO) across the Play Store and App Store –
metadata, creatives, keyword rankings, ratings, and A/B experiments that grow
installs and install-to-activation.

(featured snippets, People Also Ask, voice), GEO (Perplexity, ChatGPT Search,
Gemini, AI Overviews), and LLM citations so we are the source AI models quote
on crypto.

scale content and structured data across thousands of high-intent pages.
* Partner cross-functionally with Product, Tech, Design, and Analytics to
ship SEO-first site architecture, schema, Core Web Vitals, and clean analytics
instrumentation.

tracking across organic, app store, and AI-surface visibility.

driving organic growth at scale.

retrieve, rank, and cite content.

Core Web Vitals, and log-file analysis.

senior stakeholders.

ambiguous, fast-shifting landscape.

You'll Know You're Winning When

qualified traffic, installs, and activation.

* Documentation & Reporting: Maintain immaculate records of all actions
taken, correspondence received, and final resolutions in compliance matters.

senior legal and operational stakeholders.

teams, including Compliance, Customer Operations, and Finance, to gather

especially when dealing with legal documentation and sensitive customer data.

About the Role:

This isn’t a typical Market Risk role.

This role is suited for a hands-on risk professional who can independently
execute BAU monitoring, build practical dashboards and controls, analyse market
events, and escalate issues with clarity across spot, derivatives, and
custody-linked exposures. You will work closely with the Manager and
cross-functional teams to strengthen risk measurement, liquidation and margin
monitoring, liquidity and slippage views, governance processes, and day-to-day
risk actions.


What You’ll Do:

1) Risk Measurement & Monitoring (BAU)

Build, maintain, and run core risk views such as VaR (1-day/10-day), stress
tests, scenario loss, and drawdown / regime indicators for key exposures
including spot, perps / futures, and funding or basis-linked positions.

Monitor volatility, correlations, concentration, and tail-risk indicators on
a daily basis; identify changes in risk posture and escalate material
observations in a timely manner.

Prepare daily and periodic risk summaries with clear commentary, exceptions,
and recommended follow-ups.

2) Limits, Appetite & Governance Support

Support the implementation and ongoing monitoring of risk limits across
notional, leverage, concentration, liquidity / slippage, and basis or funding
exposures.

Track breaches, exceptions, and threshold movements; maintain escalation
logs, decision records, and supporting governance documentation.

Assist in drafting and maintaining runbooks, SOPs, and risk dashboards so
that BAU processes remain consistent, auditable, and scalable.

3) Derivatives & Liquidation Risk Controls

Monitor margin and liquidation risk across derivatives books, including mark
vs LTP behaviour, index / mark quality, liquidation outcomes, and tail-day
stress performance.

Build and track metrics such as distance-to-liquidation (DTL), effective
leverage, margin utilisation, and early-warning indicators at user, token, or
portfolio level where relevant.

Partner with Product, Operations, and Engineering teams to improve practical
guardrails such as risk checks, throttles, alerting logic, and reduce-only or
similar protective actions.

4) Liquidity & Slippage Risk

Build and maintain liquidity risk views covering order book depth, spreads,
market impact, slippage, and exit capacity under normal and stressed conditions.

Support stress liquidation cost analysis and time-to-exit estimation across
key tokens, books, and liquidity regimes.

Highlight thin-liquidity, concentration, and execution-risk hotspots that
may require tighter controls or closer monitoring.

5) Risk Support & Cross-Functional Analysis

Support analysis of venue constraints, hedgeability, pricing frictions, and
operational limitations that can affect market risk outcomes.

Contribute to exposure monitoring across related areas such as stablecoin /
INR conversion impacts, treasury-linked positions, or exchange-specific market
structure issues where relevant.

Work with stakeholders across Risk, Treasury, Product, Trade Ops, and
Analytics to improve data quality, monitoring coverage, and response readiness.

6) Controls, Incidents & Post-Mortems

Participate in incident reviews for market events, liquidation anomalies,
pricing deviations, or control breakdowns; produce clear root-cause and impact
analysis.

Maintain thresholds, control inventories, SOPs, and tracker-based follow-ups
so that risk actions are implemented and closed out properly.

Recommend practical process improvements that help move quick tactical
monitoring into stronger BAU governance over time.


You’ll Excel in This Role If You:

1–2 years of experience in market risk, trading risk, treasury risk,
derivatives risk, or similar roles in a crypto exchange, broker, prop
environment, market maker, or related trading business.

Good understanding of derivatives mechanics, including margining,
liquidation flows, funding rates, basis behaviour, and risk transmission during
stressed markets.

Strong market microstructure intuition, including order book behaviour,
spreads, impact, mark vs LTP dynamics, manipulation or wick risk, and
thin-liquidity conditions.

Hands-on comfort with risk analytics such as historical VaR, stress /
scenario testing, drawdowns, and regime-based monitoring.

Strong Excel / Google Sheets skills; working knowledge of SQL preferred;
familiarity with dashboarding, data handling, or light automation is desirable.

Ability to communicate risk observations clearly, maintain structured
documentation, and work effectively in a fast-moving operating environment.


You’ll Know You’re Winning When:


* Your risk frameworks directly guide trading and product decisions, keeping
the platform within strong risk boundaries.
* You establish a trusted, real-time “source of truth” for risk across spot
and derivatives.
* You anticipate market risks early and convert them into clear actions,
thresholds, and playbooks.
* You elevate overall risk maturity, enabling teams to better understand and
manage market volatility.

truth" at scale, moving beyond mere reporting to drive high-stakes innovation

digital finance.

implementing and independently overseeing the regulatory compliance framework
for the Company’s Broker-Dealer and Introducing Broker operations in GIFT IFSC.
The CO will monitor adherence to applicable IFSCA regulations, circulars,
directions and other regulatory requirements and provide independent compliance
advice, monitoring and challenge to the business.

You need to be a HODLer of these


* A professional qualification or postgraduate degree/postgraduate diploma of
at least one year in Finance, Law, Accountancy, Business Management, Commerce,
Economics, Capital Markets, Banking, Insurance, Actuarial Science, FinTech,
Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics; or CFA / FRM; or such other
relevant qualification as may be specified by IFSCA. Provided that minimum two
years of experience in the financial services market. Experience in another
field may be considered with at least two years of work experience in a
compliance-related role or function.

of work experience in the financial services market, in accordance with
applicable IFSCA requirements.
* A recognised Bachelor of Laws (LL.B.) are also specifically eligible
* Relevant experience in capital markets compliance, securities/brokerage
regulation, regulatory compliance, AML/CFT or financial-services compliance is
preferred.
* Strong understanding of IFSCA regulations, Broker-Dealer requirements,
regulatory reporting, client protection and compliance-monitoring frameworks.
* Strong regulatory interpretation, analytical, monitoring and documentation
skills.
* Ability to exercise independent judgement, challenge and escalation on
regulatory and compliance matters.
* Strong stakeholder-management skills, including interaction with
regulators, exchanges, auditors and senior management.
* High standards of integrity, independence and regulatory judgement.
* Must be based out of the IFSC, as required under applicable IFSCA
regulations.
* Must complete certification course "Regulatory Framework for Capital Market
Intermediaries in IFSC (ICSI)" as prescribed by IFSCA.


You will be mining through these tasks


* Establish, implement and maintain an effective regulatory compliance
framework for the Broker-Dealer and Introducing Broker activities and monitor
ongoing compliance with the IFSCA (Capital Market Intermediaries) Regulations,
applicable Broker-Dealer requirements, exchange requirements and circulars and
directions.

INX/ NSE IX) and other relevant authorities on compliance-related matters, as
applicable.

timely completion of regulatory filings, returns, disclosures, certifications
and other periodic obligations.

products, processes, policies and control framework and ensure relevant
policies, procedures and SOPs are updated accordingly.

onboarding, KYC/CDD, AML/CFT, sanctions screening, transaction monitoring and
record keeping, in coordination with designated AML personnel and relevant
operational teams.

prudential requirements, in coordination with Finance and Compliance.

adherence to regulatory requirements and internal policies and escalate
regulatory breaches or material compliance risks, and track corrective actions
to closure.

products, material process changes, client journeys and third-party
arrangements prior to implementation.

securities/assets, segregation, conflicts of interest, investor protection and
conduct of business, wherever applicable.

product and technology teams.

description:

This isn't a typical analyst role. Corporate Development sits at the

that is rapidly evolving, with limited or no precedent for what we are
attempting to build. That makes strategy all the more essential. Imagine
sitting in this function in the late 1990s at the companies that were defining
what the internet would become — mapping an emerging landscape, forming sharp
theses, and placing bets that compound for a decade.

That is the seat you'll occupy here, you will help set company strategy,

ecosystem, and drive acquisition and integration work that accelerates our
roadmap — working shoulder-to-shoulder with founders and senior leadership.


What You'll Do

differentiatedinvestment theses; translate them into periodic internal and

opportunities & build the pipeline

global blockchain ecosystem.

opportunities aligned to our theses.3. Run diligence & evaluate opportunities

competitive analysis, metrics analysis, customer/user reviews, and technical
diligence — separating signal from hype and forming a clear, defensible view.4.
Build ecosystem relationships

founders, influencers, marketing / PR / developer partners, and fellow
investors — to build both proprietary deal flow and credibility.5. Drive

surface where support is needed.6. Execute M&A & integration

opportunities through M&A, align stakeholders on potential acquisitions, and
closely handhold post-merger integration to ensure value is actually realised.

there is no playbook.

have a strong analytical and financial rigour, and can pressure-test a thesis,

heading — and can go deep, fast.

founders and investors alike.

rapid pivots.

ecosystem.

or hands-on exposure to the crypto or fintech ecosystem.


You'll Know You're Winning When


* You've built a live, continuously refreshed pipeline of investment
opportunities mapped to clear theses.
* You've published research and investment theses that shape how leadership —
and the wider ecosystem — think about where the market is heading.
* You've run diligence on multiple opportunities and driven at least one deal
or acquisition materially forward.

title: Talent Operations Executive
description:
Talent Operations Executive

millions of users. Our people are at the heart of everything we do, and our
Talent Acquisition team plays a critical role in bringing exceptional talent
into the organisation while delivering a seamless candidate experience.


Role Summary


We are looking for a detail-oriented and highly organized Talent Operations &
Pre-Onboarding Specialist to manage end-to-end recruitment operations,
candidate pre-onboarding, and interview coordination.

This role is critical in ensuring a seamless candidate experience from
application to Day 1, while maintaining strong governance, data accuracy, and
stakeholder communication.


Key Responsibilities


1) Application & Candidate Screening Operations


* Own and manage the Apply Mailbox, ensuring 100% review of all incoming
applications.
* Conduct initial due diligence to assess candidate relevance.
* Share suitable profiles with recruiters or move them into the talent pool
with proper tagging and documentation.
* Ensure no candidate application is missed or left unattended.


2) Interview Coordination & Tracking


* Coordinate and schedule all interviews across roles and panels.
* Ensure daily tracking of all interviews scheduled.
* Best practice:
* Review the interview schedule every morning.
* Send gentle reminders to candidates and panelists with time, role name, and
interview details.
* If an interview does not take place, proactively reschedule based on
candidate and panelist availability.
* Share a daily interview summary sheet (next day) capturing:
* Candidate name
* Role
* Interview stage
* Panelist feedback
* Current status
* Follow up with panelists if feedback is not shared within defined timelines.


3) Pre-Onboarding & Joining Confidence Management (JCS)

* Own the entire pre-onboarding process for all offered candidates.
* Track candidates marked as "Offered" on TA-MIS and ensure accurate data
transfer to:
* Post offer connects Sheet
* Connects Date sub-sheet
* Conduct Joining Confidence Scoring using pre-scripted questions.
* Flag candidates immediately if:
* Joining Confidence Score drops below 100
* Escalate to Recruiter & relevant stakeholder
* Maintain real-time status and accuracy across all tracking sheets.


4) Stakeholder Connects & Candidate Engagement

* Coordinate connects with:
* Hiring Manager (HM)
* Head of Department (HOD)
* HRBP
* Schedule calls and, where required, coordinate office visits / office tours.
* Ensure high-touch engagement to reduce drop-offs and increase joining
confidence.


5) Documentation & Compliance Tracking

* Track and ensure timely submission of all required documents, including:
* Banking details
* PIF
* Other onboarding documentation
* Follow up proactively with candidates for missing or incorrect documents.


6) Asset & Joining Day Readiness

* Raise asset requests via Slack form at least one week prior to the
candidate's joining date.
* One day before joining:
* Connect with candidates to confirm:
* Office address
* Reporting time (9:30 AM on orientation day)
* Support joining-day readiness through:
* Candidate communication
* Coordination with internal teams
* (Future scope) Support joining-day initiatives such as welcome lunch with
team buddy.


You'll Excel If You Have

* 1–4 years of experience in:
* Talent Acquisition Operations
* Recruitment Coordination
* HR Operations or Pre-Onboarding
* Prior experience managing interview logistics and onboarding processes is
preferred.
* Strong attention to detail and follow-through.
* High ownership mindset and accountability.
* Excellent coordination and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple trackers, sheets, and processes without errors.
* Clear written and verbal communication.
* Strong candidate experience orientation.
* Comfortable working with TA-MIS, Google Sheets / Excel, Slack, and calendars
.


Preferred Qualifications

* Experience managing high-volume interview coordination.
* Experience handling candidate pre-onboarding and documentation processes.
* Familiarity with recruitment operations and candidate lifecycle management.
* Exposure to stakeholder coordination across recruiters, hiring managers,
and HR teams.


Technical Skills

* Tools: TA-MIS, Google Sheets / Microsoft Excel, Slack, Google Calendar
* Operations: Interview scheduling, recruitment coordination, pre-onboarding,
documentation tracking
* Coordination: Stakeholder management, candidate engagement, process tracking


What We're Looking For

* Attention to Detail: Strong accuracy across trackers, documentation, and
recruitment operations.
* Ownership: Ability to independently manage multiple processes end-to-end.
* Coordination Skills: Excellent stakeholder management across recruiters,
candidates, hiring managers, and HR teams.
* Communication: Clear written and verbal communication with internal and
external stakeholders.
* Candidate Experience: Passion for creating a seamless candidate journey
from application through joining.
* Organisation: Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining
operational excellence.


You'll Know You're Winning When

* Zero missed applications or interviews.
* High joining confidence and reduced offer drop-offs.
* Accurate, real-time tracking across all sheets and systems.
* Smooth candidate experience from offer to Day 1.
* Strong trust and reliability with recruiters and business stakeholders.


Hiring Process


Here's what your journey with us looks like:

* Application Review – We assess your experience, attention to detail, and
role alignment.
* Recruiter Connect – A conversation to understand your background,
coordination experience, and career aspirations.
* Functional Round(s) – A deep dive into recruitment operations, interview
coordination, stakeholder management, and problem-solving approach.

evaluate process management, prioritisation, and operational excellence.
* Culture & Values Discussion – A conversation to understand how you work,
collaborate, and thrive in a fast-paced environment.
* Founder Conversation (Optional) – For select roles, you may meet our
founders to explore long-term alignment.


Where We Work


We believe the best ideas emerge when people build together. Collaboration,
speed, and trust come alive when teams share the same space.

With this belief, we operate as a work-from-office organisation. This role is
based out of ourBangalore office, where energy, alignment, and innovation move
in real time.

description:
