title: Team Lead - Trading
description:
Who We Are:

Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.

Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. This includes broker-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts.

Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it.

Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.

Our Team Members:

We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!

We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

Your Role:

Your job is to lead the team building Alpaca's algo trading platform to satisfy our users who expect high quality and performance from their brokerage service. You will design and architect our platform by wearing many different hats in a small team. As a Team Lead you will still write code and make critical technical decisions, but you are also accountable for how the team works: what it builds, how it prioritizes, how it grows, and how reliably it ships.

 

This is a hands-on leadership role, not a pure management role. We expect you to stay close to the code and the system, and to spend a meaningful part of your time in the codebase, in design reviews, and on production issues. At the same time you will own the team's roadmap, its delivery, and the development of the engineers on it.

 

The technical bar for this role is the same as our Senior/Staff Software Engineer bar: deep knowledge in both frontend and backend, databases and distributed systems, as well as broad experience from low to high level in CPU-level hardware for high throughput, robust concurrency system design, abstract distributed system architecture for high availability and object-oriented data modeling with long term growth in mind.

 

You must have previous software engineering experience with trading or exchange systems (OMS, EMS, exchanges, market making, algorithmic trading, quant trading), and previous experience leading engineers.

 

What you will own:

 

  • Technical direction and architecture for the team's services, including trade-off decisions and their long term consequences
  • Roadmap and delivery: breaking down ambiguous business goals into scoped, sequenced engineering work and shipping it predictably
  • Day-to-day execution: sprint or cycle planning, unblocking engineers, keeping work in flight visible to stakeholders
  • Code and design quality: setting the standard through reviews, design docs, and your own contributions
  • Production ownership: reliability, latency and correctness targets for the team's systems, on-call health, and incident follow-through
  • People: hiring, onboarding, 1:1s, feedback, performance and career growth for a small team of engineers
  • Cross-team collaboration with product, operations, compliance, clearing and the other engineering teams

 

Requirements:

 

  • Strong, experienced software engineer at a senior or staff level who has led a team, formally or as a tech lead
  • Demonstrated ability to grow engineers: mentoring, feedback, and raising the level of people around you
  • Track record of delivering complex systems on schedule, including scoping, sequencing and cutting the right things
  • Coding skills in both low and high level languages around C/C++, Go, Zig, Rust, Java, Scala, Python
  • Low latency and high throughput optimization
  • Experience with messaging queues and message brokers
  • Analytical data-oriented mindset and skills
  • Knowledge of algorithms, distributed systems, scalability, high availability, databases, low latency systems and concurrency control
  • System design skills with object-oriented data modeling, service-oriented architectures, system abstraction
  • Experience with the development and implementation of Order Management systems (OMS) and Risk Management systems (RMS)
  • Clear written and verbal communication, including with non-engineering stakeholders
  • Comfort operating with ambiguity and limited process, as expected at an early stage startup

Nice to have:

  • Experience hiring and building out an engineering team from a small base
  • Experience owning a production trading or brokerage system as the accountable lead
  • Algo trading experience (either professional or personal)
  • FIX protocol knowledge
  • Experience with observability, tracing, continuous profiling and benchmarking
  • Financial market (exchange, broker-dealers, clearing, etc.) knowledge
  • Experience with financial ledgers
  • Statistical and quantitative analysis skills
  • Experience with major cloud platforms (we primarily use GCP)
  • Experience with Docker and Kubernetes
  • Experience working with distributed, remote-first teams across time zones

How We Take Care of You:

  • Competitive Salary & Stock Options
  • Health Benefits
  • New Hire Home-Office Setup: One-time USD $500
  • Monthly Stipend: USD $150 per month via a Brex Card

Alpaca is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to pursuing and hiring a diverse workforce.

title: Product Operations Specialist | Bill Pay
description:
About Ramp

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

About the Role

As a Product Operations partner for Ramp Bill Pay, you will help build and scale the workflows that enable customers to manage accounts payable with speed, accuracy, and control. You will reduce customer friction across the bill pay lifecycle — from vendor setup and approvals to payments, reconciliation, and exception handling — while shaping product quality through data, customer feedback, and tight partnership with customer-facing internal teams.

Beyond your product vertical, you will also contribute to Product Operations process improvement and product building that allows our Product and Engineering teams to scale. You will use AI tools to improve processes around release management, collecting customer feedback, and enabling internal teams to support our customers and troubleshoot issues.

Our main goal is to reduce customer friction, measured by support tickets per active user and customer NPS.

 

What You'll Do

  • Own the voice-of-customer loop for Bill Pay — systematically capture, analyze, and prioritize feedback from CX, Sales, and direct customer channels

  • Partner with Product, Engineering, and Design to translate customer feedback into actionable product requirements and specs

  • Own launch operations for new Bill Pay features as they move from Alpha to GA

  • Directly ship product improvements (UX fixes and paper cuts) using AI tools — owning your own backlog of customer friction reduction, not just feeding the engineering backlog

  • Use AI to automate processes and build products that enable teams to ship faster while maintaining a high quality bar

  • Build scalable operating systems for release readiness, internal enablement, supportability, and issue escalation across Bill Pay workflows

 

What You Need

  • 3+ years in product operations, product management, or a customer-facing analytical role supporting B2B SaaS; experience with payments, accounts payable, fintech workflows, or financial operations preferred

  • Proficiency using data to size opportunities and analyze adoption, support trends, payment flow performance, and customer friction

  • Ability to translate qualitative feedback into crisp requirements and operational processes

  • Comfort working in ambiguous, technically complex spaces and driving clarity across multiple stakeholders

  • Strong problem solving, prioritization, and communication skills; bias to ship improvements quickly and measure impact

  • Experience using AI tools (e.g., Claude Code) to accelerate your work and directly make product improvements

About Our Teams

  • Spend Management owns our core spend product, including card issuance, reimbursements, and travel & entertainment to control spend

  • Intelligence owns the reporting, savings, and price intelligence products to help companies make better financial decisions

  • Bill Payments owns our invoice management, accounts payable, and B2B payment capabilities

  • Risk owns our underwriting and financial products that determine which businesses to approve and how to manage risk

  • Growth owns onboarding, activation and retention products to help our customers be successful on the Ramp platform

  • Accounting owns creating intelligence in our accounting platform, saving finance teams time and money

  • Mobile owns our mobile app development and mobile strategy

  • Travel owns new capabilities for bookings and expense automation throughout a trip 

For candidates located in NYC or SF, the pay range for this role is $128,000 - $180,000. For candidates located in all other locations, the pay range for this role is $120,000 - $170,000

description:
Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards.

On the trading team, our mission is to build highly intuitive, rapid-execution trading interfaces that make investing accessible and seamless for millions of users. Within our collaborative and high-performing design culture, we value deep craft, transparency, and a relentless focus on user experience. Together, we are investing heavily in design improvements and advanced tooling to support our next phase of product growth.

As a Senior Product Designer, you will be fully accountable for the design strategy and execution of our core equities business line. You will lead the design of our central, longstanding product from initial concept to launch. In this high-visibility individual contributor role, you will collaborate with engineering, product management, and legal teams, communicate transparently with leadership, and help define our long-term product evolution. Your work will directly impact millions of customers, ensuring they have an exceptional experience when trading on Robinhood!

This role is based in our Menlo Park, CA and New York, NY offices, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week. 

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.

What you’ll do

  • Lead and execute the product design strategy, creating cohesive and rapid trading experiences for millions of users.
  • Evaluate and redesign core trading surfaces, such as the order form and ladder chart, to improve interaction speed and simplify complex financial concepts.
  • Collaborate directly with engineering, product management, design leadership, and legal partners to guide projects from initial concept to final production.
  • Utilize and assess AI tools within your design process to optimize workflows and propose novel, user-friendly design solutions.
  • Provide transparent project updates to leadership and help shape the long-term design standards across our broader trading team.

What you bring

  • Proven experience designing complex user interfaces and large, multifaceted products, ideally within financial technology, trading platforms, or complex editing applications.
  • Ability to operate independently, lead projects from zero to one, and deliver results against weekly milestones.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills to coordinate across multiple teams and present design decisions clearly to leadership.
  • A deep focus on interaction craft, with a demonstrated ability to evaluate how multiple product surfaces work together as a cohesive system.
  • Openness to exploring and integrating emerging technologies, including AI tools, to enhance your design and prototyping processes.

What we offer

  • Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career
  • Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching
  • Top Tier benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents
  • Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill-building for every employee, technical or not
  • Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more
  • Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits
  • Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more!
  • Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces.

In addition to the base pay range listed below, this role is also eligible for bonus opportunities + equity + benefits.

Base pay for the successful applicant will depend on a variety of job-related factors, which may include education, training, experience, location, business needs, or market demands. The expected base pay range for this role is based on the location where the work will be performed and is aligned to one of 3 compensation zones. For other locations not listed, compensation can be discussed with your recruiter during the interview process.

Base Pay Range:

Zone 1 (Menlo Park, CA; New York, NY; Bellevue, WA; Washington, DC)
$166,000—$195,000 USD
Zone 2 (Denver, CO; Westlake, TX; Chicago, IL)
$146,000—$172,000 USD

Click here to learn more about our Total Rewards, which vary by region and entity.

If our mission energizes you and you’re ready to build the future of finance, we look forward to seeing your application.

Robinhood provides equal opportunity for all applicants, offers reasonable accommodations upon request, and complies with applicable equal employment and privacy laws. Inclusion is built into how we hire and work—welcoming different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences so everyone can do their best. title: Staff CX Software Engineer
description:
About Digital Asset & the Canton Network

Digital Asset builds the technologies that are reshaping the foundations of financial markets. Our mission is to create the world’s most trusted, privacy-enabled, and interoperable digital infrastructure for global finance.

At the heart of this mission is the Canton Network - the blockchain purpose-built for institutional finance. Uniquely combining privacy, compliance, and scalability, Canton enables real-time, secure settlement across multiple asset classes. Governed by the Canton Foundation with participation from leading financial institutions, it is the proven link between the promise of blockchain and the power of global finance.

Founded in 2014 and headquartered in New York City, with offices in London, Zurich, Budapest, Hong Kong, and Sydney— we are on a mission to transform finance— and that transformation is now playing out rapidly on the Canton Network.

If you’re interested in playing a crucial role at the intersection of traditional and crypto-capital markets and want to help bring the next trillion dollars of finance on-chain, join us.

About the role:

The Staff CX Software Engineer is a role for people that come with prior experience and exposure to distributed computing, Canton Network and our product, including topology and performance considerations. These individuals will stand in front of a client to provide sound advice, and to provide a technical leadership role for the team when working with clients on client solutions. They are comfortable with facing off to executive leadership.

Responsibilities:

  • Provides direction to clients on physical and logical architectures for Canton Network solutions and integration
  • Gives direction on Canton Network topology concerns. 
  • Coordinates and leads planning of complex, cross-functional initiatives
  • Serves as the expert in Canton Network and DA Products 
  • Leverages proficiency in multiple other languages. 
  • Estimates highly complex solutions and systematically decompose complex technical problems to arrive at a solution
  • Defines strategy for a performance test plan: proactively reasons about, identifies, and remediates performance issues in solutions using Canton Network and DA Product components; and prioritizes salient performance concerns of a system
  • Leverages a level of expertise in a subset of Canton Network and DA Products
  • Acts as a subject matter expert for other CX staff
  • Works with and customizes helm charts to enable a client easy onboarding to k8s

What We're Looking For:

  • 8+ years of software engineering experience, including a history of successfully delivering complex systems or integrations.
  • Technical Breadth: Comprehensive understanding of full-cycle technical delivery, from system design and API strategies to cloud architecture and data modeling
  • Has working knowledge of our product and Canton OS source code
  • Delivery Excellence: Ability to establish engineering standards, design reusable components, and unblock delivery teams across multiple workstreams
  • Consultative Mindset: Experience in a consulting or client-facing role; able to translate complex business requirements into scalable technical roadmaps
  • Strong financial services domain knowledge and experience
  • Thrives in a fast-moving environment with multiple competing priorities
  • Curious, pragmatic and adaptable, and able to learn quickly in complex environments

At Digital Asset, we are committed to compensation structures that reward impact consistently across our global teams. We support our people at every stage of life with comprehensive, family-forward benefits and flexible working models designed to help you do your best work.

Benefits We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the well-being of our team members. Health and insurance benefits vary by region to ensure local relevance and compliance, and may include medical, dental, and vision coverage. 

Equal Opportunity Employer Digital Asset is an equal opportunity employer committed. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, sex, religion, sexual orientation, age, disability, citizenship status, veteran status, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

Employment Eligibility If and as required by applicable law, all persons hired to work at Digital Asset will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the location for which they have an offer to work and to complete the necessary employment eligibility verification documents upon hire.

Accommodations Applicants with disabilities who require accommodation during the application or interview process should contact talent@digitalasset.com.

California Privacy Act (CCPA) If you are based in California, we encourage you to read this important information for California residents linked here.

title: VP - Head of Liquidity & Exchange Services
Product Marketing Manager
description:
About the company

Trust Wallet is the leading non-custodial cryptocurrency wallet, trusted by over 200 million people worldwide to securely manage and grow their digital assets. Our vision is to give individuals the freedom to own their assets, confidently participate in the future economy, and access opportunities that enhance their lives. Our mission is to be a trusted personal companion — helping users safely navigate Web3, the on-chain economy, and the emerging AI-powered future. With support for over 10 million assets across 100+ blockchains, Trust Wallet offers a seamless, multi-chain experience backed by industry-leading self-custody technology, a vibrant community, and a growing ecosystem of partners.


Role Summary

We're looking for a Product Marketing Manager who is equal parts strategist, executor, and Web3 native — someone who proudly calls themselves a degen and is deep in the trenches of the ecosystem they're marketing to. This is a high-impact, generalist role that sits at the intersection of brand, growth, product marketing, and community.

You crunch data for breakfast, thrive wearing multiple hats, and move fluidly between scrappy activations and long-horizon strategy without losing momentum or quality. You translate on-chain insights into compelling narratives that help millions understand and love Trust Wallet — and if you have strong opinions on L2 wars, a wallet full of on-chain history, and can ship a campaign brief and a Dune dashboard in the same afternoon, we want to talk

What You'll Do

  • Develop and own integrated marketing strategies across acquisition, retention, and brand — aligned to product launches, ecosystem milestones, and market cycles

  • Lead end-to-end campaign execution across Web3-native channels and performance channels

  • Define positioning and messaging for new product features and market segments in partnership with Product and BD

  • Set, track, and report on marketing KPIs — DAUs, installs, retention rates, campaign ROAS, community growth, and share of voice - all leading to company level OKRs

  • Own budget allocation across channels with a relentless focus on efficiency and ROI

  • Drive community engagement strategies across Discord, Telegram, and X — building loyal user cohorts, not just follower counts

  • Identify and activate KOL/influencer partnerships that are credible within the Web3 ecosystem

  • Collaborate with BD and ecosystem partners on co-marketing campaigns and joint growth initiatives

  • Work closely with Product to shape go-to-market plans for new features, chain integrations, and partner launches

  • Partner with internal teams to produce high-quality creative that resonates with both crypto natives and mainstream users

 

What We're Looking For

  • 3-5 years of marketing experience, with at least 1 year in a crypto, DeFi, or Web3 company (wallet, exchange, L1/L2 protocol, or DeFi platform strongly preferred)

  • Demonstrable track record of owning and scaling multi-channel campaigns with measurable growth impact

  • Prior experience in a generalist or "full-stack" marketing role — able to move across brand, growth, content, and product marketing fluidly

  • You are the user: genuinely degen, active on-chain, with a wallet history and ecosystem network to prove it

  • Dune and Nansen are daily tabs; proficient in Amplitude and mobile attribution (AppsFlyer, Adjust, or Branch)

  • Treats every initiative as a testable experiment; hunts for signal, quick wins, and strategic bets in the numbers

  • Moves between a scrappy activation and a long-horizon strategic initiative in the same day without dropping quality

  • Bilingual in English and Mandarin will be preferred, as we have ecosystem partners in Chinese-speaking region

 

Bonus Points

  • Marketed a self-custody wallet or non-custodial product

  • Familiarity with Trust Wallet's ecosystem (multi-chain, Web3 Browser, Staking)

  • Prior work at a top-tier exchange (Binance, Coinbase, Kraken) or DeFi protocol

  • Experience running global marketing campaigns

Additional Information

This is a global and fully remote role. You must have the right to work for the country you are based.

Why work at Trust Wallet?

  • Be a part of the world’s leading blockchain ecosystem that continues to grow.

  • Excellent learning and career development opportunities.

  • Work alongside diverse, world-class talent, in an environment where learning and growth opportunities are endless.

  • Tackle fast-paced, challenging and unique projects.

  • Work in a truly global organization, with international teams and a flat organizational structure.

  • Work fully remotely with flexible working hours.

  • Enjoy competitive salary and benefits.

Apply today to join our team in building the world’s most trusted and secure crypto wallet and enable a decentralized future for everyone.

Trust Wallet is committed to being an equal opportunity employer. We believe that having a diverse workforce is fundamental to our success.

*Due to the large amount of the applications, please consider your application as unsuccessful should you not be contacted within 4 weeks from your application date.

title: Strategic Account Manager - MENA
description:
Who we are:

Sardine is the leading agentic risk platform for fighting financial crime. Our integrated solution unifies data across risk teams to help organizations stop fraud in real time, prevent AI-driven attacks, and automate fraud and AML operations. Sardine’s platform is strengthened by one of the fastest-growing fraud consortiums in the market, spanning more than 6 billion profiled devices, 800 million consumers, and 3 million businesses worldwide. Leading companies including FIS, GoDaddy, Intuit, Edward Jones, ZoomInfo, and Checkout.com rely on Sardine to secure and grow trust in their products.

Our culture:

  • We have hubs in the Bay Area, NYC, Austin, Toronto, and São Paulo. However, we maintain a remote-first work culture. #WorkFromAnywhere

  • We hire talented, self-motivated individuals with extreme ownership and high growth orientation.

  • We value performance and not hours worked. We believe you shouldn't have to miss your family dinner, your kid's school play, friends get-together, or doctor's appointments for the sake of adhering to an arbitrary work schedule.

Location:

  • Remote - Dubai

  • From Home / Beach / Mountain / Cafe / Anywhere!

  • We are a remote-first company with a globally distributed team. So you can find your productive zone and work from there.

About the Role:

Sardine is rapidly acquiring new customers and executing on an ambitious roadmap. As a result, we're building a world-class customer success team to support our fraud, payments, and compliance-related products as we grow. As a Strategic Account Manager, you'll manage a handful of customers and act as their stakeholder within Sardine, helping maximize the value of our products and services. In addition, you will collaborate daily with Sardine teams to help customers meet their risk, fraud, compliance, and payment needs, including risk analytics, data science, integrations, and products.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Be the primary point of contact for our customers, attending to day-to-day and 'big picture' problems and opportunities and helping maximize the customer's ROI in Sardine

  • Build a thorough understanding of our product, technology, and strategy and be able to message these succinctly to customers.

  • Translate complex product and technology problems into simple and actionable solutions. Be able to manage the solution process both internally and externally.

  • Speak knowledgeably and advise on best practices relating to fraud and compliance

  • Build, monitor, and communicate KPIs to clients.

  • Provide strategic analysis and critical thinking as we plan long-term expansion.

  • Work with Sardine's risk analytics teams to proactively solve new fraud typologies and actively communicate findings to customers.


What you’ll need:

  • 7+ years of experience in Account Management, Customer Success, Risk Management, or Solutions Architecture within B2B SaaS, with an understanding of how customers integrate API's

  • Domain experience in fraud, payments, compliance, fintech, or AML/KYC

  • Experience working within the banking vertical is highly preferred

  • Strong presentation skills for both virtual and in-person meetings with various stakeholders

  • Previous customer-facing experience, preferably with a technical product

  • Exceptional project management skills and the ability to synthesize all inputs and balance the needs of multiple stakeholders

  • Proficiency in using business intelligence tools

  • Your analytical skills are second to none; you excel at number crunching and drawing insights

  • You're capable of translating complex strategies into actionable processes and outcomes

  • You're a natural at building relationships and collaborating with others

  • You constantly think about ways to improve processes

  • You love making customers more efficient as much as we do!

Benefits we offer:

  • Generous compensation in cash and equity

  • Early exercise for all options, including pre-vested

  • Work from anywhere: Remote-first Culture

  • Flexible paid time off and Year-end break

  • Health insurance, dental, and vision coverage for employees and dependents - US and Canada specific

  • 4% matching in 401k / RRSP - US and Canada specific

  • MacBook Pro delivered to your door

  • One-time stipend to set up a home office — desk, chair, screen, etc.

  • Monthly meal stipend

  • Monthly social meet-up stipend

  • Annual health and wellness stipend

  • Annual Learning stipend

Join a fast-growing company with world-class professionals from around the world. If you are seeking a meaningful career, you found the right place, and we would love to hear from you.

To learn more about how we process your personal information and your rights in regards to your personal information as an applicant and Sardine employee, please visit our Applicant and Worker Privacy Notice.

title: Independent Non-Executive Director (Resident), Seychelles
description:
Independent Non-Executive Director (Resident), Seychelles
 
About OKX
At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom. OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er. OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.
Our Seychelles business has operated since 2017 and now sits within the licensing regime established by the Virtual Asset Service Providers Act of Seychelles 2024 (the VASP Act). We are seeking an Independent Non-Executive Director, resident in Seychelles, to join the board of our Seychelles entity to supplement its board of governance with an independent resident non-executive director.

About the Role
As an Independent Non-Executive Director and Resident Director of our Seychelles entity, you will bring independent challenge to strategy, risk and conduct, hold management to account on behalf of shareholders and stakeholders, and provide the resident board presence that the licence and the entity's governance arrangements require. The role exists to do three things at once: provide independent challenge; satisfy the Seychelles Financial Services Authority (the FSA) that the board of the Company meets its expectations on composition, competence and fitness and propriety under the VASP Act; and provide local substance in Seychelles.
The entity operates within the group's global governance, risk and compliance framework while remaining separately accountable to its own board and to its regulator. The Board comprises a mix of executive and independent non-executive directors. This is a genuinely resident role. The appointee must be physically present in Seychelles, attend board and management meetings in person, and be available to engage with the FSA and the entity's advisers in Seychelles.
A non-executive director carries the same general legal responsibilities to the entity as any other director, and must perform those duties faithfully, efficiently and diligently to a standard commensurate with the role and with their own knowledge, skills and experience.

What You’ll Be Doing
Independentally Challenge
  • Bring an external and independent perspective to strategy, risk and conduct, and hold management to account on behalf of shareholders and stakeholders.
  • Provide constructive challenge and strategic guidance, and offer specialist advice to the Board.
  • Scrutinise the performance of management and of individual executive directors against agreed goals, and monitor how that performance is reported.
  • Act in good faith, honestly and responsibly, and make decisions objectively in what you consider to be the interests of the entity.
Regulatory Standing & Local Substance
  • Satisfy the FSA that the board of the Company meets its expectations on composition, competence and fitness and propriety under the VASP Act.
  • Provide the physical, resident board presence in Seychelles that the licence and the entity's governance arrangements require.
  • Attend board and management meetings in person, and engage with the FSA and the entity's advisers in Seychelles as required.
Collective Board Responsibilities
  • Promote the long term sustainable success of the entity, generating value for shareholders and contributing to wider society.
  • Establish the entity's purpose, values and strategy, and satisfy the Board that its culture is aligned to them.
  • Provide effective, prudent and ethical oversight, act with integrity, lead by example and promote the desired culture.
  • Ensure the resources needed to meet the entity's objectives are in place, and measure performance against them.
  • Establish and lead within a framework of prudent and effective controls that allows risk to be assessed and managed.
  • Ensure effective engagement with shareholders and stakeholders.
  • Ensure workforce policies and practices are consistent with the entity's values.
Individual Director Responsibilities
  • Satisfy yourself on the integrity of the entity's financial information, its financial controls, and whether its risk management systems are robust and defensible.
  • Determine appropriate remuneration for executive directors, and play a leading part in appointing and, where necessary, removing them.
  • Contribute to the entity's succession planning.
  • Uphold the highest standards of integrity, and support the chairperson in setting the values, behaviours and culture of the boardroom and beyond.
Committee Service
Serve on one or more board committees where required. The relevant terms of reference will be provided on appointment.

What We Look for in You
  • Resident in Seychelles, and currently holding the right to reside and work there.
  • Able to satisfy the FSA's fitness and propriety assessment.
  • Board level or senior governance experience in a regulated financial services, banking, insurance, fiduciary or corporate services business.
  • Working knowledge of anti-money laundering and counter terrorist financing obligations, and of the Seychelles regulatory environment.
  • Financial literacy sufficient to interrogate financial statements, controls and risk reporting without support.
  • Demonstrable independence of mind, and the willingness to challenge management and record dissent.
  • Fluent in English, with excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.
What Will Make You Stand Out
  • Experience of virtual assets, fintech, payments or capital markets.
  • Prior regulatory experience.
  • Experience chairing an audit, risk or compliance committee.
  • Experience of a group structure where much of the operating activity sits outside the licensed entity's jurisdiction, and of the oversight challenge that creates.
  • An established local network among Seychelles regulators, professional advisers and the financial services community.
 
Why Join OKX?
  • Play a pivotal role in the governance of a successful virtual asset business.
  • Bring independent oversight to a global crypto platform operating at scale across multiple jurisdictions.
  • Work alongside an experienced board and a global leadership team in a high-growth industry.
  • A defined, time-bounded commitment with genuine influence over strategy, risk and conduct.
 
Ready to Reshape Finance?
At OKX, we’re on a mission to make crypto accessible, secure, and transformative for the next billion users. Join us and help set the governance standard for virtual assets globally.

title: Senior Compliance Analyst
description:
Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.
OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.
Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er. OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

About the Opportunity

This role will support the Compliance function for OKX Türkiye, helping ensure the business operates in line with MASAK, SPK and wider local regulatory requirements. You’ll work across AML/CFT, KYC/EDD, regulatory reporting, marketing and product compliance, customer protection and compliance controls, while partnering closely with Product, Legal, Marketing, Risk and Operations. The role is ideal for an experienced compliance professional who can interpret regulation, identify risks and control gaps, and translate regulatory requirements into practical solutions within a fast-paced fintech and crypto environment.
 

What You’ll Be Doing 

  • Support the establishment, execution and maintenance of OKX TR’s local Compliance Program in accordance with MASAK regulations (Law No. 5549), SPK requirements and applicable internal policies.
  • Assist in the review and oversight of customer due diligence processes, including individual and corporate onboarding, identity verification, enhanced due diligence, customer risk assessment and ongoing monitoring requirements.
  • Support the preparation, review and maintenance of suspicious transaction reporting processes, including case analysis, supporting documentation, internal coordination and communication with MASAK where required.
  • Assist in the handling of regulatory, law enforcement and official authority requests, ensuring that relevant information is reviewed, documented and provided in line with applicable regulatory timelines and internal procedures.
  • Support the review of marketing campaigns, campaign terms and conditions, GTM materials, reward mechanics, influencer / KOL content, social media content, customer-facing communications, website / app content and research / educational materials from a local Compliance perspective.
  • Assist in assessing marketing and customer-facing materials against Türkiye-specific regulatory expectations, including fair and clear communication, customer protection, misleading statements, investment advice risk, guaranteed return language, reward disclosures, crypto-asset reward mechanics and onshore / offshore separation.
  • Support Compliance review of new products, product changes, customer journeys, product documentation, business initiatives and launch materials, helping ensure that local regulatory requirements are considered before implementation.
  • Assist in the preparation and review of internal procedures, regulatory registers and control documents relating to Compliance-related product, system, marketing and operational enhancements.
  • Support the monitoring of customer activity, risk indicators and compliance controls to help identify potential suspicious activity, financial crime risks, data-quality issues or process gaps requiring further review or escalation.
  • Assist in identifying, documenting and following up on control gaps, system limitations and remediation needs, including issues affecting customer data, account status visibility, regulatory reporting, KYC flows and operational controls.
  • Assist in regulatory mapping and horizon-scanning activities by tracking applicable MASAK, SPK and other relevant regulatory requirements, and supporting the mapping of obligations to internal processes, owners and controls.
  • Support the preparation and maintenance of Compliance trackers, management reports, Board-level inputs, regulatory DDQs, audit support materials, internal knowledge bases and workflow mappings.
  • Work closely with Product, Legal, Marketing, Customer Support, CDD, Risk, Operations and Global Compliance teams to support effective implementation of local regulatory requirements across business processes.
  • Contribute to automation, reporting and operational-efficiency initiatives, including workflow mapping, data analysis, compliance tools and system enhancement requests.
 

What We Look For In You

  • 3–5 years of experience in compliance, AML/CFT, regulatory compliance, risk management, financial crime, internal controls, legal / regulatory advisory or a similar role, preferably within financial services, fintech, crypto, payments or another regulated environment.
  • Background in technology-driven, fintech, financial services or regulated environments; crypto experience is a plus but not mandatory.
  • Understanding of, or strong interest in, AML/CFT, KYC, EDD, sanctions, PEP, Travel Rule, customer due diligence, regulatory reporting, marketing compliance and customer protection controls.
  • Familiarity with MASAK and SPK regulations/requirements
  • Ability to interpret regulatory requirements and translate them into practical operational processes, controls, documentation, customer communications and product / system requirements.
  • Experience or strong interest in reviewing marketing materials, campaign terms, customer-facing communications, product documentation, website / app content, research content or regulatory disclosures.
  • Strong analytical, research and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify risk patterns, control gaps and process weaknesses.
  • Well-organised, detail-oriented and able to manage documentation, trackers, controls and multiple workstreams accurately.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English and Turkish, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
  • Familiarity with compliance databases, case management systems, screening tools, reporting systems, data analysis or workflow automation is a plus.
  • Proactive mindset, high integrity and ability to work in a fast-paced, technology-driven environment.
 

Perks & Benefits

  • Competitive total compensation package
  • L&D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development
  • Various team building programs and company events
  • Wellness and meal allowances 
  • Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants 
  • More that we love to tell you along the process!

You’ll work closely with Compliance and cross-functional teams to investigate financial crime risks, support MASAK and regulatory requirements, and maintain effective compliance controls and documentation.   • Support the establishment and maintenance of Legal & Compliance Support Operations in accordance with Law No: 5549 on Prevention of Laundering Proceeds of Crime, related regulations and MASAK Notifications.
  • Assist in the onboarding process of individual and corporate accounts, ensuring compliance with identity verification and other customer identification measures as per Law No. 5549. Provide support in overseeing the overall process of corporate account management.
  • Support the generation and maintenance of suspicious transaction reports, collaborating with cross-functional teams for effective communication with MASAK. Assist in the management of risk control processes to ensure compliance and mitigate financial risks.
  • Assist in managing and preserving documentation processes for corporate user and suspicious transaction reports, ensuring compliance and proper record-keeping in accordance with relevant regulations and internal policies.
  • Support in conducting preparatory work for upcoming regulatory audits and proactively contributing to potential licensing requirements, ensuring compliance with applicable regulations and facilitating the smooth implementation of necessary measures.
  • Monitor national and international sanction lists, Politically Exposed Person (PEP) databases, and Legal Gazette for compliance purposes. Assist in implementing appropriate measures in accordance with relevant laws and regulations.

What We Look For In You

  • At least 1-2 years of experience in compliance, risk management, or regulatory affairs, preferably within the financial, fintech, or cryptocurrency sector.
  • Background in technology-driven, fintech, financial services, or regulated environments (crypto experience is a plus but not mandatory).
  • Understanding of or exposure to AML, compliance, risk, internal controls, or regulatory frameworks, ideally within the Turkish regulatory environment.
  • Familiarity with MASAK and SPK regulations or the ability to quickly learn and apply regulatory requirements.
  • Experience or strong interest in data analysis, business analysis, automation, AI-enabled tools, or compliance systems.
  • Strong analytical, research, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret regulatory requirements and translate them into operational processes.
  • Well-organised, detail-oriented, and able to manage documentation and controls accurately.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English; ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
  • Proficiency in monitoring compliance databases, risk tools, and reporting systems (e.g., transaction monitoring, screening tools).
  • A proactive mindset, high integrity, and the ability to work in a fast-paced, technology-driven environment.

title: Video Host & Producer
description:
At River, we are building the world's most trusted financial institution to empower people to take ownership of their financial lives through Bitcoin, the world's only incorruptible digital money. We believe in a future where every person will have bitcoin savings, and every business will have bitcoin on the balance sheet. We obsessively design and build delightful products that help our clients buy, sell, secure, and use Bitcoin.

We are looking for a Host & Producer to be the main face of River's video content and to bring our videos to life across various channels. You'll present our videos on camera with the warmth and authority of a trusted guide explaining money. You’ll shoot many of these videos yourself, occasionally working with contractors for bigger projects. Our audience is people who are navigating the reality that our money is slowly losing its value; your job is to make them trust us enough to hear the answers. The main goal of the channel is not to promote River’s products, it is to create valuable content you would enjoy watching.

You'll report to River's Director of Marketing and work closely with our Video Content Strategist, who writes the scripts you'll present.

River is growing quickly and has raised more than $50 million from leading investors, including Goldcrest, Kingsway, Polychain, M13, DG, and Valor. We have also released our company's financials publicly, so that all of our clients and employees can verify the robustness and growth of the business themselves.

What you will be doing:

  • Be the recognizable face of our videos. Present medium length scripted videos with the clarity, warmth, and authority that make viewers trust you and keep watching.

  • Shoot your own footage, anywhere the journey takes us. Own the production quality in any location you shoot from, as video content won’t be studio-based.

  • Produce shoots end to end. Plan, scout, and run the logistics that get us high-quality footage on schedule.

  • Own the craft edit. You define the color, sound, B-roll, and motion-graphics direction — and direct our editor so the finished video keeps the energy of the moment it was shot.

  • Conduct interviews for feature-style videos when a story calls for it.

  • Collaborate with the Video Content Strategist to make every script land in your natural voice.

What we look for in you:

  • On-camera presence. You can deliver scripted explainers and make a stranger feel like a friend is walking them through their money.

  • The ability to make complex topics feel simple and human on camera.

  • Proven self-shooting ability. A portfolio of footage you shot and produced yourself, not just appeared in.

  • Production skills. Framing, lighting, and audio you can execute well without a crew.

  • A strong sense of ownership and a bias for iteration to keep getting better each video.

  • Curiosity about money and Bitcoin, and eagerness to become genuinely conversant, so that it shows on camera.

  • Integrity. You will, quite literally, be one of the main faces of our brand.

Nice to have:

  • Editing skills (Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or Final Cut).

  • Motion graphics or animation experience.

  • A background in finance, economics, or journalism.

  • Interviewing experience.

Salary and benefits:

  • Annual salary range of $110-160k depending on experience

  • Competitive compensation and equity

  • Unlimited Paid Time Off

  • Parental leave, separate from PTO policy

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance + 401k for US based employees

  • Remote option: You can work from anywhere in the U.S, but your base should be in New York City to be close to leadership and several team members for a variety of productions.

Interview process:

  • Screening interview with River's Director of Marketing (20 mins)

  • Interview with Marketing team member + River's Chief Operating Officer (2x 30 mins B2B)

  • Take-home challenge (a paid exercise: shoot and present a short explainer)

  • Interview with River's CPO + CEO (2x 30 mins B2B)

title: Video Content Strategist
description:
At River, we are building the world's most trusted financial institution to empower people to take ownership of their financial lives through Bitcoin, the world's only incorruptible digital money. We believe in a future where every person will have bitcoin savings, and every business will have bitcoin on the balance sheet. We obsessively design and build delightful products that help our clients buy, sell, secure, and use Bitcoin.

We are looking for a Video Content Strategist to build River's YouTube channel and video output. You will own what we make and how we package it: sourcing and selecting ideas, writing host-led scripts, and crafting the titles and thumbnails that decide whether our work gets watched. Our audience is people who are navigating the reality that our money is slowly losing its value; your job is to make them trust us enough to hear the answers. The main goal of the channel is not to promote River’s products, it is to create valuable content you would enjoy watching.

You'll report to River's Director of Marketing and work closely with our Host-Producer, the marketing team, and company leadership.

River is growing quickly and has raised more than $50 million from leading investors, including Goldcrest, Kingsway, Polychain, M13, DG, and Valor. We have also released our company's financials publicly, so that all of our clients and employees can verify the robustness and growth of the business themselves.

What you will be doing:

  • Own the video content pipeline. Generate and filter video ideas, sourcing input from across the marketing team and our extensive research.

  • Own packaging of the titles and thumbnails. You'll craft them and test them.

  • Write scripts for medium to long form videos that make money and Bitcoin topics clear, engaging, and impossible to click away from. Some videos will be host-led, others animated.

  • Develop hooks and introductions to retain the audience and provide structure.

  • Ensure the story edit matches the script in structure and pacing.

  • Drive our success metrics on YouTube: view count, retention, and returning-viewer rate, and iterate relentlessly on what the data tells you.

  • Build the systems that let us produce quality content consistently: The idea backlog, filtering process, scripting process, and a testing loop for titles and thumbnails.

What we look for in you:

  • A track record of growing a video channel, your own or one you led. Not just script writing, but ideas and packaging that measurably moved views and retention.

  • An obsession with packaging. You study titles and thumbnails, you have real opinions about why videos win or lose, and you can prove your craft with examples.

  • Exceptional writing and storytelling. You can take a dense economic idea and make a stranger care about it in a single sentence.

  • A strong understanding of the YouTube algorithm, retention curves, and click-through rate.

  • You have a solid understanding of Bitcoin in the economic sense, and what makes it an answer to many of the financial problems the world faces.

  • A strong sense of ownership. You own the idea end to end, you gather input from the team, but the call is yours, and you stand behind the result.

  • You have integrity and know how to present the facts honestly and the brand professionally.

Nice to have:

  • On-camera, interviewing, or hosting experience.

  • A background in finance, economics, or journalism.

Salary and benefits:

  • Annual salary range of $110-165k depending on experience

  • Competitive compensation and equity

  • Unlimited Paid Time Off

  • Parental leave, separate from PTO policy

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance + 401k for US based employees

  • Remote option: You can work from anywhere in the Americas or Europe.

Interview process:

  • Screening interview with River's Director of Marketing (20 mins)

  • First round of interviews (1-hour block with River's Chief Product Officer and a Marketing teammate)

  • Take-home challenge (a paid packaging and scripting exercise)

  • Final round of executive interviews (1-hour block with River's COO and CEO)

title: Staff Software Engineer, Graphs
description:
The engineering team at Chainalysis is inspired by solving the hardest technical challenges and building products that establish trust in cryptocurrencies. We're a global organisation that thrives on challenging work and doing it alongside exceptionally talented teammates. Our industry evolves rapidly, and our mission is to build a flexible, AI-driven platform that automates entity resolution, optimises data labelling pipelines, and creates predictive models that identify illicit patterns before they escalate.

Our data and solutions have been used to solve some of the world's most high-profile criminal cases and grow consumer access to cryptocurrency safely. Now, by pairing the industry's most trusted blockchain data with agents that reason, investigate, and act, we help our customers scale their workflows as the cryptocurrency economy becomes increasingly mainstream.

As a Staff Software Engineer within Investigations, you'll be a driving force in a team of engineers, taking ownership of technical direction and sharing responsibility for providing the right tools and the right data to build best in class customer experiences. You'll lead the design, build and maintenance of new customer facing web-features as well as the APIs and services backing them. A key part of this role is partnering closely with product managers and designers, leveraging your deep understanding of the underlying data platform to deliver impactful, scalable solutions to our customers.

In this role, you'll:

  • Lead the architecture, maintenance and development of serving cloud-native data ingest and aggregation processes that intake gigabytes of data per day

  • Drive the delivery of features across our product suite that detect activities for market manipulation, fraud, behavioural patterning, and more

  • Own and scale a high-performance services on AWS that handle thousands of requests per second

  • Lead the team's modernisation efforts towards a streaming architecture, setting technical direction and best practices

  • Own and drive the direction and enablement of our graphing platform, which is used across multiple products to drive and visualize understanding of our insights and data, both on and off the blockchains

  • Debug and resolve production issues across multiple systems and services, guiding the team through complex technical challenges

  • Mentor and grow engineers across the team, fostering a culture of technical excellence and collaboration

We're looking for candidates who have:

  • Proven experience leading the design and implementation of cloud-native services-based systems in a major cloud provider like AWS or GCP

  • A strong track record of mentoring engineers, leading cross-team projects, and driving design and technology decisions at a senior or lead level

  • The ability to align technical execution with product and design partners, with a strong bias to ship and iterate

  • Deep experience with object-oriented programming languages; we mostly use Java and typescript but appreciate a variety of languages!

  • A strong technical background with extensive experience working directly on complex backend and/or frontend systems and projects, including in leadership or lead engineer roles

  • Great pride from taking ownership of product ideas from inception through to production

  • Good understanding of both frontend and backend best practices and paradigms.

  • Integrated AI impactfully in customer-facing products or engineering infrastructure

You might also have:

  • Experience with AI-friendly and driven systems

  • Exposure to or interest in the cryptocurrency technology ecosystem

  • Terraform and Kubernetes knowledge

Technologies we use:

  • Java (Spring Boot)

  • Typescript (React, Angular)

  • Kafka (Warpstream)

  • K8S

  • Terraform

  • PostgreSQL

AI at Chainalysis
AI is not a feature at Chainalysis - it is a new way of working. One that turns instructions into work done, and helps us move faster than the threats we're built to counter, and we expect our employees to take ownership of the output and ensure quality. As the world's most trusted blockchain analytics platform, Chainalysis sits at a rare intersection of proprietary data, regulatory relationships and crypto expertise that makes it uniquely placed to shape and lead the next era of AI-driven intelligence - and we expect everyone here, regardless of role, to be an active part of it.

AI fluency is tied directly to how we measure performance and how we plan to win. There is no substitute for your own curiosity. We provide the tools, workflows, and space to experiment - but the expectation is that you develop these capabilities yourself, bring ideas, and collaborate across teams to reinvent the way work gets done. We are not using AI to do less. We are using it to do what was never possible before.

About Chainalysis

Chainalysis is the blockchain data platform, making it easy to connect the movement of digital assets to real-world services. Powered by deep blockchain data and AI, organizations can investigate illicit activity, manage risk exposure, and develop innovative market solutions built on the industry's most trusted blockchain intelligence. Our mission is to build trust in blockchains, blending safety and security with an unwavering commitment to growth and innovation.

You belong here. 

At Chainalysis, we believe that diversity of experience and thought makes us stronger. With both customers and employees around the world, we are committed to ensuring our team reflects the unique communities around us. We’re ensuring we keep learning by committing to continually revisit and reevaluate our diversity culture.

We encourage applicants across any race, ethnicity, gender/gender expression, age, spirituality, ability, experience and more. If you need any accommodations to make our interview process more accessible to you due to a disability, don't hesitate to let us know. You can learn more here. We can’t wait to meet you.

title: Public Relations Manager
description:
About the company

Trust Wallet is the leading non-custodial cryptocurrency wallet, trusted by over 200 million people worldwide to securely manage and grow their digital assets. Our vision is to give individuals the freedom to own their assets, confidently participate in the future economy, and access opportunities that enhance their lives. Our mission is to be a trusted personal companion — helping users safely navigate Web3, the on-chain economy, and the emerging AI-powered future. With support for over 10 million assets across 100+ blockchains, Trust Wallet offers a seamless, multi-chain experience backed by industry-leading self-custody technology, a vibrant community, and a growing ecosystem of partners.

The Role

As the Public Relations Manager, you will own the end-to-end strategy for how the world perceives Trust Wallet. You will blend traditional public relations, executive communications, and innovative brand marketing to tell compelling stories about security, financial sovereignty, and Web3 innovation. This role requires a unique mix of high-level brand strategy and hands-on media relations in a rapid-response crypto environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Global PR Strategy: Develop and execute an impactful global PR calendar covering product launches, security milestones, strategic partnerships, and community initiatives.

  • Media Relations & Pitching: Build, maintain, and leverage relationships with tier-one tech, business, and crypto-native media outlets. Secure consistent, high-quality organic coverage.

  • Brand Positioning & Messaging: Maintain and evolve Trust Wallet's global brand guidelines, ensuring absolute consistency in voice, tone, and messaging across all public-facing channels.

  • Crisis & Security Communications: Work closely with the Security, Product, and Legal teams to draft rapid, transparent, and accurate communications during industry events, network outages, or security incidents.

  • Executive Thought Leadership: Position Trust Wallet's leadership team as authoritative voices in Web3 through speaking engagements, op-eds, podcast placements, and industry panels.

  • Brand Campaigns: Conceive and execute creative marketing campaigns that drive brand awareness, humanize self-custody, and onboard the next wave of Web3 users.

What We Are Looking For (Requirements)

  • Experience: 5+ years of experience in PR, corporate communications, or brand marketing, with at least 2 years explicitly within the Web3, crypto, or DeFi space.

  • Crypto-Native Mindset: A deep, functional understanding of decentralized ecosystems, non-custodial wallets, smart contracts, and major layer-1/layer-2 networks. You don't just know the jargon; you can explain complex cryptographic concepts simply.

  • Proven track record of securing high-tier media placements and established relationships with prominent crypto journalists and tech editors.

  • An elite storyteller with the ability to draft compelling press releases, messaging frameworks, and executive talking points under tight deadlines.

  • Global Execution: Experience working across decentralized, distributed teams and executing localized campaigns across diverse regions (e.g., LATAM, APAC, EMEA)

Additional Information

This is a global and fully remote role. You must have the right to work for the country you are based.

Why work at Trust Wallet?

  • Be a part of the world’s leading blockchain ecosystem that continues to grow.

  • Excellent learning and career development opportunities.

  • Work alongside diverse, world-class talent, in an environment where learning and growth opportunities are endless.

  • Tackle fast-paced, challenging and unique projects.

  • Work in a truly global organization, with international teams and a flat organizational structure.

  • Work fully remotely with flexible working hours.

  • Enjoy competitive salary and benefits.

Apply today to join our team in building the world’s most trusted and secure crypto wallet and enable a decentralized future for everyone.

Trust Wallet is committed to being an equal opportunity employer. We believe that having a diverse workforce is fundamental to our success.

*Due to the large amount of the applications, please consider your application as unsuccessful should you not be contacted within 4 weeks from your application date.

title: Crypto Risk Lead
description:
Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. 

The Crypto Risk team's mission is to identify, assess, and mitigate risk across our products, operations, and platforms, protecting customers and the firm as the business scales. We work to deliver an excellent end-customer experience while upholding the safety and soundness of the business, so Robinhood can keep expanding access to crypto responsibly. As Robinhood expands its operations in Canada, we are building an independent risk management function to support that growth.

As our new Crypto Risk Lead, you will own the design, implementation, and ongoing operation of an independent risk management program for Robinhood's Canadian crypto business. 

This role is based in our Toronto, ON office, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week. 

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. 

What you’ll do

  • Implement and own Canada's independent risk management program, adapting Robinhood's global risk framework to meet Canadian regulatory expectations, including CIRO and the CSA, and keeping it current as that landscape evolves.
  • Lead risk assessments (including RCSAs) across Canadian crypto operations and manage the issue and incident lifecycle from identification through remediation and closure.
  • Evaluate new products, digital assets, and business changes for risk and control impact prior to launch, and provide independent risk opinions to the business and compliance teams.
  • Own risk reporting for the board and risk committees, including committee materials, key risk indicators, and issue and incident trends.
  • Support regulatory exams, audits, and assessments related to risk management in Canada.
  • Partner with Canada's compliance leadership and cross functional teams, including operations, engineering, legal, and global enterprise risk, to maintain a consistent view of risk.

What you bring

  • 7+ years of experience in risk management within financial services, crypto or fintech operations, or a comparably regulated industry, including experience building or independently running a risk program
  • Working knowledge of the Canadian financial services regulatory environment, with direct experience with CIRO, the CSA, or crypto specific regulatory frameworks strongly preferred.
  • Experience designing and implementing risk governance frameworks, policies, and procedures, including RCSAs, key risk indicator development, and issue management.
  • Demonstrated experience preparing materials for and presenting to boards, risk committees, or senior executives, with strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Comfort using data, automation, and AI-enabled tools to enhance risk monitoring, analysis, and reporting, with appropriate governance and validation. A proactive, independent, detail oriented approach, comfortable operating with a high degree of autonomy while staying closely aligned with global risk leadership; experience with GRC tools is a plus.

What we offer

  • Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career.
  • Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, and equity ownership.
  • Top tier benefits to fuel your work, including supplemental health insurance, ancillary insurance, and mental health support programs.
  • Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill-building for every employee, technical or not.
  • Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible employer-paid benefits spending account expenses beyond traditional benefits such as wellness, childcare, learning, and more.
  • Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, paid volunteer time off, parental leave, and more!
  • Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces. 
  • Monthly commuter stipend to help offset in-office commuting costs.

Our team is committed to providing an inclusive and welcoming interview experience for all candidates. If you require a specific accommodation during the application or interview process due to a physical or mental condition, please complete this Applicant Accommodation Form to notify our team. The form should only be completed if you need a specific accommodation.

title: People Operations Partner
description:
Who We Are:

Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.

Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. This includes broker-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts.

Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it.

Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.

Our Team Members:

We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!

We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

Your Role:

We’re looking for a People Operations Partner to be a reliable, high-touch operator for our global workforce. You’ll own the day-to-day People Ops engine such as onboarding, offboarding, employee lifecycle transactions, data quality, and employee support while also stretching into employee relations support and cross-functional People projects as needed.

This is a hands-on, execution-first role: roughly 70% core People Operations and 30% adjacent work (employee relations support, analytics, systems, and special projects). You’ll work across regions and time zones, not as a single-region specialist, and you’ll help keep our processes consistent, compliant, and human as we scale.

If you like making operations feel invisible when they work and you’re curious about how AI and modern HR systems can take the busywork out of People work this role will fit.

What you’ll do

  • Process a high volume of employee lifecycle work such as onboarding, offboarding, transfers, job/comp changes, and related requests. Coordinate cross-functional follow-through so employees and managers get timely, high-quality support.
  • Partner with employees and leaders across regions and time zones. Execute global People processes while navigating local nuances so support feels consistent and locally aware.
  • Provide benefits support where needed, including answering employee questions, helping with enrollments or life event changes, and coordinating with vendors or specialists on more complex issues.
  • Maintain accurate, audit-ready employee files and HRIS records. Flag data gaps, process breaks, and compliance risks early, and help keep the People tech stack running smoothly.
  • Triage employee and manager questions on policies, processes, benefits, and systems. Know when to resolve it yourself, when to loop in Benefits/Payroll/Legal/IT, and when to escalate.
  • Handle sensitive situations with discretion and sound judgment.
  • Pull and clean reports from the HRIS and adjacent systems (headcount, starters/leavers, tenure, and other people metrics). Help maintain dashboards and turn raw data into clear, usable summaries for the People team and leadership. 
  • Support high-impact People initiatives: HRIS/ATS improvements, workflow redesign, policy rollouts, audit prep, and other cross-functional projects. 
  • Look for practical ways to use AI and automation to reduce manual work (FAQs, documentation, reporting, request triage, process mapping) while staying thoughtful about privacy, accuracy, and employee trust.

What we’re looking for

Required

  • 1–3 years in People Operations, HR Operations, HR Coordinator/Generalist, or a closely related role
  • Experience supporting the employee lifecycle (onboarding, offboarding, and day-to-day HR transactions)
  • Comfort working with a global or multi-country workforce, or clear evidence you can learn local nuances quickly and operate across time zones
  • Strong attention to detail, organization, and follow-through in a high-volume environment
  • Clear, professional written and verbal communication including with employees and managers 
  • Discretion with confidential employee information
  • Confidence in spreadsheets (Excel or Google Sheets) and HR systems; able to pull reports, spot data issues, and keep records clean
  • A service mindset: you default to helpful, calm, and reliable, even when volume is high
  • Comfort in a fast-moving environment: you can juggle competing priorities, stay composed when things are busy, and still deliver accurate work without losing the human touch

Nice to have

    • Hands-on experience with modern HRIS platforms such as HiBob, Rippling, Workday, BambooHR, or similar
    • Exposure to employee relations (intake, documentation, case tracking, or supporting investigations)
    • Experience supporting employee benefits (questions, enrollments, life events, or vendor coordination)
    • Experience supporting systems or process projects (HRIS implementation, workflow redesign, audit, or policy rollout)
    • Genuine interest in AI and how it can improve People operations (tools, prompts, automation, documentation)
    • Startup, high-growth, or similarly fast-paced experience
    • Experience in a remote or multi-entity environment

How We Take Care of You:

  • Competitive Salary & Stock Options
  • Health Benefits
  • New Hire Home-Office Setup: One-time USD $500
  • Monthly Stipend: USD $150 per month via a Brex Card

Alpaca is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to pursuing and hiring a diverse workforce.
