title: Engineering Manager - Pro
description:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.


Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

 

The Exchange team is responsible for everything to do with the trading backend services such as the matching engine, market data gateways, internal and external APIs, margin systems and various other trading services. The team is located globally and responsibilities are split into sub-teams, working with various tech stacks. Our teams code in C++, Go, Rust, and Python, depending on the product they are contributing to within Kraken and work agile around the globe. Recently, the Trading Technologies team played a critical role in scaling Kraken's trading infrastructure.

The opportunity

  • Lead and grow a team of 8-10 engineers owning core trading backend services, including the matching engine, market data gateways, and order entry systems

  • Guide the team through the ongoing evolution of our trading stack, from legacy systems to their modern replacements

  • Stay technically close enough to the stack to unblock, review, and contribute to architecture discussions across matching engine, market data, and order entry work with ability to jump in and assist with coding

  • Champion performance and market data work as top priorities, while also supporting the team's broader technical scope

  • Bring AI-assisted engineering practices into the team's workflow and help engineers adopt them

  • Partner cross-functionally with product and other engineering pods to drive roadmap execution

  • Represent the team technically with peer teams and stakeholders, communicating tradeoffs and progress clearly

 

What you bring

  • Experience managing engineering teams, with a preference for managers who stay technically engaged rather than purely administrative

  • Prior hands-on experience in at least one of the following using Linux: distributed and/or highly-concurrent systems; low-latency and/or high-volume transaction environments

  • Proficiency in Rust and/or C++; comfort operating in a team split across C++, Rust, Go, and Python

  • Demonstrated knowledge of order types, trading systems, and financial products

  • Experience with Aeron or similar messaging/transport systems a strong plus

  • Comfort with multicast-based market data distribution a plus

  • Cryptocurrency/blockchain familiarity highly preferable

  • Proactive mindset with the ability to prioritize across a technically deep team and adhere to aggressive deadlines

description:
AI Systems Researcher / Research Engineer

UK: London (Preferred) - Hybrid 

About Brave

Brave is on a mission to protect the human right to privacy online. We’ve built a free web browser that blocks creepy ads and trackers by default, a private search engine with a truly independent index, private AI assistant, latest privacy and security features, and a private ad network (opt-in!) that directly rewards you for your attention. Already over 120 million people regularly use Brave for a faster, more private web. Millions more switch every month.

The internet is a sea of ads, hackers, and echo chambers. Big Tech makes huge profits off our data, and tells us what’s true and what’s not. Brave is fighting back. Join us!

Summary

Join us at Brave as we redefine the future of online experiences with a range of cutting-edge, top-performing products. We’re seeking an experienced AI Systems and Performance Researcher/Engineer to shape and improve our performance evaluations and optimizations across desktop and mobile. If you’re passionate about innovation, privacy, and delivering impactful AI solutions, this is your opportunity to make a difference. We need you to help with a wide range of key products, ranging from our browser ML models, novel applications, on-device AI agents, performance evaluations, and collaborating closely with privacy and security researchers to protect the users from AI risks.

About you

An ideal candidate will have a mix of skills that include the following:

Specific Skills

Skills That Will Set You Apart from the Competition

Working at Brave - What we offer

title: SOC Analyst
description:
About MoonPay

MoonPay is for builders with something to prove.

This isn't a "work on cool crypto stuff" company. It's a high-standards, high-velocity, high-accountability company building the operating system for value movement. If the internet moves information, we move value: crypto, stablecoins, tokenized assets, and whatever comes next. Four offerings make that real: fund, tokenize, trade, and spend. 30M+ customers and 500+ ecosystem partners run on us. Licensed in the U.S. Regulated across the UK, EU, Canada, and Australia.

AI is the default operating mode here. It's woven into every role, and we expect you to use it daily. It handles the manual work so you can deliver on what actually matters.

You'll thrive here if outcomes excite you more than process, if impact motivates you more than titles, and if you want hard problems, real ownership, and teammates who love winning, building, and doing it together.

The bar is high. The pace is real. We're building for what's next, for humans and agents.

Recent recognition:

2nd in Crypto Services on Fortune's inaugural Crypto 100
The Sunday Times Best Places to Work two years running

Research has shown that women are less likely than men to apply for this role if they do not have experience in 100% of these areas. Please know that this list is indicative, and that we would still love to hear from you even if you feel that you are only a 75% match. Skills can be learned, diversity cannot.

Relocation available: No

Work pattern:

About the Opportunity

👉Join the Security Operations Center as a SOC Analyst, a critical frontline role responsible for protecting the organization against security threats and operational disruptions across 24×7 rotation. You'll be at the intersection of security and operations, monitoring real-time alerts, investigating suspicious activity, responding to incidents, and supporting infrastructure operations. This role is perfect for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment where multiple security and IT issues can converge at once, and who wants to build deep expertise across both security-focused and operational-support workflows.

What You Will Do

  • Monitor real-time security alerts and investigate suspicious network, endpoint, and cloud activity through SIEM queries and threat-analysis tools to detect emerging threats.

  • Identify, declare, document, and escalate security incidents in line with established incident-response (IR) playbooks, ensuring rapid containment and remediation.

  • Analyze and remediate email-based threats including phishing, malware, spoofing attempts, and manage endpoint device security through EDR workflows and MDM policies.

  • Act as the first-line point of contact for IT requests including password resets, account unlocks, hardware provisioning, email/collaboration-platform issues, and application access problems

  • Maintain accurate and timely ticket documentation, case notes, and incident summaries, contribute to runbook improvements, process documentation, and knowledge base articles to support team efficiency.

  • Monitor external attack surface including brand-impersonation activity, fraudulent domain registrations, social-engineering threats, and validate honeytoken decoys to detect unauthorized lateral-movement attempts.

About You

  • Solid understanding of IT infrastructure concepts including networks (IP, DNS, ports, protocols), endpoints (macOS), and identity systems (IAM, SSO, MFA).

Nice-to-have experience

  • Experience with Jamf for Apple/macOS device management

title: Principal Product Manager - Risk & Decisioning
description:
About Coinflow

Coinflow is the next-generation payment service provider revolutionizing global financial infrastructure with stablecoins, AI-driven fraud prevention, and instant settlement. Coinflow enables businesses to grow faster with instant settlement, fraud & chargeback indemnity, global pay-ins, multi-currency FX, and unified payouts. Founded in 2023, the company serves marketplaces, fintechs, remittance providers, gaming platforms, and ecommerce merchants worldwide.

Since our seed round in 2024, we’ve achieved 23x revenue growth and scaled to multi-billion-dollar annual transaction volume. In response to this growth, Coinflow announced a $25M Series A in October 2025—led by Pantera Capital, CMT Digital, Coinbase Ventures, Jump Crypto, and Reciprocal Ventures—accelerating our mission to power the world’s fastest-moving businesses with innovative, reliable global payments.

Coinflow is proudly headquartered in Chicago, IL. Learn more at coinflow.cash.

Role Overview

We're hiring a Principal Product Manager to own risk and decisioning across the Coinflow platform — the systems that decide, in real time, which transactions we approve and on what terms.

This is a role where product decisions carry direct P&L consequences. We don't pass risk through to our merchants; approval-rate and loss-rate outcomes land on our own books. That changes the job. Every threshold, model, and policy you ship is a bet with a cost, and you'll own both sides of it.

The surface area spans:

  • Real-time decisioning — the models, rules, and signals that evaluate transactions across 170+ countries and a multi-billion-dollar volume run rate

  • Loss economics — understanding where losses come from, what they cost, and how pricing and policy should respond

  • Merchant-facing risk product — giving merchants visibility into decisions, and control where they should have it

  • Risk operations tooling — the internal surfaces where analysts, underwriters, and ops teams do their work

You'll work directly with engineering, data science, finance, compliance, and our commercial team. This is a high-ownership, high-ambiguity role: limited structure, problems you'll identify before they're handed to you, and execution you'll drive end to end.

What You'll Do

  • Own the approval-rate and loss-rate tradeoff — set the policy, defend the position, and be accountable for both numbers

  • Productize risk models — work with data science to turn models into decisioning products with clear thresholds, monitoring, and failure behavior

  • Build the loss economics view — partner with finance to understand exposure at the portfolio and merchant level, and translate that into pricing and policy recommendations

  • Ship merchant-facing risk product — decisioning transparency, controls, and reporting that reduce support load and increase trust

  • Evaluate and integrate risk infrastructure — assess signal providers, data sources, and decisioning vendors across coverage, accuracy, cost, and technical fit

  • Make calls with incomplete data — much of this space has thin baselines and long feedback loops; you'll need to decide anyway, and instrument so you learn fast

What You Need

  • 7+ years of product management experience, including ownership of a technically complex or regulated surface area

  • Experience with products where a wrong decision costs the company money — lending, BNPL, issuing, insurance, risk, or payments products where your employer carried the loss rather than passing it downstream

  • Fluency with loss economics — you can reason about expected loss, unit economics, and how a policy change moves both revenue and exposure

  • Experience productizing models — you've shipped against precision/recall tradeoffs and know what breaks when a model meets production traffic

  • Track record of shipping end-to-end, from ambiguous problem to production, without a roadmap handed to you

  • Strong communication across technical and non-technical stakeholders — you'll be explaining risk posture to engineers, finance, and merchants in the same week

About You

  • Comfortable owning expensive decisions — you'd rather hold the number than advise on it

  • Rigorous with data, decisive without it — you instrument everything and let results change your mind, but you don't stall waiting for certainty that isn't coming

  • Operationally deep — you learn a workflow well enough to see what the people doing it can't

  • Attentive to edge cases and failure modes — in this domain the tail is where the money is

  • Raises the operating bar — you find the process held together by one person's memory and turn it into something that scales

  • Drawn to hard problems — payments risk is high-stakes and unglamorous, and that's the appeal

  • Founder or early-employee instincts — you've built from zero, with no team and no one to escalate to

Nice to Have

  • Fraud, underwriting, or credit risk product experience — you've owned a loss number, not just observed one

  • Cross-border payments experience — you've worked risk across markets with different rails, regulators, and fraud patterns

  • Product work under heavy regulatory constraint — NACHA, MiCA, BSA/AML, PSD2, or equivalent, where the regulation shaped the design

  • Actuarial, quantitative finance, or data science background — formal or informal

The base salary range for this role is $175,000 - $225,000 USD. The actual base salary offered depends on a variety of factors, including but not limited to experience, education, skills, qualifications and business needs.

In addition, the employee who fills this role will be eligible for an equity grant, allowing you to share in the long-term success of the company. You will also have access to a wide array of benefits, including health and wellness benefits, 401(k) savings plan, and flexible time off.

Join the team rewriting how money moves worldwide—and become a driving force in the $194 trillion cross-border payments market.

What You'll Do

  • Build market strategy for geographic expansion — research and prioritize new geographies, develop go-to-market strategy, identify product gaps, and ship the offerings that close them

  • Own global payments vendor procurement — identify pay-in and payout providers across target markets, run structured evaluations across pricing, coverage, compliance posture, and technical fit, drive MSA and legal review, and own the relationship post-onboarding

What You Need

  • Track record of shipping end-to-end — from ambiguous problem to production

  • Demonstrated ability to define a problem space and build the roadmap yourself

  • Strong communication skills and ability to work across technical and non-technical stakeholders

  • Working knowledge of payments rails — how pay-in and payout providers differ, what makes one better in a given market, and how vendor selection affects pricing, compliance exposure, and product capability

About You

  • High bias for action — you move fast, default to building, and unblock yourself

  • Operationally fluent — you can sit with a compliance analyst or underwriter, learn their workflow in depth, and translate it into product requirements

  • Raises the operating bar — you find the process that's held together by one person's memory and turn it into something that scales. Manual steps get automated, tribal knowledge gets documented, and the team gets faster because of work you did.

  • Obsessed with customer experience — you hold internal tools to the same UX bar as merchant-facing surfaces

  • Rigorous with data — you instrument what you ship, and let the numbers change your mind

  • Drawn to hard problems — payments and risk are high-stakes and unglamorous, and that's the appeal

  • Builder mindset — you take real ownership and treat the product like it's yours

Nice to Have

  • Cross-border or multi-market payments experience — you've launched in a market where the rails, regulator, and settlement mechanics were all unfamiliar

  • Risk or underwriting product work — you've shipped against approval-rate and loss-rate tradeoffs, not just funnel metrics

  • Product work under heavy regulatory constraint — you've shipped in an environment where the regulation shaped the design, not just the disclosure copy: NACHA, MiCA, BSA/AML, PSD2, or equivalent

  • Experience at a company that grew through your tenure — you've seen what breaks between Series A and Series C

The base salary range for this role is $175,000 - $225,000 USD. The actual base salary offered depends on a variety of factors, including but not limited to experience, education, skills, qualifications and business needs.

In addition, the employee who fills this role will be eligible for an equity grant, allowing you to share in the long-term success of the company. You will also have access to a wide array of benefits, including health and wellness benefits, 401(k) savings plan, and flexible time off.

Join the team rewriting how money moves worldwide—and become a driving force in the $194 trillion cross-border payments market.

title: Logistics & Expediting Manager
description:
ABOUT HUT 8

Imagine the ultimate destination for those who want to work at the cutting edge of technology, energy, and infrastructure. Hut 8 is on a mission to build and operate some of the world’s largest data centers for next-generation computing workloads, including AI, Colocation, Cloud, and Bitcoin Mining. We are proud to offer interesting and challenging opportunities for individuals who want to build teams, solve problems, and make an impact from day one. If you’re an ambitious individual looking for a career that is as rewarding as it is challenging, you’ve come to the right place.

ABOUT THE ROLE

The Logistics & Expediting Manager owns inbound logistics, freight, and delivery scheduling for major equipment on Hut 8's data center builds - and expedites the critical-path items that decide whether we energize on time. Transformers, switchgear, generators, and chillers are the longest levers in the schedule; this role makes sure they show up when the site needs them, intact, with no surprises.

Some of the key responsibilities you should expect are the following:

Logistics Planning & Heavy Haul

Own the inbound logistics plan for major equipment: transformers, MV/LV switchgear, generators, chillers, CDUs, and UPS systems. Plan heavy-haul routing and permits, escort and police coordination, bridge/road studies where needed, rigging and offload interfaces, and site delivery windows aligned to crane and laydown availability.

Vendor Expediting

Run structured expediting on critical-path POs: factory production milestone tracking, in-person or third-party factory visits, FAT scheduling coordination, and ship-date protection. Provide early warning the moment a vendor date is at risk - with a recovery option, not just the bad news.

Freight & Carrier Management

Select and manage freight forwarders, carriers, and heavy-haul specialists. Manage freight terms, insurance requirements, and OS&D claims; handle customs brokerage and import compliance for international equipment where applicable.

Delivery Scheduling & Site Coordination

Maintain the rolling delivery lookahead with the Materials Manager, superintendents, and planner/scheduler. Sequence deliveries against installation need dates and site constraints, and referee conflicts when multiple critical loads compete for the same window.

Issue Resolution

Resolve shipping damage, shortage, mis-delivery, and storage-in-transit issues fast, with clean documentation supporting claims and vendor accountability.

Reporting & Process

Report logistics status, risks, and expediting actions into the weekly project rhythm. Build Hut 8's logistics playbook: preferred carriers, routing lessons, and delivery requirements baked into future POs.

 

ABOUT YOU

-      What we're looking for:

- 6+ years in project logistics, traffic, or expediting for major capital projects - data center, power generation, oil & gas, or heavy industrial.

- Hands-on heavy-haul experience: permits, routing studies, escorts, and rigging interfaces for loads in the 100k-500k+ lb class.

- Vendor expediting depth: factory milestone tracking, FAT logistics, and holding OEMs accountable to ship dates.

- Freight commercial fluency: Incoterms, carrier contracts, cargo insurance, and claims.

- Customs/import experience for international equipment a plus.

- Strong scheduling instincts and comfort working directly against a P6-driven need-date list.

- Calm, solution-first operator when a load is stuck, damaged, or late.

- Proficiency with logistics tracking tools and Excel; ERP exposure a plus.

- Travel to factories, ports, and project sites as needed (typically 25-40%).

ABOUT THE WORK ENVIRONMENT

This role is full-time on site.

WHAT MAKES HUT 8 A GREAT PLACE TO WORK

Hut 8 offers a benefits and wellness program that includes medical, dental, vision, life, and short-term and long-term disability insurance, as well as paid time off. We are proud to invest in building the best team in the industry. At all levels of the organization, we are driven by an entrepreneurial spirit, radical transparency, and relentless growth mentality.

At Hut 8, you will have the opportunity to:

▶ Work with bright, driven peers from a range of educational and professional backgrounds including software development, energy, engineering, entrepreneurship, investment banking, private equity, and management consulting

▶ Design and pitch new products, services, and other initiatives to a leadership team consisting of serial entrepreneurs and seasoned executives and backed by a board of directors consisting of industry veterans of energy, finance, and government

▶ Debate ideas and alternatives in a truly meritocratic setting where the learning curve is steep and the lessons come from both senior and junior members of the team

▶ Build a lifelong network of friends and professional connections at the cutting-edge intersection of technology, energy, and infrastructure

title: Creative Operations Manager, Media & Trafficking
description:
About Polymarket

Polymarket is the world's largest prediction market platform. We enable individuals to express views on real-world events by trading on outcomes across politics, economics, sports, culture, and current affairs. Built as a peer-to-peer marketplace with no centralized "house," Polymarket aggregates diverse opinions into transparent, market-based probabilities that reflect collective expectations about the future.

We're growing fast, both in terms of volume ($21B traded in 2025) and adoption as an alternative news source. Our ambition is to become a ubiquitous beacon of truth in global media and we need your help adding fuel to the fire.

About the Role

As Creative Operations Manager, you own everything between a finished asset and a live, measurable impression. That means trafficking, ad server architecture, spec management, agency coordination, and the tracking infrastructure that makes attribution trustworthy. You're the person every channel depends on to launch clean and on time, and the person analytics depends on to trust the data coming back.

This is a senior individual contributor role with real ownership. You won't inherit a functioning system. You'll build one, document it, and hold every internal and external stakeholder to it. If you treat operational rigor as a product rather than a queue, this is the right job.

What You'll Do

  • Own end-to-end trafficking across linear TV, streaming, audio, podcast, display, video, programmatic, and social, including tag generation, creative uploads, QA, launch, and in-flight troubleshooting.

  • Run and maintain the ad server: campaign and placement architecture, naming conventions, taxonomy, creative rotation logic, and permissions, kept clean enough that anyone can pull a report and trust what they see.

  • Build and manage the creative operations calendar, working backward from flight dates to set asset deadlines, spec deliveries, review gates, and approval windows, and hold every party to them without exception.

  • Own the spec library across every channel and partner, covering durations, file sizes, bitrates, aspect ratios, safe zones, loudness standards, and closed captioning requirements, and get specs to creative early enough to actually matter.

  • Build the tracking and measurement layer alongside analytics: click and impression trackers, conversion pixels, UTM governance, verification wrapping, and a consistent taxonomy so attribution reporting reconciles across platforms.

  • Investigate and resolve discrepancies between ad server, platform, and partner reporting, document root cause, and put fixes in place so the same issue doesn't recur.

  • Manage agency, vendor, and platform relationships day to day, acting as the operational point of contact and escalating with enough detail that problems get solved on the first pass.

What We're Looking For

  • 5 or more years in ad operations, creative operations, or campaign management, ideally spanning both brand side and agency experience.

  • Hands-on trafficking experience across CTV and streaming, audio, and programmatic environments, with working knowledge of current spec and loudness standards and why they get creative rejected.

  • Direct ad server experience with Campaign Manager 360, Innovid, or Flashtalking, including tag generation, floodlight or conversion setup, and creative QA.

  • Fluency with VAST and VPAID, JavaScript and iframe tags, click trackers, impression pixels, and rich media formats. You can debug a tag yourself, not just forward the error.

  • Programmatic operations experience across DSPs and verification vendors such as DoubleVerify or IAS.

  • Demonstrated ownership of process: you have personally built the naming conventions, spec sheets, intake systems, or trackers that a team now depends on.

  • Working understanding of attribution and measurement, enough to build tracking that analytics can actually use and to explain clearly why two platforms disagree.

  • Exceptional organization and follow-through, with the judgment to know which slipping deadline is manageable and which one blocks a launch.

  • (Plus) Experience trafficking regulated categories such as fintech, trading platforms, or gaming, including disclaimer and compliance workflows.

  • (Plus) Familiarity with dynamic creative optimization, creative versioning at scale, or asset management systems.

  • (Plus) Working knowledge of SQL or ad server APIs for automating reporting and QA work.

  • (Plus) Experience standing up an operations function from scratch rather than inheriting one.

  • (Plus) Formal ad server credentials such as Innovid or Flashtalking campaign management certifications.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary & equity

  • Unlimited PTO

  • Full Health, Vision, & Dental coverage

  • 401k match

  • Hardware setup: new MacBook Pro, big display, & accessories

title: Performance Marketing Lead, International
description:
About Polymarket

Polymarket is the world's largest prediction market platform. We enable individuals to express views on real-world events by trading on outcomes across politics, economics, sports, culture, and current affairs. Built as a peer-to-peer marketplace with no centralized "house," Polymarket aggregates diverse opinions into transparent, market-based probabilities that reflect collective expectations about the future.

We're growing fast, both in terms of volume ($21B traded in 2025) and adoption as an alternative news source. Our ambition is to become a ubiquitous beacon of truth in global media and we need your help adding fuel to the fire.

About the Role

The role is to build a systematic, scaled approach to paid international acquisition. This role exists to build that from scratch, with full ownership of the channels, markets, budgets, and outcomes.

You'll sit inside the Growth team and own everything related to international performance marketing: programmatic at scale, market prioritization, creative localization, non-traditional acquisition channels, and the measurement infrastructure to know what's actually working. The mandate is funded users and trading volume, not impressions or installs. You'll report directly to leadership and be the person who decides where capital goes and why.

This is the right role if you've built something real in a difficult category, have genuine fluency in crypto, and want accountability that matches your ambition. It's the wrong role if you need a lot of process in place before you can move.

What You'll Do

  • Own international paid acquisition end to end, with clear accountability for funded users, CAC, payback period, and trading volume across every market we operate in.

  • Build and manage our global channel mix from the ground up, leading programmatic as the scaled foundation while identifying and testing non-obvious channels that others haven't prioritized yet.

  • Prioritize markets with discipline, deciding where we invest first based on unit economics, adoption signals, competitive dynamics, and operating requirements, then localizing the full experience properly rather than just translating copy.

  • Build the measurement layer for an on-chain product, including wallet-level attribution, on-chain conversion tracking, geographic holdouts, and incrementality testing that separates real lift from growth we would have captured anyway.

  • Coordinate with legal and compliance on every market we enter, clearing creatives and campaigns against local requirements without letting process become an excuse to move slowly.

  • Support non-traditional acquisition alongside paid media, including creator partnerships, affiliate and referral programs, on-chain incentives, and community-led growth, applying the same rigor to these channels as to media buying.

  • Own forecasting, budget allocation, and channel mix modeling across markets, and build the reporting infrastructure that lets leadership move capital quickly and with conviction.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years in performance marketing or paid acquisition, with a clear track record of scaling spend efficiently and owning outcomes, not just executing plans.

  • Deep programmatic expertise at meaningful spend scale, including supply path optimization, inventory quality, fraud mitigation, and audience strategy across multiple markets.

  • Real multi-market, multi-language campaign experience, with genuine judgment about what localizes and what doesn't, and the ability to explain what your unit economics looked like across different geographies.

  • Hands-on use of crypto and on-chain products. You understand how wallets, chains, stablecoins, and on-ramps actually work, not just at a conceptual level.

  • Experience operating in a compliance-heavy or regulated category where market-by-market requirements shaped how campaigns were built and approved.

  • Strong analytical foundation across attribution, incrementality testing, geographic experiments, and cohort economics. You can separate real lift from noise and explain your methodology clearly.

title: Paid Search Manager
description:
About Polymarket

Polymarket is the world's largest prediction market platform. We enable individuals to express views on real-world events by trading on outcomes across politics, economics, sports, culture, and current affairs. Built as a peer-to-peer marketplace with no centralized "house," Polymarket aggregates diverse opinions into transparent, market-based probabilities that reflect collective expectations about the future.

We're growing fast, both in terms of volume ($21B traded in 2025) and adoption as an alternative news source. Our ambition is to become a ubiquitous beacon of truth in global media and we need your help adding fuel to the fire.

About the Role

Polymarket's Growth team owns the full acquisition funnel, from first impression to first deposit. We move fast because the product does. Markets open and close in hours, major events drive massive spikes in intent, and the window to capture demand is often narrow. Paid search sits at the center of that challenge: it's where existing intent meets our product, and converting that intent efficiently is one of the highest-leverage things we can do right now.

This role owns demand capture end to end across Google and Apple. That means Search, Performance Max, Demand Gen, YouTube, UAC, and Apple Search Ads, all under one roof, with full accountability for CAC, LTV, and payback. You'll be the person building the account architecture, owning the measurement layer, and making the budget allocation calls. There's no committee. There's no one above you in the channel who will catch mistakes or set the direction.

The challenge is real. Prediction markets are a new category for most users, the ad environment is regulated, and the news cycle never stops. The person who wins in this role is someone who treats account structure as a competitive advantage, builds systems so that launching around a major event takes minutes not hours, and reads marginal return data rather than blended averages to make allocation decisions.

What You'll Do

  • Own paid search and app marketing end to end across Google Search, Performance Max, Demand Gen, YouTube, UAC, and Apple Search Ads, with direct accountability for CAC, LTV, payback period, and incremental revenue.

  • Build and maintain account architecture that holds up at scale, covering campaign structure, bid strategy, budget pacing, negative keyword hygiene, and audience signals across web and app environments.

  • Mine the full keyword and query surface continuously, including competitor conquesting, brand defense, category expansion, and identifying demand signals before competitors price them in.

  • Build and own the measurement layer for the channel, including conversion tracking, MMP integration, SKAdNetwork and AEM setup, and incrementality testing that separates captured demand from created demand.

  • Allocate large budgets across campaign types, devices, geos, and platforms based on marginal return, and own the forecasting and reporting that keeps leadership informed and able to act quickly.

  • Partner with creative on ad copy, extensions, sitelinks, video assets, app store creative, and landing page experiences that close the loop between search query and conversion.

  • Be first on new platform betas, campaign types, and bidding products, with a clear framework for what to test, how to read the result, and when to kill it.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in paid search or app marketing, ideally in consumer tech, fintech, or a high-growth startup.

  • Deep expertise across Google Ads, specifically Search, Performance Max, Demand Gen, YouTube, and UAC, including scaled budget management and bid strategy decisions.

  • Real fluency in Apple Search Ads, including campaign structure, Creative Sets, and store-level conversion dynamics.

  • Demonstrated full-channel ownership: you have built or rebuilt an account from scratch and can walk through every structural decision and explain why it held up as spend grew.

  • Cross-environment buying experience across web and mobile app, with genuine fluency in MMP integration, SKAdNetwork, AEM, and how app measurement differs from web.

  • Strong analytical foundation, including experience with attribution modeling, incrementality testing, geo experiments, and performance forecasting tied to depositing users, not just clicks.

  • Proven ability to scale spend while holding or improving CAC, LTV, and payback period, with allocation decisions driven by marginal return rather than channel-level averages.

  • (Plus) Experience navigating regulated ad categories in fintech, crypto, or financial products, including platform policy constraints and approval workflows.

  • (Plus) Proficiency with Google Ads scripts or the API for reporting automation, bid management, or feed operations.

  • (Plus) Background in trading, crypto, sports betting, or financial products, where market timing and category sensitivity affect campaign decisions.

  • (Plus) Experience running paid search alongside a large paid social program, with a clear view on cross-channel overlap and how to measure it.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary & equity

  • Unlimited PTO

  • Full Health, Vision, & Dental coverage

  • 401k match

  • Hardware setup: new MacBook Pro, big display, & accessories

title: Senior Marketing Associate - Social & Community
description:
Stronghold's mission is to provide fast, secure, and accessible financial services for all. Through our developer APIs, we enable pay-by-bank embedded payments and financial services while pushing the boundaries of financial innovation. Our SHx token is a key component of our ecosystem, supporting merchant rewards, DeFi-based financing, and governance.

We're a fast-moving, data-driven team committed to compliance, scalability, and innovation. We value curiosity, autonomy, and creative problem solving and we're looking for someone excited to bring a marketing edge.

As our Senior Marketing Associate, you'll work across Stronghold and SHx to produce high-quality marketing content that supports social growth, campaign execution, and product storytelling. You'll manage and grow our online communities, serving as the team's ear to the ground on community sentiment by surfacing trends, concerns, and feedback and reporting findings back regularly. You'll operate in a fast-paced, execution-heavy role where you collaborate with the team to bring our brand voice to life across multiple platforms. This role reports to the Director of Marketing.

What You’ll Do

  • Execute daily operations for Stronghold and SHx’s social presence (X, LinkedIn, YouTube, Discord, TikTok, Instagram).

  • Manage and grow online communities, including moderating conversations, responding to questions, and keeping members informed on product and ecosystem updates.

  • Serve as the team's ear to the ground and monitor community sentiment, surface emerging trends or concerns, and report findings back to the team regularly.

  • Use creative tooling to create marketing collateral: social assets, blog posts, visuals, email campaigns.

  • Manage a content calendar across channels in partnership with the team.

  • Repurpose long-form content into formats fit for social, email, or web.

  • Monitor engagement metrics and report insights to improve future campaigns.

  • Support campaign execution for SHx marketing, governance updates, and merchant rewards programs.

  • Stay current on fintech and crypto trends to inform timely, relevant content across both Stronghold and SHx audiences.

What You’ll Own

In the first 6–12 months, you are the person who:

  • Manages the content calendar across Stronghold’s social media ecosystem.

  • Owns the response layer: replies, moderation, and the tone people associate with Stronghold and SHx.

  • Owns the feedback loop that carries community signals back to marketing, product, and leadership.

  • Owns the reporting that informs channel strategy, and brings a point of view to planning not just a dashboard.

Stronghold is growing fast and SHx keeps finding new audiences. That means the channels get more interesting, not more repetitive. If you want a seat where the work compounds instead of resetting every quarter, this is it.

Who You Are

  • 3–7 years of experience in marketing, content, or social roles.

  • Strong writing skills with an eye for tone, clarity, and brand alignment.

  • Proficiency with AI tools and visual design platforms.

  • You’ve managed or contributed to social media channels and online communities.

  • Comfortable supporting brand voice and campaigns across both B2B and crypto-native audiences.

  • You’re organized, creative, self-motivated, and good at hitting deadlines.

  • Bonus: Familiarity with Discord, Telegram, Canva, Notion, HubSpot, or Figma.

Compensation & Details

  • Salary range: $110-130k per year

  • Location: Must be located within a 25-mile radius of San Francisco; hybrid office schedule required.

  • Perks & Benefits: Health benefits, hands-on experience with leading-edge fintech and blockchain initiatives, and a team that values speed, curiosity, and autonomy.

If you’re ready to help grow SHx and Stronghold by executing fast and learning faster, we want to talk to you.

Interview Process

Recruiter screen, then hiring manager, then a short project (~1.5 hours) plus a remote panel (~1–1.5 hours). The project is a slice of the real job (posts, calendar, a community reply), not a strategy memo.

As an equal opportunity employer, Stronghold does not discriminate against any applicant or employee based on race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, religion, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, military or veteran status, genetic information or any other basis protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws.

Authorized to work in the United States (required)

No visa sponsorship available at this time

AI is not a feature at Chainalysis - it is a new way of working. title: Senior Go Engineer (Distributed Data Systems), Presence
Senior Data Engineer
description:
About the company

Trust Wallet is the leading non-custodial cryptocurrency wallet, trusted by over 200 million people worldwide to securely manage and grow their digital assets. Our vision is to give individuals the freedom to own their assets, confidently participate in the future economy, and access opportunities that enhance their lives. Our mission is to be a trusted personal companion — helping users safely navigate Web3, the on-chain economy, and the emerging AI-powered future. With support for over 10 million assets across 100+ blockchains, Trust Wallet offers a seamless, multi-chain experience backed by industry-leading self-custody technology, a vibrant community, and a growing ecosystem of partners.

About the Role

As a Senior Data Engineer, you will play a key role in building and scaling the data platform that powers analytics across Trust Wallet. You'll be responsible for designing, developing and maintaining data pipelines and data models, ensuring a seamless, scalable and reliable flow of data from source systems through to the decisions it supports. Leveraging your experience with Databricks and Spark across both streaming and batch workloads, dbt or a similar transformation framework, cloud infrastructure, and custom solutions in Python, you'll work closely with our data analysts and engineering teams to turn data into a strategic asset for our company.

Key Responsibilities

  • Data Platform Engineering: Architect and maintain robust, scalable and secure data infrastructure on Databricks, covering both streaming and batch workloads.

  • Data Pipeline Development: Design, develop and maintain data pipelines, primarily in Python and Spark, to automate ingestion and transformation across internal systems, external providers and on-chain sources.

  • Data Modelling: Design and maintain dimensional data models and transformation layers in dbt, with tests and documented contracts, so metrics are consistent and reusable across the company.

  • Data Lake Management: Oversee the data lake and lakehouse layers, ensuring efficient storage, effective partitioning, high data quality, and monitoring and alerting that surfaces issues early.

  • Integration and Customisation: Integrate Databricks with a wide range of data sources, including change data capture from operational databases, third-party APIs and blockchain data, and adapt data flows to specific business needs.

  • Performance, Scalability and Cost: Optimise pipelines and storage for performance, reliability and cost efficiency at scale.

  • Data Governance and Security: Apply best practices for governance, security and compliance in cloud and Databricks environments, including access control, encryption and monitoring.

  • Collaboration and Documentation: Work closely with platform engineers, data analysts and other stakeholders to understand data requirements, and document infrastructure, models and best practices.

Required Qualifications

  • Experience in Data Engineering: 3+ years as a Data Engineer, with hands-on ownership of production pipelines and lakehouse or data warehouse architecture.

  • Databricks and Spark: Strong practical experience with Databricks, Delta Lake and Spark, including both streaming and batch processing, and the judgement to choose between them.

  • Data Modelling: Solid understanding of dimensional modelling, slowly changing dimensions and data warehouse design, with the ability to define and defend the grain of the models you build.

  • Transformation Frameworks: Experience with dbt or an equivalent framework for managing transformations, testing and lineage.

  • Cloud Proficiency: Strong cloud fundamentals, including identity and access management, object storage, networking and infrastructure as code. We run on AWS; deep experience with Azure or GCP transfers well.

  • Proficiency in Python and SQL: Comfortable writing production transformations as well as services and connectors.

  • Data Quality and Governance: Experience implementing testing, monitoring and governance practices in cloud data environments.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with change data capture and replication from operational databases

  • Familiarity with blockchain or on-chain data

  • Infrastructure as code, ideally Terraform, and CI/CD for data workloads

  • Experience with BI and semantic layers such as Holistics, Looker or similar

  • Containerisation and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes)

Additional Information

This is a global and fully remote role. You must have the right to work for the country you are based.

Why work at Trust Wallet?

  • Be a part of the world’s leading blockchain ecosystem that continues to grow.

  • Excellent learning and career development opportunities.

  • Work alongside diverse, world-class talent, in an environment where learning and growth opportunities are endless.

  • Tackle fast-paced, challenging and unique projects.

  • Work in a truly global organization, with international teams and a flat organizational structure.

  • Work fully remotely with flexible working hours.

  • Enjoy competitive salary and benefits.

Apply today to join our team in building the world’s most trusted and secure crypto wallet and enable a decentralized future for everyone.

Trust Wallet is committed to being an equal opportunity employer. We believe that having a diverse workforce is fundamental to our success.

*Due to the large amount of the applications, please consider your application as unsuccessful should you not be contacted within 4 weeks from your application date.

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

The Consumer team owns the Kraken app experience used by millions of traders and crypto newcomers worldwide, the product that turns someone's first crypto curiosity into a long-term relationship with Kraken. We build the interfaces people actually use to buy, sell, manage their portfolio, and interact with their assets. Our stack is React on web and React Native on mobile, and we ship fast, measure everything, and iterate based on real user behaviour. We work agile, globally distributed, and we care as much about why we build something as how we build it.

We're looking for a world-class Senior Frontend Engineer to join our product-minded engineering team: we care about customer problems, measurable outcomes, frontend craft, and fast iteration. We work across web and mobile surfaces, partner closely with Product, Design, Data, and Platform teams, and use experimentation, observability, and user behaviour to guide what we build next.

 

The opportunity

  • Design, develop, and maintain high-quality consumer-facing features across web (React) and mobile (React Native), owning the full experience from concept to production monitoring.

  • Own the full lifecycle of product work, from discovery and technical design through release, monitoring, experimentation, and iteration.

  • Drive A/B testing and experimentation strategies forming hypotheses, designing experiments, analysing results, and iterating based on data.

  • Partner with Product, Design, Data, and Mobile engineers to create coherent experiences across Kraken’s consumer surfaces.

  • Make opinionated technical decisions on framework and architecture choices (we want engineers who have strong views on things like TanStack Router vs Next.js App Router and can back them up with real experience).

  • Set the standard for high-quality code — functional correctness, accessibility, performance, and testability are non-negotiables.

  • Mentor engineers across seniority levels and contribute to a culture of craft and continuous improvement.

  • Lead and collaborate on complex cross-platform initiatives, driving alignment across web and mobile surfaces.

  • Stay ahead of the curve on React ecosystem tooling, React Server Components, concurrent features, streaming, and bring those insights back to the team.

  • Work AI-natively, we use AI tools across the full SDLC and expect engineers to have a structured, opinionated workflow, not just autocomplete.

 
 

What you bring

  • 6+ years of professional software development experience with a strong focus on consumer-facing web and/or mobile products.

  • Deep expertise in TypeScript and the React ecosystem, you have opinions about state management, data fetching patterns, and component architecture, and you can articulate the trade-offs.

  • Production experience with React Native and cross-platform mobile development, including App Store and Google Play release pipelines.

  • Experience with Next.js — specifically familiarity with App Router, React Server Components, and the client/server boundary decisions that come with them.

  • Hands-on experience with A/B testing, feature flags, and experimentation frameworks (LaunchDarkly, Optimizely, or similar).

  • Experience with WebSockets or Server-Sent Events for real-time UI updates.

  • Strong testing culture Jest, React Testing Library, Playwright or Cypress, and the judgement to know when to use each.

  • Familiarity with modern build tooling (Vite, Webpack, CI/CD pipelines) and performance profiling.

  • Experience in fintech, crypto, payments, or other high-trust consumer products where correctness and user confidence matter.

  • Strong written and verbal English, you can write a clear RFC, give direct feedback in a PR review, and explain a technical trade-off to a non-technical stakeholder.

  • An active AI-assisted development workflow, Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, or equivalent with the engineering rigour to review and own what gets produced.

OKX will be prioritising applicants who have a current right to work in Hong Kong, and do not require OKX's sponsorship of a visa.

Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.
 
OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. 
 
Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.

OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.
 

About The Opportunity

Our Trading Product Group leads the design of all the products on OKX's derivatives trading exchange, including spot trading, spot margin, futures, leveraged tokens, trading options, etc.
We seek a senior trading product manager to join the Trading team.
The successful candidate will manage the development and delivery of our product, including defining and executing product strategy, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and ensuring that our product meets the needs of traders in onboarding and Spot & Derivatives trading experience.

What You’ll Be Doing 

  • Plan and design risk monitoring and risk-related solutions for our crypto asset trading products, including mark price, liquidation system, insurance fund, etc.
  • Optimize risk control rules, improve the efficiency of the risk control system, reduce the probability of and losses from abnormal events, and increase the amount and growth rate of the insurance fund.
  • Monitor risks and collect feedback on our risk control system after its launch, and continue to optimize the system based on effective iterative mechanisms.
  • Monitor project progress and coordinate with developers, designers, market team, operation team and other departments.
  • Instruct junior product managers to form a methodology on risk control products.

What We Look For In You 

  • Bachelor's degree with product manager experience, preferably from a well-known internet or blockchain company.
  • Have a strong interest in trading, blockchain and the financial industry.
  • Solid product design and project management knowledge, especially skilled at discovering user demands through data analysis.
  • Ability to think logically, work in a team and communicate effectively. Be able to organize and coordinate resources to solve problems and achieve goals in collaboration with different departments.
  • Proactive, enthusiastic, responsible to our customers and your team.
  • Proficient in English language, Chinese Language is an added bonus but not a requirement (to work cross functionally with the tech team).

Nice-To-Haves 

  • Experience in designing or trading financial products such as stocks, funds, forex, futures, options is preferred.
  • Having in-depth insight based on data analysis, with extensive experience using Excel, SQL, Python and other tools for data processing and analysis is preferred.

Perks & Benefits 

  • Competitive total compensation package
  • L&D programs and education subsidy for employees' growth and development
  • Various team building programs and company events
  • Wellness and meal allowances
  • Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
  • More that we love to tell you along the process!


Please note that Hong Kong is a group-level service hub, and OKX does not carry on a business of operating a virtual asset trading platform in Hong Kong.

title: Product Manager / Director, Trading Risk (Parameter Management & Price Protection)
description:
OKX will be prioritising applicants who have a current right to work in Hong Kong, and do not require OKX's sponsorship of a visa.

Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.
 
OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. 
 
Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.

OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.
 

About The Opportunity

The Core Trading Risk Product team builds the core trading infrastructure and platform-level risk capabilities that support OKX’s spot and derivatives businesses across multiple account and margin modes.
We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead the delivery of trading risk workflow automation, agentic parameter governance, agent-driven execution, and foundational price-protection capabilities. Your scope will also include margin-tier rules, collateral haircuts, price limits, index price, and mark price across spot, derivatives, and Perp DEX scenarios.
You will work closely with Risk Management, Quantitative Research, Engineering, Data, Trading Operations, Legal, Compliance, and regional market teams to translate risk-control methodologies into configurable, verifiable, and observable platform capabilities. Success in this role means continuously improving liquidity, users’ capital efficiency, and the trading experience while safeguarding platform resilience and market integrity.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Drive product planning and roadmap execution. Own product discovery and delivery across risk parameter governance, AI-agent workflow automation, controlled execution, and price protection. Translate risk-control needs and operating SOPs into product requirements, priorities, 3-12-month delivery plans, and success metrics; partner with engineering, risk, quant, data, and operations teams to launch, measure adoption, and iterate.
  • Research and iterate on risk-control methodologies. Research, formulate, and continuously improve risk-control methodologies, including pricing logic, risk-scoring models, and approaches for handling market volatility.
  • Build platform-level risk controls. Build and optimize platform-level risk-control mechanisms to ensure stability under extreme market conditions.
  • Drive effective implementation of risk systems. Collaborate with engineers, quants, data analysts, and other stakeholders to ensure risk systems are effectively implemented and continuously monitored.
  • Drive continuous improvement. Continuously improve the product through feedback loops and retrospective analysis of past market incidents or system performance.
  • Stay close to markets and users. Maintain regular communication with traders, institutional clients, and market-making teams. Continuously study crypto and traditional financial market structures, competitor mechanisms, and regulatory changes; determine when to lead and when to fast-follow; and adjust product priorities accordingly.
  • Strengthen team methodologies and AI leverage. Codify risk product methodologies, decision records, parameter dictionaries, and incident case libraries, and mentor other product managers. Design automation and AI-native workflows to improve efficiency in analysis, configuration review, monitoring and troubleshooting, documentation, and product operations..

What We Look For In You 

  • Five or more years of product management experience in trading-related domains. Be familiar with trading system principles, understanding users' trading, and be able to identify risky scenarios.
  • An AI-native approach to work, with the ability to design multi-step automation or agentic workflows incorporating tool use, retrieval, evaluation, and human-review checkpoints, together with an understanding of the access-control and audit boundaries required in risk-control contexts.
  • Strong systems thinking and technical judgment, with the ability to work closely with engineering and quantitative teams on real-time, highly available, data-intensive systems and the related configuration, monitoring, resilience, and audit requirements.
  • Experience in data-driven product decision-making and risk change management, with the ability to define effective metrics and drive continuous improvement through simulation, backtesting, stress testing, production monitoring, and incident reviews.
  • Mature cross-functional leadership and project execution capabilities.
  • Rigorous logical thinking, clear written and verbal communication, and fluency in both Chinese and English, with the ability to collaborate effectively with clients and cross-functional teams across global and Chinese-language working environments.
  • A bachelor’s degree or higher, preferably in a quantitative or technical field such as Computer Science, Finance, Engineering, or Mathematics.
     

Nice-To-Haves

  • A deep understanding of the trading and risk mechanisms for spot, margin, perpetuals, expiry futures, or options, with familiarity with core concepts including the order lifecycle, margin, leverage, liquidation, position tiers, index price, mark price, and price limits.
  • Experience working at a digital asset exchange, securities or futures exchange, brokerage, clearing platform, market-making firm, quantitative trading firm, or another high-throughput trading environment.
  • Experience scaling automation, AI agents, or human-in-the-loop workflows in safety-critical environments.

Perks & Benefits 

  • Competitive total compensation package
  • L&D programs and education subsidy for employees' growth and development
  • Various team building programs and company events
  • Wellness and meal allowances
  • Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
  • More that we love to tell you along the process!

Who We Are:

Galaxy Digital Inc. (Nasdaq: GLXY) is a global leader in digital assets and data center infrastructure, growing the economy that runs on code. Galaxy delivers the onchain infrastructure that connects institutions to digital assets, including trading, advisory, asset management, staking, self-custody, and tokenization. The Galaxy Internship Program offers students the opportunity to gain hands-on, practical experience while contributing to meaningful work across the business. As a Cybersecurity Intern on Galaxy’s Product Security team, you will help support the development and refinement of secure engineering standards used by our software and production engineering teams. These standards may include areas such as authentication and authorization, secure API communication, web UI security, and secure coding practices. The intern will help enhance existing guidance with more specific implementation details and may support the development of custom libraries, artifacts, or other resources that help engineering teams apply these standards effectively.

  • Experience using Generative AI tooling such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or similar Large Language Model (LLM) tools.
  • Pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a related technical field
  • General knowledge of the cryptocurrency ecosystem
  • Interest in product development, secure engineering, and cybersecurity best practices
  • Strong communication, problem-solving, and collaboration skills

Eligibility Requirements

  • Undergraduate or master’s students graduating between December 2026 and June 2027
  • Eligible master’s students must have fewer than two years of relevant, full-time work experience
  • Students enrolled in PhD, MBA, or JD programs are not eligible to apply

Program Dates: Fall Semester 

Location: Remote UK / Remote US

Compensation: $55/hr.

description:
The exchange team develops and maintain a cutting-edge trading platform. With a global presence across APAC, EMEA and North America, the team has since grown with the goal to provide a seamless and secure trading experience for our clients.

Exchange Support team is responsible for maintaining global system for the firm’s cryptocurrency trading business which operates 24x7. This team provides L2/L3 support to Business users and has full ownership of the production environment for all key business lines (Exchange platform, Risk management system, Backoffice, Market data and non-trading activities). We are adding strong technology focused team members for various position in the Exchange Production Support team.

Responsibilities

    Primary responsibility includes but not limited to
  • User Management: Provide technical support to Sales, Business Users, Institutional and Retail customer base with focus on application support, API support and network connectivity.
  • Incident Management: Identification and resolution of production incidents. The roles requires end-to-end ownership of Production issues, collaborating with various technical and business support teams, escalation and resolution of incident in timely manner.
  • Process Management: Take ownership of all release activities, participate in audit reviews and execute BCP exercise. Ensure Process Management continue to meet ITIL best practice standards, SLA and Client expectations.
  • Operations Management: Monitor and automate application and infrastructure alerts to ensure timely actions are taken to maintain system stability and uptime for all the applications. Maintain knowledge repository and standard operating procedure documentation.
  • Continuous Improvement: Identify area of improvements, implement process optimization, automation of manual task and improve the service level the team provides to the end users.
    •  

Required Skills

  • 2+ years of production support experience preferably within the Banking or Financial Service industry.
  • Technical Skills: Experience with UNIX commands in debugging , SQLs and Bash/Python scripting. Previous experience on supporting FIX protocol and APIs is must.
  • Strong technical understanding of Linux/Java based systems with exposure to Cloud Technology and DevOps utilities.
  • Good knowledge of monitoring, visualization and scheduling tools like Grafana, Prometheus, Control-M, ITRS Geneos, Dynatrace or similar utilities.
  • Service oriented with strong Incident handling & troubleshooting skills. ITIL certification preferred.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills (English). Ability to communicate with different Stakeholders and interfacing teams in clear and concise manner.
  • Required experience in supporting Trading System (OMS/EMS) with exposure to Equities, Derivatives, FX or Cryptocurrency Trading domain.
  • Must be able to work under high pressure, handle multiple priorities, result driven with attention to details and deliver to demanding deadlines.
  • Self-starter and able to quickly pickup new concepts, business areas and technologies.
  • Open to shift work and weekend support.
