title: Head of Community and Ecosystem
description:
About the Organization

World Foundation serves as the steward of World, an open-source protocol supported by a global community of developers, individuals, economists, and technologists.

World is building a real human network designed to accelerate people in the age of AI. As bots and autonomous agents reshape the internet, people, institutions, and applications need a trusted way to confirm who is a real human while preserving privacy.

The Foundation supports and expands the network’s self-sufficiency, including through protocol governance, grants, community affairs, and ecosystem development. Tools for Humanity is a core World contributor and operates World App. This role is hired by and represents the World Foundation.

The Opportunity

As AI and autonomous agents reshape the internet, proving who is human while preserving privacy is becoming critical infrastructure. World ID already serves as a trust layer for consumer platforms and enterprises, and our goal is to make World ID the default trust layer for agents. This role leads that push.

We're seeking a Head of Community and Ecosystem to define and lead the voice of the World Foundation and World Chain across the AI, Web3, technology, and broader digital communities.

This is a senior, hands-on role for someone who knows crypto and AI inside out, has a proven track record in building credibility across influential communities, and can ensure that World Foundation is represented in the online and offline conversations and events that matter most.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the integrated communications strategy and narrative for World Foundation, World Chain, and the broader World ecosystem.

  • Build a strong presence across crypto-native channels, especially X.com, while supporting broader media and public communications.

  • Ensure World Foundation has a voice in important AI, Web3, digital identity, privacy, and emerging technology conversations.

  • Identify important AI and Web3 conferences, events, and communities, and ensure the Foundation is represented in the right places.

  • Build relationships with developers, builders, researchers, investors, founders, opinion leaders, media (traditional and new or emerging), and ecosystem partners.

  • Translate complex technical, governance, and ecosystem work into clear communications for different audiences.

  • Partner with Tools for Humanity’s communications and marketing teams to coordinate messaging and represent the Foundation’s perspective.

  • Manage the Events Manager and Grants Specialist, and lead external communications, community, and growth agencies and contractors where appropriate.

  • Support the Foundation’s grants and ecosystem strategy by identifying high-leverage partners and opportunities.

  • Travel regularly to build relationships and represent World at relevant events.

What We’re Looking For

  • Significant experience in strategic communications, community, ecosystem, media, or a related function, ideally in crypto, AI, technology, or open source.

  • Fluency in Web3 and AI communities, including the leading companies, researchers, founders, conferences, and industry conversations.

  • Excellent writing, communication, and judgment, with experience engaging technical audiences, developers, founders, investors, media, and opinion leaders.

  • Experience managing teams and overseeing communications, community, or growth agencies and contractors.

  • Ability to build trusted relationships and operate independently in a fast-moving environment.

  • Willingness to travel approximately 20–25% of the time.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with grants, ecosystem development, partnerships, or community programs.

  • Existing relationships across AI, crypto, developer, research, media, and technology communities.

Who You Are

  • You’re fluent in crypto and know how to engage credibly with its communities.

  • You are genuinely interested in AI and have existing relationships across AI, crypto, developer, research, and technology communities.

  • You know where important conversations are happening and how to make sure World is represented and meeting the moment appropriately and successfully.

  • You are a clear thinker, compelling writer, and credible representative.

  • You are comfortable moving between strategy, relationship-building, events, and hands-on execution.

  • You have high agency, are self-directed, collaborative, and motivated by ambitious, mission-driven work.

  • You thrive in start up environments and display grit.

  • You’re based in the CET or ET time zones.

title: Business Operations Manager - Nashville
description:
At Offchain, we aren’t just building products: we’re leading a movement. 

As pioneers in blockchain scalability and security, we're at the forefront of transforming how the world interacts with decentralized applications. We're laying the foundation that will define the next generation of digital commerce, governance, and human interaction. This involves tackling real-world challenges that come with scaling blockchain technology, without compromising on its core principles: decentralization, security and transparency. 

At the center of this vision is our people. Our team is made up of thinkers and doers that embrace new challenges and seek solutions that push existing boundaries. If you’re energized by solving unprecedented problems, and believe in the role that decentralized systems will play in creating a more equitable digital future, then we want to hear from you. 

Why Offchain?

Offchain is setting the pace for the entire Ethereum ecosystem. We built the Arbitrum stack that powers Arbitrum One, the most widely adopted Ethereum scaling solution that exists today.

Arbitrum’s ecosystem is undergoing tremendous growth with hundreds of projects and dApps on Arbitrum One today. Over 100 different teams have used Offchain technology to build their own Arbitrum chains. Major players in the space, Robinhood, BlackRock, Ethena Labs, Securitize, Aave, and Apechain are all using the Arbitrum stack.

Arbitrum’s thriving ecosystem wouldn’t exist without our advanced technology stack. Arbitrum, Prysm, ZeroDev. These aren’t just product names. These are tools that are actively reshaping what's possible on Ethereum and advancing its core infrastructure.

To top it all off? We’re backed by $124 million in funding. We’ve demonstrated consistent execution with billions in secured value, thousands of supported projects, and infrastructure processing millions of transactions seamlessly.

The Role:
Offchain is seeking a highly organized, hands-on Business Operations Manager to help drive operational excellence across the company. This role is based in our downtown Nashville office and requires in-office attendance five days per week.

Sitting at the intersection of business operations, project management, and execution, this person will own the high-impact, day-to-day operations of our Nashville office.

The ideal candidate is exceptionally detail-oriented and equally comfortable creating structure around projects, coordinating stakeholders, managing timelines and deliverables, and diving into the details to get things done. They should bring a strong background in general business operations and thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth technology environment.

What You’ll Do:

  • Take ownership of ad hoc operational priorities and projects as they arise.
  • Manage office vendors, facilities needs, shipping and receiving, supplies, technical equipment, and other operational requirements.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for Nashville office operations and proactively identify and resolve issues.
  • Partner with internal teams including People, IT, Finance, and Operations to support employee and business needs.
  • Manage inventory, and the shipping and receiving of workstations, devices, and technical hardware.
  • Ensure projects are completed with a high degree of quality, attention to detail, and urgency.

What You'll Need:

  • 1+ years of experience in business operations, project management, office management, procurement or a related field.
  • Project management skills with a demonstrated ability to drive cross-functional projects to completion.
  • Strong organizational skills and an exceptional attention to detail—you naturally create structure, establish priorities, and keep things moving.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate clearly with senior leaders and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a bias toward practical solutions and execution.
  • Must be based in Nashville and able to work from the Nashville office five days per week.

Nice to Haves:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant experience; PMP certification is a plus, but not required.
  • Experience in a startup, high-growth technology, fintech, or crypto environment is a plus.
  • Facilities management in a technical environment is a strong plus, but not required.
  • Must be able to lift up to 75lbs.

Perks:

  • Remote-first global workforce + NY office
  • Professional reimbursement program (facilitates industry conference attendance, certifications, and more)
  • Medical, dental & vision coverage (US + some other countries)
  • 401k retirement plan + company match (US only)
  • Wellness stipend
  • Home office set up / ergonomic equipment program
Attention Offchain Job Seekers:
 
This role cannot be performed in California, or Colorado.
 
Please be advised that there has been a rise in fraudulent recruiter activities, particularly within the Web3 space. If you would like to confirm whether someone is an Offchain employee or the legitimacy of an offer you received, please email jobs@offchainlabs.com
 
At Offchain, we are committed to building a welcoming and supportive workplace for all employees, regardless of their background or identity. We strive to create an environment where everyone feels valued and has an equal opportunity to succeed and thrive. We encourage candidates from all walks of life to apply and join our team.
 
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Client Platforms Engineer
description:
About Us:

Founded 20 years ago and headquartered in Chicago, the DV Group of financial services firms has grown to more than 600 people operating throughout North America, Europe and Asia. Since spinning out of a large brokerage firm in 2016, DV Trading has rapidly scaled as an independent proprietary trading firm utilizing its own capital, trading strategies, and risk management methodologies to provide liquidity to worldwide financial markets and hedging opportunities to commodity producers and users. Now, DV group affiliates include two broker dealers, a cryptocurrency market making firm, and a bourgeoning investment adviser.

Overview:

DV is looking for a highly motivated and customer-focused Client Platforms Engineer to join our dynamic IT support team. In this role, you will be responsible for providing exceptional technical support and assistance to DV Trading's end-users. Your primary goal will be to ensure the smooth functioning of IT services, resolve technical issues promptly, and deliver top-notch customer service.

Job Responsibilities:

  • First Point of Contact: Acting as the first point of contact for IT, you will be the point person for all issues and requests from end-users via phone, tickets, email, Slack, or in-person. You will ensure that all requests are acknowledged, logged, prioritized, and properly routed in our ticketing system.
  • Technical Troubleshooting: Identify and diagnose hardware, software, and application problems. Resolve issues efficiently or escalate to the appropriate team for further investigation.
  • Incident Management: Follow established procedures for incident management, ensuring timely and accurate resolution of technical problems while keeping the end-users informed of progress.
  • Request Fulfillment: Handle service requests such as password resets, software installations, access permissions, and hardware configurations in a timely and efficient manner.
  • Documentation: Maintain accurate records of all service desk interactions, including incidents and service requests. Document solutions and create knowledge base articles to facilitate self-service.
  • IT Asset Management: Assist in managing IT assets, including inventory, tracking, and allocation of hardware and software licenses.
  • Continuous Improvement: Actively participate in ongoing training and development to enhance technical skills and keep abreast of emerging technologies and best practices. Propose process improvements to enhance service delivery.
  • Customer Service: Provide exceptional customer service, demonstrating strong interpersonal skills and empathy while dealing with end-users.
  • Communication: Communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, translating technical concepts into understandable language.
  • Team Collaboration: Collaborate with other IT teams to resolve complex technical issues and ensure smooth coordination in handling IT projects.

Requirements:

  • 4+ years of experience as a Service Desk Engineer or similar role in an IT support environment
  • Solid knowledge of IT fundamentals, including operating systems (Windows, macOS, Linux), software applications, hardware, and networking concepts
  • Familiarity with service desk ticketing systems and incident management procedures
  • Experience with endpoint management solutions such as: SCCM, Intune, Jamf
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills with a keen eye for detail
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with a customer-oriented approach
  • Ability to work well under pressure and manage multiple tasks simultaneously
  • Willingness to work on-call rotation, including weekends and holidays, to ensure 24/7 coverage
  • Ability to work in our Chicago office 5 days a week

DV is not accepting unsolicited resumes from search firms. Only search firms with valid, written agreements with DV should submit resumes in response to DV’s posted positions. All resumes submitted by search firms to DV via e-mail, the Internet, personal delivery, facsimile, or any other method without a valid written agreement shall be deemed the sole property of DV, and no fee will be paid in the event the candidate is hired by DV. DV is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Security Compliance Manager
description:
Who we are:

Sardine is the leading agentic risk platform for fighting financial crime. Our integrated solution unifies data across risk teams to help organizations stop fraud in real time, prevent AI-driven attacks, and automate fraud and AML operations. Sardine’s platform is strengthened by one of the fastest-growing fraud consortiums in the market, spanning more than 6 billion profiled devices, 800 million consumers, and 3 million businesses worldwide. Leading companies including FIS, GoDaddy, Intuit, Edward Jones, ZoomInfo, and Checkout.com rely on Sardine to secure and grow trust in their products.

Our culture:

  • We have hubs in the Bay Area, NYC, Austin, Toronto, and São Paulo. However, we maintain a remote-first work culture. #WorkFromAnywhere

  • We hire talented, self-motivated individuals with extreme ownership and high growth orientation.

  • We value performance and not hours worked. We believe you shouldn't have to miss your family dinner, your kid's school play, friends get-together, or doctor's appointments for the sake of adhering to an arbitrary work schedule.

Location:

  • Remote - US

  • From Home / Beach / Mountain / Cafe / Anywhere!

  • We are a remote-first company with a globally distributed team. You can find your productive zone and work from there.

About the role

As Security Compliance Lead, you own Sardine’s security compliance and GRC function end-to-end and reduce risk to our environment through effective communication, partnership, and program ownership. You are the primary point of contact for auditors, regulators, and industry stakeholders, and you partner with engineering, IT, product, security, and legal teams to run successful compliance and review exercises across multiple frameworks.

This is a senior, hands-on ownership role. You set how the compliance program runs rather than executing a plan handed to you, and you are accountable for keeping Sardine continuously audit- and customer-ready. You also lead and develop the team, with a Security Compliance Analyst reporting to you and room to grow the function as Sardine scales.

What you’ll do

  • Own compliance planning and the compliance program across SOC 2 Type II, PCI DSS (Level 1 Service Provider), ISO 27001, GDPR, CCPA, and DORA — responsible for the program’s design and direction, not only its execution.

  • Drive Sardine's FedRAMP effort by working toward authorization, coordinating NIST SP 800-53 control implementation, 3PAO assessment, and continuous monitoring across engineering and IT.

  • Serve as the primary interface to auditors, regulators, and industry stakeholders, and partner with internal engineering, IT, product, security, and legal teams to drive reviews to clean outcomes.

  • Present objectives, scope, and results to senior management and the board (via the CISO), clearly articulating the business impact of control gaps in a highly professional and proficient manner.

  • Own the control framework — including rationalizing overlapping controls across standards into a coherent, evidence-efficient set — and the security policy and standards library.

  • Own the risk picture — the risk register, risk quantification, and reporting cadence — and validate that actions taken to address risks are appropriate and reported accurately.

  • Own the customer assurance and trust program — security questionnaires, attestations, and trust artifacts — so security review does not block deals.

  • Manage evidence and drive improvement — coordinate the assimilation of evidence, scans, and artifacts, and lead process improvements in response to findings from regulators, internal and external quality reviews, and maturity assessments.

  • Build product and technical fluency — understand Sardine’s platform and architecture well enough to ground control design and risk decisions in how the technology actually works, and to engage engineering and product as a peer.

  • Look for creative, alternative solutions that promote consistency and unlock streamlining and automation opportunities.

  • Produce executive-ready work — high-quality documentation and presentations, and well-run meetings with regulators and internal stakeholders where you set the objectives, plan, and content.

  • Lead and develop the team — starting with a Security Compliance Analyst — setting priorities, reviewing work, mentoring, and scaling the function as obligations grow.

What we’re looking for

  • 7+ years in security compliance, GRC, or audit, including end-to-end ownership of audit or certification programs (SOC 2, PCI DSS, and/or ISO 27001).

  • Deep knowledge of security and privacy frameworks — PCI DSS, SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR/CCPA, and DORA; familiarity with control frameworks such as NIST CSF and CIS.

  • Technical and product comfort — able to build fluency in a technical product (e.g., device intelligence, behavioral biometrics, transaction monitoring) and hold your own with engineering and product teams.

  • Excellent communication — strong written and verbal skills, executive-ready documentation, and credible presence with auditors, regulators, and leadership.

  • Fast-paced, high-growth experience — fintech or payments strongly preferred given Sardine’s PCI Level 1 service provider obligations.

  • Able to work as a leader, a partner, and an individual contributor as the situation calls for, and to travel as needed.

  • People leadership — experience leading, mentoring, or managing others, or clear readiness to step into managing a direct report.

Bonus points

  • Direct experience running a PCI DSS Level 1 service provider program.

  • Operational resilience — hands-on exposure to DORA requirements.

title: GTM Leader, Enterprise
description:
About us

Parallel is a web infrastructure company. Our products are used by leading businesses in sales, marketing, insurance, and coding to build best-in-class AI agents with flexible and powerful programmatic access to the web.

We've raised $230 million from Kleiner Perkins, Sequoia, Index Ventures, Spark Capital, Khosla Ventures, First Round, and Terrain to build the web for AIs. We're currently valued at $2 billion and we're forming a world-class team of engineers, designers, marketers, sellers, researchers, and operational experts to achieve our mission.

Job: You'll lead Parallel's enterprise sales team, working alongside the most talent-dense GTM leaders and ICs in the business. You'll carry a piece of the pipeline yourself, running discovery and closing cycles with enterprise buyers so your coaching comes from doing the work, not just watching it. These are six-to-twelve month cycles with a buying committee instead of a buyer — security review, procurement, legal redlines, a champion who has to sell internally for you when you're not in the room. You'll sharpen the playbook for navigating that process without losing momentum, build the ramp and coaching rhythm that gets new reps productive fast, and scale the team as pipeline grows. You'll partner with the head of Recruiting to build a dream team and with the head of GTM on segmentation. You're accountable for pipeline coverage, ramp time, and win rates across your team — not just your own number.

You: Have led an enterprise sales team for at least 4 years and know how to navigate a room with a CTO or VP without blinking. You've run deals through security reviews, procurement, and multi-stakeholder legal negotiations, and you know how to keep a champion engaged and a deal alive through a six-month lull. You've sold to technical buyers and can hold your own in a conversation about LLMs, agents, or RAG without a technical co-pilot in the room. You know the difference between coaching someone through a deal and doing it for them, and you'd rather build reps up than carry them. You create your own pipeline instead of waiting for it, and you're allergic to hand-holding, both giving and receiving it. You want to take an existing team further, not inherit a blank slate or a fully solved function.

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

Life at Parallel

Our team works fully in-person, between our Palo Alto HQ and San Francisco office. We’re a flat, talent-dense organization dedicated to solving technical and creative problems.

We seek like-minded individuals who share our passion for applying science, creativity, and consistency to big and complex problems with equally big outcomes. These are our values:

  • Own customer impact: It’s on us to ensure real-world outcomes for our customers.

  • Obsess over craft: Perfect every detail because quality compounds.

  • Accelerate change: Ship fast, adapt faster, and move frontier ideas into production.

  • Create win-wins: Creatively turn trade-offs into upside.

  • Make high-conviction bets: Try and fail. But succeed an unfair amount.

Compensation & benefits

  • Competitive salary

  • Generous equity

  • Visa sponsorships

  • 401K plans

  • Daily lunch & office snacks

  • Dinner at the office

  • Unlimited vacation

  • Caltrain pass reimbursement

title: Social & Technical Content Manager
description:
About Alchemy

Alchemy is the Web3 infrastructure and developer platform that powers millions of users and the world’s most innovative blockchain applications. From enabling $1+ trillion in financial transactions worldwide to scaling L2s and enabling DeFi, Alchemy provides the infrastructure and tools developers need to build reliable, scalable, and accessible experiences.

Trusted by companies like JPMorgan, Stripe, Visa, Franklin Templeton, Nike, and backed by a16z, Coatue, Silver Lake, Lightspeed, and Stanford University, Alchemy is building the foundational layer for a decentralized and AI-enabled Web3 ecosystem. For more information, visit alchemy.com.

 

About the Role

Alchemy is hiring a Social & Technical Content Manager to own how our strongest product, engineering, and customer stories show up online. This is a social-first role focused initially on X and LinkedIn, with opportunities to extend strong ideas into video, email, events, and longer-form content.

You have strong social instincts, a sharp editorial eye, and enough technical curiosity to earn the trust of engineers. You can find the idea worth building around, choose the right format, and carry an incomplete brief through to a finished package. You prefer a few stories with a clear point of view to filling a calendar for its own sake.

 

What You’ll Do

  • Own day-to-day editorial planning and execution for Alchemy's social channels, with a primary focus on X.

  • Help shape channel strategy with Marketing leadership: identify our core content pillars, build the brand of internal Alchemists, and experiment with ambassadors, KOLs, and other growth levers.

  • Build a reliable story pipeline with Product Marketing, Product, Engineering, Developer Relations, Customer Success, and the broader Marketing team.

  • Interview engineers, product leaders, customers, and executives to find the detail that makes a story credible.

  • Turn launch briefs, product demos, technical documentation, engineering interviews, and customer results into platform-native social posts, videos, emails, and longer-form content.

  • Develop repeatable content pillars, formats, and distribution plans that extend important launches and customer stories beyond launch day.

  • Partner with designers and video producers while owning the idea, message, script, and editorial bar.

  • Help Alchemy's experts show up on social with posts that sound like them.

  • Use AI to move faster on research, drafting, repurposing, and analysis. Use performance data to decide what to repeat or stop.

 

What we’re looking for

  • 3+ years creating social or technical content for a company, product, or expert.

  • Work samples that show strong storytelling, including at least one social-first example and one piece that makes a technical subject clear.

  • Strong instincts for social media. You understand how each platform works and know when a format or trend serves the story.

  • Clear, concise writing and rigorous editing. You can simplify a complex idea without making it less accurate.

  • Technical curiosity and the confidence to learn from documentation, demos, and subject-matter experts. You do not need to be an engineer, but you should know when a claim needs verification before publishing.

  • Sound editorial judgment. You can choose what deserves amplification, cut what does not, and finish the work with limited oversight.

  • Experience earning trust across technical and creative teams, managing feedback, and keeping launches moving.

  • A practical approach to measurement. You can explain what worked, what did not, and what you would change.

  • The ability to develop strong video concepts and scripts. On-camera work and video editing are useful, but not required.

  • You might come from social media, developer relations, technical content, developer education, or product marketing. Experience in developer tools, infrastructure, AI, fintech, cybersecurity, or Web3 is helpful. Prior Web3 experience is not required.

 

Benefits and Perks

🏥 Medical, Dental, & Vision
💪 Gym Reimbursement
🖥️ Home Office Build-out Budget
🥙 In-Office Group Meals
🚅 Commuter Benefits
🌴 Flexible Time Off
🧘‍♂️ Wellbeing & Mental Health Perks
🧠 Learning & Development Stipend
🌎 Company Sponsored Conferences & Events
💸 HSA and FSA Plans
🧬 Fertility Benefits

 

Alchemy is committed to offering competitive compensation, including base salary as well as bonus and equity. Additionally, Alchemy offers comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, as well as other benefits such as 401k and unlimited flexible time off.

title: Sr. Systems Analyst, Finance, Enterprise Apps
Senior Ecosystem Marketing Manager
description:
About Alchemy

Alchemy is the Web3 infrastructure and developer platform that powers millions of users and the world’s most innovative blockchain applications. From enabling $1+ trillion in financial transactions worldwide to scaling L2s and enabling DeFi, Alchemy provides the infrastructure and tools developers need to build reliable, scalable, and accessible experiences.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Ecosystem Marketing Manager to own and scale Alchemy's presence across the Web3 ecosystem, spanning chain partnerships, infrastructure providers, channel partners, customers, and emerging verticals like traditional finance and agentic commerce.

Alchemy is the AWS of blockchain. We power everyone from Azuki and Polymarket to JP Morgan and Robinhood. This role sits at the intersection of all of those relationships and has the unique mandate to build deep, strategic connections across the entire ecosystem, then turn those relationships into high impact co-marketing programs, joint campaigns, thought leadership, and distribution at scale.

This role has extraordinary breadth. You'll develop and execute strategy across Web3 native partners (chains, protocols, infrastructure providers), traditional finance institutions entering onchain (JP Morgan, Visa, MasterCard), customers, and channel partners (AWS and beyond). You'll also keep a pulse on the frontiers of blockchain, including stablecoins, RWA tokenization, deposit tokens, institutional staking, and agentic commerce, positioning Alchemy as the infrastructure layer that makes it all possible.

This is a senior, strategic role. We're looking for someone who already has existing relationships across the ecosystem and a proven track record of expanding their network, developing a distribution strategy, and executing it at scale. You won't be building a network from scratch. You'll be activating one.

 

What You’ll Do

  • Develop and own the ecosystem marketing strategy across chain partnerships, infrastructure partners, channel partners (e.g., AWS), and key customers spanning Web3 native and TradFi verticals.

  • Build and deepen strategic relationships with ecosystem players, including chains, protocols (Chainlink, Fireblocks, Canton Network), technology partners, and enterprise customers, to create mutual distribution opportunities.

  • Design and execute joint campaigns, co-branded content, co-hosted events, and thought leadership programs that amplify Alchemy's brand across partner channels and audiences.

  • Drive ecosystem distribution at scale by identifying and activating opportunities to leverage partner channels (newsletters, events, social, developer communities) to expand Alchemy's reach and brand awareness.

  • Host and coordinate thought leadership workshops, panels, and executive roundtables with key ecosystem players to reinforce Alchemy's position as the foundational infrastructure layer for onchain development.

  • Keep a pulse on the TradFi to onchain movement, tracking how institutions like JP Morgan, Visa, MasterCard, and Coinbase are adopting blockchain and identifying marketing opportunities at the intersection of traditional finance and Web3.

  • Monitor and engage with emerging trends including stablecoins, RWA tokenization, deposit tokens, institutional staking, and agentic commerce (AI agents on blockchain rails), positioning Alchemy as the infrastructure powering these movements.

  • Collaborate cross functionally with Product Marketing, Sales, Partnerships, and Content to ensure ecosystem marketing efforts are tightly aligned with Alchemy's GTM strategy and revenue goals.

  • Build and maintain a comprehensive ecosystem map, tracking key players, partnership health, co-marketing pipeline, and campaign impact across verticals.

  • Report on ecosystem marketing performance, providing clear metrics and insights to leadership on brand awareness, partner engagement, and pipeline contribution.

What we’re looking for

  • 5+ years of experience in ecosystem marketing, partner marketing, or strategic marketing within crypto, blockchain, or developer infrastructure.

  • Existing relationships across the Web3 ecosystem, including chains, protocols, infrastructure providers, and key industry players. You are not starting from zero.

  • Proven track record of developing an ecosystem or partner marketing strategy and distributing it at scale, driving measurable brand awareness, partner engagement, and pipeline impact.

  • Experience executing joint campaigns, co-marketing programs, and events with ecosystem partners that drove real business outcomes.

  • Strong understanding of the blockchain landscape, including L1s/L2s, DeFi, infrastructure, wallets, and the developer tooling ecosystem.

  • Working knowledge of TradFi's onchain adoption, with familiarity around how institutions are approaching stablecoins, tokenization, and blockchain based settlement.

  • Awareness of emerging trends in agentic commerce and AI powered onchain transactions.

  • Exceptional relationship building and communication skills, with the ability to navigate conversations with chain foundations, protocol teams, enterprise partners, and C-suite executives with equal comfort.

  • Strong cross functional collaborator with a proven ability to work closely with Sales, Product Marketing, Partnerships, Content, and Engineering to align ecosystem efforts with company wide priorities and drive unified go-to-market execution.

  • Strategic thinker who can also execute, comfortable building a plan from scratch and rolling up sleeves to ship campaigns, host events, and manage partner activations.

  • Self-starter mentality with extreme ownership who thrives in fast paced, high autonomy environments.

Nice to Haves

  • Ability to be in office in SF or NYC 3x a week.

  • Experience at a blockchain infrastructure company, chain foundation, or developer platform.

  • Previous experience marketing to both Web3-native and enterprise/TradFi audiences.

  • Familiarity with Alchemy's product suite (RPC, Gasless Transactions, Data APIs, Webhooks, etc.).

  • Experience managing or influencing channel partnerships with major cloud/tech providers (AWS, GCP, etc.).

  • Background in developer relations or developer-focused marketing.

  • Existing presence and influence on Crypto Twitter / X and within key Web3 communities.

🖥️ Home Office Build-out Budget
🥙 In-Office Group Meals
🚅 Commuter Benefits
🌴 Flexible Time Off

🧠 Learning & Development Stipend
🌎 Company Sponsored Conferences & Events
💸 HSA and FSA Plans
🧬 Fertility Benefits

title: Change Management & Communications Manager
description:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.


Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.

The team

We're looking for an experienced change communications pro to join our Internal Communications team and help us keep employees informed, engaged, and empowered as Payward grows.

Payward moves fast, and this role sits right at the center of that momentum: an opportunity for a sharp communications professional to shape how change lands across the company.

This is a 100% remote position reporting to our Head of Internal Communications & Engagement. You'll partner with our People Team (aka Payward Experience, or PX) and leaders across the business to shape and execute change communications strategies, guide global teams through organizational shifts, and drive employee engagement.

The opportunity

  • Serve as the communications and change lead focused on supporting our global People team and related employee programs and initiatives.

  • Create and execute internal communications strategies to support business and organizational changes, new program launches, and engagement with existing Payward offerings.

  • Plan, produce, and promote inspirational employee-focused content, including videos, presentations, internal messages, and events.

  • Track and measure the effectiveness of communications and change management strategies, and calibrate as needed.

  • Identify opportunities to continually improve communications and change management efforts – at the team/function levels and companywide.

  • Ensure People team and other functional communications are aligned with Payward’s brand voice and global internal communications strategy.

  • Required to collaborate with leaders on central and west-coast US timezone daily.

  • Based in US preferred.

What you bring

  • 5+ years experience in internal communications and change management, preferably with a technology company.

  • Experience working with HR and delivering HR-focused change communications programs.

  • Superior written and oral communication skills with a laser eye for detail.

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Communications, Journalism, or equivalent experience preferred.

  • Excellent organization and project management skills.

  • Willingness to work hard and roll up your sleeves to get work done, even when at times it is outside the scope of the job.

  • Ability to develop creative, effective approaches to difficult communications challenges.

Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Our commitment

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto.

We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision.

As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

title: Senior Program Manager, Partner Programs
description:
Interested in working on cutting-edge blockchain technology and creating equitable access to the global financial system? Since 2014, the mission-driven team at the Stellar Development Foundation (SDF) has helped fuel the tremendous growth of the Stellar blockchain network, an open-source platform that operates at high-scale today. Developers and companies around the world build on it, and the SDF team is expanding to support the rapidly growing and changing Stellar ecosystem.

The Stellar Development Foundation (SDF) is looking for a talented and experienced Senior Program Manager, Partner Programs to help key partners integrate with the Stellar Network. In this role, you will coordinate across our partners and internal stakeholders (Engineering, BD, Marketing, Product, Account Management) to build innovative blockchain solutions. SDF's partners span the globe and include some of the most innovative software and financial companies in the world.

In this role, you will:

  • Manage, plan, and direct software and product development activities from launch to completion, with overall responsibility for delivering on time and at high quality.

  • Own long-term partner integration roadmaps and the success of multiple partners in the Stellar ecosystem.

  • Host and drive partner meetings with technical and business stakeholders.

  • Identify and manage technical dependencies and blockers across partner and internal engineering teams.

  • Maintain partner-related documentation, including milestone plans, dependencies, schedules, risks, and meeting notes.

  • Measure program performance, analyzing the successful completion of short- and long-term goals against company and team OKRs.

  • Define process frameworks, program plan templates, tools, and best practices that can be adopted throughout the organization.

You have:

  • 7+ years of experience managing software development programs in the financial services industry, some of which took place in a blockchain startup or small-company environment.

  • Comfort engaging in technical discussions — APIs, integration flows, system dependencies — enough to coordinate credibly with engineering, track technical risks and blockers, and translate fluidly between technical and business stakeholders. You don't need to write the code, but you need to understand what's being built well enough to drive it.

  • Familiarity with blockchain/crypto concepts, or a demonstrated ability to ramp quickly on a complex, unfamiliar technical domain.

  • A habit of using AI tools to work smarter — you look for ways to apply AI to your day-to-day, whether that's drafting and summarizing documentation, accelerating research, streamlining reporting, or automating repetitive workflows, and you're eager to help the team do the same.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • Excellent leadership skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with partners from various backgrounds and positions.

  • Great organizational skills, including attention to detail, multitasking, and creating and instituting processes to streamline workflows.

  • Experience with program and project management tools like Jira, Airtable, Asana, Confluence, and Google Suite.

  • An independent nature and results-driven attitude — you're good at identifying priorities and working in an environment with dynamic objectives.

  • A knack for problem-solving — you have an eye for untold problems in the program life cycle and create solutions to minimize or mitigate them.

  • An aptitude for advocating for partners while supporting the company's mission.

  • Willingness to travel as needed (mostly to the Americas/Europe).

  • Enthusiasm for working in a startup environment with some level of ambiguity and wearing multiple hats.

Bonus Points if (optional):

  • You have a deeper curiosity about new blockchain technologies (for example, DeFi, Earn, contract tokens) and cryptocurrencies.

  • You have worked directly with external partners in the capacity of program manager, project manager, delivery manager, technical program manager or consultant.

We offer competitive pay with a base salary range for this position of $145,000 - $195,000 depending on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and location. In addition, we offer lumen-denominated grants along with the following perks and benefits:

USA Benefits/Perks:

  • Competitive health, dental & vision coverage with most plans covered at 100% for the employee + any dependents

  • Flexible time off + 15 company holidays including a company-wide holiday break

  • Generous paid parental leave for all parents, plus paid pregnancy disability leave for birthing parents

  • Gym reimbursement ($80 per month)

  • Life & ADD (up to $50K)

  • Short & Long term disability

  • 401K with 4% match

  • Health & Dependent Care FSA Accounts

  • Commuter benefits with $250/month employer contribution

  • Health Savings Account (HSA) with monthly employer contribution

  • Family building benefits through Kindbody

  • Wellbeing benefits (One Medical, Rightway, Headspace)

  • L&D budget of $1,500/year

  • Daily lunch and snacks in the office

  • Company retreats

#LI-Hybrid

About Stellar

Stellar is more than a blockchain. Powered by a decentralized, fast, scalable, and uniquely sustainable network made for financial products and services and a thriving and passionate ecosystem that includes a non-profit organization driven by a mission, Stellar is paving the path to unlock the world’s economic potential through blockchain technology. Built with speed and low costs in mind, the Stellar network provides builders and financial institutions worldwide a platform to issue assets, and to send and convert currencies in real time creating real world utility. Founded in 2014, the Stellar Development Foundation (SDF) supports the continued development and growth of the Stellar network and also serves the ecosystem of NGOs, corporations, universities, small businesses, governments, and solo entrepreneurs building on the Stellar network through tooling, funding and strategic collaborations. Together, Stellar is where blockchain meets the real world.

About the Stellar Development Foundation

The Stellar Development Foundation (SDF) is a non-profit organization focused on working with and supporting change-makers to create equitable access to the global financial system through blockchain technology. SDF provides grants, investments, funding, and other awards to builders and organizations. SDF also develops resources and tooling on the Stellar network to help unlock real world utility. As a nonprofit foundation, SDF puts the health of the Stellar network and the Stellar ecosystem and its mission above all else.

We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Head of Business Development - Middle East
description:
Who We Are:

Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.

Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. This includes broker-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts.

Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it.

title: Risk
description:
What is Kalshi?

Kalshi has defined a new category: prediction markets. Kalshi allows people to trade on the outcome of any events and turn any question about the future into a financial asset. Kalshi fought for years and legalized prediction markets in the US for the first time in history, is currently the fastest growing financial market in America, and has thousands of markets across politics, economics, financials, weather, tech, AI, culture and more.

We believe prediction markets have the potential to be the largest financial market because they turn anything into a financial position.

  • Our vision: well… build the largest financial market on the planet.

  • Our mission: bring more truth to the world through the power of markets.

Our culture is simple: we hire really talented people, work really hard, and enjoy the climb. We are looking for ambitious and exceptional people to join our (relatively small) team to help us build the next generation of financial markets.

Role Roadmap

As Kalshi Prime scales, our Risk role will strengthen and build out the risk function to match that growth.

This role is about staying ahead of customer exposure: refining margin methodology so it keeps pace with position risk, building out stress tests that size potential shortfalls before they happen, and strengthening the residual interest calculation and process to hold up under CFTC scrutiny. In the first six months, you'll build out advanced stress testing tools, deepen the margin models, and sharpen forecasting for the firm's residual interest contribution. From there, the role expands into collateral and credit risk management.

What You'll Do

Margin & Exposure Management

  • Own and continuously refine Kalshi Prime's margin methodology so required margin reflects actual position risk

  • Monitor customer positions and concentration in real time, setting house margin above exchange minimums where risk calls for it

Stress Testing & Scenario Analysis

  • Build and run stress tests modeling how customer portfolios hold up under extreme market moves, sizing potential shortfalls against margin on file

  • Backtest models against historical price action and maintain a live set of tail-risk scenarios as market conditions shift

Regulatory Capital & Residual Interest

  • Own the residual interest calculation and process, ensuring the firm's capital contribution to segregated customer funds meets CFTC requirements

  • Monitor net capital and segregated funds compliance, partnering with compliance and finance on regulatory risk reporting

Default Management & Governance

  • Maintain the playbook for an actual customer default, improving auto-liquidation logic and thresholds for manual intervention

  • Prepare risk materials for the Risk Management Committee and assess new products and markets for margin parameters before launch

What You Bring

  • Direct experience managing a risk function at an FCM; absent that, CFTC Swap Dealer risk experience is the next closest fit

  • 4-7 years of experience minimum with a track record as a decision-maker and approver in a risk function

  • Deep fluency in risk and margin models, with the ability to build them yourself

  • Strong grounding in derivatives and financial markets, comfortable working with concepts like VaR

  • Ability to independently build risk scenarios and forecasts, like modeling residual interest

  • Working knowledge of the relevant regulatory landscape, or the ability to get up to speed on it fast

  • Technically savvy and self-sufficient, comfortable building your own tools rather than waiting on others

  • Strong multitasking ability across risk, financial markets, and operational demands

NYC Pay Transparency Disclosure

Salary Range: $200,000 to $250,000 annually plus equity and benefits.
This range reflects current market data for this role. Kalshi has minimal hierarchy and broad variance in experience levels within each title; if your compensation expectations exceed this range, we encourage you to reach out - we’re always happy to discuss.

Our Culture

Meritocracy is at our core, and we value people who take ownership and figure (usually hard) things out. We dream big. We love our craft deeply and are proud of what we put out in the world. We are committed to our vision of building something big… but also useful: a product that brings more truth through the power of markets.

Kalshians are Kalshi’s most important asset: we pick Kalshians carefully, so we trust them fully on day 1.

Commitment to Equal Opportunity

Kalshi is committed to creating a culture of inclusion and belonging, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe it is our collective responsibility to uphold these values and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to join us in our mission. All qualified applicants will be treated with respect and receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, uniform service, veteran status, age, or any other protected characteristic per federal, state, or local law. If you are passionate about what you do and want to use your talents to support our mission and values, we’d love to hear from you.

title: SRE L1 Support/Cloud Platform Ops Engineer
Cloud Service Security Platform DevOps & Maintenance
Founding Product Designer
description:
Initial 3-month contract with possibility to extend

About Bolter

Bolter is an AI agent platform built to help people get real work done, without needing to stitch together multiple tools or spend weeks setting things up.

You describe what you need in plain language and Bolter creates and runs agents that can carry out the work end to end. They retain context, remember how you work and can also create real, shareable apps such as trackers and dashboards.

Bolter is funded and currently at the validation-sprint stage, working with a small group of high-impact operators. The product already exists. We are now looking for a founding designer to lead a significant redesign and establish the design foundations for what comes next.

About the role

As Bolter’s founding designer, you will rethink how people create, understand and work with AI agents across the product.

That includes the agent-building experience, the workspace where people can steer their agents, and the applications those agents generate.

You will be working with an existing product, but there is no established design system you need to preserve. You will build that system from the ground up while deciding which parts of the current experience should evolve, which should be reworked and what new interaction patterns Bolter needs.

The design problem goes beyond improving the interface. It is working out what it should feel like to collaborate with agents that retain context, carry out work and create software themselves.

You will work directly with the GM in a lean team, with specialised AI agents supporting implementation. The product is still early enough that the core design decisions are open, and your work will shape how Bolter develops from here.

What you’ll do

  • Lead a significant redesign of the existing Bolter product

  • Build and own Bolter’s design system from the ground up

  • Define the interaction patterns for creating, understanding and steering AI agents

  • Shape the experience across the workspace and agent-generated applications

  • Make pragmatic trade-offs between speed, clarity and craft

  • Move quickly from ideas to working designs and strengthen what proves useful

  • Help shape the early design and product team as Bolter grows

What we’re looking for

  • Experience designing and shipping consumer-facing digital products, ideally AI products, productivity tools or chat applications

  • Experience significantly improving or rethinking an existing product experience

  • You think in systems and interaction patterns, not individual screens

  • You have strong product and design judgement

  • You care about craft, but know when speed and pragmatism matter more than polish

  • You’re comfortable designing while the product itself is still being defined, rather than working from a settled brief

  • You can form clear opinions and adapt them when the evidence changes

Experience with AI products is particularly relevant, but we are also interested in designers who have worked on strong B2C or D2C productivity and chat experiences.

Bolter already has a working product, but the design foundations are still being set. You will have meaningful ownership over how that experience evolves and the opportunity to help define what working with AI agents should actually feel like.

If you want to transform an early AI product, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Workforce Management Forecasting Analyst
description:
About Figure

Figure (NASDAQ: FIGR) is transforming capital markets through blockchain. We’re proving that blockchain isn’t just theory - it’s powering real products used by hundreds of thousands of consumers and institutions. 

By combining blockchain’s transparency and efficiency with AI-driven automation, we’ve reimagined how loans are originated, funded, and traded in secondary markets. From faster processing times to lower costs and reduced bias, our technology is helping borrowers, investors, and financial institutions achieve better outcomes.

Together with our 170+ partners, we’ve originated over $22 billion in home equity loans (HELOCs) on our blockchain-native platform, making Figure the largest non-bank provider of home equity financing in the U.S. Figure’s ecosystem also includes YLDS, an SEC-registered yield-bearing stablecoin that operates as a tokenized money market fund, and several other products and platforms that are reshaping consumer finance and capital markets. 

We’re proud to be recognized as one of Forbes’ Most Innovative Fintech Startups in 2025 and Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies in Finance and Personal Finance.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead the gathering and analysis of data for forecasting purposes, including historical performance data, volume trends, and seasonality patterns.
  • Identify and address any deviations from planned staffing levels and service targets.
  • Assess forecasting variances and align with business objectives and support strategic decision-making.
  • Provide insights and recommendations based on data analysis to drive operational efficiency and improve service delivery.
  • Act as a subject matter expert (SME) in advanced forecasting techniques, models, and tools, ensuring forecast accuracy and reliability.
  • Conduct regular capacity planning to ensure that staffing levels meet business demands and service level agreements (SLAs).
  • Document standard operating procedures (SOPs), guidelines, and best practices related to scheduling, forecasting, and capacity planning.
  • Identify opportunities for process improvement within the WFM department and assist in implementing solutions to enhance efficiency and effectiveness.
  • Address volume discrepancies and trends, call arrival pattern deviations, and proactive forecasting practices to ensure successful operations.
  • Provide insights and recommendations based on data analysis to drive operational efficiency and improve service delivery.

This is a hybrid role based that can be based out of our Charlotte, NC or Reno, Nevada office.

What We Look For

  • 5+ years of experience in performing WFM functions (specifically forecasting and capacity planning) in a contact center environment required.
  • Strong knowledge and experience with workforce management software (NICE) and telephony systems (e.g., Automatic Call Distributors, IVR systems.
  • Excellent working knowledge of Excel or Google Sheets, and the ability to organize/analyze data in a structured manner
  • Focused, self-motivated, and reliable with the ability to stay focused on a task and work independently
  • Ability to build rapport and trust with teams cross-functionally and across all levels
  • Possesses a positive attitude with excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to interact and build solid working relationships with all levels of the organization
  • Ability to work in a team environment and adapt to changing workload and circumstances effectively as well as respond to new information quickly
  • Knowledge of the financial services regulatory environment
  • Ability to maintain and follow Hybrid policy and commutable distance to the office
  • Adhere to all company security policies and data handling procedures.
  • Complete mandatory security awareness training within required timeframes.
  • Promptly report any suspected security incidents or suspicious activity to the Security team.

Salary

  • Base Compensation Range: $51,920 - $64,900/yr
  • 25% annual bonus target, paid quarterly 

This is the compensation range for the role in the United States. Actual compensation may vary based on a candidate’s experience, skills, location, internal equity, and evolving business needs. While most offers are generally made within the middle of the range, final compensation is determined based on the factors above.

Benefits

  • Company HSA, FSA, Dependent Care FSA, 401(k), and commuter benefits
  • Employer-paid life and disability insurance

title: Staff Infrastructure Engineer, US
description:
Infrastructure Engineer — Polymarket

About Polymarket

Polymarket is the world's largest prediction market platform. We enable individuals to express views on real-world events by trading on outcomes across politics, economics, sports, culture, and current affairs. Built as a peer-to-peer marketplace with no centralized "house," Polymarket aggregates diverse opinions into transparent, market-based probabilities that reflect collective expectations about the future.

We're growing fast: both in volume ($21B traded in 2025) and in adoption as an alternative news source. Our ambition is to become a ubiquitous beacon of truth in global media, powered by fast, reliable, and deeply technical market infrastructure.

About the role

Polymarket is looking for an Infrastructure Engineer to help build, scale, and operate the platform that our exchange and product engineering teams run on. This role is focused on the systems underneath the systems — Kubernetes, cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, observability, and reliability — that let our engineers ship fast without breaking things.

You'll be a core individual contributor working with senior engineers across the org to design, automate, and harden the infrastructure that powers Polymarket at scale. This is a high-ownership role with minimal bureaucracy and a strong bias toward execution.

What you'll do

We're looking for an experienced infrastructure engineer who's comfortable owning systems end-to-end and enjoys solving hard operational and scaling problems.

  • Own core infrastructure: Design, build, and operate the Kubernetes-based platform that runs Polymarket's services, including cluster architecture, workload scheduling, and multi-environment management.

  • Build for scale & reliability: Design and implement systems for autoscaling, load balancing, service discovery, and disaster recovery that hold up under real trading volume.

  • Automate everything: Write code (not just scripts) to manage infrastructure as code, build internal tooling, and eliminate manual toil across deployment, provisioning, and operations.

  • Strengthen CI/CD: Build and maintain fast, reliable deployment pipelines that let engineering teams ship confidently and frequently.

  • Drive observability & incident response: Build monitoring, logging, and alerting systems; participate in on-call rotations and lead root-cause analysis for production incidents.

  • Manage cloud infrastructure: Architect and optimize our cloud footprint (AWS/GCP) for cost, performance, and security.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally: Work closely with backend, exchange, and product engineering teams to ensure infrastructure decisions support the platform's performance and growth needs.

What we're looking for

  • 8+ years of professional infrastructure/platform/DevOps engineering experience, ideally at a large-scale company with high-traffic, production systems.

  • Deep hands-on experience with Kubernetes and Docker in production — cluster operations, workload orchestration, and container lifecycle management.

  • Strong software engineering fundamentals — able to write production-grade code (Go, Python, or similar), not just configuration and scripts.

  • Solid experience with at least one major cloud provider (AWS or GCP), including networking, IAM, compute, and storage.

  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code tooling (Terraform, Pulumi, or similar) and CI/CD systems.

  • Comfortable debugging complex, distributed production systems on Linux and taking ownership of correctness, performance, and uptime.

  • (Plus) Experience operating infrastructure for high-throughput, low-latency, or financial/trading systems.

  • (Plus) Experience with service mesh, GitOps (ArgoCD/Flux), or multi-cluster/multi-region architectures.

  • (Plus) Familiarity with observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, OpenTelemetry).

Benefits

  • Competitive salary & equity

  • Unlimited PTO

  • Full Health, Vision, & Dental coverage

  • 401k match

  • Hardware setup — new MacBook Pro, big display, & accessories

title: Strategic Account Manager
description:
Institutional Fabric for the Digital Asset Market

Founded in 2018, Talos provides institutional-grade trading technology for the global digital asset market, powering many of the major players in the crypto ecosystem. Our mission is clear: to advance the mass adoption of digital assets by seamlessly connecting institutions to the digital asset ecosystem. We are committed to building the most innovative and trusted platform in the world, supporting the entire trading lifecycle.

At Talos, you’ll find an environment that champions kindness and respect, values diverse perspectives, and upholds inclusivity at every turn. We believe every member of our team brings invaluable insights and abilities that drive Talos forward. In our pursuit of excellence, we foster a culture of trust, integrity, collaboration, and mutual growth.

We are a tight-knit yet globally distributed team of highly experienced engineers and business leaders, with hubs in New York, London, Singapore, and Cyprus. You’ll be part of a hybrid-friendly environment where your unique talents and insights will play a crucial role in building something extraordinary.

 

Strategic Account Manager

We are seeking a Strategic Account Manager to own Talos's most consequential client relationships across large asset managers, hedge funds, retail brokers, institutional brokers, and global banks.

These institutions are at a technology inflection point. Their existing OMS, EMS, and custody infrastructure was built for traditional asset classes, not 24/7 digital markets. They are deciding right now which technology partners will take them forward, and most of those decisions will be made before a formal process begins. The mandate of this role is to get ahead of those decisions: understand what each client is trying to build, shape how they think about the problem, and make Talos the obvious answer before alternatives are seriously evaluated.

This is a high-agency individual contributor role. You will own the outcome for your accounts without a team beneath you and without formal authority over the internal stakeholders you need to move. You will partner closely with the Global Head of Revenue and Global Head of Account Management, and work in a matrix relationship with Product, Business Development, and Executive leadership.

 

Responsibilities

Strategic account ownership

  • Own a defined book of Talos's largest strategic accounts across asset managers, hedge funds, institutional and retail brokers, and global banks.

  • Build and maintain a rolling 12-month account plan for each account: stakeholder map, current product footprint, white space, active client initiatives, and a prioritized expansion thesis.

  • Get ahead of client technology decisions including OMS evaluations, custody transitions, and settlement or clearing infrastructure upgrades.

  • Know each client's organization well enough to identify which business units are about to prioritize a digital asset initiative.

Relationship and stakeholder development

  • Build relationships across each account at multiple levels: trading desks, technology, operations, finance, risk, and the C-suite.

  • Identify and develop executive sponsors in business units where Talos does not yet have active engagement. This means initiating conversations, not waiting for introductions.

  • Run structured discovery engagements: map the client's end-to-end workflow, identify operational bottlenecks, and translate those findings into documented product opportunities.

Expansion and growth

  • Identify expansion opportunities across additional product lines, new business units, and adjacent workflows before clients raise them.

  • Qualify tokenization and digital asset initiatives by separating genuine demand from exploratory interest, and build a business case for Talos's involvement before engaging the product team.

  • Prioritize your expansion pipeline. When product resources are constrained, make a reasoned case for which opportunity should move first and why.

  • Drive net-new opportunities surfaced within strategic accounts through the commercial process. Establish clear ownership and maintain client momentum to close.

Product strategy input

  • Serve as the primary connection between strategic client requirements and Talos's product organization. Client problems you surface should become documented product inputs.

  • Evaluate whether a client problem is specific to that account or indicative of a broader market need, and build a structured case before bringing it to the product team.

  • Represent client requirements in internal product discussions with the specificity needed to act on them: current workflow, scale of impact, and competitive risk if left unaddressed.

Cross-functional execution

  • Align Sales, BD, Product, and Executive stakeholders around strategic account opportunities. You will not have organizational authority over any of them. You will need to build the case, create the urgency, and hold people accountable to commitments.

  • Set the agenda for strategic engagements, QBRs, and executive briefings. Prepare the internal team, own what gets communicated, and follow through on every commitment made in the room.

  • Maintain accurate account records in Salesforce: contact roles, account plans, open opportunities, activity history, and health status. Clean records are a prerequisite for cross-functional coordination at this account size.

  • Bring competitive intelligence from client conversations into Talos's GTM and product strategy.

Qualifications

Required

  • 7 or more years of experience in strategic account management, enterprise sales, or client coverage at a market technology vendor, financial institution, or institutional digital asset platform.

  • Direct experience working with or selling into asset managers, hedge funds, institutional brokers, or global investment banks on either the buy side or the sell side.

  • Fluency in institutional trading workflows: OMS, EMS, and PMS platforms; order management and execution; allocations, settlement, and post-trade processes. You can map a client's front-to-back trade lifecycle without asking them to explain it.

  • Demonstrated ability to navigate complex organizations and build relationships at multiple levels simultaneously, without relying on formal introductions or organizational authority to open doors.

  • A track record of identifying expansion opportunities within existing accounts and converting them to commercial outcomes, including cases where you initiated the conversation before the client had a defined need.

  • Operates with high agency. Identifies what needs to happen, builds the internal alignment to make it happen, and drives it to completion without waiting to be directed.

  • Clear executive communication. Can turn a complex client workflow or strategic opportunity into a specific, evidence-based case for clients and internal stakeholders.

Highly valued

  • A background managing strategic relationships at an institutional digital asset firm, covering large asset managers, prime brokers, retail brokers, or global banks.

  • Experience holding roles both inside a financial institution and at a technology vendor. Understanding the operating model from both sides is a meaningful advantage in this role.

title: Junior Quantitative Researcher
description:
Flow Traders is looking for a Junior Quantitative Researcher to join the quantitative trading team in our New York office. This is a unique opportunity to join a leading proprietary trading firm, working alongside some of the brightest minds in the industry. As a firm, we are committed to leveraging advances in computer science, statistics, and machine learning to generate value in the financial markets.

A successful Quantitative Researcher is an expert in mathematics and statistics, passionate about translating challenging quantitative problems into equations and models, and skilled at optimizing them using cutting-edge computational techniques. If you're at the top of your quantitative, modeling, and coding game, and excited to test these skills in competitive live markets, this opportunity is for you.

What you will do

  • Design, build, optimize, and deploy state-of-the-art models and algorithms for systematic trading.
  • Analyze large datasets to identify patterns and signals that can be translated into trading strategies.
  • Collaborate with traders and technologists to bring models from research into live production.
  • Monitor and refine existing models based on live market performance.

What you need to succeed

  • A PhD degree in Mathematics, Physics, Computer Science or a related quantitative field.
  • Strong statistical and linear algebra knowledge.
  • Proficiency in implementing models and algorithms in programming languages such as Python or C++.
  • Experience in Deep Learning is a plus.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently on open-ended, ambiguous problems.
