title: Product Manager II, Workspace and Multi-User
Senior Software Engineer, CUDA
description:
About Provable

At Provable, our mission is to redefine trust and privacy in the digital world.

By creating tools that simplify the complexities of zero-knowledge technology, we empower developers to build applications that prioritize security, user control and scalability. We envision a future where privacy is not an afterthought but a fundamental standard, enabling a more secure and equitable Web3.

Our commitment extends beyond technology to fostering a vibrant, collaborative community of innovators. Through accessible resources, thoughtful design, and a focus on developer success, we aim to bridge the gap between cutting-edge blockchain technology and real-world applications. Together we’re not just building tools-we’re shaping the foundation for a private decentralized future.


The Role

Provable is searching for exceptional senior CUDA engineers to help build privacy preserving zero knowledge protocols and products.

As a Provable senior engineer you will use your engineering talent to design, implement and maintain both cryptographic and distributed systems and help build privacy preserving products on top of those systems. Collaboration will be key. You should be able to work well with engineers, designers, and leadership to turn our products and technical vision into deliverables each quarter. You should be able to clearly and thoroughly communicate your ideas.

 

Responsibilities

  • Designing, developing, and optimizing high-performance confidential computing solutions using CUDA for our core services and products.

  • Identifying and resolving performance bottlenecks in complex computational workflows, leveraging advanced CUDA programming techniques and profiling tools.

  • Writing clean, efficient, well-documented, and thoroughly tested CUDA code that sets a high standard for quality within the engineering team.

  • Collaborating closely with developer services and infrastructure teams to integrate GPU-accelerated algorithms into our existing systems and ensure seamless functionality.

 

Key Qualifications

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience

  • 2-3+ years of professional CUDA experience

  • A strong foundation in blockchain concepts and ideally, experience contributing to a blockchain project

  • Low-level system programming and/or distributed systems design experience

 

Provable is committed to diversity in its workforce and is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer and to review all of our job postings to minimize biased language. Provable does not make hiring or employment decisions on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, sex, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, citizenship, or any other basis protected by applicable local, state, or federal law. Provable will also consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records in a manner consistent with San Francisco’s Fair Chance Ordinance and similar local laws.‍

title: Senior Product Designer, DeFi
location: Menlo Park, CA; New York, NY
description:
Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

title: APAC Community Lead (Contract)
description:
The Sui Foundation exists to support the development, growth and adoption of the Sui network. Sui is the first permissionless Layer 1 blockchain designed from the ground up to enable creators and developers to build unique Web3 experiences from gaming to finance.

The Sui Foundation is committed to three decentralization principles; Embrace transparency and level the playing field, Communicate openly to build a culture of trust, and Engage directly with the community.

Mission:

Onboard the next billion users to web3 by supporting the advancement and global adoption of the Sui blockchain.

Vision:
To create a better world that unlocks opportunities through universal access and individual ownership.


Role Overview:

The Community Lead for APAC will play a pivotal role in cultivating and expanding the Sui community across the region. This person will be responsible for developing and executing community programming and events, driving adoption, and fostering a deep connection between Sui and its users. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in community management in web3, and a proven track record of scaling communities.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Community Programming & Events: Design, launch, and manage community initiatives that resonate with Sui's APAC audience. Organize events, both virtual and in-person, that drive engagement and foster a strong sense of community.

  • Cross-Channel Engagement: Manage and grow regional market community engagement across multiple platforms, including Discord, Telegram, Twitter, and forums. Ensure consistent communication and active participation across channels.

  • Engagement & Advocacy: Build and maintain relationships with key community members and builders. Act as the voice of the community within the Sui Foundation’s community channels, ensuring that feedback is integrated into decision-making processes. Find ways to spotlight key community and builder contributions.

  • Content Creation & Amplification: Collaborate with the marketing team to create and distribute high-quality content that educates, informs, and engages the community. Develop a content calendar to ensure consistency.

  • Community Supporter Network: Existing relationships with, or strong familiarity with, APAC based crypto and trading communities.

  • Moderation & Community Health: Oversee the moderation of community channels to ensure a positive, safe, and inclusive environment. Address conflicts and issues within the community proactively.

  • Data-Driven Approach: Use analytics to assess community health, optimize engagement strategies, and report key metrics to the leadership team.


Key Qualifications:

  • Experience: 3-5 years of experience in community management. Proven track record of launching and scaling community programs.

  • Communication: Native Mandarin speaker. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both English and Mandarin.

  • Web3 Knowledge: Deep understanding of Web3 culture, including familiarity with blockchain technology, decentralized applications, and the unique dynamics of Web3 communities.

  • Event Management: Experience in planning and executing successful community events, both online and offline.

  • Strategic & Tactical: Ability to think strategically while being hands-on in execution. Comfortable working in a fast-paced, startup environment.

  • Proactive & Solutions-Oriented: A self-starter who takes initiative and thrives in a dynamic, evolving environment. You should be comfortable with ambiguity and ready to tackle challenges head-on.

  • Collaboration & Teamwork: Strong ability to work cross-functionally with product, marketing, and engineering teams to align community efforts with broader company goals.

  • Tech-Savvy: Proficiency in using community management tools, social media platforms, and data analytics tools.


Why Join Us?

  • Impact: Play a critical role in shaping the future of the Sui community and the broader Web3 ecosystem.

  • Growth: Be part of a rapidly growing foundation with significant opportunities for personal and professional development.


Culture:

Work with a passionate, innovative, and collaborative team that values creativity and autonomy.

亚太地区（APAC）社区负责人


职位概述

APAC 社区负责人致力于拓展Sui 亚太地区社区关系。该职位负责策划并执行社区项目和活动，推动 Sui 的用户采用率，并建立 Sui 与用户之间深厚且长期的联系。理想的候选人应具备扎实的 Web3 社区运营背景,并有成功打造和扩展社区规模的实战经验。

主要职责

社区项目与活动（Community Programming & Events）

  • 设计、发起并管理面向亚太地区用户的社区项目和活动。

  • 策划并执行线上及线下活动，提升社区活跃度并增强社区凝聚力。

多渠道社区运营（Cross-Channel Engagement）

  • 负责 Discord、Telegram、X（Twitter）及各类论坛等多个平台的社区运营与增长。

  • 确保各渠道保持一致、及时且积极的与社区成员沟通与互动。

社区互动与倡导（Engagement & Advocacy）

  • 建立并维护与核心社区成员、开发者及生态建设者（Builders）的长期关系。

  • 作为社区声音的代表，在 Sui Foundation 社区渠道中收集并反馈社区意见，推动其纳入相关决策流程。

  • 挖掘并展示优秀社区成员及开发者的贡献，提升社区影响力。

内容创作与传播（Content Creation & Amplification）

  • 与市场团队紧密合作，策划并发布高质量内容，为社区提供教育性、信息性及互动性的内容。

  • 制定并维护内容发布计划（Content Calendar），确保内容持续稳定输出。

社区资源网络（Community Supporter Network）

  • 拥有亚太地区加密货币（Crypto）及交易（Trading）社区的人脉资源，或对相关社区有深入了解。

社区管理与健康度（Moderation & Community Health）

  • 负责社区日常管理及内容审核，营造积极、安全、包容的社区氛围。

  • 主动处理社区中的冲突及问题，维护社区健康发展。

数据驱动运营（Data-Driven Approach）

  • 利用数据分析评估社区健康状况，持续优化社区运营策略。

  • 定期向管理团队汇报关键社区指标及运营成果。


任职要求

工作经验（Experience）

  • 3–5 年社区运营相关经验。

  • 具有成功搭建并扩大社区项目规模的实际经验。

沟通能力（Communication）

  • 普通话母语水平（Native Mandarin Speaker）。

  • 具备优秀的中英文书面及口头沟通能力。

Web3 知识（Web3 Knowledge）

  • 深刻理解 Web3 文化。

  • 熟悉区块链技术、去中心化应用（dApps）以及 Web3 社区生态和运作模式。

活动策划（Event Management）

  • 具有策划和执行线上、线下社区活动的丰富经验，并有成功案例。

战略思维与执行能力（Strategic & Tactical）

  • 兼具战略思维和落地执行能力。

  • 能够适应快速发展的创业环境，并高效推动项目落地。

自驱力与问题解决能力 （Proactive & Solutions-Oriented）

  • 具备主人翁精神，主动推动工作。

  • 能够适应快速变化及不确定的环境，并积极解决各类挑战。

团队协作（Collaboration & Teamwork）

  • 能够与产品、市场及工程团队高效协作，推动社区目标与公司整体战略保持一致。

技术能力（Tech-Savvy）

  • 熟练使用社区管理工具、社交媒体平台及数据分析工具。

为什么加入我们？（Why Join Us?）

影响力（Impact）

  • 在塑造 Sui 社区未来以及推动整个 Web3 生态发展过程中发挥关键作用。

成长机会（Growth）

  • 加入快速发展的基金会，获得广阔的个人成长和职业发展机会。

我们的文化（Culture）

与一支充满激情、勇于创新、重视协作的团队共事。我们鼓励创造力、自驱力，并相信优秀的人才能够在开放、灵活的环境中发挥最大的价值。


To support an efficient and fair hiring process, we may use technology-assisted tools, including artificial intelligence (AI), to help identify and evaluate candidates. All hiring decisions are ultimately made by human reviewers.

title: Senior Technical Recruiter
description:
Who We Are:

Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.

Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. This includes broker-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts.

Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it.

Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.

Our Team Members:

We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!

We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

Your Role

As a Senior Technical Recruiter, you’ll own full-cycle recruiting for high-impact technical roles across Alpaca, primarily within Engineering. You’ll partner closely with Engineering leaders to build hiring strategies, develop strong talent pipelines, and drive searches from kickoff through close.

You’ll thrive in a fast-paced environment, managing multiple concurrent technical searches while maintaining strong stakeholder relationships, a high-quality candidate experience, and clear visibility into hiring progress and performance.

Things You’ll Do

  • Own full-cycle recruiting across a high volume of technical roles, from sourcing through offer and close.
  • Partner closely with Engineering leaders and hiring managers to define profiles, develop hiring strategies, and drive searches forward.
  • Build proactive technical talent pipelines through outbound sourcing, referrals, networking, and talent mapping.
  • Manage competing priorities and a high req load while maintaining hiring quality and velocity.
  • Provide clear reporting on pipeline health, funnel performance, hiring progress, and risks.
  • Use recruiting data to identify gaps, improve conversion, and inform hiring decisions.
  • Deliver a high-quality candidate experience through clear communication and efficient processes.
  • Leverage AI and recruiting technology to improve sourcing, research, reporting, and recruiter productivity.
  • Maintain strong ATS hygiene and help continuously improve recruiting processes and workflows.

Who You Are (Must-Haves)

  • 6+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, with a strong track record of hiring software engineers and other technical talent.
  • Proven ability to successfully manage a high volume of concurrent technical searches.
  • Excellent stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence, advise, and build credibility with Engineering leaders.
  • Strong sourcing skills and a track record of building pipelines for difficult-to-fill technical roles.
  • Experienced in using ATS reporting, funnel metrics, and recruiting data to communicate hiring performance and drive decisions.
  • Skilled in using AI tools and modern recruiting technology to improve efficiency and recruiting outcomes.
  • Strong communication, organization, and prioritization skills.
  • Experience working in fast-paced, remote or distributed teams.

Who You Might Be (Nice-to-Haves)

  • Background recruiting in fintech, trading, brokerage, crypto, or other highly technical environments.
  • Experience hiring backend, infrastructure, platform, API, data, or distributed systems engineers.
  • Exposure to recruiting across multiple global markets.
  • Experience with Greenhouse or similar ATS platforms and recruiting dashboards.

 

How We Take Care of You:

  • Competitive Salary & Stock Options
  • Health Benefits
  • New Hire Home-Office Setup: One-time USD $500
  • Monthly Stipend: USD $150 per month via a Brex Card

Alpaca is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to pursuing and hiring a diverse workforce.

Recruitment Privacy Policy

title: Business Analyst (New Grad)
description:
Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. As part of the broader Credit organization, we work closely with product, engineering, risk, and operations to unlock sustainable business growth through deep analytical rigor. You'll own real work from day one, build cross-functional fluency fast, and leave each rotation having made a measurable impact.

This role is based in our Washington, D.C. office, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.

What you’ll do

  • Build fluency across the Money and Growth org by rotating through roughly 5 distinct team assignments over the program, each with its own stakeholders, metrics, and strategic priorities
  • Analyze business performance metrics and economic drivers to identify growth opportunities and optimize business outcomes
  • Structure and solve complex, ambiguous problems across product strategy, pricing, user segmentation, and risk-return trade-offs
  • Partner with engineering, product, risk, and finance teams to execute key strategic initiatives and monitor program efficacy
  • Develop analytical models, dashboards, and executive-level presentations to inform leadership decision-making and influence core business direction

What you bring

Operating within the Consulting Services organization, the Forward Deployed Engineer partners closely with Product Management, Engineering, Enterprise Sales, and Delivery teams to help customers successfully implement and adopt Blockstream's products.

Customer Delivery & Implementation

  • Financial Institutions: Work directly with financial institutions to understand business processes, operational workflows, and technical environments.

  • Configure, deploy, and optimize Blockstream products based on customer requirements and approved solution designs.

  • Deliver administrator and end-user enablement sessions to ensure successful customer adoption.

  • Enterprise integration: Integrate with core banking and capital-markets systems.

Engineering & Technical Delivery

  • Controlled environments: Deploy into on-premise, network-isolated, and air-gapped banking environments under formal change control, producing the security and audit evidence that compliance and pen-test reviews require.

  • Design and implement integrations between Blockstream enterprise products and customer systems using required integration interfaces and data pipeline technologies.

  • Troubleshoot complex technical, configuration, and integration challenges throughout the implementation lifecycle.

  • Work closely with customer engineering teams to ensure secure, scalable, and production-ready deployments.

  • Develop reusable deployment assets, implementation playbooks, technical documentation, and best practices.

  • Collaborate closely with Engineering to resolve product issues and improve implementation quality.

Customer Collaboration

Embed directly with customer teams to gain a deep understanding of their operating environment and technical challenges.

  • Facilitate technical workshops, architecture discussions, and implementation planning sessions.

  • Act as a trusted technical advisor throughout the implementation lifecycle.

  • Build strong relationships across customer Technology, Operations, Security, and Engineering functions.

Digital Assets Product Improvement Feedback Loop

  • Turn implementation learnings, customer feedback, and product enhancement opportunities into code

  • Identify repeatable deployment patterns across engagements and contribute to standardized implementation methodologies.

  • Partner with Product Management and Engineering to shape the roadmap and improve platform capabilities based on real customer implementations.

  • Help accelerate customer time-to-production through continuous improvement of deployment frameworks and best practices.

What We Look for In You (Required Qualifications):

  • 4-8 years of experience in Software Engineering, Forward Deployed Engineering, Solutions Engineering, Professional Services, Technical Consulting, Implementation Engineering, or Enterprise Software Delivery.

  • Proficiency in at least one systems or backend language (e.g. Python, Go, Rust) sufficient to build and ship integrations, tooling and services independently

  • Experience implementing and deploying enterprise software solutions within complex customer environments.

  • Strong understanding of protocol intermediation, enterprise integration patterns, cloud technologies, security fundamentals and modern software architectures.

  • Experience working directly with enterprise customers throughout implementation and deployment projects.

  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.

  • Ability to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.

  • Comfortable collaborating across Product Management, Engineering, Enterprise Sales, and Consulting teams.

  • Strong customer-facing communication and stakeholder management skills.

  • Self-starter with proven ability to work independently while managing multiple customer engagements.

  • Willingness to travel regularly to customer locations across Europe.

  • Excellent English skills are required

Nice To Haves (Preferred Qualifications):

  • Experience working with financial institutions, like private banking, wealth management, custody, payments, treasury, or capital markets.

  • Background in Bitcoin, blockchain, digital assets, tokenization, or fintech.

  • Experience integrating enterprise software using APIs and modern integration frameworks.

  • Knowledge of cloud platforms, containerized deployments, or infrastructure automation.

  • Familiarity with Layer-2 technologies and digital asset infrastructure.

  • Experience contributing product feedback from customer implementations into engineering roadmaps.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer - APAC (Platform & Reliability)
description:
Blockstream was founded in 2014 by Dr. Adam Back and a group of fellow cryptographers and engineers who are passionate about Bitcoin and its potential to change the world. Today, Blockstream is the leading Bitcoin company, providing cutting-edge infrastructure solutions for enterprises, institutions, and individual Bitcoin users. We develop industry-leading Bitcoin self-custody solutions, Bitcoin-based financial products, second-layer scaling technologies, and enterprise-grade blockchain infrastructure.

Blockstream is looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to build and operate secure, resilient infrastructure across our global Bitcoin products and internal platforms.

You will be a hands-on owner of Kubernetes, GCP, Terraform, GitOps, observability, and stateful production services. You will strengthen follow-the-sun operations during APAC hours, coordinate reliable handoffs with Europe, and turn operational incidents into durable automation, runbooks, and reliability improvements.

What You’ll Be Doing (Key Responsibilities):

  • Own production reliability during APAC operating hours, including alert triage, incident coordination, mitigation, communication, and cross-region handoffs

  • After onboarding and shadowing, participate in a shared primary/secondary on-call rotation with documented backup and escalation paths

  • Build and operate GCP/GKE and hybrid Kubernetes infrastructure using Terraform, Atlantis, FluxCD, Helm, and Kustomize

  • Ship reviewed, observable, and reversible production changes through GitLab CI/CD and GitOps workflows

  • Build monitoring and alerting with Prometheus/Mimir, Grafana, Alertmanager, and Grafana IRM; improve alert quality, SLOs, runbooks, and post-incident actions

  • Operate stateful services and recovery mechanisms, including PostgreSQL/CloudNativePG, WAL backups, Redis, Kafka, persistent volumes, and capacity tuning

  • Manage IAM, Workload Identity, secrets, artifact registries, DNS, TLS, ingress, load balancers, and network policies

  • Automate repetitive operations using Python, Go, Bash, or similar tools

  • Review infrastructure changes and collaborate asynchronously with engineers across APAC, Europe, and North America

What We Look For In You (Required Qualifications):

  • Typically five or more years of production experience in DevOps, SRE, platform engineering, or infrastructure operations, or equivalent demonstrated experience

  • Strong Kubernetes and cloud-platform experience; production GCP/GKE experience is preferred

  • Strong Terraform/IaC, GitOps, and CI/CD fundamentals

  • Solid Linux, containers, networking, DNS/TLS, IAM, and secrets-management knowledge.

  • Experience monitoring and responding to incidents involving distributed or stateful services

  • Practical scripting and automation skills.

  • Clear written and spoken English, with strong documentation and asynchronous handoff habits

  • Ability to work the published APAC schedule and participate in the defined on-call rotation

Nice To Haves (Preferred Qualifications):

  • FluxCD, Helm, Kustomize, Atlantis, or GitLab CI

  • Prometheus, Mimir, Grafana, Grafana IRM, Loki, or Alertmanager

  • CloudNativePG, Barman/WAL recovery, Redis, Kafka, or GCS

  • Bitcoin, Elements/Liquid, electrs, Lightning, exchange-market-data, or other high-availability financial infrastructure

  • Hybrid/on-premises Kubernetes or security-sensitive infrastructure experience

🔒 Stay Safe from Job Scams
All official Blockstream communication will come from an @blockstream.com email address. We will never ask you to share sensitive information or purchase equipment during the hiring process. If in doubt, contact us at hr@blockstream.com. Learn more about avoiding job scams here.

title: Senior Staff Security Engineer, AI Security
Senior Staff Security Engineer, AI Security
Lead IT Security Administrator
description:
About Digital Asset & the Canton Network

Digital Asset builds the technologies that are reshaping the foundations of financial markets. Our mission is to create the world’s most trusted, privacy-enabled, and interoperable digital infrastructure for global finance.

At the heart of this mission is the Canton Network - the blockchain purpose-built for institutional finance. Uniquely combining privacy, compliance, and scalability, Canton enables real-time, secure settlement across multiple asset classes. Governed by the Canton Foundation with participation from leading financial institutions, it is the proven link between the promise of blockchain and the power of global finance.

Founded in 2014 and headquartered in New York City, with offices in London, Zurich, Budapest, Hong Kong, and Sydney— we are on a mission to transform finance— and that transformation is now playing out rapidly on the Canton Network.

If you’re interested in playing a crucial role at the intersection of traditional and crypto-capital markets and want to help bring the next trillion dollars of finance on-chain, join us.

About the role:

The Lead IT Security Administrator is a senior individual contributor responsible for designing, implementing, and optimizing the organization's enduser, endpoint, cloud infrastructure and networking systems. This role focuses on high-level hands-on engineering, ensuring the reliability and scalability of our technology stack through robust system design, advanced CI/CD management, and automated operations.

Partnering as a technical expert with the Engineering teams, the Lead IT Security Administrator drives the evolution of our cloud-native environment, manages critical Juniper networking hardware, and develops sophisticated automation scripts to streamline deployment pipelines and enhance overall system performance.

Responsibilities:

  • Network — the Juniper/Junos estate end-to-end (routers, switches, firewalls), plus secure hybrid architecture: VPNs, VPCs, Interconnect
  • Linux at scale — Ubuntu server fleet, hardened baselines, automated patching via Canonical Landscape, drift eliminated through Salt/Ansible/Terraform
  • Security operations — EDR, SIEM, email security, and identity (SSO/MFA/PAM), from detection tuning through triage, access reviews, and incident root cause
  • Cloud — AWS, GCP, and Azure with a focus on networking, IAM, and security configuration; read and review Terraform to validate changes
  • Kubernetes & databases — production incident resolution, observability and runbooks, managed RDBMS provisioning and upgrades, tested backup/restore
  • Automation — Python and Bash tooling and API-driven SaaS integration that removes manual work permanently
  • Technical leadership — Tier-3 escalation, mentorship, and security standards across the org

What We're Looking For:

  • Deep hands-on experience with Junos and enterprise network architecture
  • Proven Linux fleet management — patching, hardening, compliance reporting at scale
  • Fluency with at least one of Salt, Ansible, or Terraform; more is an advantage
  • Strong identity and access management background: SSO, MFA, RBAC, privileged access
  • Practical cloud security experience in AWS, GCP, or Azure
  • Python/Bash automation skills applied to real operational problems
  • Experience investigating alerts and running incident response
  • Familiarity with SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIST CSF, or CIS Controls
  • Clear communicator who can explain technical risk to non-technical stakeholders
  • Learns unfamiliar technology quickly and takes ownership through to resolution

Nice to have

  • Fintech, payments, crypto/blockchain, or other regulated environments
  • CIS Benchmarks / STIG hardening and drift detection
  • CI/CD troubleshooting across GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, CircleCI
  • Building AI-assisted monitoring, log analysis, or troubleshooting pipelines

The range below may vary if based outside the New York tri-state area (New York, New Jersey, and Connecticut). Base salaries are determined during our interview process, during which we assess the candidate's experience, skills, and capabilities against internal peers and the scope and responsibilities of the position.

$160,000—$185,000 USD

title: Finance Manager
description:
We are seeking a high-performing Finance professional with a strong accounting foundation and a passion for AI, automation and finance transformation. This is a broad role spanning financial reporting, FP&A, business partnering, M&A and Finance transformation within a fast-paced FinTech / digital asset environment.

Responsibilities

  • Manage financial and management reporting, cash flow, tax, GST, budgeting, statutory accounts and reconciliations.

  • Support FP&A, forecasting, performance analysis and business partnering, providing insights to drive commercial decisions and cost optimisation.

  • Drive Finance transformation and automation, leveraging AI, GenAI, data and technology to improve efficiency, controls and scalability.

  • Identify opportunities to simplify processes, automate manual work and improve Finance operating models.

  • Partner with Finance, Technology and business teams to deliver scalable solutions.

  • Ensure compliance with accounting standards, tax regulations and corporate governance, and liaise with auditors and external advisors.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Accountancy / Finance, ACCA or equivalent qualification with 7+ years' relevant experience.

  • Strong accounting, analytical, financial modelling and reconciliation skills.

  • Experience in FP&A, consulting, M&A or Finance transformation is highly valued.

  • Strong interest and practical experience in AI, automation, data analytics or financial systems.

  • Advanced Excel skills; ERP / BI / workflow automation experience is a plus.

title: Growth Marketing Manager
description:
About Coinflow

Coinflow is the next-generation payment service provider revolutionizing global financial infrastructure with stablecoins, AI-driven fraud prevention, and instant settlement. Coinflow enables businesses to grow faster with instant settlement, fraud & chargeback indemnity, global pay-ins, multi-currency FX, and unified payouts. Founded in 2023, the company serves marketplaces, fintechs, remittance providers, gaming platforms, and ecommerce merchants worldwide.

Since our seed round in 2024, we’ve achieved 23x revenue growth and scaled to multi-billion-dollar annual transaction volume. In response to this growth, Coinflow announced a $25M Series A in October 2025—led by Pantera Capital, CMT Digital, Coinbase Ventures, Jump Crypto, and Reciprocal Ventures—accelerating our mission to power the world’s fastest-moving businesses with innovative, reliable global payments.

Coinflow is proudly headquartered in Chicago, IL. Learn more at coinflow.cash.

Role Overview

Coinflow's marketing function is small, fast, and already driving real pipeline — a multi-voice content engine, a packed events calendar, and a growing inbound motion built from scratch over the past year. We now need someone to own the growth layer on top of it: turning our brand and content momentum into repeatable, measurable pipeline.

This is a builder's role, not a maintainer's. You'll own outbound campaign activation, design and run growth experiments end-to-end, and tighten the loop between marketing spend and qualified pipeline. You'll work shoulder-to-shoulder with the Head of Marketing, Revenue, and Partnerships to find what works, kill what doesn't, and scale what does.

Plainly: you'll be the person who takes Coinflow to its next level of growth, running the tests and iterations that turn what's working into scalable, sustainable pipeline, and expanding our reach into new verticals and audiences as we grow.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own outbound campaign activation end-to-end — audience, offer, channel, creative, follow-up — partnering closely with Revenue and the SDR function.

  • Design and run growth experiments across paid, email, LinkedIn, events, and lifecycle channels, with clear hypotheses and fast iteration based on results.

  • Own pipeline metrics — qualified leads, meetings booked, cost per qualified lead, marketing-attributed pipeline — and report on them consistently.

  • Go beyond surface-level analytics: dig into the data to find the “why” behind performance, and use AI tools to visualize and communicate those insights clearly to leadership.

  • Build and optimize the demand funnel — landing pages, conversion paths, forms, nurture sequences — to turn traffic into qualified pipeline.

  • Manage paid acquisition and retargeting where it earns its place, prioritizing measurable ROI over reach.

  • Partner with content and SEO to convert organic momentum into pipeline.

  • Maintain clean attribution across campaigns (UTM discipline, CRM hygiene in Attio, analytics in PostHog).

  • Test new verticals and audiences as Coinflow expands, standing up and measuring campaigns in early-fit segments.

  • Build and run account-based marketing (ABM) programs for new verticals — target accounts, multi-channel outreach with Revenue, testing which segments convert before scaling.

  • Work with Partnerships and Events to convert high-intent moments into pipeline, not just awareness.

Required Qualifications

  • 4+ years in growth, demand generation, or performance marketing, ideally at a B2B SaaS, fintech, or payments company.

  • A demonstrated track record of building and running campaigns that generated measurable pipeline — you can point to experiments you ran, what you learned, and what you scaled.

  • Fluency with the modern growth stack: analytics, CRM, marketing automation, paid platforms, and attribution. Comfort with tools like Attio, PostHog, and Google Analytics is a plus.

  • Strong data analysis skills — you don't just read a dashboard, you dig into the numbers to find the insight underneath, and can visualize and present findings clearly (using AI tools where useful) to influence decisions.

  • A bias for action and experimentation: you'd rather ship a scrappy test this week than a perfect plan next quarter.

  • Excellent collaboration skills across Marketing, Revenue, and Partnerships — you can align a cross-functional group around a growth bet and drive it to a result.

  • Based in or willing to relocate to New York City or Chicago; this is an in-office role.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience marketing a technical or infrastructure product to developer, fintech, or payments buyers.

  • Familiarity with payments, stablecoins, or financial infrastructure — or the curiosity and speed to get fluent fast.

  • Experience standing up growth motions in new verticals or markets from zero.

  • Fluent with AI-assisted tools for data analysis, visualization, and reporting — comfortable using AI to turn raw campaign data into clear, decision-ready insights.

  • Hands-on experience with Apollo (or comparable sales-intelligence and outbound sequencing tools) for prospecting, list-building, and ABM outreach.

What We Offer

  • The chance to own the growth function at a fast-scaling, well-funded payments company at an inflection point.

  • Competitive compensation including base salary and equity.

  • Collaborative environment with regular exposure to Coinflow's founders and leadership team.

  • Comprehensive benefits, including health and wellness coverage, 401(k), and flexible time off.

  • Direct partnership with the Head of Marketing and close collaboration with the founders, Revenue, and Partnerships.

  • Real ownership and autonomy — the mandate to experiment, the budget to test, and the trust to move fast.

The base salary range for this role is $150,000 - $200,000 USD + equity. The actual base salary offered depends on a variety of factors, including but not limited to experience, education, skills, qualifications, and business needs.

Join the team rewriting how money moves worldwide—and become a driving force in the $194 trillion cross-border payments market.

Role Overview

We're hiring a Product Manager to own a high-impact surface area across our risk and compliance infrastructure — and grow into a generalist across the broader product org.

This role sits at the center of:

  • Risk and compliance tooling — internal systems used by our compliance, underwriting, and operations teams

  • Fraud and decisioning infrastructure — the systems that protect the platform and merchants at scale

  • Vendor and banking partner onboarding — owning the end-to-end process of procuring and implementing new payment providers, banks, and networks; coordinating requirements across engineering, legal, compliance, and operations to get partners live

You'll work closely with engineering, data, operations, and our compliance team to design and ship tools that make our internal teams faster, our risk decisions smarter, and our platform more defensible.

This is a high-ownership, high-ambiguity role. You'll be expected to operate with limited structure, identify problems before they're handed to you, and drive execution end-to-end.

What You'll Do

  • Own internal tooling for risk and compliance — identify gaps in how our internal teams work, and build systems that make them faster and more accurate

  • Drive process clarity through product — translate ambiguous, manual workflows into structured, scalable tools

  • Build risk-adjacent product — case management, onboarding flows, decisioning logic, fraud reporting surfaces

  • Own global payments vendor procurement — research and identify pay-in and payout providers across target markets; run structured evaluations across pricing, coverage, compliance posture, and technical fit; drive MSA and legal review; and own the vendor relationship post-onboarding

  • Work directly with engineering and data — turn complex operational requirements into clear, shippable product

  • Contribute across the product org — as you ramp, take on generalist product work across pay-in, payout, and orchestration beyond the risk surface

  • Drive decisions with data — analyze performance, surface insights, and iterate quickly

About You

  • Extremely high bias for action — you move fast, default to building, and unblock yourself

  • Operationally fluent — you can sit with a compliance analyst or underwriter, understand their workflow in depth, and translate that into product requirements

  • Very detail-oriented — you think through edge cases, failure modes, and the messy realities of how internal teams actually work

  • Obsessed over customer experience — You are obsessed with customer experience and want to deliver world class UI/UX internally or externally

  • Deeply data-driven — you rely on metrics, not intuition, to make decisions

  • Genuinely interested in payments and risk — you want to work on hard, high-stakes problems

  • Commercially and operationally fluent across payments rails — you understand how different pay-in and payout providers work, what makes one better than another in a given market, and how vendor selection affects pricing, compliance exposure, and product capability

  • Builder mindset — you take real ownership and treat the product like it's yours

Nice to Have

  • Experience in payments, fintech, or financial infrastructure

  • Experience building internal tooling or operational products

  • Experience in global payments vendor procurement or partnerships

  • Exposure to compliance, fraud, underwriting, or risk workflows

  • Experience working with data or ML-driven products

What You Need

  • 4+ years of product management experience

  • Track record of shipping end-to-end — from ambiguous problem to production

  • Comfortable owning a problem space without a roadmap handed to you

  • Strong communication skills and ability to work across technical and non-technical stakeholders

Why Coinflow

  • Work on systems that matter — internal tools that power how real risk decisions get made

  • Direct exposure to payments infrastructure, compliance, and fraud at scale

  • Small, high-caliber team where you'll have real ownership from day one

  • Fast execution environment — what you ship will be in production quickly

The base salary range for this role is $150,000 - $200,000 USD. The actual base salary offered depends on a variety of factors, including but not limited to experience, education, skills, qualifications and business needs.

In addition, the employee who fills this role will be eligible for an equity grant, allowing you to share in the long-term success of the company. You will also have access to a wide array of benefits, including health and wellness benefits, 401(k) savings plan, and flexible time off.

Join the team rewriting how money moves worldwide—and become a driving force in the $194 trillion cross-border payments market.

title: Senior Staff Software Engineer, Core Infrastructure
description:
Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world's biggest financial problems. We're looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn't a place for complacency, it's where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We're a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards.

The Core Infrastructure team's mission is to build and evolve the foundational platform that every Robinhood engineering team builds on — owning the systems, primitives, and developer-facing abstractions that power 24/7 trading, crypto, and global expansion. We treat infrastructure as a product: reliable, fast to provision, and invisible to the teams above it.

As a Senior Staff Software Engineer on Core Infrastructure, you will own the architectural evolution of three deeply interconnected domains: service mesh and connectivity, compute platform, and infrastructure provisioning. Your decisions will directly shape engineering velocity, operational reliability, and Robinhood's ability to expand to new regions and markets. This is not an operations role — it's a once-in-a-platform-lifecycle opportunity to redesign the foundation before complexity becomes permanent!

This role is based in our Bellevue, WA office, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.

What you'll do

  • Own service mesh architecture end-to-end — standardize and evolve Robinhood's Istio and Envoy deployment, eliminate deprecated communication patterns, and build the networking foundation for multi-region operation
  • Drive Kubernetes compute platform evolution — define the long-term direction for cluster lifecycle, scheduling strategy, control plane architecture, and multi-region resiliency across Robinhood's entire compute fleet
  • Redesign infrastructure provisioning — transform Terraform from a collection of ad-hoc configurations into a scalable, self-service platform capability that enables rapid region provisioning and developer autonomy
  • Operate with source-level depth — diagnose and resolve issues at the Kubernetes API machinery, etcd, Envoy xDS, and Terraform provider layer, and contribute upstream where it serves the platform
  • Define technical direction across teams — produce architecture proposals, lead design reviews, and drive cross-functional alignment on infrastructure decisions that affect every engineering organization at Robinhood

What you bring

  • Deep, hands-on expertise with Kubernetes internals — API server, controller reconciliation, etcd watch propagation, scheduler mechanics, and admission control
  • Deep working knowledge of Istio and/or Envoy at the source code level — including the xDS API as a protocol; experience debugging at the control-plane/data-plane boundary
  • HTTP/2 and gRPC wire-level knowledge — connection management, flow control, stream multiplexing, and observability
  • Terraform at architectural scale — module design patterns, provider internals, remote state management, and multi-region provisioning
  • Production Go or Python for infrastructure tooling; strong fundamentals in writing well-structured, tested, operationally sound code
  • Proven ability to drive cross-functional architectural change across large or complex engineering organizations — influencing without authority and shipping durable decisions

What we offer

  • Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career
  • Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, and equity ownership
  • Top tier benefits to fuel your work, including supplemental health insurance, ancillary insurance, and mental health support programs
  • Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill-building for every employee, technical or not
  • Lifestyle wallet — a highly flexible employer-paid benefits spending account for expenses beyond traditional benefits such as wellness, childcare, learning, and more
  • Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, paid volunteer time off, parental leave, and more!
  • Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces
  • Monthly commuter stipend to help offset in-office commuting costs

 

In addition to the base pay range listed below, this role is also eligible for bonus opportunities + equity + benefits.

Base pay for the successful applicant will depend on a variety of job-related factors, which may include education, training, experience, location, business needs, or market demands. The expected base pay range for this role is based on the location where the work will be performed. For other locations not listed, compensation can be discussed with your recruiter during the interview process.

$264,000—$310,000 USD

description:
Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

Robinhood is seeking a Senior Applications Engineer to join Enterprise Build, the small, high-leverage team that turns the company's best AI-built prototypes into true enterprise-grade services. Robinhood's corporate ecosystem is deep, Okta identity, Google Workspace, Slack, ServiceNow, Atlassian, Salesforce, and the agent fabric that makes all of it agent-accessible. When a prototype graduates into a real service, someone has to make it a native citizen of that ecosystem: single sign-on and access done right, provisioning and audit wired in, data flowing to and from the systems of record, surfaces appearing where people already work. That someone is you. 

You will own the front of the pipeline: when prototypes arrive at the team's intake, you perform the rapid technical assessment, what data it touches, what systems it needs, what would break, that determines whether it self-serves in the sandbox, becomes a Build engagement, or is better bought than built. You’ll partner with the team's SWEs, who rebuild prototypes from the ground up into production services. You determine how everything connects, with breadth across enterprise surfaces, and you personally deliver the many ‘graduations’ that are 80% integration, configuration, and workflow automation with 20% glue code, where a ground-up rebuild isn’t needed. Between builds, your intake assessments shape what the whole team does next.

Robinhood operates in a heavily regulated industry: ambiguity is constant, playbooks are yours to write, and safe-by-default is the house style.

This role is based in our Menlo Park, CA office, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. 

What You'll Do

  • Own intake assessment for the graduation pipeline: rapidly evaluate incoming prototypes, data classification, system touchpoints, integration surface, risk flags, and recommend the disposition: sandbox, build, or buy.
  • Make graduated services native to the enterprise: SSO and access via Okta, SCIM provisioning, audit logging, and surfaces in Slack, Workspace, and ServiceNow where users already live.
  • Deliver integration-led graduations end-to-end where configuration, workflow automation, and targeted glue code beat a ground-up rebuild.
  • Build and maintain the MCP integrations and automations that connect Build's services to Robinhood's SaaS estate, and make them agent-accessible by default.
  • Work directly with business partners to map their real workflow before anything is built, and stay their translator throughout the engagement.
  • Partner with Enterprise Platforms on the identity and application-onboarding paved road, and with Enterprise Operations on clean operational handoffs.
  • Apply approved AI tools relentlessly to your own work: automate the repetitive parts of assessment, integration, and documentation so your time goes to judgment.

What We're Looking For

  • Hands-on experience across a modern enterprise SaaS estate, Okta (identity, SSO, lifecycle), Google Workspace, Slack, ServiceNow, Atlassian, and with integration or workflow-automation platforms (e.g., Workato or similar).
  • Strong scripting and API fluency: Python or similar for glue code and automation, plus working depth in REST, webhooks, OAuth, and SCIM. You ship working integrations; you don't need to be a full-stack systems engineer, that's what your SWE teammates are for.
  • Proven ownership of at least one significant service or platform area as its domain expert, with sound decisions under medium-to-high ambiguity.
  • An assessor's eye: you can look at an unfamiliar app and quickly see what data it touches, what it depends on, and what it would take to run it safely.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Enterprise Build
description:
Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. 

Robinhood is seeking a Senior Software Engineer to join the Enterprise Build team: the small, high-leverage team that turns the company's best AI-built prototypes into true enterprise-grade services. Robinhood has gone all-in on an AI-accelerated workforce: every week, Hoodies across Finance, HR, Legal, Compliance, and beyond use sanctioned AI tools to build working prototypes of the tools they wish they had. The best of those ideas deserve to become real software. That is this team's entire job, and yours. 

The team is built on the premise that AI multiplies what a senior engineer can own: agents do the first pass of assessment, porting, and scaffolding; you review, harden, and decide. The work is a distinctive loop.  A prototype earns real usage in our experimental sandbox and arrives through a single front door. You assess it, decide what survives, often the idea and the workflow, rarely the code, and rebuild it as an enterprise-grade, production-spec service that meets our full engineering standards: SSO, audit logging, secrets management, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, and security review, baked in from the first commit. While you build, you work directly with business partners, the forward-deployed pattern, pointed inward. Robinhood operates in a heavily regulated industry. Building fast here means building safely, and this team exists to help make sure those aren't in tension.

This role is based in our Menlo Park, CA office, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. 

What You'll Do

  • Assess vibe-coded prototypes from across the company and make the technical call: harden, rebuild, or redirect, then own the outcome end-to-end.
  • Design, build, and ship services on Robinhood's enterprise platforms, meeting the company's full standards for secure, reliable enterprise software.
  • Build AI-natively: drive agents through first-pass assessment, porting, and test scaffolding, and ship MCP servers, sub-agents, and agent skills as production artifacts where the solution calls for them.
  • Work directly with sponsoring business units (Finance, HR, Legal, Compliance) during each build, translating real workflows into software people actually adopt.
  • Deliver clean operational handoffs as part of your definition of done: runbooks, evals, and dashboards.
  • Establish the paved patterns with the Enterprise Platforms team: when you solve the same problem twice, make it a platform capability the third time.
  • Raise the bar on AI-era engineering quality, including rigorous, teaching-quality review of AI-generated code, your own and others'.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience building and running production backend or full-stack systems, with a track record of independently delivering high-ambiguity projects end-to-end.
  • Hands-on cloud depth, GCP preferred, including containerized services, CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure as code, with a strong focus on a serverless stack.
  • Demonstrated AI-native development: daily fluency with agentic coding tools, experience building LLM-powered applications or agentic workflows, and the judgment to review, harden, and productionize AI-generated code.
  • Product sense and scoping discipline: you can find the 20% of a prototype worth keeping, say no to the rest, and finish, this team's leverage depends on engagements that end.
  • Exceptional communication with non-engineers: you're comfortable embedded with finance, legal, or HR partners, translating in both directions without losing precision.
  • Experience in highly regulated industries, particularly finance or fintech, is strongly preferred.

What we offer

  • Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career.
  • Performance-driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching.
  • Best-in-class benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents.
  • Lifestyle wallet — a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more.
  • Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits.
  • Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more!
  • Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces.

title: Senior Media Planner, Strategy & Insights
description:
About Polymarket

Polymarket is the world's largest prediction market platform. We enable individuals to express views on real-world events by trading on outcomes across politics, economics, sports, culture, and current affairs. Built as a peer-to-peer marketplace with no centralized "house," Polymarket aggregates diverse opinions into transparent, market-based probabilities that reflect collective expectations about the future.

We're growing fast — both in terms of volume ($21B traded in 2025) and adoption as an alternative news source. Our ambition is to become a ubiquitous beacon of truth in global media and we need your help adding fuel to the fire.

About the Role

The Growth team owns how Polymarket acquires users and converts attention into volume. We move fast, spend real money across a range of channels and geographies, and hold ourselves to business outcomes — not vanity metrics. The media investment function sits at the center of that, and right now it needs someone who can build the analytical backbone that makes every dollar accountable.

This is not a coordination role. You will own the media plan, the forecast, the measurement approach, and the reconciliation. Polymarket operates in an event-driven, highly seasonal environment where timing and pricing can matter as much as budget size — we're looking for someone genuinely restless about finding edge, willing to go looking for the insight nobody asked for and kill their own conclusion when the data doesn't hold.

What You'll Do

  • Build the media plan across channels, categories, and geographies, and present a clear, defensible recommendation with tradeoffs and a point of view — not a menu of options

  • Own the forecasting layer covering spend, volume, acquisition cost, payback, and seasonality, and maintain scenario models that make tradeoffs legible before capital is committed; when we miss a forecast, explain why and make the next model better

  • Pace spend daily and weekly against approved allocations, flag over and under delivery early enough to act, and surface when the actual channel or geographic mix has drifted from the approved plan

  • Lead the measurement approach across mix modeling, incrementality testing, and geographic experiments, and synthesize the outputs into one defensible view of what is working rather than four competing ones

  • Reconcile every media dollar spent, tying platform spend to invoices, agency billing, and the finance ledger, and own accruals, credits, make-goods, and discrepancy resolution through monthly close

  • Hunt continuously for edge in auction dynamics, underpriced inventory, seasonality patterns, and competitive activity, and recommend in-flight reallocation with evidence when the data supports it

  • Build the reporting and analytics layer the team runs on, including dashboards, metric definitions, and a single source of truth that holds up under scrutiny from finance and leadership

What We're Looking For

  • 6+ years in media planning, marketing analytics, or growth strategy with real ownership of plans and numbers — not just supporting roles

title: Senior Market Data Analyst
description:
Flow Traders is seeking a Senior Market Data Analyst to own the strategy, governance, and value realization of our external market data portfolio. You will ensure the right data reaches the right users under the right terms, helping to maximize utility, minimize waste, and empower our Trading, Research, and Technology teams with fit-for-purpose datasets.

Your work will bridge commercial, technical, and operational domains to deliver market data that is compliant, cost-effective, and actionable. As the steward of our external market data, you will shape how Flow Traders discovers, acquires, and applies information at scale.

Core Responsibilities

  • Act as the subject-matter expert on market data usage across the firm, mapping datasets to use cases, workflows, and systems, covering real-time, delayed, and historical data for pricing, analytics, execution, and research.
  • Drive budgeting and forecasting accuracy: model usage, seat inventory, and consumption trends; translate business demand into spend forecasts; track variance and ROI; and advise on cost optimization.
  • Govern entitlements and compliance: ensure data consumption aligns with licensing requirements, exchange/provider policies, display vs. non-display rules, redistribution terms, derived data policies, and audit requirements.
  • Maximize the utility of external data: benchmark vendors, evaluate quality and coverage, run pilots and proof-of-value studies, and partner with engineers to integrate data into production workflows.
  • Provide operational coverage by fulfilling reporting obligations and managing entitlement administration. Actively contribute to knowledge and process management best practices related to market data administration.
  • Collaborate with Legal and Compliance on contract interpretation and policy adherence; with Data Engineering on integration patterns and monitoring; and with Trading and Research on evolving data needs.

Core Skills and Requirements

  • Deep familiarity with data usage in a trading organization, including exchange data, consolidated feeds, alternative data, reference data and corporate actions, ESG data, OTC pricing, and historical and derived datasets.
  • Hands-on experience with market data licensing, entitlements, and compliance, including display vs. non-display usage, redistribution, derived data, device counts, end-user policies, and audit workflows.
  • Proven track record in market data vendor management and negotiations with exchanges and major providers.
  • Strong analytical and financial skills in budgeting, forecasting, and consumption modeling, with experience working with usage telemetry and cost allocation.
  • Experience working with data engineering, MDM, and market data platforms (e.g., feed handlers, tick stores, API gateways, and entitlement systems), with the ability to translate business needs into technical requirements.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence across Trading, Research, Technology, Finance, Legal, and Compliance.
  • A structured, process-oriented mindset with a focus on continuous improvement and measurable outcomes.

 

Flow Traders does not accept unsolicited resumes from any professional staffing or search firms. All resumes, and any other information identifying potential candidates, submitted to any employee at Flow Traders via-email, the Internet or directly without a valid and signed search agreement will be deemed free to contact by Flow Traders without any restrictions and no placement fee of any kind will be paid in the event the candidate is hired by Flow Traders.

title: Security Engineer, Institutional Trading
description:
Blockchain is connecting the world to the future of finance. As the most trusted and fastest-growing global crypto company, it helps millions of people worldwide safely access cryptocurrency. Since its inception in 2011, Blockchain has earned the trust of over 90 million wallet holders and more than 40 million verified users, facilitating over $1 trillion in crypto transactions.

You’ll be the hands-on security engineer embedded with the Institutional Trading and Financial Operations (FinOps) team. Your focus is the secure operation of off-chain trading processes and infrastructure that empowers our institutional business: integrations, signing flows, key custody interfaces, middle-office workflows, order routing and settle pipelines that handle significant capital. You will support risk assessments, operating controls, automation to detect operational anomalies and remediation coordination. This is a high-visibility role where you will focus on operational security engineering - ensuring that the tools and processes our traders use are resilient against both external threats and internal errors. This role does not require smart-contract auditing.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Partner with Trading, Middle Office and Quant (Institutional FinOps) teams to map out inventory trading systems, data flows, third-party integrations and custody/settlement touchpoints.
  • Conduct deep-dive assessments mapping critical assets and workflows to identify structural vulnerabilities. You will be responsible for defining the Target State and drafting the strategic Risk Treatment Plans (RTP) required to meet institutional-grade standards (e.g., CCSS, NIST, DORA).
  • Act as the primary security liaison for Senior Management and third-party vendors. You will translate complex technical gaps into actionable business risk summaries, drive vendor evaluations for core security infrastructure, and manage the project lifecycle for high-impact posture uplifts.
  • Implement and maintain monitoring for FinOps-specific security signals such as abnormal order patterns, signature misuse, unusual settlements. You will integrate these signals into our SIEM/SOAR for real-time response.
  • Support secrets and key-management hygiene. You will ensure app/service keys are stored in KMS/Vault, scoped to least privilege and rotated automatically to prevent credential leakage.
  • Assist product security in triage of SAST/SCA findings for FinOps-related repositories. You will help implement CI checks and remediation playbooks.
  • Participate in incident exercises, post-incident reviews and remediation tracking for trading incidents.
  • Document controls and produce concise risk summaries for FinOps leads and the Security.
  • AI-Driven Innovation: Research, architect, and safely embed cutting-edge AI utilities and Large Language Model (LLM) agents directly into our secure infrastructure.

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • 5+ years in security engineering, platform security, or application security experience.
  • Proven expertise in Threat Modeling. Ability to perform structured reviews (e.g., STRIDE) of complex data flows and operational processes.
  • Experience with observability and detection tooling (SIEM, logs, metrics) and ability to write basic detection rules.
  • Practical experience with KMS/HSM, secrets management platforms (Vault, 1Password, AWS/GCP KMS), IAM patterns and least-privilege.
  • Exceptional ability to translate "Technical Debt" into Business Risk for C-suite stakeholders (CFO, CTO, Head of Trading).
  • Ability to raise, read and audit Pull Requests in at least one language used in our stack (TypeScript, Java/Kotlin, Python).
  • Experience conducting technical due diligence and scoping for third-party security integrations.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Familiarity with trading systems or financial operations (market-making, execution, settlement) or close collaboration background with trading/quant teams.
  • Exposure to blockchain on-chain concepts (wallets, addresses, transactions) but no requirement to audit contracts.
  • Familiarity with SOC operations, and post-incident forensic analysis.
  • Familiarity with SOC2, ISO 27001, or financial audit requirements
  • Any relevant industry certification

COMPENSATION & PERKS

  • Unlimited vacation policy; work hard and take time when you need it.
  • Unlimited books policy; order the technical resources you need or simply pick something up from our company library.
  • Apple equipment.
  • Full-time salary based on experience and meaningful equity in an industry-leading company.
  • Role based in our Paris office, with a mandatory in-office presence four days per week
  • Work from Anywhere Policy: You can work remotely from anywhere in the world for up to 20 days per year.

Blockchain is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sex, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law. This policy applies to all employment practices within our organization, including hiring, recruiting, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, leave of absence, and apprenticeship. Blockchain makes hiring decisions based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs at the time.

You may contact our Data Protection Officer by email at dpo@blockchain.com. Your personal data will be processed for the purposes of managing Controller’s recruitment related activities, which include setting up and conducting interviews and tests for applicants, evaluating and assessing the results thereto, and as is otherwise needed in the recruitment and hiring processes. Such processing is legally permissible under Art. 6(1)(f) of Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (General Data Protection Regulation) as necessary for the purposes of the legitimate interests pursued by the Controller, which are the solicitation, evaluation, and selection of applicants for employment.

Your personal data will be shared with Greenhouse Software, Inc., a cloud services provider located in the United States of America and engaged by Controller to help manage its recruitment and hiring process on Controller’s behalf.  Accordingly, if you are located outside of the United States, your personal data will be transferred to the United States once you submit it through this site. Because the European Union Commission has determined that United States data privacy laws do not ensure an adequate level of protection for personal data collected from EU data subjects, the transfer will be subject to appropriate additional safeguards under the standard contractual clauses. 

Your personal data will be retained by Controller as long as Controller determines it is necessary to evaluate your application for employment.  Under the GDPR, you have the right to request access to your personal data, to request that your personal data be rectified or erased, and to request that processing of your personal data be restricted. You also have the right to data portability. In addition, you may lodge a complaint with an EU supervisory authority.

title: Senior Compliance Analyst
description:
Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.
 
OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.
 
Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.

About the Opportunity

The Compliance function at OKX is responsible for the overall compliance culture at the company. We’re a team of risk-minded problem solvers who advise the business on the company’s regulatory obligations and enterprise risk.Our OKX Malta team, in particular, is responsible for the overall AML and regulatory compliance programs in-country, meeting ongoing EU and global applicable requirements.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Support the MLRO in operating the firm's financial crime compliance framework, ensuring adherence to MiCA, local AML/CFT law, and applicable EU AML/CFT requirements
  • Assist in preparing responses to information requests, RFIs, and inspections from national competent authorities, FIUs, and European supervisory bodies
  • Contribute to enterprise-wide and business-line financial crime risk assessments, and support monitoring, testing, and issue remediation across KYC/CDD, transaction monitoring, sanctions, and blockchain analytics controls
  • Partner with Product teams on new product, service, and token listings to ensure ML/TF risks are assessed and financial crime obligations — including Travel Rule and wallet screening — are addressed before launch
  • Build working relationships with stakeholders across Data, Engineering, Finance, Legal, Product, and Risk to embed financial crime controls into systems and processes
  • Support ad hoc projects, including regulatory change initiatives and remediation programmes, in a fast-paced and evolving environment
  • Help maintain AML/CFT policies, procedures, and risk appetite documentation in line with changing regulatory expectations, and assist with MLRO reporting to senior management and the Board
  • Stay current on developments across the crypto economy and the financial crime landscape — including typologies, illicit finance trends, blockchain and protocol developments, industry participants, and EU/national rulemaking, guidance, and enforcement

What We Look For In You

  • 3+ years of experience in AML/CFT compliance within cryptocurrency industry, financial services or FinTech ideally combined with some MiFID II compliance experience
  • Experience in Client onboarding, KYC or AML monitoring
  • Regulatory project management skills with attention to detail, proactive, and well-organized
  • Some knowledge of the crypto economy with a strong desire to learn more
  • Ability to work within a global working environment
  • Strong communication and presentation skills, both verbal and written

Nice to Haves

  • Compliance experience within Traditional Exchanges or Investment banks
  • Familiarity with MiCA or Payments rules as well as some understanding of MiFID II regulation
  • Experience with AML suspicious transactions fillings
  • Interest in leveraging AI tools (in particular Claude) to improve reporting, documentation, workflow management, and productivity.

Perks & Benefits

  • Competitive total compensation package
  • L&D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development
  • Various team building programs and company events
  • Wellness and meal allowances 
  • Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants 
  • More that we love to tell you along the process!
