title: Senior Software Engineer, Blockchain Platform Nodes
Partnerships, Capital Markets
description:
Tempo is a layer-1 blockchain purpose-built for stablecoins and real-world payments, born from Stripe’s experience in global payments and Paradigm’s expertise in crypto tech.

 

Tempo’s payment-first design provides a scalable, low-cost predictable backbone that meets the needs of high-volume payment use cases. Our goal is to move money reliably, cheaply, and at scale. Our north star is simplicity for users: fintechs, traditional banks, merchants, platforms, and anyone else looking to move their payments into the 21st century.

 

We're building Tempo with design partners who are global leaders in AI, e-commerce, and financial services: Anthropic, Coupang, Deutsche Bank, DoorDash, Mercury, Nubank, OpenAI, Revolut, Shopify, Standard Chartered, Visa, and more.

 

We’re a team of crypto-optimists, building the infrastructure needed to bring real, substantial economic flows onchain. We like to move fast and swing for the fences — join us!

The Role

We’re hiring for someone to build Tempo’s real-world asset and stablecoin capital markets strategy. In this role, you will source attractive yield opportunities and bring them onchain, structure new financial products with appropriate risk protection and liquidity, and develop durable institutional onchain borrow demand.

Responsibilities

  • Define and drive Tempo’s commercial partnership strategy across onchain capital markets and real-world assets.

  • Build and own relationships with asset originators, asset managers, banks, lenders, insurers, broker-dealers, institutional borrowers, and other capital markets participants.

  • Source and evaluate traditional financial assets and yield opportunities that can be brought onchain.

  • Structure financial products and partnerships that incorporate insurance, guarantees, credit enhancement, reserves, or other risk-transfer mechanisms where appropriate.

  • Develop liquidity strategies across issuance, redemption, duration and cash-flow matching, secondary liquidity, and periods of market stress.

  • Build relationships with institutional borrowers and source durable institutional onchain borrow demand

  • Serve as a consultative, technical design partner to discover and guide product integration with customers.

  • Act as the voice of partners internally, shaping GTM priorities and feedback loops.

  • Help develop scalable playbooks for onboarding, product launches, and partner success.

  • Represent Tempo externally at conferences, industry forums, and ecosystem events.

Qualifications

  • Deep experience in capital markets, structured credit, private credit, fixed income, securitization, insurance, or an adjacent financial product role at an investment bank, asset manager, insurer, lender, or other financial institution.

  • Proven track record of structuring and launching new financial products, from opportunity identification and risk analysis through distribution and execution.

  • Strong understanding of financial risk protection, including insurance, guarantees, credit enhancement, collateral, reserves, and other risk-transfer structures.

  • Strong command of liquidity considerations, including asset-liability matching, redemption design, duration, secondary-market liquidity, and stress scenarios.

  • Experience sourcing capital or borrow demand and building relationships with institutional borrowers, lenders, and allocators.

  • Experience bringing traditional financial assets or credit products onchain, or deep experience across blockchain and adjacent fintech infrastructure.

  • Proven track record of sourcing and scaling partnerships with enterprises and high-growth startups.

  • Comfortable navigating complex organizations and aligning stakeholders across technical and business teams.

  • Excellent judgment in sourcing, evaluating, and prioritizing high-impact opportunities.

  • Comfort working closely with legal, compliance, risk, finance, product, and engineering teams.

  • Experience with B2B or developer-adjacent products, such as APIs, dashboards, or partner platforms.

Attributes

  • High-energy, proactive, and execution-driven.

  • Proficient at understanding and communicating technical concepts.

  • Sharp communicator who can tell Tempo’s story clearly and persuasively.

  • Strong organizational and relationship management skills.

  • Commercially creative and analytically rigorous, with the ability to balance yield, risk, liquidity, and distribution.

  • Curious, adaptable, and eager to learn from partners and the ecosystem.

  • Scrappy and hands-on; willing to dive deep to make partners successful.

title: Marketing Operations & Content Manager
description:
About Symbiotic

 

Symbiotic is the infrastructure beneath collateral markets, where capital can secure financial obligations, remain productive, and be enforced by code.

By changing the economics of onchain collateral, Symbiotic enables new categories of neofinance applications that were previously impossible to build - including credit, insurance, RWA liquidity, and more.

As institutional capital increasingly moves onchain, Symbiotic is positioned to become the coordination layer connecting capital and risk across the onchain economy.


Backed by Paradigm, Pantera, Cyber.fund, and Coinbase Ventures, we power 80+ vaults, 74,000+ active stakers, and 111 operators - with Chainlink and Cap Labs among the teams live in production.

 

See how Symbiotic is powering the next generation of onchain finance: symbiotic.fi

Our People

 

We’re a tight-knit team of experienced builders working at the forefront of financial infrastructure. Our backgrounds span high-growth tech start-ups, leading crypto companies, major banks, insurers, and financial institutions. We work with ownership, a high bar for craft, and the urgency of an early-stage company - in an environment where people are trusted to take initiative and supported to do their best work.

We’re looking for talented professionals to join us at a defining moment, as Symbiotic helps shape the next generation of onchain finance.

The Role

Marketing at Symbiotic spans two very different audiences: crypto-native and traditional institutions. This role is the operational heart of that function; part creator, part operator. You'll run the day-to-day machinery of co-marketing, events and produce content for our socials.

Moreover, you’ll act as the quality bar for everything marketing puts out. As we scale, this role will grow with the function: podcast, newsletter, and other new channels are on the roadmap, and you'll help build them.

What You'll Do

• Own day-to-day marketing ops: the calendar, the pipeline, the follow-through, so nothing ships late and nothing falls through the cracks

• Create content: you'll come up with ideas, execute the simpler ones yourself, and coordinate the team on the rest

• Run ecosystem and co-marketing coordination with partners over Telegram and other channels

• Act as QA for marketing output, keeping things on-brand and on time

• Coordinate the occasional international event, from logistics to on-the-ground execution when required

• Help launch new initiatives as the function grows: podcast, newsletter, etc.

Who You Are

• Organized, high-energy, and proactive: you bring momentum to the team rather than waiting for direction

• Experienced in or around crypto, with enough baseline knowledge to get up to speed on our products quickly and own recurring content yourself

• A sharp eye for brand: you notice when something is off-brand or off-quality before it ships

• You've worked close to TradFi or institutional audiences, or at minimum know how to speak to them

• Hands-on experience running marketing ops: campaigns, calendars, coordination across stakeholders

• You've coordinated events before, ideally internationally

• Comfortable juggling multiple partner conversations and internal stakeholders without dropping threads

Nice to Have

• A knack for spotting crypto trends we can jump on quickly

• Active participant in crypto communities

• You understand onchain or traditional financial products (credit, insurance, lending)

title: Enterprise Sales Lead (Korea)
description:
OP Labs builds Optimism, an open-source blockchain network that powers the next generation of financial infrastructure. Hundreds of companies, from the world's largest enterprises like Sony, Coinbase, Kraken, Uniswap, OKX, and Bitpanda to the most ambitious early-stage builders, use the OP stack to launch their own blockchains and bring their users onchain. Today, over 65% of Layer 2 activity on Ethereum runs through the OP stack.

We are a small team building at the speed of the ecosystem we support. We’re remote-friendly but the NYC office is our center of gravity. We've raised $178M from a16z, Paradigm, and others. We have our work cut out for us and are looking for exceptional people to join us.

About the Role

We’re looking for an entrepreneurial, highly strategic Enterprise Sales Lead to drive adoption of Optimism across global institutions. You’ll be responsible for identifying, closing, and scaling high-impact partnerships with the largest institutions in the world which are strategic to our growth strategy.

This role is both strategic and executional. You’ll work directly with Optimism leadership, product, marketing, and partnership to shape new financial primitives that are only possible onchain. You will bring them to market through deep partnerships with the world’s most ambitious builders in institutions.

What are the role responsibilities?

  • Own and execute strategy

    • Define and lead Optimism’s strategy for institutions end-to-end - act like a GM

    • Identify high-leverage market entry points (e.g., stablecoin corridors, embedded finance use cases, B2B/B2C rails)

    • Translate protocol advantages into compelling narratives tailored to institutional decision-makers

  • Originate and close deals

    • Source, structure, and close high-impact partnerships with institutions

  • Drive product alignment

    • Collaborate closely with product, engineering, and partner teams to ensure successful integration and onboarding

    • Channel market feedback to influence roadmap decisions (e.g., compliance features, wallet UX, account abstraction)

    • Shape internal Optimism offerings (e.g., SDKs, liquidity support, ecosystem programs) to better meet institution partner needs

  • Lead externally

    • Represent Optimism at industry events, institutions conferences, and global policy forums

    • Publish thought leadership on programmable money, composable compliance, and the future of payments infrastructure

    • Build and maintain strong relationships with ecosystem players (wallets, stablecoin issuers, banking-as-a-service providers, L2s)

What skills do you bring?

  • Experience

    • 10+ years of experience in enterprise sales

    • Proven track record of closing and scaling complex deals with institutional clients

    • Deep understanding of fintech infrastructure: wallets, custody, card issuing, stablecoins, compliance tooling, and developer platforms

    • Familiarity with crypto infrastructure—especially Ethereum, Layer 2s, and wallet abstraction concepts

  • Skills & Approach

    • Sharp strategic thinker who can map fragmented fintech value chains and craft compelling BD theses

    • Independent deal-closer who’s comfortable interfacing with C-level stakeholders and navigating multi-party partnerships

    • High agency operator who can build 0→1 partnerships, GTM strategies, and partner programs with minimal oversight

    • Strong communicator who can translate between business, technical, and ecosystem stakeholders across varying levels of crypto fluency

    • Comfortable navigating ambiguity in a fast-moving, frontier market and iterating quickly based on learnings

  • Culture & Mindset

    • Motivated to rebuild the global financial stack on open, composable rails

    • You value results over recognition

    • Thrive in collaborative, cross-functional teams but can also move quickly on your own

    • Always looking to create scalable impact via product, partnerships, or ecosystems

We are aware of fraudulent individuals falsely claiming to represent OP Labs in recruitment activities.
Please note:

  • All official communication will come from an @oplabs.co email address, or from a verified Linked profile.

  • We will never ask for payment, banking information, or personal identification details at any stage of our hiring process.

  • All current openings are listed exclusively on our official careers page and linked from our verified social profiles.

  • If you’re ever unsure about a communication that claims to be from OP Labs, please contact us directly at people@oplabs.co to verify authenticity.

Your safety and trust are very important to us. Thank you for helping us prevent fraud.

title: Lead, FCM Legal
description:
About Polymarket

Polymarket is the world's largest prediction market platform. We enable individuals to express views on real-world events by trading on outcomes across politics, economics, sports, culture, and current affairs. Built as a peer-to-peer marketplace with no centralized "house," Polymarket aggregates diverse opinions into transparent, market-based probabilities that reflect collective expectations about the future.

We're growing fast — both in terms of volume ($21B traded in 2025) and adoption as an alternative news source. Our ambition is to become a ubiquitous beacon of truth in global media and we need your help adding fuel to the fire.

About the Role

Polymarket operates a CFTC-regulated designated contract market (DCM) and derivatives clearing organization (DCO). As we scale, the legal and regulatory infrastructure supporting our FCM relationships has to keep pace with the business. This role exists to own that work directly — not manage it from a distance.

You'll sit inside a small, senior legal team and work closely with Compliance, Surveillance, and product. The mandate is clear: keep the FCM function legally sound, anticipate regulatory risk before it becomes a problem, and engage with the CFTC and NFA from a position of deep technical fluency. We need someone who knows FCM regulation cold, can move quickly, and will be consulted early and often by the business — not looped in at the end to sign off.

What You'll Do

  • Advise product and business teams on CFTC implications before new features ship, not after

  • Draft and negotiate customer-facing FCM agreements, disclosures, and related documentation to ensure they are accurate, compliant, and ready to send

  • Prepare responses to CFTC and NFA regulatory inquiries and examinations, coordinating across Legal and Compliance to produce tight, well-supported submissions

  • Draft comment letters, no-action requests, and interpretive submissions on matters affecting the FCM, DCM, and DCO

  • Track CFTC enforcement actions, rulemaking, and NFA notices to surface emerging risks and translate them into actionable guidance for internal teams

  • Advise on FCM policies and procedures covering segregation, net capital, margin, and customer protection requirements

  • Support litigation strategy on matters touching FCM operations and exchange regulation

What We're Looking For

  • J.D. and active U.S. bar membership

  • 3–7 years of FCM-focused legal or compliance experience, either in private practice, at a regulator, or in-house at a derivatives firm

  • Deep working knowledge of the Commodity Exchange Act, CFTC regulations, and NFA rules, particularly as they apply to FCMs — including segregation, net capital, and margin requirements

  • Demonstrated ability to write clearly and persuasively — comment letters, no-action requests, and customer agreements that are filed or sent with minimal revision

  • A track record of being brought into business and product decisions early, not used as a last-minute legal check

  • Strong judgment about when to escalate, when to move, and how to give practical guidance under regulatory uncertainty

  • Direct experience with CFTC examination or enforcement processes

  • (Plus) Familiarity with prediction markets or event contracts

  • (Plus) Interest in emerging financial technologies and market structure

Benefits

  • Competitive salary & equity

  • Unlimited PTO

  • Full Health, Vision, & Dental coverage

  • 401k match

  • Hardware setup: new MacBook Pro, big display, & accessories

Pay Transparency

Base salary range: $250,000 to $340,000 annually, plus equity and benefits.

This range reflects a good-faith estimate for this position. Experience levels vary widely within a title here, so please reach out even if your expectations fall outside it. We're always happy to chat.

title: Director, Cybersecurity
description:
ABOUT HUT 8

Imagine the ultimate destination for those who want to work at the cutting edge of technology, energy, and infrastructure. Hut 8 is on a mission to build and operate some of the world’s largest data centers for next-generation computing workloads, including AI, Colocation, Cloud, and Bitcoin Mining. We are proud to offer interesting and challenging opportunities for individuals who want to build teams, solve problems, and make an impact from day one. If you’re an ambitious individual looking for a career that is as rewarding as it is challenging, you’ve come to the right place.

ABOUT THE ROLE

The Partner, Cyber Security is the leader accountable for defining and building Hut 8's entire security program from the ground up. Operating at the domain owner, this person owns security strategy, architecture, and governance across corporate IT, mining operations, data-center infrastructure, cloud, and AI/compute environments. They set the security vision, establish the control framework, manage the cyber security vendor (i.e. Kernel Advisory) relationship, and in-house Security Operations capability. This is a hands-on builder-leader role, reporting into the Technology organization.

What You'll Do

+  Define and own Hut 8's end-to-end cybersecurity strategy, roadmap, and security architecture spanning corporate IT, mining operations, data centers, cloud, and AI/compute environments.

+  Establish the enterprise security control framework and governance, risk & compliance (GRC) program, aligning to recognized standards (e.g., NIST CSF, ISO 27001, SOC 2) and relevant regulatory obligations.

+  Design defense-in-depth architecture across network segmentation, identity & access management (IAM), endpoint, cloud, and OT/industrial control systems, embedding "security by default" into all new systems.

+  Build and lead the Security Operations capability — threat detection, monitoring, incident response, and vulnerability management.

+  Own identity and access governance, including privileged access, MFA, SSO, least-privilege policy, and access reviews across the enterprise.

+  Lead incident response and breach management end to end: preparation, detection, containment, eradication, recovery, and post-incident review, including executive and regulatory communication.

+  Manage the security vendor ecosystem and budget, defining tooling strategy, evaluating and selecting platforms, and setting clear exit criteria for reducing external dependency.

+  Establish the security awareness and anti-phishing program, driving a security-conscious culture across a rapidly scaling, multi-site workforce.

+  Partner with Software, Networking, Data Engineering, Business Intelligence and Applied AI leaders to secure the technology lifecycle, production platforms, and enterprise data without slowing delivery.

+  Recruit, mentor, and grow the internal security team, building the cyber security internal capacity.

ABOUT YOU

title: Project Manager
description:
About the Role

0G is looking for a highly proactive Project Manager to drive execution across our business, product, and engineering teams.

This role is for someone who enjoys bringing structure to a fast-moving, remote environment. You will take company priorities and turn them into clear projects, owners, timelines, and measurable outcomes—then stay close to execution to make sure things actually get done.

You will work across multiple functions. You should be comfortable understanding priorities, translating context clearly, identifying blockers early, and proactively driving teams toward resolution.

Because we operate as a distributed team, strong remote communication is essential. You should know how to create clarity without relying on constant meetings—documenting decisions, communicating context asynchronously, following up proactively, and making sure stakeholders know what they own and what happens next.

This is not a role where you simply maintain project trackers or schedule meetings. We are looking for someone with strong ownership who will actively identify gaps, follow up on commitments, challenge unclear priorities, and help teams execute more effectively.

What You'll Do

  • Drive cross-functional projects from planning through execution and completion across business, product, engineering, and other teams

  • Coordinate closely with engineering and business teams to ensure priorities, requirements, dependencies, and timelines are clearly understood

  • Document important context, decisions, action items, owners, and deadlines so teams can move forward without unnecessary meetings

  • Proactively identify blockers, risks, and misalignment, and work with stakeholders to resolve them before they impact delivery

  • Follow up on commitments and ensure clear ownership and accountability across teams

  • Support company- and team-level OKR and KPI setting, tracking, and review

  • Build dashboards, trackers, and reporting processes that give leadership clear visibility into progress, risks, and performance

  • Facilitate focused cross-functional meetings when real-time discussion is needed, and ensure every discussion translates into clear decisions and next steps

  • Help improve internal processes, workflows, documentation, and communication as the company scales

  • Identify areas where teams are operating inefficiently or where ownership is unclear, and proactively propose improvements

  • Communicate project status, trade-offs, risks, and decisions clearly to leadership and relevant stakeholders

  • Take on high-priority operational and strategic projects as business needs evolve

What We're Looking For

  • Approximately 4–7 years of experience in project management, program management, business operations, strategy & operations, PMO, or a similar cross-functional role

  • Proven experience independently driving complex projects involving multiple teams and stakeholders

  • Strong project management fundamentals, including planning, prioritization, dependency management, risk management, and execution tracking

  • Experience working closely with product and/or engineering teams

  • Experience with OKRs, KPIs, performance tracking, or business review processes

  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills

  • Strong experience working in remote or distributed teams, with the ability to communicate clearly and proactively without relying on constant synchronous meetings

  • Strong written communication and documentation habits, with the ability to summarize complex discussions into clear decisions, owners, and next steps

  • Comfortable coordinating across functions and time zones and proactively following up when communication stalls

  • Highly proactive and comfortable pushing for clarity, surfacing issues, and holding stakeholders accountable

  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to bring structure to ambiguous problems

  • Comfortable working in a fast-moving startup environment where priorities can change quickly

  • Able to operate independently without waiting for detailed instructions

  • Fluent in English, with the ability to communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders, Chinese is a plus

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience at a startup, scale-up, AI, cloud infrastructure, developer tools, or other technology company

  • Experience building project-management and communication processes for distributed teams

  • Experience coordinating between Chinese-speaking engineering teams and English-speaking business stakeholders

  • Experience building project management or operating processes from the ground up

  • Familiarity with tools such as Linear, Jira, Notion, Slack, or similar collaboration and project-management platforms

  • Consulting or strategy experience is a plus, but not required

What we offer

  • Purpose: The opportunity to contribute to making AI a public good

  • Growth: A self-directed environment where you can take initiative to shape your role and career

  • Compensation: Market-competitive compensation including, for most roles, exposure to pre-launch tokens

In addition, 0G Labs is committed to the health and well being of all of our team members. To that end, we provide reimbursements towards a holistic set of experiences and courses:

  • Core self: Transcendental Meditation

  • Build multi-agent systems with tool use, function calling, and multi-step reasoning that connect fragmented HR tools (HRIS, ATS, payroll, ticketing) into coherent, end-to-end workflows.

  • Build error handling, audit trails, payroll-calendar awareness, and human-in-the-loop checkpoints into every production system before deployment.

  • Ensure all automations comply with data classification requirements for employee PII, regulated data, and cross-jurisdictional privacy obligations.

Own governance and risk for People AI systems

  • Classify all automation builds by risk tier before work begins. No build goes to production without a named Process Owner, documented data flows, and access controls confirmed.

  • Maintain audit logging and documentation for all systems touching regulated employee data or payroll-adjacent workflows.

  • Halt or redesign builds that introduce unacceptable payroll, legal, or data privacy risk. Own that decision and get organizational acceptance before proceeding.

  • Serve as the HRKX domain representative in contributing to governance standards and cross-functional build alignment.

Multiply the People team's capability

  • Produce documentation, workflow templates, and runbooks that HRKX professionals can use and maintain without technical support.

  • Train People team members on AI-assisted tools and workflows deployed in production. Drive adoption, not just delivery.

  • Track and report on automation impact: manual hours eliminated, error rates reduced, payroll exceptions avoided, and capacity unlocked for strategic HR work.

  • Act as a force multiplier for the HR KX team, enabling HR professionals to focus on high-value advisory and people judgment work through process, technology, and AI enablement.


What You Bring

These are verified requirements for this role. Candidates who do not meet the core requirements will not advance to interview.

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 2+ years focused on building AI/ML-powered applications or agentic systems in production.

  • 2–3+ years of experience working on HR, People Operations, or people technology problems—either at an HR tech company, on an internal People Engineering team, or in a technical role embedded within an HR function. You don’t need to be an HR expert, but you need to understand HR dynamics, workflows, and the sensitivity of people's data.

  • Strong fluency with AI and workflow automation tools, with demonstrated experience designing, deploying, and driving adoption of AI solutions within HR workflows

  • Demonstrated hands-on experience designing and deploying AI-powered or automated workflows in a production environment used by others, not just experimentation.

  • Deep working knowledge of Workday, including job change workflows, worker conversions, EIB data uploads, integration architecture, and payroll dependencies.

  • Systems thinker with a strong implementation mindset — able to move from discovery → design → build → deployment → optimization without relying on external consultant

  • Proficiency with AI tooling stack: n8n, Python, Claude API/Anthropic SDK, or equivalent. Experience connecting HR systems via API is required.

  • Strong analytical problem-solving skills with the ability to structure ambiguous people questions into clear, actionable, automated analysis.

  • Solid understanding of employee data classification, PII handling requirements, and cross-jurisdictional HR compliance obligations.


Nice to Haves

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
About the company

Hi, we're Ondo Finance. Our mission is to provide institutional-grade, blockchain-enabled investment products and services. We have both a technology arm that develops decentralized finance technology, and an asset management arm that creates and manages tokenized funds. We are the global leader in tokenized treasuries, tokenized stocks and ETFs, and are building the future of institutional-grade financial services onchain.

Founded by alumni of Goldman Sachs' Digital Assets team, we're backed by some of the best investors in the world, including Founders Fund, Coinbase Ventures, Pantera Capital, Tiger Global, and more. We are the category leader by AUM, well-capitalized, and growing quickly. We're fully remote, with team members across the U.S.

About the role

Our Data Science team turns on-chain and off-chain data into the analytics, risk, and decision-making infrastructure behind Ondo Global Markets (tokenized stocks) and Ondo Perps. We're hiring Ondo's first Data Engineer to build the foundational data platform that this work depends on—consolidating fragmented data sources, standing up a unified warehouse in BigQuery, and making trustworthy, well-modeled data available to the entire team.

This is a hands-on infrastructure role with end-to-end ownership. You'll lead the migration of analytics into BigQuery, work directly in the Go services that power Ondo Perps to ingest additional data into the warehouse, and build the repeatable ETL pipelines that let data scientists, risk, and analytics move quickly and self-serve. You'll partner closely with Data Science, Backend Engineering, Risk, and Product to replace today's siloed, ad-hoc pipelines with reliable, observable, and reusable data infrastructure.

Our team operates with high autonomy, high trust, urgency, and an uncompromising quality bar. We're looking for someone who improves the platform without waiting to be asked, cares deeply about data quality and correctness, and pairs strong engineering judgment with humility. You'll shape both Ondo's data foundation and how our Data Science team builds and scales analytics.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the migration of analytics and existing data workflows into BigQuery, establishing it as Ondo's unified, trusted warehouse and reporting layer.
  • Read, understand, and extend the Go services powering Ondo Perps to ingest additional data into the warehouse (e.g. changefeeds and streaming/batch sinks from production systems).
  • Design, build, and operate repeatable, well-tested ETL/ELT pipelines that the wider Data Science team can rely on and reuse.
  • Consolidate fragmented and siloed data sources—internal databases (CockroachDB, QuestDB), on-chain and market-data vendors (Allium, Dune, Databento), and product analytics—into consistent, well-modeled datasets.
  • Establish standards for data ingestion, transformation (e.g. dbt), orchestration, testing, lineage, and documentation so definitions are consistent and self-serve.
  • Experience building foundational metrics and dashboards, with strong opinions on data lineage and quality, in partnership with Data Science.
  • Own data quality, observability, monitoring, access controls, and cost management across the pipelines and warehouse.
  • Partner with Data Science, Backend Engineering, Risk, and Product to turn analytical and reporting needs into durable data infrastructure.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of data engineering experience building and operating production data pipelines and warehouses.
  • Deep hands-on experience with a cloud data warehouse—BigQuery strongly preferred—including performance, partitioning, and cost optimization.
  • Strong SQL and data modeling skills, plus experience with modern transformation and orchestration tooling (e.g. dbt, Airflow, Dagflow-style schedulers, or similar).
  • Experience designing batch and streaming ingestion (CDC/changefeeds, event pipelines) from operational databases into a warehouse.
  • Experience building data infrastructure for fintech, trading, or other high-integrity financial systems where correctness and auditability matter.
  • High standards for data quality, reliability, testing, observability, and documentation.
  • Clear communication, high ownership, and a track record of delivering effectively with both technical and non-technical partners.

Nice to haves

  • Proficiency reading and writing Go, or strong general software-engineering ability and a track record of quickly ramping on unfamiliar production codebases.
  • Experience with crypto-native or on-chain data, and vendors such as Allium, Dune, or Databento.
  • Familiarity with CockroachDB, QuestDB, Snowflake, or similar operational and analytical stores.
  • Experience enabling self-serve analytics and AI-over-data workflows for analytics and data science teams.
  • Exposure to risk, quantitative analytics, or trading microstructure data.

What we offer

  • Competitive compensation including salary, future token rights, and/or equity, according to your preferences. We're well-funded and believe that great talent deserves great compensation.
  • Full benefits, including medical, vision, and dental coverage, plus a flexible vacation policy.
  • A remote-first team across many countries. You'll be an early team member helping shape our vision, culture, and engineering practices.
  • A+ colleagues. Our team includes alumni from Goldman Sachs, BlackRock, Two Sigma, Bridgewater, SpaceX, AWS, Meta, Google, McKinsey, Coinbase, Circle, and Uniswap.
  • Best-in-class investors. We are proud to be backed by leading crypto experts and venture firms, including Pantera Capital, Founders Fund, and Coinbase Ventures.

title: Senior Director, Ecosystem Growth, South Korea
Head of Engineering, Onchain
description:
About Mesh

At Mesh, our mission is to enable consumers to pay and be paid with any asset. Today, trillions of dollars in tokenized assets exist but remain largely unusable for everyday commerce. Mesh is bridging this gap by making crypto payments reliable, useful, and ubiquitous. We combine a powerful orchestration engine with a seamless consumer app to unlock liquidity for the world. Backed by leading investors like SBI, Money Forward, Paradigm, Dragonfly, Galaxy, and PayPal Ventures, we are building the infrastructure for the next era of the global economy. Join us!

Overview

We’re hiring a Head of Engineering to lead our Full-Stack Web3 team building the products and infrastructure that power our crypto payments platform, from client-facing wallet connection flows and dashboards to backend transaction processing, multi-chain infrastructure, and on/off-ramp systems. Mesh is a global company headquartered in San Francisco. 

What You'll Do

  • Own the technical strategy for Web3 initiatives, translating company priorities into a multi-quarter plan executed across your team.
  • Build, manage, and grow a team of mainly senior to staff level engineers – hire, coach, and set career paths.
  • Lead the design and technical direction for complex workflows spanning wallets, transactions, settlements, and on-chain/off-chain orchestration, partnering closely with your managers on execution.
  • Own planning, execution, and delivery of multi-chain integrations, wallet infrastructure (self-custody and MPC/custodial), RPC node management, and on-chain transaction monitoring at the org level.
  • Partner with Product, Design, Compliance, Legal, and other cross-functional and external teams to turn ambiguous requirements into a coherent technical roadmap.
  • Represent engineering in exec-level planning and reporting, influencing company-wide roadmap decisions and resourcing.

Who You Are

  • 5+ years of experience managing engineering teams with a track record of scaling teams and organizational structure.
  • 8+ years of overall engineering experience, including production experience across frontend, backend, and on-chain components in a Web3/blockchain context.
  • Hands-on (or recent hands-on) experience with Web3 building blocks — wallet connectivity/integrations, dApp development, blockchain RPCs and indexing, and/or on-chain/off-chain payment & settlement flows — and comfortable going deep with your teams on technical tradeoffs.
  • Familiar with DeFi primitives (DEXs, swaps, lending, trading platforms) and how they operate in production systems.
  • Strong understanding of the transaction lifecycle (signing, submission, execution) and a security-first mindset you can instill across an organization.
  • Experience setting engineering standards and technical direction across a stack that spans modern frontend frameworks (TypeScript, React), backend services/APIs (Go, Rust, Java/Scala, Node.js, or similar), and smart contracts/on-chain interactions (Solidity).
  • Solid fundamentals in building scalable, reliable, observable distributed systems (monitoring, logging, tracing, performance) and a track record of holding teams accountable to reliability bars.
  • Comfort operating in the ambiguity of a fast-moving, regulated fintech environment — able to navigate cross-functional and cross-border collaboration (Mesh’s teams span North America, Europe, and India).
 

The compensation range provided may span multiple career levels and will be narrowed during the interview process based on factors including a candidate's experience, skills, qualifications, and geographic location. For candidates outside of New York or San Francisco, compensation will be adjusted to reflect the applicable market and location-based pay band. The base salary range listed excludes commission (if applicable), equity, and benefits. The pay range represents the minimum and maximum target for new-hire compensation. Actual compensation may vary and may be higher or lower depending on individual circumstances.

Pay Range
$210,000—$300,000 USD

Why You’ll Love It Here

At Mesh, you're not stepping into a typical role—you're joining a rocket ship in mid-liftoff. You'll tackle complex, meaningful problems that actually move an industry forward, working alongside a sharp, motivated team that moves quickly, collaborates deeply, and expects everyone to operate with ownership. This is the kind of place where you'll see your work ship fast, make real impact, and be able to point to something and say, "I built that." You'll grow fast, level up your skills, and get a front-row seat to how a high-growth company scales from the inside, with competitive comp, solid benefits, and room to stretch your craft all coming standard. If you're energized by building, learning, and shaping something big—this is where you'll want to be.

In-Office Expectations

Employees based in our San Francisco, New York, and Bangalore hubs are expected to work from the office at least 40% of the time (approximately two days per week). This expectation may vary slightly depending on role, team, and business needs. Certain roles that require closer cross-functional collaboration or operational support may have additional in-office requirements, which will be discussed during the interview process. Our hybrid approach is designed to balance meaningful in-person collaboration, team building, and real-time decision-making with the flexibility to work remotely. We believe this structure supports strong execution while preserving autonomy and focus time.

How We Care For Our Team

We believe great work happens when people feel valued and supported. That starts with competitive salary and equity that grows as you and the company grow, plus comprehensive health coverage for you and your family. We offer unlimited PTO—and we mean it. Take the time you need to recharge and show up at your best.

We're invested in your growth with a dedicated budget for courses, conferences, and certifications. Work from wherever you're most productive with our remote-friendly approach, and count on having the top-tier tools and equipment you need to do exceptional work.

Mesh Pay is committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, genetic information, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, lawful alien status, national origin, age, marital status, and non-job related physical or mental disability, or protected veteran status. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

title: Senior Copywriter
description:
Phantom is on a mission to connect the world to the freedom of open markets. Tens of millions of people all over the world use Phantom to access global markets that never close, including perpetuals, prediction markets, tokenized assets, stablecoins and memes. Phantom users are able to discover the markets that matter and the cultural moments that shape them, building conviction through real-time data and the verified performance of top traders. With self-custody and access to open networks at its core, Phantom lets them control their financial moves in the same app they use to safely store or spend money worldwide.

Phantom has reached #1 in Google Play's finance category and consistently ranks in the top 50 apps across all categories. Phantom partners with many of the most trusted and influential names in finance like Hyperliquid, Stripe, Kalshi and Visa, to make the most popular and innovative financial products accessible to everyone.

We are around 180 people, fully remote, backed by a $150M Series C investment from a16z, Sequoia Capital and Paradigm.

As a Senior Copywriter on our brand creative team you’ll craft compelling and impactful copy that brings our brand to life across all channels. Your work will engage and inspire our global community, helping users understand and embrace Phantom the next generation of digital finance.

This is a general opening, based on your fit and marketing experience you could be working on projects across product, partnerships, brand, content, influencer, and experiential marketing. There will be a lot of space to conceive, own and drive initiatives with 20M+ monthly active users, Phantom is a rare opportunity to impact the experience of people at scale.

Responsibilities

  • Lead creative development of impactful copy, concepts, and campaigns across both product and brand marketing, ensuring alignment with our brand voice, tone, and creative direction.

  • Create high-quality marketing copy for all digital channels including website, email, social media, push notifications, in-app communications, blogs, newsletters, and press releases.

  • Generate innovative content ideas and conceptualize creative campaigns that drive brand engagement and align with business goals, ensuring that each piece of content is strategically designed to capture attention and deliver measurable impact across all channels.

  • Ensure brand consistency by maintaining our tone of voice across all communications, fostering a cohesive and unified user experience.

  • Oversee quality control to ensure messaging meets the highest standards, and optimize processes for efficiency and productivity to meet company-wide copy needs.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (including product, design, and engineering) to develop narratives that engage audiences and align with Phantom’s broader strategic vision.

  • Stay up-to-date with industry trends, audience insights, and competitive landscape to ensure our messaging stays relevant, fresh, and innovative.

  • Use data-driven insights to optimize copy performance and refine messaging, ensuring maximum impact and user engagement.

  • Adapt quickly to changes in business needs and audience preferences, ensuring the copy reflects evolving trends and demands.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience as a Copywriter or in a similar creative role, with a strong portfolio that demonstrates excellence in writing for digital marketing and brand communications.

  • Exceptional writing and editing skills with a keen eye for detail, tone, and voice.

  • Strong ability to adapt copy across different formats while maintaining consistency.

  • Excellent communication and storytelling abilities to convey product benefits effectively

  • Understanding of marketing principles and digital marketing tactics

  • Familiarity with data analytics tools and performance metrics to refine messaging.

  • Experience in the cryptocurrency, fintech, or tech industry is a plus, but not required.

  • A passion for creativity and innovation, with a solid understanding of how compelling storytelling drives engagement and action.

  • Proven ability to influence cross-functional teams without formal authority

Why Work with Us

Opportunity

We are a team of experienced builders in the blockchain and crypto industry. Our journey began from users seeking an easy, seamless path to accessing the crypto ecosystem. This passion fueled our exponential growth, allowing us to onboard over 20M+ active users in just over five years; with our user base growing weekly. Our dedication to a secure and seamless user experience has made us the leading wallet on Solana as well as our multi-chain approach enhances our platform's versatility, meeting the needs of a diverse and growing user base. By staying at the forefront of technology and user expectations, we continue to innovate and set industry standards on self-custodial crypto wallets.

There has never been a better time to work in crypto to help shape the future of innovation.

  • First impressions matter: Wallets are responsible for a users first impression with crypto and onboarding new users into crypto. By ensuring that a user has a great first-time experience with crypto, we can help supercharge the growth of the entire ecosystem.

  • Make crypto easier to navigate: There is no easy way for a user to discover and navigate all that crypto has to offer. Wallets have a unique opportunity to help users not only onboard to crypto but also stay retained by exploring new things to do.

  • We live in a multi-chain world: We currently support Solana, Ethereum, Polygon and Bitcoin with more networks to come in the new future. We are focused on creating a unified, multi-chain crypto experience for users.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary and equity

  • Eligibility to participate in performance bonus program

  • Comprehensive insurance (medical/dental/vision) — 100% covered

  • Stipend for your ideal remote / WFH set-up: laptop, headphones, and any other work gear you may need

  • Flexible hours and a long-standing, supportive remote environment

  • Unlimited vacation: Take time when you need it (and we really mean it!)

  • 401(k) retirement plan

title: Payments & Risk Operations Manager
description:
About Cantina

Cantina Labs is a social AI company, developing a suite of advanced real-time models that push the boundaries of expression, personality, and realism. We bring characters to life, transforming how people tell stories, connect, and create. We build and power ecosystems. Cantina, our flagship social AI platform, is just the beginning.

If you're excited about the potential AI has to shape human creativity and social interactions, join us in building the future!

About the Role

Cantina.ai is building a commerce business—subscriptions, credits, and payments—and we're looking for the person who will own customer support for it.

You won't be doing this alone. Executives and teammates across Product, Engineering, and Operations are already invested in getting this right. Your job is to turn that shared focus into a support function that actually works, day to day.

Early on, that means rolling up your sleeves: working tickets yourself, building the first workflows, and getting a system in place fast. As volume grows, you'll shift toward setting direction, managing our vendor partners for billing and payments and overflow customer support capacity, and knowing which cases need Product, Engineering, or leadership rather than your own hands.

We think this is a great fit for someone 3-7 years into their career who's run support or support ops before, enjoys building something new alongside people who care about it, and wants real ownership over how it takes shape.

The role reports into Operations and works closely with the Product and Engineering teams behind subscriptions. It starts as an individual contributor role with high ownership; and as the business scales, you'll help decide whether and how the team grows with it.

What You'll Do

  • Own day-to-day customer support across eCommerce. Handle billing questions, cancellations, refunds, credit balance and top-up issues, failed or disputed payments, access issues, and general customer inquiries directly, especially early on while volume is low and workflows are still taking shape.

  • Own payments risk operations. Monitor fraud, refund abuse, disputes and chargeback patterns; investigate anomalous transaction and account behavior; develop policies and operational controls that balance loss prevention with a low-friction customer experience; and partner with Product, Engineering and our payment provider on improvements to authorization, fraud prevention and dispute performance.

  • Create and maintain the playbook. Build support workflows, macros, escalation paths, and SLAs across subscriptions, credits, and payments, working closely with the executives and teammates across Product, Engineering, and Operations who are also focused on getting this right.

  • Leverage and manage the payment platform relationship. Own billing operations with our payments platform day to day—disputes, chargebacks, failed payments, refund workflows, credit/balance adjustments, and reconciliation questions—coordinating with Finance as needed.

  • Leverage and manage the outsourced operations relationship. Serve as the primary point of contact with our outsourced operations team for surge/overflow support capacity, including onboarding their agents, maintaining documentation and macros they'll use, monitoring quality, and adjusting volume commitments as demand fluctuates.

  • Escalate effectively. Recognize which cases need to go beyond you—to Product or Engineering for a bug or root-cause fix, to Finance for a billing exception, or to leadership for a judgment call—and route them clearly rather than trying to resolve everything solo.

  • Partner with Product and Engineering. Surface recurring support themes, bugs, and friction points; represent the voice of the customer in roadmap conversations; validate fixes before they ship.

  • Track and report on support health. Own core support metrics (response time, resolution time, CSAT, ticket volume/drivers by category, cost per ticket) and report on them regularly to Operations leadership.

  • Scale the model. As volume grows across subscriptions, credits, and payments, help determine when and how to bring on additional internal headcount vs. lean further on outsourced operations, and help build out whatever tooling (help desk platform, macros, self-serve/FAQ content) is needed to keep up.

What We're Looking For

  • 3-7 years of experience in payments operations, payments risk, fraud operations, billing operations, or customer operations for a high-volume consumer product, with hands-on experience resolving complex customer cases.

  • Experience with payments risk, fraud operations, disputes/chargebacks, or transaction monitoring in a consumer subscription, marketplace, gaming, virtual currency/credits, or digital-goods business.

  • Direct, hands-on experience actually working support tickets—not just managing a team that does.

  • Experience working with a payments/billing platform (Stripe or similar strongly preferred) and comfort navigating billing edge cases like disputes, refunds, and failed payments.

  • Experience managing or coordinating with a BPO or outsourced support vendor (TaskUs or similar) through standard operational KPIs is a strong plus.

  • Comfort operating cross-functionally with Product and Engineering: you can translate ticket and account patterns into clear, prioritized, data-informed feedback they'll actually act on.

  • A builder's mindset – you're energized by implementing a process where none exists yet, and comfortable doing so alongside others across the company who are already invested in getting it right.

  • Strong written communication – you'll be writing macros, documentation, and escalation summaries that other people (including vendor agents) rely on.

  • Comfortable with ambiguity and change – this function will look different in six months than it does today, and you'll be the one shaping that evolution.

  • Thrives in a fast-paced environment with minimal structure or oversight – you will set priorities with your manager, but do not need a manager checking in daily to stay on track.

Bonus:

  • Strong data skills - ability to utilize dashboards to track metrics and do basic investigations to spot and explore problems; ability to build or edit SQL queries (or willingness/ability to learn)

  • Using AI to scale - experience optimizing workflows and processes by building or utilizing AI agents

Compensation:

The anticipated annual base salary range for this role is between $150,000-$170,000. When determining compensation, a number of factors will be considered, including skills, experience, job scope, location, and competitive compensation market data.

 

Benefits:

  • Competitive salary and generous company equity

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance – 99.99% of premiums covered by Cantina

  • 42 days of paid time off, including:

    • 15 PTO days

    • 10 sick days

    • 15 company holidays

    • 2 floating holidays

  • Generous parental leave & fertility support

  • 401(k) retirement savings plan

  • Lifestyle spending account – $500/month to use however you’d like

  • Complimentary lunch and snacks for in-office employees

  • One Medical membership, and more!

description:
ABOUT HUT 8

The Superintendent, MEP leads mechanical, electrical, and plumbing field execution for a new data center build - owning day-to-day site operations for this scope in a high-stakes, mission-critical environment. Reporting to the Construction Manager and Director, Construction, this role drives schedule, coordinates trades, and enforces safety and quality from mobilization through turnover. Superintendents are the standard on a Hut 8 site: what you walk past, you approve.

Some of the key responsibilities you should expect are the following:

Electrical Systems

Supervise installation of MV/LV distribution: switchgear, transformers, generators, UPS, busway/busduct, PDUs, and branch circuits to the rack. Enforce cable management, termination and torque documentation, grounding, and labeling standards, and coordinate NETA acceptance testing and energization sequencing with the Superintendent, HV and the Electrical SME.

Mechanical & Cooling Systems

Supervise chilled water plants, air and liquid cooling systems, CRAH/CDU installation, piping and insulation, and hydronic balancing. Manage pipe flushing, pressure testing, and cleanliness protocols - contamination in a critical cooling loop is a commissioning-stopping event.

Trade Sequencing in Dense Space

Own trade stacking and sequencing across electrical, mechanical, plumbing, and controls in congested white space, galleries, and yards. Run BIM-supported coordination in the field and resolve clashes before they're installed clashes.

Commissioning Handoff

Drive completion of installation checklists and prerequisites supporting Level 1-3 commissioning, and support Cx execution through Levels 4-5 with the CXQC Field Manager - your installation quality is the Cx schedule's foundation.

Safety & Quality Enforcement

Enforce electrical safety (NFPA 70E), LOTO, energized work permits, and hot work controls as systems progressively energize around ongoing construction. Hold MEP trade partners to first-time quality with documented QC.

Planning, Documentation & Issues

Own the MEP three-week look-ahead, daily coordination, and progress reporting. Drive MEP RFIs and field issues to closure with the Project Engineer (MEP) and discipline engineers, and keep test records and as-builts current as systems complete.

 

ABOUT YOU

-      What we're looking for:

- 7+ years supervising electrical and/or mechanical trades on data center, semiconductor, hospital, or heavy industrial projects; mission-critical strongly preferred.

- Working knowledge of MV/LV power distribution, standby generation, UPS systems, and hydronic/liquid cooling plants, including testing and energization practices.

- Experience driving Level 1-5 commissioning prerequisites and turnover documentation inside a live Cx program.

- Strong trade-sequencing instincts in congested, schedule-critical space; fluent in look-ahead planning and manpower loading.

- Safety leadership including NFPA 70E, LOTO, and energized-facility transitions; OSHA 30 preferred.

- Pipe cleanliness, flushing, and pressure-test discipline for critical hydronic systems.

- Comfortable with Procore/ACC, BIM field use, and full MEP drawing packages.

- Clear documentation habits: dailies, QC records, and test documentation.

 

ABOUT THE WORK ENVIRONMENT

Full-time site-based role in St. Francisville, LA. 

WHAT MAKES HUT 8 A GREAT PLACE TO WORK

Hut 8 offers a benefits and wellness program that includes medical, dental, vision, life, and short-term and long-term disability insurance, as well as paid time off. We are proud to invest in building the best team in the industry. At all levels of the organization, we are driven by an entrepreneurial spirit, radical transparency, and relentless growth mentality.

At Hut 8, you will have the opportunity to:

▶ Work with bright, driven peers from a range of educational and professional backgrounds including software development, energy, engineering, entrepreneurship, investment banking, private equity, and management consulting

▶ Design and pitch new products, services, and other initiatives to a leadership team consisting of serial entrepreneurs and seasoned executives and backed by a board of directors consisting of industry veterans of energy, finance, and government

The Protection & Controls Engineer is responsible for protection schemes, relay settings, and controls design for Hut 8's high-voltage systems across the program. Reporting to the Principal, HV Engineering, this role supports commissioning, coordination studies, and utility acceptance for the substations and interconnections serving our data center campuses. P&C talent is the scarcest discipline in our build program - this seat carries real authority over how our facilities are protected and how fast they energize.


Some of the key responsibilities you should expect are the following:

Protection & Controls Design

Develop and review protection schemes, relay panel arrangements, and control designs for HV substations and interconnection facilities. Produce and review AC/DC schematics, wiring diagrams, and logic diagrams. Specify protective relays (SEL platforms), RTUs, meters, and panel equipment against utility, NERC, IEEE, and ANSI requirements.

Relay Settings & Setting Philosophy

Develop, review, and manage relay settings files and the program's setting philosophy. Own settings version control and the reconciliation between issued settings, as-left settings, and study models - the discipline that prevents mis-operations.

Studies

Perform and validate protection coordination, fault, and arc-flash studies (ASPEN/CAPE), coordinating with the Application Engineer on system models, equipment ratings, and interconnection study requirements.

Utility Coordination & Acceptance

Support interconnection protection requirements, protection review packages, SCADA/RTU point lists, and witness testing with serving utilities. Drive utility comments to resolution through energization and maintain compliance documentation (including NERC PRC-related records where applicable).

Commissioning & Field Support

Support factory and site acceptance testing, relay functional testing, and end-to-end testing with NETA firms during commissioning. Provide field support during construction and energization - troubleshooting protection and controls issues with contractors, testing firms, and utility personnel in real time.

Standards & Program Building

Build Hut 8's P&C standards: templates, panel typicals, settings libraries, and testing requirements. Review vendor drawings for P&C scope across projects and mentor the Project Engineer (HV/MV) on protection fundamentals.

 

ABOUT YOU

- 5+ years of protection and controls engineering for HV substations, transmission, or utility interconnections (69kV-345kV).

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering; PE license preferred.

- Strong hands-on depth with protective relaying - SEL platforms strongly preferred - including scheme design, settings development, and event analysis.

- Coordination and fault study fluency in ASPEN or CAPE; comfort defending your settings to a utility.

- Working knowledge of NERC PRC standards and utility interconnection protection processes.

- Commissioning experience: relay functional testing, end-to-end tests, and working alongside NETA field crews.

- SCADA/RTU and communications-assisted protection familiarity (mirrored bits, fiber schemes) a plus.

- Rigorous documentation habits - settings control is a discipline, not a chore.

 Receiving & Inspection

Coordinate closely with the Logistics & Expediting Manager on inbound major equipment and with vendors on discrepancies.

Enforce OEM preservation and maintenance requirements for stored major equipment - transformer nitrogen/oil checks, generator block heaters and rotation, VFD and electronics climate requirements - with logged compliance.

 Inventory Control

Run a disciplined material issue process to trade partners - requisitions, staging, sign-out accountability - and manage returns, surplus, and attrition tracking.

 Site Coordination & Safety

Submittal & Vendor Data Review

Construction Support

Respond to electrical RFIs with clear, buildable answers. Review field changes for ratings, code, and coordination impacts. Walk installations with the MEP superintendent at key milestones - equipment setting, terminations, grounding - and flag quality issues early.

Commissioning Support

Review electrical test procedures and Cx scripts for Levels 2-5. Witness key tests (protective relay verification, load bank, UPS/generator transfers, pull-the-plug scenarios), drive electrical punch and Cx issues to closure with the Electrical SME, and validate settings and test records for turnover.

Contribute to Hut 8 electrical design standards, specification updates, and typical details. Capture field and commissioning lessons back into the next project's design.

title: Staff Product Manager- Integrations & Advisor Platform
location: Clearwater, FL; Menlo Park, CA; New York, NY
description:
Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the Team

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards.

TradePMR is Robinhood's custody and technology platform for registered investment advisors. We're in the middle of one of the most ambitious builds in Robinhood's history: building a next-generation custody platform that lets advisors work seamlessly across custodians, with AI-native insights, digital onboarding, and access to cutting-edge, first-of-a-kind asset classes — delivered as cohesive platform. A core part of this vision is bringing the same intuitive, retail-grade tools and experiences Robinhood has built for individual investors to financial advisors and the clients they serve.

The advisors we serve are growth-oriented, multicustodial RIAs, and they run their practices on a stack of portfolio management, CRM, financial planning, and increasingly AI-native tools. Our job is to make TradePMR the easiest, most modern custodian in that stack to build and work with — foundational APIs today, and an increasingly partner-first platform as the industry moves toward agentic, AI-driven advisor workflows tomorrow.

This role sits at the center of that effort: part outward-facing partner/advisor advocate, part technical product owner for our integration platform.

This role is based in our  Clearwater, Fl, Menlo Park, CA and New York, NY offices, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.

 

What You'll Do:

  •  Own our third-party integration strategy end-to-end — from prioritizing and scoping which APIs and connectivity we build (including emerging AI-agent standards like MCP) to defining the sandbox, documentation, authentication, and governance that make us easy to integrate with.
  • Be the primary, outward-facing product owner for our technology-partner ecosystem — leading commercial and technical conversations with PMS/CRM vendors and AI-native advisor tools, scoping statements of work, setting production-access requirements, and representing Robinhood at industry events and with key RIA-industry influencers.
  • Build and run the framework for how we tier, prioritize, and resource integration requests across dozens of vendors and advisor firms at once — balancing large-firm strategic bets against overall platform coherence and engineering capacity.
  • Partner closely with engineering to translate advisor and partner needs into technical requirements and make the build-vs-partner-vs-defer calls — comfortable reading an API spec or discussing an SSO/OAuth flow directly with a partner's engineering team.
  • Develop a clear point of view on how AI and agentic workflows are changing custodial integrations
  • Represent the integrations function in Robinhood's broader next-generation custody roadmap, working closely with cross-functional partners across product, engineering, and operations to keep near-term integration work aligned with our long-term vision for advisor-facing custody.

What you bring:

  •  6+ years of product management experience, with a meaningful portion spent in a technical, platform, or API/integrations-focused PM role.
  • Experience working at a high-growth fintech company, with a track record of navigating the regulatory, compliance, and legacy-system realities that shape technical integration work in financial services.
  • A strong, informed point of view on how AI is reshaping fintech and advisor workflows — ideally backed by direct experience shipping AI-enabled features or evaluating AI-native vendors and partners.
  • Genuinely technical and a proven builder — comfortable as the primary point of contact with external partner engineering teams, able to reason through API design, auth (SSO/SAML/OAuth), and data models, with a track record of shipping developer-facing platform capabilities (documentation, sandboxes, versioning) in a regulated or enterprise B2B environment.
  • Experience running a partner or vendor ecosystem: prioritization frameworks, SOWs/contracts, production-access gating, and managing a portfolio of integrations at very different maturity stages at the same time.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication — you can flex between a technical design conversation with engineering and a strategic partnership conversation with an executive or advisor.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity: this role is being created by combining two existing scopes into one, and part of the job is defining what "great" looks like as you go. 
  • Bonus Points
    • Experience in wealth management, RIA custody, or advisor technology, or working with custodial/clearing operations (e.g., First Clearing, Schwab, Fidelity).
    • Experience building or scaling a formal integration/partner program (tiering, vendor onboarding, developer portal) from a relatively early stage.

What we offer

  • Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career.
  • Performance-driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching.
  • Best-in-class benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents.
  • Lifestyle wallet — a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more.
  • Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits.
  • Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more!
  • Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces.

In addition to the base pay range listed below, this role is also eligible for bonus opportunities + equity + benefits.

Base pay for the successful applicant will depend on a variety of job-related factors, which may include education, training, experience, location, business needs, or market demands. The expected base pay range for this role is based on the location where the work will be performed and is aligned to one of 3 compensation zones. title: Software Engineer, Java (Asset Systems)
description:
Who we are 

We simplify wealth creation. Founded in 2014 in Vienna, Austria by Eric Demuth, Paul Klanschek and Christian Trummer, we’re here to help people trust themselves enough to build their financial freedom — for now and the future. Our user-friendly, trade-everything platform empowers both first-time investors and seasoned experts to invest in the cryptocurrencies, crypto indices, stocks*, precious metals and commodities* they want — with any sized budget, 24/7. Our global team works across different cultures and time zones, bringing our products to more than 7 million customers, making us one of Europe’s safest and most secure platforms that powers modern investing.

 

Headquartered in Austria but operating across Europe, our products are built by fast-moving, talented, “roll-up-your-sleeves-and-make-it-happen” kind of people. It’s these diverse perspectives and innovative minds operating as ONE TEAM that keep Bitpanda at the cutting edge of our industry. So if you’re someone who thinks big, moves fast and wants to make an impact right from day one, then get ready to join our industry-changing team. Let’s go!

 

Your mission

As a software engineer within Bitpanda’s Trade Hub, you will help design, build and scale the core systems that power our trading ecosystem end-to-end — from pricing, execution and portfolio lifecycle, to asset infrastructure, hedging and prime services. You will work on highly available, low-latency and financially critical back-end services that handle order flow, market data, risk, balances, assets and exposure management at scale. Your work will directly impact how customers trade, how liquidity is managed, how portfolios are valued, and how Bitpanda operates safely and efficiently across markets. You will collaborate closely with product, quantitative, risk and trading stakeholders to deliver resilient, high-performance systems that form the backbone of our trading platform.

As a bonus, you get work on new age tech projects, tackling architectural and conceptual challenges, integrating with 3rd party vendors and interface and collaborate with many other Engineers and teams within Bitpanda.

What you’ll do

  • Design and develop scalable, resilient, message-driven services using Java 25 & Micronaut
  • Write clean and future proof code with 80% unit test test coverage, end to end and integration testing before deploying into event driven microservices architecture
  • Optimise payment modules/services to ensure reliability, maintainability, performance and scalability using tools like 
  • Drive innovation by researching and adopting the latest trends and technologies in backend development, ensuring our applications remain cutting-edge.

Who you are

  • 4+ years of knowledge and experience of software development using modern frameworks such as Micronaut/Spring Boot, with Java as your main programming language
  • Understanding of relational and non-relational databases (bonus points for experience with Postgres and MongoDB)
  • Experience creating and maintaining publicly available REST APIs with a keen understanding of performance optimisation and scalability
  • Practical knowledge in using message-oriented middleware as we’re working with event driven microservices (ideally Apache Kafka or ZeroMQ)
  • Understanding of CI/CD: familiarity with AWS and Kubernetes is ideal but any public cloud experience is fine

 

What’s in it for you

  • Flexibility to work where you thrive – Enjoy the freedom of our Hybrid working model, combining onsite collaboration and remote work, with an additional 25 days per year to work from a city or country of your choice.
  • Reward for your impact – Receive a competitive total compensation package aligned with Bitpanda’s pay-for-impact policy, including participation in our stock option plan.
  • Support for your mental wellbeing – Access confidential coaching, counselling, and mental health resources whenever you need them through OpenUP.
  • Time to recharge – On top of your standard annual leave, prioritise your wellbeing in 2027 with 3 additional days of paid time off to rest, reset, and recharge, available once you’ve been with us for 6 months.
  • Continuous learning and growth – Grow your skills and stay ahead in your career with unlimited access to Udemy’s library of online courses at your own pace.
  • Exclusive perks and rewards – Enjoy discounts, rewards, and perks from partners worldwide across lifestyle, wellness, tech, and travel.
  • Support during life milestones – Take advantage of up to 8 additional weeks of gender-neutral new parent leave to welcome and bond with your new addition to the family.
  • Fuel and focus on-site – Pandas in Vienna, Bucharest, Barcelona, and Berlin can enjoy free onsite dining, with freshly prepared lunches and snacks to keep you fueled and focused all day long.
  • Recognition for your contributions – Celebrate milestones and achievements with recognition and rewards for your Tenure at Bitpanda.
  • Show your Bitpanda pride – Access exclusive Bitpanda-branded merchandise and gear to represent.
  • Connect and celebrate with your team – Join unforgettable company events, from our Winter Party in Vienna to gatherings worldwide, fostering fun, connection, and celebration

       .…and even more location-specific benefits designed to make life at Bitpanda even more rewarding wherever you are.

 

Above all, you will have the opportunity to learn and grow as part of Bitpanda’s incredible journey towards being Europe’s future #1 investment platform.

Bitpanda is committed to fostering a fair and equal environment based on trust and mutual respect. We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace is paramount to our success and we are committed to building a team that represents a wide variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.
* These benefits may be adjusted at Bitpanda’s discretion and do not apply to our internships and exceptions to our Hybrid Working policy apply to teams with shift schedules or for folks whose roles require them to be in-office (think: Workplaces team or IT).
