title: Head of Compliance
description:
Capital markets are undergoing a fundamental shift. Assets that live in fragmented systems and manual workflows are moving onto blockchains – systems designed to move and store value more transparently and efficiently. While this unlocks more open and programmable financial systems, it also introduces significant complexity, and for most people, moving money into this new world is still far too hard.

Fun builds the infrastructure that powers consumer-facing fintech applications – handling onboarding, account access, and powering money movement so users can interact with blockchain-based systems as seamlessly as they do with traditional finance. For fintech builders, Fun provides a best-in-class onboarding and deposit stack that drives conversion and unlocks growth. We operate at the intersection of financial infrastructure, complex engineering, and product experience.

We're looking for a Head of Compliance to build and own the compliance function behind that infrastructure – the standards, controls, tooling, and judgment that let Fun’s infra orchestrate money movement globally without ever being the reason a partner, a bank, or a regulator hesitates.

This is a first-hire, build role. Compliance here is a design input, not a checklist bolted onto a finished product. Our architecture is non-custodial, our rails span fiat and crypto, and our mandate is global – which means the compliance posture has to be reasoned from first principles rather than copied from a bank or an exchange. You will work closely with the General Counsel to help set that posture.

This role reports directly to the General Counsel and works closely with the CEO, Financial and Operations, Engineering, Partnerships and Customer Support. You will start with sanctions and the crypto side of the business, and grow into ownership of the full program – including the fiat side as those rails expand.

What You'll Own

    The sanctions program. Screening standards, escalation and decisioning, recordkeeping, and reporting – end to end, with a clear and documented rationale for every design choice.

    Policies, procedures, and risk assessment. The written foundation of the program, built for our unique defi-rails architecture rather than inherited from a template. You will be able to explain that architecture, and what it does and does not implicate, to counterparties who have never seen one.

    Vendors and tooling. Selection, implementation, and ongoing management of blockchain analytics and screening providers, held to measurable performance rather than to their sales decks.

    Compliance by design. Working with Engineering, Product and Customer Success early enough that controls live inside the product, not around it. You will be in the room when rails are designed, offering critical insight and guidance.

    Outside advisors. Directing compliance support and specialist advisors – setting the questions, owning the answers, and deciding what gets built in-house versus bought.

What We're Looking For

    Eight or more years in compliance, including meaningful time at a leading crypto or decentralized finance (DeFi) company, a digital asset exchange, or a financial institution with a serious digital assets practice.

    Working command of Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) sanctions requirements as applied to on-chain activity – practical and current, not theoretical.

Why Join Us

Location and Work Environment

title: Tax, Strategy & Operations
description:
What is Kalshi?

Kalshi has defined a new category: prediction markets. Kalshi allows people to trade on the outcome of any events and turn any question about the future into a financial asset. Kalshi fought for years and legalized prediction markets in the US for the first time in history, is currently the fastest growing financial market in America, and has thousands of markets across politics, economics, financials, weather, tech, AI, culture and more.

We believe prediction markets have the potential to be the largest financial market because they turn anything into a financial position.

  • Our vision: well… build the largest financial market on the planet.

  • Our mission: bring more truth to the world through the power of markets.

Our culture is simple: we hire really talented people, work really hard, and enjoy the climb. We are looking for ambitious and exceptional people to join our (relatively small) team to help us build the next generation of financial markets.

Role Roadmap

As Kalshi scales, we are looking for an experienced tax professional to build and own the tax function across the company.

You will own federal and state income tax compliance, state tax examinations, ASC 740 provision support, excise and transaction-tax positions, information reporting, international tax planning, and relationships with external tax advisors.

This is a builder role for someone who wants to create a tax function rather than inherit one.

What You’ll Do

  • Own federal, state, indirect, and international tax matters across Kalshi's entities

  • Oversee federal consolidated and multistate income tax compliance and manage relationships with external tax preparers

  • Take end-to-end ownership of state tax examinations and controversy matters, including response strategy, document production, deadlines, and coordination with outside advisors

  • Develop and maintain Kalshi's positions on federal and state excise and transaction-based taxes, including research, documentation, and monitoring of regulatory developments

  • Own ASC 740 tax provision support and tax-related financial statement disclosures in partnership with Technical Accounting

  • Build and maintain a comprehensive tax calendar covering federal, state, international, and information-reporting obligations

  • Drive tax planning for new products, new markets, international expansion, and entity-structuring decisions

  • Evaluate VAT, GST, withholding, transfer pricing, nexus, and apportionment considerations as the business expands

  • Own information reporting, including 1099 processes and customer tax documentation

  • Direct and challenge external tax advisors, including PwC and EY, while managing scopes, budgets, and auditor-independence requirements

  • Partner closely with Finance, Accounting, Legal, and business teams on novel tax questions in a rapidly evolving regulatory environment

  • Determine how the tax function should evolve over time, including what capabilities should remain outsourced and where Kalshi should build internally

What You Bring

  • 10–15 years of progressive tax experience in public accounting, industry, or a combination of both

  • Active US CPA

  • Deep corporate income tax expertise with hands-on ASC 740 experience in a PCAOB-audited environment

  • Strong multistate and SALT experience, including meaningful exposure to tax audits, examinations, or controversy

  • Experience operating in complex, transaction-heavy businesses; financial services, fintech, exchanges, or similar environments are particularly relevant

  • The ability to independently develop and defend tax positions where precedent may be limited or evolving

  • Experience directing Big 4 or other external advisors and the judgment to challenge recommendations rather than simply defer to them

  • Strong written communication skills and experience producing tax positions and documentation that can withstand scrutiny from auditors and tax authorities

  • Comfort operating in a highly regulated environment and partnering with Legal when tax issues intersect with regulatory or litigation matters

  • A builder mentality and willingness to operate as the primary in-house tax expert while establishing the function

  • Exposure to excise taxes, transaction-based taxes, and information reporting is strongly preferred

  • International tax experience, including VAT/GST, withholding, or transfer pricing, is a plus

  • Experience preparing a company for an IPO or operating within a public-company tax function is a strong plus

NYC Pay Transparency Disclosure:

Salary Range: $200,000 to $300,000 annually plus equity and benefits. This range reflects current market data for this role. Kalshi has minimal hierarchy and broad variance in experience levels within each title; if your compensation expectations exceed this range, we encourage you to reach out - we’re always happy to discuss.

Our Culture

Meritocracy is at our core, and we value people who take ownership and figure (usually hard) things out. We dream big. We love our craft deeply and are proud of what we put out in the world. We are committed to our vision of building something big… but also useful: a product that brings more truth through the power of markets.

Kalshians are Kalshi’s most important asset: we pick Kalshians carefully, so we trust them fully on day 1.

Commitment to Equal Opportunity

Kalshi is committed to creating a culture of inclusion and belonging, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe it is our collective responsibility to uphold these values and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to join us in our mission. All qualified applicants will be treated with respect and receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, uniform service, veteran status, age, or any other protected characteristic per federal, state, or local law. If you are passionate about what you do and want to use your talents to support our mission and values, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Graduate Frontend Engineer -  React/TypeScript
description:
Who we are 

We simplify wealth creation. Founded in 2014 in Vienna, Austria by Eric Demuth, Paul Klanschek and Christian Trummer, we’re here to help people trust themselves enough to build their financial freedom — for now and the future. Our user-friendly, trade-everything platform empowers both first-time investors and seasoned experts to invest in the cryptocurrencies, crypto indices, stocks*, precious metals and commodities* they want — with any sized budget, 24/7. Our global team works across different cultures and time zones, bringing our products to more than 7 million customers, making us one of Europe’s safest and most secure platforms that powers modern investing.

 

Headquartered in Austria but operating across Europe, our products are built by fast-moving, talented, “roll-up-your-sleeves-and-make-it-happen” kind of people. It’s these diverse perspectives and innovative minds operating as ONE TEAM that keep Bitpanda at the cutting edge of our industry. So if you’re someone who thinks big, moves fast and wants to make an impact right from day one, then get ready to join our industry-changing team. Let’s go!

 

 

Your Mission:

The Onboarding & Activation team shapes the very first moments of a user’s journey with Bitpanda, turning a new signup into a verified, active account. We design and build the identity verification and activation experiences that millions of people rely on, working across web and mobile to create a path that feels effortless on the surface while meeting the technical and regulatory rigor a trusted financial platform demands.

What You’ll Do

  • Build & Learn: Develop and maintain web applications using React, NextJS, and TypeScript, working closely with senior engineers to turn product and design concepts into clean code.
  • Debug & Troubleshoot: Investigate bugs, maintain existing features, and resolve edge-case issues by collaborating directly with Product Managers, Engineering Managers, and Backend Engineers to analyze and explain technical root causes.
  • Contribute to Core Codebase: Help write modular UI components, manage state logic, and improve frontend flows that directly impact our global user base.
  • Maintain High Engineering Standards: Follow established coding standards (and contribute ideas to improve them), writing unit and integration tests (Jest, React Testing Library) to keep our platform secure and reliable.
  • Grow & Share: Participate actively in code reviews, technical discussions, and team learning sessions to accelerate your engineering career.

Who You Are

  • CS Fundamentals: Strong understanding of core Computer Science principles, including algorithms, object-oriented programming (OOP), operating systems, and a foundational grasp of how web browsers work under the hood.
  • Web Tech & Practical Exposure: Hands-on experience with JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, CSS3, React, and TypeScript, built through personal projects, open-source contributions, internships, or self-directed learning outside of university coursework.
  • Problem Solver & Analytical Thinker: Curious mindset with an aptitude for debugging complex issues and breaking down technical problems into clear solutions.
  • Quality & Best Practices: A desire to follow engineering best practices, write clean and maintainable code, and use testing frameworks to validate your work.
  • A strong interest or personal curiosity in cryptocurrency, fintech, stocks, or financial markets.

 

What’s in it for you

  • Flexibility to work where you thrive – Enjoy the freedom of our Hybrid working model, combining onsite collaboration and remote work, with an additional 25 days per year to work from a city or country of your choice.
  • Reward for your impact – Receive a competitive total compensation package aligned with Bitpanda’s pay-for-impact policy, including participation in our stock option plan.
  • Support for your mental wellbeing – Access confidential coaching, counselling, and mental health resources whenever you need them through OpenUP.
  • Time to recharge – On top of your standard annual leave, prioritise your wellbeing in 2027 with 3 additional days of paid time off to rest, reset, and recharge, available once you’ve been with us for 6 months.
  • Continuous learning and growth – Grow your skills and stay ahead in your career with unlimited access to Udemy’s library of online courses at your own pace.
  • Exclusive perks and rewards – Enjoy discounts, rewards, and perks from partners worldwide across lifestyle, wellness, tech, and travel.
  • Support during life milestones – Take advantage of up to 8 additional weeks of gender-neutral new parent leave to welcome and bond with your new addition to the family.
  • Fuel and focus on-site – Pandas in Vienna, Bucharest, Barcelona, and Berlin can enjoy free onsite dining, with freshly prepared lunches and snacks to keep you fueled and focused all day long.
  • Recognition for your contributions – Celebrate milestones and achievements with recognition and rewards for your Tenure at Bitpanda.
  • Show your Bitpanda pride – Access exclusive Bitpanda-branded merchandise and gear to represent.
  • Connect and celebrate with your team – Join unforgettable company events, from our Winter Party in Vienna to gatherings worldwide, fostering fun, connection, and celebration

       .…and even more location-specific benefits designed to make life at Bitpanda even more rewarding wherever you are.

 

Above all, you will have the opportunity to learn and grow as part of Bitpanda’s incredible journey towards being Europe’s future #1 investment platform.

Bitpanda is committed to fostering a fair and equal environment based on trust and mutual respect. We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace is paramount to our success and we are committed to building a team that represents a wide variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.
* These benefits may be adjusted at Bitpanda’s discretion and do not apply to our internships and exceptions to our Hybrid Working policy apply to teams with shift schedules or for folks whose roles require them to be in-office (think: Workplaces team or IT).

title: Product Manager, Identity
description:
About MoonPay

MoonPay is for builders with something to prove.

This isn't a "work on cool crypto stuff" company. It's a high-standards, high-velocity, high-accountability company building the operating system for value movement. If the internet moves information, we move value: crypto, stablecoins, tokenized assets, and whatever comes next. Four offerings make that real: fund, tokenize, trade, and spend. 30M+ customers and 500+ ecosystem partners run on us. Licensed in the U.S. Regulated across the UK, EU, Canada, and Australia.

AI is the default operating mode here. It's woven into every role, and we expect you to use it daily. It handles the manual work so you can deliver on what actually matters.

You'll thrive here if outcomes excite you more than process, if impact motivates you more than titles, and if you want hard problems, real ownership, and teammates who love winning, building, and doing it together.

The bar is high. The pace is real. We're building for what's next, for humans and agents.

Recent recognition:


Forbes' America's Best Startup Employers 2026 .
2nd in Crypto Services on Fortune's inaugural Crypto 100
The Sunday Times Best Places to Work two years running

Research has shown that women are less likely than men to apply for this role if they do not have experience in 100% of these areas. Please know that this list is indicative, and that we would still love to hear from you even if you feel that you are only a 75% match. Skills can be learned, diversity cannot.


About the Opportunity

  • In this role, you will own the roadmap for the systems that establish and verify who a MoonPay customer is, from sign-in through KYC clearance. This spans authentication (sign-in, MFA, session security), identity verification (KYC tiers, risk scoring, sanctions screening), and document verification, the vendor-driven flows that sit inside the KYC funnel.

  • You will sit within the Identity team and work closely with Compliance, Risk/Fraud, Legal, and Engineering, as well as the third-party identity verification vendors MoonPay relies on.

  • Your work will directly impact onboarding conversion, fraud loss, and MoonPay's ability to operate compliantly across multiple countries, balancing customer experience against risk and regulatory requirements on every decision.

  • This is a great opportunity for someone who wants to own a product area where user experience, fraud risk, and hard regulatory constraints all collide, and who's motivated by getting that balance right rather than optimizing for just one of the three.

What You Will Do

  • Own the roadmap for authentication and identity verification, prioritizing across conversion, fraud/risk reduction, and regulatory requirements.

  • Drive improvements to onboarding funnels, reducing drop-off in document capture and verification while maintaining or improving fraud and conversion rates.

  • Manage and evaluate third-party KYC/IDV vendor relationships, including performance, cost, and regional coverage.

  • Partner with Compliance and Legal to translate regulatory requirements into product specs and rollout plans.

  • Work with Engineering to ship changes to authentication flows without introducing account-takeover or fraud exposure.

  • Define and track funnel metrics.

  • Represent Identity in cross-functional planning with Risk, Fraud, Compliance, and Legal stakeholders.

About You

Must-have experience and skills

  • 4+ years of product management experience, with meaningful time spent on identity verification, KYC/AML, fraud, or authentication/security products.

  • Working familiarity with KYC/AML concepts and authentication concepts.

  • Experience managing or evaluating third-party identity/KYC vendors.

  • Comfort operating in a regulated, multi-region environment where the same feature behaves differently by jurisdiction.

Nice-to-have experience

  • Background in fintech, crypto, or another regulated marketplace.

  • Experience with sanctions screening, PEP/adverse media checks, or transaction monitoring.

Bonus Points

  • Experience with crypto-native authentication (wallet-based sign-in, sign-in with Ethereum) or crypto compliance requirements.

Benefits & Perks 💡

  • 💰 Competitive salary package

  • 🤝 Equity package: financial freedom starts with our employees, so all employees have ownership at MoonPay

  • 📈 Pay-for-performance equity bonus: those who drive outsized outcomes receive outsized rewards

  • 🚀 Moonshot award: we honor exceptional impact. 10 employees twice a year, each earning a $250,000 equity grant

  • 📊Pension: employer contributions from day one

  • 🎁Employee referral program: refer great people, earn 10K in USDC

  • 🏝 Flexible Time Off: choose when to work and when to switch off

  • 🎂 Birthday leave: take the day off to celebrate you

  • 🍼 Enhanced parental leave: more time with family, no second thought

  • 🌍 Hybrid working schedule: work fully remotely or from your nearest Moonbase

  • 🚆 Commuter benefits: public transport to and from the office

  • 🩺 Private healthcare benefits: to protect you and your loved ones

  • 🧘 Wellhub wellness membership: access to gyms, studios, classes, and wellness apps in one membership

  • 🤖 Unlimited enterprise access to the latest AI tools: Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini and whatever's next

  • 🍱 Lunch credit: meals covered on the days you're in the office

  • 🪑 Home office setup allowance: build the home office of your dreams

  • 👛 Remote working allowance: those working fully remotely get a little extra for utilities

  • 🌕 Monthly product budget and zero-fee crypto transactions

  • 📚 $1,000 Annual training budget: we support your learning journey

  • 🎯 High Potential Program: structured development, mentorship, and stretch opportunities

  • ✈️ Regular remote company offsites: high-impact in-person sessions and hackathons

description:

The Sunday Times Best Places to Work two years running

1. About the Opportunity ✍️ 

This is a hands-on technical leadership role with the opportunity to shape the long-term direction of our data platform.

You will lead the design and evolution of the systems that power analytics, product insights, integrations, and machine learning across MoonPay. Working across teams, you’ll solve complex challenges spanning architecture, reliability, scalability, governance, and cost efficiency within a regulated environment.

We’re looking for an engineer who can move confidently between setting technical direction and contributing directly to implementation. Your impact will come from evolving and adding new capabilities to our platform, establishing shared engineering patterns, and helping teams make pragmatic decisions that support both immediate delivery and long-term growth.

2. What you will do

As a Staff Data Engineer on our Data Platform team, you’ll provide technical leadership across the platform while remaining closely involved in design and delivery.

Day-to-day, you will:

  • Set and evolve the technical direction of our data platform across streaming, batch processing, warehousing, orchestration, governance, and machine learning enablement.

  • Lead the design and delivery of complex, cross-team initiatives from early architectural decisions through to implementation

  • Design and build core platform capabilities, from reliable real-time pipelines, shared tooling, reusable frameworks, and scalable data infrastructure for other teams

  • Establish and champion golden paths that enable teams to build securely, consistently, and efficiently.

  • Improve platform reliability, scalability, performance, and cost efficiency as data volumes and use cases grow.

  • Partner with Security, Compliance, Product, and Engineering teams to ensure our systems meet operational and regulatory requirements.

  • Identify systemic risks, reduce unnecessary complexity, and guide pragmatic, incremental improvements to the platform.

  • Strengthen engineering standards across data modelling, pipeline design, observability, testing, deployment automation, and infrastructure as code.

  • Influence technical priorities and planning by working closely with engineering managers, product managers, and senior technical leaders.

  • Mentor senior engineers and raise technical capability through design reviews, code reviews, documentation, and hands-on collaboration.

💻 What you will be working with/on

  • GCP

  • Pub/Sub and Kafka

  • Apache Beam

  • Bigtable

  • Redis

  • Kubernetes

  • Airflow

  • BigQuery

  • Terraform

  • Python and SQL

  • Real-time and batch processing

  • Data governance, quality, and observability

3. About You

You’re a systems thinker who has helped design and scale data platforms used by multiple teams. You’re comfortable operating across architecture, hands-on delivery, and organisation-wide technical influence.

You value pragmatic solutions, strong engineering foundations, and quality outcomes over complexity for its own sake.

We’re looking for someone who brings:

  • Significant experience designing and evolving large-scale data platforms, distributed and stream processing systems

  • Deep knowledge of real-time and event-driven architectures using technologies such as Kafka or Pub/Sub.

  • A track record of leading complex technical initiatives that span multiple teams or domains.

  • Experience building platform capabilities, shared services, and engineering patterns that other teams can adopt

  • Strong judgement across reliability, scalability, performance, governance, security, and cost management.

  • The ability to move between high-level architectural decisions and hands-on implementation.

  • Experience influencing engineers and stakeholders around shared technical standards and long-term priorities

  • A team-first approach, with a passion for mentoring experienced engineers and raising the technical bar

  • Strong communication skills and the ability to make complex technical decisions clear to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Experience working in a regulated environment, or designing systems with strong compliance and auditability requirements

Experience with our specific technology stack is helpful, but architectural judgement, systems thinking, and technical leadership matter more than expertise in any one tool.

Salary Bandings: $260,000 - $274,000

Benefits & Perks 💡

  • 💰 Competitive salary package

  • 🤝 Equity package: financial freedom starts with our employees, so all employees have ownership at MoonPay

  • 📈 Pay-for-performance equity bonus: those who drive outsized outcomes receive outsized rewards

title: Software Engineer, Proactive Capabilities

title: Systems Engineer - Cleared Programs
description:
About Chainalysis Government Solutions

Chainalysis Government Solutions (CGS) is a wholly-owned Chainalysis subsidiary that provides blockchain intelligence solutions, including technology, training, and services to law enforcement, defense, intelligence and regulatory customers across the U.S. Government.

Blockchain technology is powering a growing wave of innovation. Businesses and governments around the world are using blockchains to make banking more efficient, connect with their customers, investigate criminal cases and track transnational threats. As the adoption of blockchain technology grows, more and more organizations seek access to all this ecosystem has to offer. That’s where Chainalysis comes in. We provide complete knowledge of what’s happening on blockchains through our data, services, and solutions. With Chainalysis, organizations can navigate blockchains safely and with confidence.

As a Systems Engineer supporting Cleared Programs, you’ll serve as a key technical bridge between Chainalysis Government Solutions and national security customers operating in highly sensitive environments. You’ll support the full technical lifecycle — from technical discovery, capability demonstrations, and proofs of value through deployment, integration, configuration, and ongoing operation of the platform in customer environments.

The role has a strong emphasis on on-premises infrastructure and requires the ability to operate independently within classified customer environments. You’ll work closely with customer technical stakeholders as well as Chainalysis product and engineering teams, translating customer needs and operational feedback into technical solutions and product direction. The ideal candidate is an experienced systems or solutions engineer with strong technical depth, excellent communication skills, an ownership mindset, and the ability to serve as a trusted technical advisor to both operators and executives.

Please note that this role requires you to be physically on-site with the customer in the Washington DC Metropolitan Area (WMA) on an as-needed basis.

In this role, you’ll:

  • ILead technical discovery, capability demonstrations, and proofs of value with cleared customers

  • Serve as the technical expert customers rely on, owning deployment, integration, and configuration of the Chainalysis platform within customer environments, both on-premises and cloud-based

  • Lead the deployment and operation of solutions with a strong focus on on-premise infrastructure

  • Diagnose, report, and independently resolve product and system issues while maintaining rigorous documentation

  • Interface between customer technical stakeholders and Chainalysis product and engineering teams, building strong relationships based on technical expertise and trust

  • Collaborate closely with product and engineering teams to resolve technical challenges and communicate key updates to customers and the internal CGS team

  • Contribute technical responses to RFIs and RFPs and support pursuit teams as the on-premise subject matter expert

  • Train and enable customer technical staff and troubleshoot alongside them

  • Configure and integrate systems across customer environments, APIs, data integrations, and cloud infrastructure

  • Translate customer requirements, operational feedback, and technical constraints into actionable recommendations for internal teams

  • Actively learn the environments in which the Chainalysis platform operates in order to identify risks, constraints, and opportunities for improvement

We’re looking for candidates who have:

  • Active TS/SCI Clearance with Full Scope Polygraph required at the start

  • U.S. citizenship required; this position is not eligible for visa sponsorship

  • 5+ years of experience in systems engineering, solutions engineering, sales engineering, or technical delivery for data platforms, analytics, cybersecurity, or SaaS products in classified environments

  • Deep expertise with on-premise infrastructure and enterprise products, along with APIs, data integrations, cloud environments, and enterprise deployment patterns

  • Proficiency with core Amazon Web Services (AWS) services, including EC2, VPC, ELB, RDS, S3, and EBS

  • Strong Linux and Windows system administration experience, preferably in C2S/AWS environments

  • Familiarity with PostgreSQL, including navigating database schemas and querying tables

  • Experience troubleshooting and diagnosing web application issues using browser developer tools and system/application logs

  • Experience remediating security vulnerabilities and hardening systems in accordance with RMF and STIG requirements

  • Proficiency with automation and scripting, specifically Python and Bash/Unix shell scripting

  • Ability to demonstrate, whiteboard, and clearly explain technical concepts to both operators and executive stakeholders

  • A self-directed and proactive operating style suited to working within a small cleared team

  • Strong written documentation skills and the ability to produce work that stands on its own within customer environments

Stands Out:

  • Prior systems engineering, solutions engineering, or technical delivery experience supporting IC or DoD programs

  • Experience deploying and sustaining software in air-gapped or disconnected environments

  • Exposure to blockchain technology, financial data, or investigative tooling

  • Familiarity with FedRAMP and/or Impact Level (IL) deployments

Compensation & Benefits:

  • $230,000 base salary + annual bonus

  • Equity

  • Flexible time off, plus mental-health and volunteer days

  • Up to 16 weeks of paid parental leave for primary caregivers

  • Cigna nationwide health plans with company HSA contribution

  • Fidelity 401(k)

  • $1,500 annual professional development budget

  • Phone and internet reimbursement

title: Director, Brand Operations
description:
About Ramp

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

About the Role

Ramp's Brand team ships a high volume of ambitious creative across product launches, growth, events, customer marketing, and brand awareness. As the work has scaled, so has the need for a strong operating system around it.

We're hiring a Director of Brand Operations to build that operating system: the processes, milestones, and cross-functional coordination that let a world-class creative team do its best work and ship fast. This is an operations role focused on how the work gets done; it is not a traditional production-management role.

You'll be the operator who protects creatives from organizational swirl, sets clear ways of working, and fixes cross-functional breakdowns upstream so great ideas reach the world quickly.

What You’ll Do

  • Own and build the operating system for how Brand's creative gets produced.

  • Build the brand operating system: the processes, milestones, and ways of working that turn creative direction into shipped work.

  • Diagnose and fix bottlenecks across functions. Find where work stalls, trace it to the source, and remove the limiting factor wherever it lives.

  • Protect creatives from org swirl by absorbing cross-functional complexity so the team stays focused on the work.

  • Automate with AI: use AI to streamline how work flows and cut manual overhead across the operation (intake, triage, status, reporting, handoffs).

  • Partner with the creative leads so operations and creative are complementary, freeing creative leads to focus on creative.

  • Be Brand's ambassador to the rest of Ramp: scope incoming work and pull Brand into projects early, at the right time.

What You Need

  • Exceptional organization: you hold 20+ live workstreams and keep everyone on track

  • A cross-functional root-cause instinct: you can walk into a tangled, multi-team workflow, explain why it's slow, and fix it. This is the most important capability for the role.

  • A track record of building systems and automation: you've taken an operation from messy to repeatable and use tooling and AI to compress cycle time.

  • A metrics-driven approach: you instrument delivery so progress is clear and provable.

  • Hands-on, lean leadership: you lift both the operation and the people in it.

  • A bias for better ways of working: you remove limiting factors and speed up delivery without adding process for its own sake.

  • An operator-first profile: we care more about someone who can diagnose and fix how work flows than about a creative, production, or marketing pedigree. Strong candidates come from product ops, biz ops, GTM ops, finance ops, or chief-of-staff backgrounds.

Nice to Haves

title: Sr Product Manager, BitGo Labs
description:
BitGo is the leading infrastructure provider of digital asset solutions, delivering custody, wallets, staking, trading, financing, and settlement services from regulated cold storage. Since our founding in 2013, we have focused on enabling our clients to securely navigate the digital asset space. With a global presence and multiple Trust companies, BitGo serves thousands of institutions, including many of the industry's top brands, exchanges, and platforms, and millions of retail investors worldwide. As the operational backbone of the digital economy, BitGo handles a significant portion of Bitcoin network transactions and is the largest independent digital asset custodian, and staking provider, in the world. For more information, visit www.bitgo.com.

This role will require being full-time onsite at our Palo Alto office to support collaborative team dynamics and innovative problem-solving.

BitGo spent a decade building the infrastructure the digital asset industry runs on. Custody, settlement, wallets, a national trust bank charter. Rails that institutions trust with hundreds of billions of dollars.

Custody is the operating system. BitGo Labs builds the apps.

We are looking for a product manager who wants to launch more real products in one year than most PMs ship in a career.

What BitGo Labs is

Most corporate innovation labs are where ideas go to be studied. Decks get made. Pilots get piloted. Nothing ever meets a customer.

We built Labs to be the opposite of that. We push out real, live, revenue-generating products, and every one has to clear the same two-part bar:

  1. A value proposition or economics only possible because of crypto. If a normal company could build it on normal rails, it fails the test. We only build things where owning the infrastructure is the unfair advantage.
  2. Only buildable this fast because of AI. Three months from blank page to live product. Not a prototype, not a beta behind a waitlist. Live.

The first product is already out in the world, built and launched inside ninety days. More are coming. Some will become businesses. Some will be shut down on schedule, without ceremony, because the numbers said so. Both outcomes are the system working.

What You’ll Do:

You'll sit at the center of the machine, working directly with BitGo's CEO and the Head of Labs.

Ideas can come from anywhere, including you. Most will come from those two. Either way, an idea is just a thesis until someone turns it into a product real people use, and that someone is you.

A cycle looks like this:

  • Take a thesis and find the product inside it. The first user, the wedge, the smallest version worth putting in the world. Push back hard if the thesis is wrong. You'll be doing this with the CEO in the room, so be the kind of person who gets sharper in that room, not quieter.
  • Ship it in ninety days. Write the spec, run the build, make the tradeoffs, cut scope when the calendar says so. Pull BitGo's custody, stablecoin, and settlement rails into a consumer surface. Buy instead of build where it's faster.
  • Set the bar before launch. Real numbers, committed in advance, that decide the product's fate. No moving the goalposts after the fact.
  • Read the results honestly. Then double down or kill it, and start the next one.

You will not be handed a roadmap. You'll be handed rails, a budget, and a deadline.

Who Would Be a Great Fit:

  • Someone who has taken a product from nothing. Startup, side project, or a true zero-to-one team inside a bigger company. We don't care which. "I ran the roadmap for an existing product" is a different job.
  • Someone with 5+ years in product, at least some of it consumer.
  • Someone who builds. You prototype with AI tools, wire up working demos, run your own analysis. The era of the PM who can only write documents is over, and you're glad.
  • Someone comfortable with crypto, or unafraid of getting there fast. You don't need to have shipped a crypto product. You need to understand why owning the rails changes what a consumer app can be.
  • Someone who decides. Small team, short cycles, no committee coming to save you.
  • Someone who can kill their own work. Shut it down, take the learning, start the next one without a mourning period. This is rarer than shipping, and we screen for it.

The honest part

This job has no stable roadmap, no big team, no tidy org chart. Some of what you build will be shut down, and you'll be the one who makes that call. If you want three years compounding on a single product, this is the wrong job, and we'd rather you know now.

But if you've ever looked at a big company's infrastructure and thought about everything you could build if someone just let you, this is the job where someone lets you.

Why Join BitGo?

Revolutionizing finance requires vision, innovation, and execution. Join a team of world-class professionals who embody our values of ownership, craftsmanship, and open communication. At BitGo, we are building the infrastructure that secures the future of digital assets.

We offer:

  • Competitive base salary, bonus and stock options
  • Paid vacation
  • Free custom lunches, dinners and snacks 
  • Computer equipment and workplace furniture to suit your needs
  • Great colleagues and inspiring startup environment
  • Benefits may vary based on location

If you're passionate about scaling secure, compliant, and user-friendly wallet infrastructure, we'd love to talk.

Pay Transparency Notice: Depending upon your leveling and location, the compensation for this role averages between $180,000 - $200,000 USD base salary. Equity, an annual performance bonus and the benefits outlined below are also a part of this role's package.

title: Software Engineer II, Foundation
description:
Platform Engineering at Chainalysis provides the shared infrastructure, tooling, and developer experience layer that powers every engineering team. We are moving away from team-owned infrastructure silos and consolidating onto shared, scalable platform patterns. The Foundation discipline owns the substrate: cloud infrastructure, networking, Kubernetes, streaming, and security primitives. Everything else runs on what we build.

We are hiring a Software Engineer II to join the Foundation team. Your job is straightforward: build, improve, and operate the infrastructure primitives that every service at Chainalysis depends on — Kubernetes clusters, cloud networking, streaming infrastructure (Kafka / WarpStream), secrets management, IAM, and the reconcilers that make it all self-service and drift-free. This is an infrastructure-focused IC role at the C4 level, typically suited for someone with 3–5 years of experience. You will work alongside senior engineers who will pair with you, review your work, and invest in your growth. You will report to the Senior Manager of Platform Engineering.

In this role, you'll:

  • Build and maintain cloud infrastructure across AWS and GCP using Terraform — designing the modules and patterns that provision the substrate our services run on, and thinking beyond the immediate use case to how your work is consumed across the organization

  • Operate and evolve multi-tenant Kubernetes clusters (EKS) serving the entire engineering organization — owning node lifecycle, upgrades, security contexts, and networking decisions that affect every team

  • Own the operational side of our streaming infrastructure migration from managed Kafka (MSK) to WarpStream, building and maintaining the tooling that supports it

  • Contribute to platform tooling and reconcilers that underpin our platform contract model — writing Go, working with the Kubernetes API, and building high-quality self-service primitives that engineering teams rely on to declare what their services need

  • Design and maintain foundational networking and security infrastructure — transit gateways, GCP interconnect, ingress, security groups, IAM policies, and IRSA — getting the invisible plumbing right so nobody has to think about it

  • Participate in on-call rotations and drive operational excellence — responding to infrastructure incidents, writing and improving runbooks, and feeding every incident pattern back into automation so the same class of issue never repeats

We're looking for candidates who have:

  • 3+ years of software engineering or infrastructure engineering experience

  • Hands-on experience with AWS services (EC2, EKS, IAM, S3, VPC, or similar) — we're looking for people who have built and operated real infrastructure, not certifications

  • Working knowledge of Kubernetes in production — you have operated or deployed workloads on K8s clusters beyond a local environment

  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform strongly preferred; Pulumi or CloudFormation acceptable)

  • Proficiency in at least one of Go, Python, or shell scripting — Go is preferred because our reconciler work is in Go, but you should be ready to turn your hand to whatever the problem demands

  • Comfort with CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Argo, Jenkins, or similar) and hands-on experience with on-call and incident response — you understand what it means to be accountable for production systems

You might also have:

  • Experience building Kubernetes operators or controllers — CRDs, reconcilers, and the controller-runtime library

  • Familiarity with streaming infrastructure (Kafka, WarpStream, or similar event-driven systems) or depth in networking (VPCs, transit gateways, ingress controllers, DNS, load balancing, and security groups)

  • Experience in regulated environments (SOC 2, ISO-27001, or similar compliance frameworks) or familiarity with GitOps patterns (ArgoCD, Flux)

  • A passion for platform engineering as leverage — you care about making other engineers more productive, and when you see toil, your instinct is to eliminate it

Technologies we use:

  • Languages: Go, Python, Bash/Shell, HCL (Terraform)

  • Cloud: AWS (EC2, EKS, IAM, S3, VPC, Lambda), GCP

  • Infrastructure as Code: Terraform

  • Kubernetes: EKS, Helm, CRDs, controller-runtime

  • Streaming: Kafka, WarpStream (migrating from MSK)

  • Networking: Transit Gateway, GCP Interconnect, Ingress Controllers, DNS, Security Groups

  • Identity & Security: IAM, IRSA, Secrets Management

  • CI/CD: GitHub Actions

  • GitOps: ArgoCD, Flux

AI at Chainalysis
AI is not a feature at Chainalysis - it is a new way of working. One that turns instructions into work done, and helps us move faster than the threats we're built to counter, and we expect our employees to take ownership of the output and ensure quality. As the world's most trusted blockchain analytics platform, Chainalysis sits at a rare intersection of proprietary data, regulatory relationships and crypto expertise that makes it uniquely placed to shape and lead the next era of AI-driven intelligence - and we expect everyone here, regardless of role, to be an active part of it.

AI fluency is tied directly to how we measure performance and how we plan to win. There is no substitute for your own curiosity. We provide the tools, workflows, and space to experiment - but the expectation is that you develop these capabilities yourself, bring ideas, and collaborate across teams to reinvent the way work gets done. We are not using AI to do less. We are using it to do what was never possible before.

About Chainalysis

Chainalysis is the blockchain data platform, making it easy to connect the movement of digital assets to real-world services. Powered by deep blockchain data and AI, organizations can investigate illicit activity, manage risk exposure, and develop innovative market solutions built on the industry's most trusted blockchain intelligence. Our mission is to build trust in blockchains, blending safety and security with an unwavering commitment to growth and innovation.

You belong here. 

At Chainalysis, we believe that diversity of experience and thought makes us stronger. With both customers and employees around the world, we are committed to ensuring our team reflects the unique communities around us. We’re ensuring we keep learning by committing to continually revisit and reevaluate our diversity culture.

We encourage applicants across any race, ethnicity, gender/gender expression, age, spirituality, ability, experience and more. If you need any accommodations to make our interview process more accessible to you due to a disability, don't hesitate to let us know. You can learn more here. We can’t wait to meet you.

title: Compliance Officer, Caymans
description:
Who are we?

FalconX is a pioneering team of operators, investors, and builders committed to revolutionizing institutional access to the crypto markets. Operating at the intersection of traditional finance and  cutting-edge technology, FalconX addresses the industry's foremost challenges: Navigating the digital asset market can be complex and fragmented, with limited products and services that support trading strategies, structures, and liquidity found in conventional financial markets. As a comprehensive solution for all digital asset strategies from start to scale, FalconX operates as the connective tissue empowering clients with seamless navigation through the ever- evolving cryptocurrency landscape.

Position Summary

The Compliance Officer, Caymans will be based in our New York City office and serve as the dedicated compliance manager for FalconX’s Cayman Islands operations. In this role, you will oversee regulatory adherence under the applicable Cayman Islands regulatory framework, including the Proceeds of Crime Act and Cayman Anti-Money Laundering Regulations (AMLRs).

You will bridge local entity governance with global compliance operations, managing local regulatory requirements, maintaining local compliance documentation, handling complex escalations, and supporting the new product approvals process for our lending, borrowing, and derivatives products. 

Key Responsibilities

1. Regulatory Management & Oversight

  • Regulatory Oversight: Act as the internal subject matter expert for all regulatory requirements applicable to FalconX’s Cayman entities, including the the Proceeds of Crime Act and Cayman Anti-Money Laundering Regulations (AMLRs), Anti-Terrorism Act, and Proliferation Finance (Prohibition) Act 
  • Filings & Communications: Manage regulatory filings, notifications, and response drafting for regulatory inquiries
  • New Product Evaluation & Compliance Product Management: Act as the subject matter expert for the Compliance team for new product assessments and requirements, as well as for the ongoing management of FalconX products offered from our Cayman entities, from a Compliance perspective 

2. Cayman AML/CFT & Sanctions Execution

  • Program Alignment: Ensure internal AML/CFT/CPF policies and monitoring tools align with Cayman Islands AMLRs and guidance notes.
  • CDD/EDD Escalations: Handle escalated Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD), PEP, and high-risk client reviews for entities onboarding into the Cayman structure.
  • Travel Rule & Sanctions: Oversee compliance with sanctions regimes and digital asset Travel Rule obligations relevant to Cayman client flows.

3. Entity Governance & Cross-Border Reporting

  • Board Engagement: Prepare comprehensive quarterly compliance and AML/CFT reporting materials for the Cayman Entity Board of Directors and global compliance leadership.
  • Internal Advisory: Serve as an internal advisor to NYC-based Product, Trading, and Legal teams on product launches and client structures touching the Cayman jurisdiction.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Experience: 5 –10 years of financial compliance, legal, or regulatory experience with dedicated exposure to derivatives products (commodities or securities based). 
  • Institutional Background: Experience working within a US-headquartered broker-dealer, crypto platform, asset manager, or law firm managing offshore Cayman structures.
  • Crypto Knowledge: Solid understanding of institutional digital asset market structure, execution flows, and custody models.
  • Certifications: ACAMS, ICA, or equivalent compliance credentials preferred.
  • Communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with experience drafting regulatory responses and board-level presentations.

The Cryptographic Services & Infrastructure team secures and manages cryptographic keys and enables Robinhood engineering teams to safely leverage core capabilities like encryption and decryption.

Join a high-impact team responsible for protecting some of Robinhood's most sensitive financial and customer data! In this role, you will help build and operationalize Robinhood's new in-house card-processing service—a critical initiative that brings core capabilities in-house and offers meaningful ownership across software, infrastructure, security, and operations. While prior cryptography or security experience is highly preferred, we are excited to empower strong engineers with a passion for security to learn and grow their skills on the job.

This role is based in our Bellevue, WA and Menlo Park, CA offices, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.

What you'll do day-to-day

  • Design, build, and maintain production services and infrastructure supporting key management, encryption, and decryption functions.
  • Help architect, launch, and scale Robinhood’s new in-house card-processing environment to protect sensitive card, financial, and tax-related data.
  • Write clean, maintainable production code and build operational tooling across software, infrastructure, and security controls.
  • Collaborate with internal engineering teams to support migrations, drive adoption of shared cryptographic capabilities, and ensure safe system design.

What you bring

  • Comfort working across multiple technical domains, including software development, infrastructure, and operational reliability.
  • Clear and concise communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to explain technical decisions and proactively collaborate when facing challenges.
  • Curiosity and willingness to learn security engineering principles and participate in a light on-call rotation.

Bonus points

  • Prior experience in site reliability engineering (SRE), platform engineering, or cloud security.
  • Familiarity with key management, secrets management, or core cryptographic concepts (such as symmetric encryption or public/private key pairs).
  • Experience handling sensitive financial, payment, or card data in regulated environments.
  • Background in supporting internal customer migrations or driving platform adoption across engineering teams.

title: Operations and Financial Specialist (E4A Solutions - A Subsidiary of Riot Platforms)
Senior Web Engineer, Perps
description:
About Polymarket

Polymarket is the world's largest prediction market platform. We enable individuals to express views on real-world events by trading on outcomes across politics, economics, sports, culture, and current affairs. Built as a peer-to-peer marketplace with no centralized "house," Polymarket aggregates diverse opinions into transparent, market-based probabilities that reflect collective expectations about the future.

We're growing fast — both in terms of volume ($21B traded in 2025) and adoption as an alternative news source. Our ambition is to become a ubiquitous beacon of truth in global media and we need your help adding fuel to the fire.

About the Role

Polymarket is launching perpetual futures and we're looking for a Senior Web Engineer to own the frontend of our perps product. You'll build the trading interfaces that traders will rely on every day: order entry, position management, real-time market data, and the full suite of UI that makes a great perps exchange feel fast, reliable, and intuitive.

This is a high-ownership role at the intersection of frontend product development, backend systems, performance, and reliability. We want someone who has shipped trading UIs before, understands the domain deeply, and can move fast without compromising quality.

What You'll Do

  • Own and ship complex trading UI features end-to-end — order books, position panels, trade history, funding rates, liquidation displays, and more — making thoughtful tradeoffs between speed, quality, and long-term maintainability

  • Work closely with backend engineers to design APIs, reason through real-time data flows, and build reliable trading experiences on top of complex exchange systems

  • Partner with QA, TPM, product, and design to clarify requirements, manage launches, and improve product quality

  • Monitor dashboards, alerts, and user reports to identify and respond to issues quickly; work with backend and infrastructure teams during incidents to isolate root causes and follow through with fixes

  • Design and implement UI that handles live market data, streaming order books, and fast-moving prices in a way that feels responsive and accurate to traders

  • Build and improve the logs, metrics, alerts, dashboards, and error reporting that give the team visibility into frontend system performance

  • Identify meaningful technical debt, propose pragmatic refactors, and contribute to system design discussions that evolve our frontend architecture as the product scales

What We're Looking For

  • 3–5+ years of frontend web engineering experience

  • Strong hands-on experience with React, Next.js, TypeScript, and modern frontend development

  • Experience building trading, exchange, or financial product UIs — you understand the domain and know what a great trading interface requires

  • Strong frontend system design instincts across state management, data fetching, caching, performance, reliability, and maintainability

  • Experience working with real-time data: WebSockets, streaming APIs, or live market feeds

  • Strong debugging skills and experience responding to production issues

  • Comfortable working with backend engineers on APIs, data contracts, failure modes, and system behavior

  • High agency — you notice problems, propose solutions, and drive work to completion

  • Clear communicator during planning, launches, bugs, and incidents

  • (Plus) Direct experience building UI for a perpetuals exchange or derivatives trading product

  • (Plus) Frontend performance specialization, particularly around real-time data rendering

  • (Plus) Experience in crypto, Web3, or adjacent financial infrastructure

  • (Plus) Experience improving frontend observability, alerting, or reliability practices

  • (Plus) Strong practical use of AI tools to improve engineering productivity

Benefits

  • Competitive salary & equity

  • Unlimited PTO

  • Full Health, Vision, & Dental coverage

  • 401k match

  • Hardware setup: new MacBook Pro, big display, & accessories

Pay Transparency

Base salary range: $250,000 to $500,000, plus equity and benefits.

This is a good-faith range for the level we're hiring at. Experience varies widely within a title here, so if your expectations fall outside it, reach out anyway. We're always happy to talk it through.

title: Product Manager, Consumer
description:
About Blackbird:

Blackbird Labs is a loyalty and payments platform establishing meaningful connections between the world’s best restaurants and their customers.

Served up in 2022 by Ben Leventhal, co-founder of Eater and Resy, Blackbird offers a fully customizable loyalty programming platform for restaurants and a consumer app designed to make every guest feel like a bonafide VIP no matter where they dine. Backed by Union Square Ventures, a16z, Amex Ventures, Variant Fund, and other forward-thinking investors, Blackbird is out to revolutionize the restaurant industry.

About Our Team:

At Blackbird, our values guide everything we do and our talent principles define the key traits we seek in our employees.

We have passion for our product – committed to our mission and instinctively think like and go the extra mile for our customers. We are elite performers – striving for excellence, going above and beyond to achieve exceptional results, and learning quickly with horsepower, drive, and grit. We make others better – taking initiative to elevate others, giving and receiving feedback, and championing a culture of growth. We hold one another accountable to living out our talent principles as we march together to achieving our mission.

About the Job

Blackbird is looking for a Product Manager to help lead our payments and loyalty platform to its next chapter. You'll influence the product experience across both sides of our marketplace: the restaurants who utilize Blackbird in their daily operations and the diners who deserve to feel like a VIP every time they walk through the door. This is a high-ownership role on a small, fast-moving team where your decisions will directly shape what we build, how fast we ship, and how interactions between restaurants and guests unfold.

You'll work at the intersection of consumer experience, consumer loyalty, payments, and real-time restaurant operations, a uniquely complex and rewarding product space. If you thrive in ambiguity, think deeply about users, move with urgency, and love building products that create incredible real-world experiences, this role is for you.

Responsibilities

  • Own the roadmap for critical portions of the Blackbird platform and product experience end-to-end, from strategy and prioritization through execution and launch

  • Define and drive the product vision for features that balance speed, quality, and scale across both our restaurant-facing and consumer-facing experiences

  • Partner closely with engineering, design, marketing, sales, and operations to ship high-quality product at a pace that keeps us ahead of the market

  • Deeply understand our users, including restaurant operators, servers, and diners, through research, data analysis, and time spent in the field

  • Translate complex operational and technical constraints into elegant, user-centered product solutions

  • Develop strategies to create product leverage through AI tools

  • Set clear goals and metrics for your product areas, track progress rigorously, and use data to inform iteration

  • Identify and untangle systemic problems across payments flows, loyalty mechanics, and restaurant integrations - then build and launch the solutions

  • Represent the voice of the customer in every cross-functional conversation and continuously elevate the bar for user experience

Requirements

  • 4+ years of product management experience, ideally with a track record in consumer experiences, payments, fintech, or marketplace platforms

  • Demonstrated ability to ship impactful product in a fast-moving environment without sacrificing quality or long-term scalability

  • High ownership mentality with the grit to push through hard problems and the judgment to know when to cut scope and when to hold the line

  • Strong user empathy - you talk to customers regularly and let real insight drive your decisions

  • Exceptional cross-functional collaborator who can align engineering, design, marketing, and business stakeholders around a shared vision

  • Analytical and structured thinker who is equally comfortable writing a PRD, digging into a funnel, or whiteboarding a system design

  • Clear, compelling communicator who can influence without authority and bring people along

Nice to Haves

  • Background in consumer apps with loyalty, rewards, or membership mechanics

  • Excited about the application of AI into building world class products

  • Experience at a high-growth startup where scope was fluid and ambiguity was the norm

Pay Transparency Notice & Benefits

Depending on your work location and experience, the target annual salary for this position can range from: $170,000–$200,000 USD. This range does not include the equity component of the overall compensation package. Disclosure in accordance with New York City's Pay Transparency Law.

Commitment to Equal Opportunity

Blackbird Labs is committed to diversity in its workforce and is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sex, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation or any other basis protected by applicable law. Blackbird will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable law. For US applicants, you may view the Know Your Rights notice here. Additionally, Blackbird participates in the E-Verify program.

Join us and find out what the best work of your career could look like here at Blackbird.

title: Head of Marketing (Director)
description:
About Keyrock

Since 2017, Keyrock has been a change-maker in digital assets. We're a global, remote-first team of 200+ people across 40+ nationalities, with hubs in Brussels, London, Paris and New York.

We provide liquidity across 80+ centralized and decentralized exchanges - a position cemented by our Series C, led by SC Ventures. Today we run a full spectrum of capital markets businesses across centralized and on-chain venues: market making, high-frequency trading, options, OTC, DeFi trading desks, advisory, and asset management.

We're building toward the agentic investment banking capabilities for the era of digital finance. A proprietary agentic layer runs the mechanics of the market, so our people can focus on the work code cannot do: the deal, the relationship, and the judgement.

 

We're not just envisioning the future of finance - we're building it.

 

The Opportunity

We are hiring a Head of Marketing to take full ownership of our marketing strategy, rebrand Keyrock and reposition us as the market evolves from crypto-native to institutional, merging with traditional finance.

This is not a maintenance role. It is a transformation mandate with full discretionary decision-making on how to implement our commercial strategy. You will work as a close strategic partner to the CCO, operating almost as co-marketeers.

The team is lean by design: 2-3 direct reports plus heavy use of AI and agentic tooling. We are looking for someone who inspires and sets direction, not someone who runs campaigns. Operational execution will increasingly be handled by AI agents.

 

What You Will Do

  • Own and execute the complete rebrand and repositioning of Keyrock in the market

  • Define and drive the marketing strategy across institutional and crypto-native audiences

  • Build a premium, forward-looking brand identity. Think distinctive, audacious, credible to both institutional allocators and crypto-native operators

  • Push information into the market in ways that make people pay attention and take Keyrock seriously

  • Partner closely with the CCO and commercial team to drive measurable commercial impact

  • Build and lead a small, high-impact team augmented by AI tooling

  • Shape how Keyrock is perceived as the industry converges with traditional finance

 

Who You Are

  • Crypto-native. You have been through market cycles. You understand blockchain technology deeply but you are pragmatic, not ideological. You know this is not a binary world.

  • A brand-builder, not an ops person. You are inspiring, not operational. You set direction, tone and creative vision.

  • An exceptional communicator. You can face institutional allocators who care about regulation and licensing, and crypto-native counterparties who value speed and edge. You switch between both with ease.

  • Confident and assertive. You project authority. You bring conviction and directness - you challenge constructively and don't default to consensus. You bring edge, energy and a slightly audacious style.

  • Human-centric. You connect with people, build followership and bring teams along.

  • Detail-oriented. Despite the strategic focus, you sweat the details on brand consistency, messaging precision and design quality.

  • A challenger mindset. You dare to think differently, question the status quo and push things forward through constructive tension.

 

Our Recruitment Philosophy

We look for self-aware candidates who bring both the core skills required for the role and a deep alignment with our performance principles. We seek fiercely passionate, mission-driven people who communicate with purpose and practice proactive ownership. The perfect fit? A crypto enthusiast who prioritizes mission over ego, maintains a commercial mindset, and delivers long-term value through pragmatic flexibility.

 

Experience and Background

Required

  • Significant experience in marketing leadership at a crypto or digital-asset firm

  • Deep understanding of the crypto market, its participants and its culture

  • Track record of building or transforming a brand in a fast-moving, commercially-driven environment

  • Strong communication skills Exceptional fluency in English, both written and spoken.

Preferred

  • Experience positioning a firm through a TradFi/crypto convergence narrative

  • Exposure to publicly listed or IPO-track companies

  • Familiarity with EU regulatory environment (MiCA) and how it shapes marketing and financial promotions

  • Experience working with or building AI-augmented marketing functions

 

Why Keyrock

  • Step-up opportunity. Own the function globally, report directly to the CCO, shape the brand from scratch.

  • Transformation moment. Keyrock is pivoting from appreciated-but-underrated to a firm that commands respect. This is a before-and-after career story.

  • Commercial partnership. Not a siloed marketing role. Deeply embedded in commercial strategy with commission upside.

  • Lean and AI-augmented. Small team, big impact. No bureaucratic bloat. Use agents and tools to move fast.

  • Global footprint. Offices across EU, UK, US and Switzerland. International exposure from day one.

  • Competitive offer. A base compensation package ranging from $175.000 to $220.000 p/a, attractive global benefits, and a performance-based variable.

  • Annual Team Retreats. A yearly offsite dedicated to strategy, celebration of our wins and fun team activities
