title: Special Projects Lead - Category Expansion
description:
Can you help us fix the world's most broken supply chain?

The fashion industry produces over 100 billion garments a year. 60% end up in landfill, not because people don't want these clothes, but because the supply chain for getting secondhand fashion from donation to resale is completely offline, manual and broken.

Fleek is fixing this. Our mission is to make secondhand the first choice. We're building the infrastructure powering the global secondhand clothing trade, through a B2B marketplace and the AI systems digitising the supply chain behind it.

Through Fleek, vintage stores, online resellers and retail buyers source graded secondhand inventory directly from wholesalers and rag houses across multiple countries. Our key enabler is FleekSort, an AI model fine-tuned on secondhand fashion that can grade, price and categorise items with just a photo. Turning what has historically been an opaque and manual trade into a structured, searchable and tradable global inventory layer.

Since 2022, we've saved 9 million items from landfill while tripling in size year-on-year. We're backed by some of the world's best investors, including a16z, Y Combinator and HV Capital, alongside world-class angels who helped build Depop, Shopify, and Postmates.

Today, we serve thousands of resellers and retailers across the UK, Europe and the US. With the secondhand fashion market projected to reach $350B by 2027, Fleek is building the AI-native operational and financial backbone for secondhand commerce globally.

We're looking for people who want to build something that matters and move fast doing it. Sounds good? Keep reading.

About the Role

We're hiring a Special Projects Lead to take Fleek's new category bets from thesis to proven economics. Each is a new business line that could add £5M+ in GMV, opening a new supply category or a new sourcing geography for the marketplace. Here's what makes these bets unusually winnable. Fleek already owns the demand. Most of the live bets sell to buyers who transact on Fleek today, so they're a supply-first test rather than a two-sided cold start. Your job on a new bet is to find and onboard the supply, sell it into demand that already exists and read the economics fast.

Every bet runs through the same gates. If a bet misses its gates, you kill it with evidence and move to the next one. If it works and you're running it well, you don't have to hand it off. You scale into owning the category, with supply, acquisition and ops building out under you. Think of this seat as a venture builder inside Fleek.

One thing this is not. We're not building a sales team or a sales culture, and this is not an AE or account manager role with a new title. You'll work directly with the founders and our commercial lead, close to the centre of the company.

What You'll Do

  • Run bets through the gates: take each bet from market research to first suppliers to first GMV to a feasible-or-not call, with win metrics and kill metrics defined before you start.

  • Go where the supply is: get on planes. You'll visit suppliers, graders and rag houses in the markets your bets open up, because this trade is built face to face and the best stock never gets listed anywhere.

  • Sell supply into live demand: onboard brands, brokers, graders and wholesalers, then get Fleek's existing buyers transacting on the new inventory. The sell is fast, informal and relationship-led, over WhatsApp and Instagram as often as in a boardroom.

  • Make the kill calls: hold a clear view of unit economics and the competitive landscape on every bet. Double down or cut on evidence, not attachment.

  • Be the ops function, for now: work out importer-of-record structures, duties, freight cost and last mile for each new flow.

  • Ride the AI infrastructure: our acquisition team has spent months building the agentic outreach and enrichment engine. You'll plug your bets into it and extend it, rather than building from a blank page or adding headcount.

  • Learn the actual trade: how stock is graded, routed and priced across markets, and who's sitting on good inventory that nobody has approached. You'll get deep in it fast.

What You Bring

  • Zero-to-one is your natural habitat. You've built something from nothing as a founder, an early employee or the person who started a new line inside an existing company. You've operated without a playbook and you didn't wait for one.

  • Operator and commercial in one person. You build the machine and you carry the number. You're not pure strategy and you're not pure sales, and you're comfortable being measured on GMV within your first quarter.

  • AI fluency. You work with agents and automations daily and you'd rather build a workflow than repeat a task.

Strong signals on top of that:

  • An instinct for physical goods. You understand inventory, margins and trading relationships, or you've worked around fashion, resale or marketplaces.

  • Deals you structured yourself, at any size, that didn't exist before you wrote them.

  • Exposure to cross-border trade, logistics or supply chain operations.

Nice to Have

  • Direct experience in resale, surplus or secondary-market inventory

  • Experience launching a new market, geography or product line from scratch

  • Established networks in international sourcing markets

What You'll Get

  • Generous equity: being on Fleek means you'll own a part of it

  • Comprehensive healthcare coverage

  • A collaborative team in a lovely office in the heart of East London

  • Access to founders. We're a small team and they're heavily involved (and good fun!)

  • Exclusive employee discounts to buy on Fleek

  • Access to borrow any item from our collection of vintage and reworks in the office

  • A disproportionate level of responsibility and the opportunity to drive massive impact

How We Work

Fleek is an in-office company. We're based at Commercial Street, E1 (Liverpool Street / Aldgate East). We operate a fully in-person culture at our office in Shoreditch, with trust-based flexibility. We hire adults and trust them to perform.

The Practicalities

  • Location: London HQ, Commercial Street, E1 (Liverpool Street / Aldgate East)

  • Stage: Post-Series B, hyper-growth

  • Team: 200 across three geographies

  • Culture: High ownership, non-hierarchical, fast-moving. Founder-led with strong opinions loosely held.

Our Values

Five values shape how we work at Fleek:

  • Dream Big and Disrupt Yourself: Push the most ambitious version of what you're building. Step out of your comfort zone. Nothing is out of reach.

  • Absolute Ownership: The buck stops with you. Drive initiatives to completion. Experiment, learn, persevere. The job isn't done until the job is done.

  • Curiosity Leads the Way: Don't accept anything at face value. Ask questions you don't know the answer to. That's how you innovate.

  • Talk to the Customer: Deeply understand their challenges, motivations, and ambitions. Every decision starts with the customer at the centre.

  • Embrace Diversity: A global team building for a global supply chain. Bring your authentic self and embrace the diversity of everyone you encounter.

Ready to build the infrastructure for the world's fastest-growing fashion economy? If you want to work on genuinely hard problems, with a world-class team, at a company that's tripling annually, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Senior Campaign Manager
description:
About Polymarket

Polymarket is the world's largest prediction market platform. We enable individuals to express views on real-world events by trading on outcomes across politics, economics, sports, culture, and current affairs. Built as a peer-to-peer marketplace with no centralized "house," Polymarket aggregates diverse opinions into transparent, market-based probabilities that reflect collective expectations about the future.

We're growing fast, both in terms of volume ($21B traded in 2025) and adoption as an alternative news source. Our ambition is to become a ubiquitous beacon of truth in global media and we need your help adding fuel to the fire.

About the Role

Polymarket's marketing team is building the creator and UGC engine that introduces millions of people to prediction markets for the first time. This is a Senior Campaign Manager role sitting within that team, reporting to a director, and owning the full lifecycle of influencer and UGC campaigns from initial brief through final performance report. You will work across creative, product, and leadership to get campaigns out the door and make them better each time.

The challenge here is real. Polymarket is a crypto-native, news-driven product that lives and dies by current events. The content that works today may not work next week. You need to move fast, have genuine taste, and know how to brief a creator so they produce something that actually converts, not just something that looks good in a recap deck. This is not a role for someone who needs a lot of direction or who treats campaign analysis as a formality.

This is a backfill, so the infrastructure exists. What we need is someone who can step in, take ownership immediately, and raise the bar on both execution quality and the rigor with which we learn from results.

What You'll Do

  • Own active influencer and UGC campaigns end-to-end, from writing the brief to delivering the final performance report with clear takeaways.

  • Source and manage creator partnerships across relevant verticals, building relationships that produce repeat, high-quality content rather than one-off posts.

  • Brief creators clearly and manage feedback rounds with the internal creative team, keeping timelines tight and quality high.

  • Pull campaign performance data regularly, identify what is working and what is not, and translate those findings into concrete changes for the next campaign.

  • Manage up to directors by proactively communicating campaign status, flagging blockers early, and coming to meetings with answers rather than questions.

  • Navigate cross-functional workflows across product, creative, and leadership without needing hand-holding, keeping campaigns moving even when internal processes are ambiguous.

  • Stay current on content formats, creator trends, and platform shifts so that Polymarket's campaigns reflect what is actually resonating right now, not what worked six months ago.

What We're Looking For

  • 4 to 5 years of experience running influencer and UGC campaigns for tech companies, with work that spans both brand awareness and conversion-focused content.

  • Demonstrated ability to analyze campaign performance data and implement specific, measurable changes to subsequent campaigns based on what you found.

  • Experience managing creator relationships independently, including sourcing, briefing, and holding partners accountable to deliverables and quality standards.

  • Comfort working cross-functionally and managing up, including regular communication with directors and navigating internal workflows that are not always clearly defined.

  • Genuine fluency in online culture and content, you consume it, you understand what is landing right now, and you can apply that instinct to a product tied to real-world events.

  • Strong written communication skills, particularly when it comes to creative briefs and performance summaries that drive decisions rather than just document activity.

  • (Plus) Prior experience working on crypto, web3, or fintech products, or comfort marketing a product that requires some audience education.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary & equity

  • Unlimited PTO

  • Full Health, Vision, & Dental coverage

  • 401k match

  • Hardware setup: new MacBook Pro, big display, & accessories

Pay Transparency

Base salary range: $125,000 to $150,000, plus equity and benefits.

This is a good-faith range for the level we're hiring at. Experience varies widely within a title here, so if your expectations fall outside it, reach out anyway. We're always happy to talk it through.

title: Senior Intelligence Analyst, Iran Focus
description:
The R&D team at Chainalysis is inspired by solving the hardest technical challenges and building products that establish trust in cryptocurrencies. We're a global organization that thrives on challenging work and doing it alongside exceptionally talented teammates. Our industry evolves rapidly, and our mission is to build a flexible, AI-driven platform that automates entity resolution, optimizes data labeling pipelines, and creates predictive models that identify illicit patterns before they escalate.

Our data and solutions have been used to solve some of the world's most high-profile criminal cases and grow consumer access to cryptocurrency safely. Now, by pairing the industry's most trusted blockchain data with agents that reason, investigate, and act, we help our customers scale their workflows as the cryptocurrency economy becomes increasingly mainstream.

Chainalysis data has helped solve some of the world’s highest-profile criminal and national-security cases and made it safer for people everywhere to access crypto. The Global Intelligence Team produces the attribution at the heart of that data — connecting on-chain activity to the real-world entities behind it, across the global crypto ecosystem. It’s the intelligence data moat beneath every Chainalysis product, and what investigators, sanctions authorities, and national-security agencies rely on to follow the money and disrupt threats.

Few threats test that mission harder than Iran. Through the IRGC and its Qods Force, a network of proxies and Shia militant groups, state-linked cyber actors, and a sprawling sanctions-evasion apparatus, the Islamic Republic has turned to cryptocurrency to raise, move, and launder value beyond the reach of the traditional financial system — from exchange-based sanctions evasion and crypto mining powered by subsidized energy, to oil- and commodity-for-crypto schemes, dual-use procurement, and the financing of proxies across the region. Making that activity visible on-chain is one of the most consequential problems in crypto intelligence today.

As our Iran-focused intelligence analyst — the team’s subject-matter expert on Iran and the IRGC — you’ll own that problem end to end. This is a depth role: while our analysts cover the breadth of the crypto-services ecosystem, you’ll go deep on a single, high-stakes domain — becoming the person, inside Chainalysis and increasingly across the industry, who understands how Iran and its proxies use crypto and can prove it on-chain. You’ll own the attribution for Iran’s crypto footprint, map how these networks actually operate, turn that into finished intelligence customers act on, and be the expert voice representing Chainalysis on Iran crypto threats.

Who you’ll work with

You’ll join a fast-moving, globally distributed team — analysts, threat-domain SMEs, data scientists, and engineers — collaborating across time zones, async and in real time. We move fast, hold each other to a high bar, and back each other up across regions. As the Iran SME, you’ll be the single point of depth for the domain and a force multiplier for everyone working adjacent to it.

In this role, you’ll:

  • Own Iran attribution end to end — the threat-actor entities, their definitions, and the accounts, addresses, and infrastructure they operate: Iranian exchanges and OTC/no-KYC networks, IRGC and IRGC-QF financing, Iranian proxy and Shia militant finance (e.g., Hezbollah, the Houthis, and Iraqi militias), sanctions-evasion infrastructure, Iranian ransomware and state-linked cyber operations, and oil-, commodity-, and procurement-for-crypto flows.

  • Lead the attribution response to Iran-related sanctions events — when OFAC or allied authorities designate Iranian entities, actors, or infrastructure, drive the rapid, high-visibility on-chain attribution that turns those designations into coverage in our data, often against the clock.

  • Map the networks on-chain — trace how Iranian actors raise, move, launder, and cash out value through Iranian VASPs, regional exchanges, mixers, no-KYC swaps, mining operations, and off-ramps, and keep that picture current as they adapt to pressure.

  • Produce finished intelligence — advisory notes, customer and partner briefings, and contributions to flagship publications (the Crypto Crime Report and beyond) that make the Iran crypto threat legible and actionable.

  • Be the named external expert — represent Chainalysis on Iran crypto threats at conferences, on panels, with the press, and in briefings to public- and private-sector partners.

  • Help set the Iran collection agenda — surface what data we need on Iranian networks and feed those requirements into our collection process and priority intelligence requirements; you direct collection for the domain, but it runs through the team’s apparatus and prioritization, not you alone.

  • Translate typologies into detection — turn what you learn about Iranian methods into guidance that our products and our customers can operationalize.

  • Build with AI — design and tune the automation that scales your analysis and the team’s, and handle the hard cases automation can’t.

  • Level up the team — raise the bar on Iran and threat-finance tradecraft broadly, and partner closely with analysts, other SMEs, data science, and engineering.

We’re looking for candidates who have:

  • Deep, demonstrable Iran expertise — real command of the IRGC and IRGC-Qods Force, Iran’s proxy and Shia militant landscape, Iranian sanctions evasion, and/or Iran’s illicit-finance and procurement systems. This is the core of the role, and we’ll expect you to show it.

  • On-chain tracing ability against Iranian targets — direct experience following Iranian crypto activity on-chain (Iranian exchanges, sanctions evasion, proxy or terror finance), or deep Iran threat-finance expertise paired with proven blockchain-tracing skill you can bring to bear here from day one.

  • A national-security or threat-finance background — intelligence, sanctions, counter-threat-finance, or investigations, from the IC, Treasury/OFAC, law enforcement, the military, a think tank or research institution, or private-sector CTF/sanctions work.

  • Regional fluency — a strong grasp of Iranian geopolitics, the proxy network, and regional financial flows. Farsi (or Arabic) language ability is a significant plus.

  • Elite potential and a proven track record — exceptional aptitude, judgment, and work ethic; you’ve led hard problems end to end and you raise everyone around you.

  • Excellent writing and communication — this is an outward-facing expert role; your intelligence has to land with analysts, customers, and senior audiences alike.

  • AI-forward instincts — you build automation to scale your work and others’, not just use it.

  • Comfort working with data; blockchain forensics experience strongly preferred.

  • 5+ years of relevant analytic, intelligence, or threat-finance experience for a Senior hire; 8+ years and recognized domain authority for a Staff hire.

You might also have:

  • Farsi language ability.

  • Direct experience with OFAC sanctions, terror-finance designations, or the designation process.

  • A record of published research or public speaking on Iran, sanctions evasion, or crypto threat finance.

  • Familiarity with Iranian exchange infrastructure, crypto mining as a sanctions-evasion vector, or dual-use procurement networks.

AI at Chainalysis
AI is not a feature at Chainalysis - it is a new way of working. One that turns instructions into work done, and helps us move faster than the threats we're built to counter, and we expect our employees to take ownership of the output and ensure quality. As the world's most trusted blockchain analytics platform, Chainalysis sits at a rare intersection of proprietary data, regulatory relationships and crypto expertise that makes it uniquely placed to shape and lead the next era of AI-driven intelligence - and we expect everyone here, regardless of role, to be an active part of it.

AI fluency is tied directly to how we measure performance and how we plan to win. There is no substitute for your own curiosity. We provide the tools, workflows, and space to experiment - but the expectation is that you develop these capabilities yourself, bring ideas, and collaborate across teams to reinvent the way work gets done. We are not using AI to do less. We are using it to do what was never possible before.

About Chainalysis

Chainalysis is the blockchain data platform, making it easy to connect the movement of digital assets to real-world services. Powered by deep blockchain data and AI, organizations can investigate illicit activity, manage risk exposure, and develop innovative market solutions built on the industry's most trusted blockchain intelligence. Our mission is to build trust in blockchains, blending safety and security with an unwavering commitment to growth and innovation.

You belong here. 

At Chainalysis, we believe that diversity of experience and thought makes us stronger. With both customers and employees around the world, we are committed to ensuring our team reflects the unique communities around us. We’re ensuring we keep learning by committing to continually revisit and reevaluate our diversity culture.

We encourage applicants across any race, ethnicity, gender/gender expression, age, spirituality, ability, experience and more. If you need any accommodations to make our interview process more accessible to you due to a disability, don't hesitate to let us know. You can learn more here. We can’t wait to meet you.

title: Senior Technical Account Manager
description:
Applying to Paxos? Our only careers site is paxos.com/careers, and we only recruit via @paxos.com email. Details below.
___

About Paxos

Today’s financial infrastructure is archaic, expensive, inefficient and risky — supporting a system that leaves out more people than it lets in. So we’re rebuilding it.

We’re on a mission to open the world’s financial system to everyone by enabling the instant movement of any asset, any time, in a trustworthy way. For over a decade, we’ve built blockchain infrastructure that tokenizes, custodies, trades and settles assets for the world’s leading financial institutions, like PayPal, Venmo, Mastercard and Interactive Brokers.

About the team

  • The Technical Services team at Paxos supports our partnerships with Crypto Brokerage, Tokenized Asset and Payments customers post-launch, enabling growth through optimizing integrations and driving product adoption.

  • As part of Paxos' mission to modernize financial infrastructure, the Technical Services team directly impacts business growth by managing the integrations with major financial institutions like PayPal, Interactive Brokers, Stripe, and Kraken.

About the role

  • Technical Account Managers (TAMs) own the day‑to‑day technical administration, integration, technical stability, and operational execution required to deliver against account plans and day to day needs.

  • We only use @paxos.com email addresses

  • We never ask for payment or financial details to apply, interview, or work here

Thanks for your interest in Paxos!

title: Staff Software Engineer (Web Automation & Open Banking Infrastructure)
Assoc/VP, Assistant Controller
description:
Who We Are:

Galaxy Digital Inc. (Nasdaq: GLXY) is a global leader in digital assets and data center infrastructure, growing the economy that runs on code. Galaxy delivers the onchain infrastructure that connects institutions to digital assets, including trading, advisory, asset management, staking, self-custody, and tokenization. Galaxy also develops and operates data center infrastructure to power AI and HPC workloads. Anchored by its Helios campus in Texas, Galaxy is building a multi-gigawatt pipeline of more than 5.7 GW of potential capacity, positioning it among the largest and fastest-growing data center developers in North America.

The Company is headquartered in New York City, with offices across North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.

Additional information about Galaxy's businesses and products is available on www.galaxy.com.

What We Value:

We are a diverse team of free thinkers, and fast movers united to help investors and creators energize the global economy. We are looking for individuals who thrive in a culture of builders and overachievers and embrace high performance, transparent feedback, and a mission-first approach. Our culture shapes our way of working and gets us where we want to be.

  • Seek Excellence.
  • Be Selective To Be Effective.
  • Be Highly Aligned, Loosely Coupled.
  • Disagree Transparently.
  • Encourage Independent Decision-Making.
  • Build Dream Teams.

Who You Are:

The ideal candidate will have 3-7 years of experience working in a mix of public and private accounting focusing on venture capital, private equity, or other closed-end fund structures. This person will sit on the asset management team with primary responsibility for Galaxy’s venture capital and closed-end fund products, with the opportunity to broaden their responsibilities and support our liquid hedge fund products as needed.

This role will contain a unique opportunity to work on both the Finance and Operations teams and get involved in all middle and back-office functions of the funds. Role will be much broader than a standard accounting role and include treasury, capital call and distribution execution, investment closing support, valuation support, automation, and various other operational functions.

What You’ll Do:

  • Review quarterly and annual fund NAVs, capital account allocations, and partners' capital account statements across Galaxy's venture capital and closed-end fund products.
  • Manage the capital activity lifecycle — calculate and issue capital call and distribution notices, and track limited partner commitments, contributions, distributions, and unfunded balances.

  • Calculate and review management fees, carried interest, and distribution waterfalls in accordance with each fund’s limited partnership agreement.

  • Embrace and champion the thoughtful adoption of AI to improve team performance and business outcomes.
  • Leverage AI tools (e.g., generative AI, automation platforms, data copilots) to improve productivity, decision-making, and output quality in your day-to-day work.

What We’re Looking For:

  • 3-7 years of experience with a strong background in accounting
  • Experience with venture capital, private equity, or other closed-end fund accounting, including capital calls, distributions, and capital account allocations
  • Experience coordinating with third party fund administrators
  • Experience in managing audits of closed-end fund structure
  • A working knowledge of limited partnership agreements, including management fee, carried interest, and waterfall provisions
  • Familiarity with fair value measurement (ASC 820) for level 3 illiquid, privately held investments

Bonus Points: 

  • CPA preferred
  • Experience in digital assets/crypto currencies
  • Experience with venture-stage instruments such as SAFEs, convertible notes, token warrants, and direct token investment
  • Experience with SPVs and co-investment vehicles
  • Experience in client service or communicating directly with stakeholders

What We Offer:

  • Competitive base salary and discretionary bonus
  • Hybrid/Flexible Working Arrangements 
  • Flexible Time Off (paid)
  • 3% 401(k) company contribution
  • Company-paid health and protective benefits for employees, partners, and other dependents
  • Generous paid Parental Leave
  • Competitive family planning benefits for US employees 
  • Opportunities to learn about the Crypto industry
  • Smart, entrepreneurial, and fun colleagues
  • Free daily snacks and weekly breakfasts/lunches 
  • Employee Resource Groups
  • Free coaching and counseling sessions through Headspace

Apply now and join us as we grow the economy that runs on code.

The base salary ranges included below will be commensurate with candidate experience, expertise and local market. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors, including candidate experience and expertise. At Galaxy, we maintain a total compensation philosophy which consists of a competitive base salary, annual bonus, and equity incentives.

$125,000—$180,000 USD

Galaxy respects diversity and seeks to provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and job applicants for employment without regard to actual or perceived age, race, color, creed, religion, sex or gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, lactation and related medical conditions), gender identity or gender expression (including transgender status), sexual orientation, marital or partnership or caregiver status, ancestry, national origin, citizenship status, disability, military or veteran status, protected medical condition as defined by applicable state or local law, genetic information or predisposing genetic characteristic, or other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws and ordinances.

title: Portfolio Manager
description:

title: Quant Risk Analyst
description:
About Polymarket

Polymarket is the world's largest prediction market platform. We enable individuals to express views on real-world events by trading on outcomes across politics, economics, sports, culture, and current affairs. Built as a peer-to-peer marketplace with no centralized "house," Polymarket aggregates diverse opinions into transparent, market-based probabilities that reflect collective expectations about the future.

We're growing fast, both in terms of volume ($21B traded in 2025) and adoption as an alternative news source. Our ambition is to become a ubiquitous beacon of truth in global media and we need your help adding fuel to the fire.

About the Role

Polymarket is building a regulated US exchange, and we're hiring a Quant Risk Manager to anchor the risk function from the ground up. This is not a maintenance role. You'll be designing the models, frameworks, and systems that protect the exchange as we launch perpetuals and traditional commodity derivatives into a live, fast-moving market.

The US Exchange team is small and moving quickly. You'll work directly with engineers, product leads, and compliance to translate quantitative risk thinking into real infrastructure. That means writing code, making policy calls, and owning outcomes across margin design, stress testing, and default risk, not handing specs over a wall and waiting.

This hire matters because the exchange doesn't function safely without it. You'll be the person who decides how we measure and contain exposure, how we protect the guarantee fund, and how we hold up under stress scenarios that no one has fully mapped yet for a market like ours. If you want to build something that doesn't exist yet, this is it.

What You'll Do

  • Build quantitative risk models for perpetuals and commodity derivatives, covering margin requirements, position limits, and tail risk across normal and stressed market conditions.

  • Design and maintain the exchange's stress testing framework, including scenario construction, loss estimation, and regular calibration as market conditions evolve.

  • Develop default risk models that determine how the guarantee fund is sized, structured, and triggered in a default event.

  • Partner with engineers to build a real-time risk monitoring platform that surfaces exposure, breaches, and anomalies as they happen during live trading.

  • Translate risk model outputs into actionable exchange policy, including margin schedules, liquidation logic, and market maker requirements.

  • Own CFTC-related risk reporting and capital obligations, working with legal and compliance to ensure the exchange meets its regulatory requirements without flying blind.

  • Identify gaps in the current risk architecture and prioritize what gets built next, based on where actual exposure is growing fastest.

What We're Looking For

  • Hands-on experience managing derivatives or futures risk, either at an exchange, clearinghouse, or trading firm where real money was on the line.

  • Quantitative risk management background with direct ownership of model development, not just consumption of outputs from a research team.

  • Strong financial modeling skills in Python. You write clean, production-quality code and move fast.

  • Comfort working with AI tools across the full development cycle. You use them to ship better work faster, not as a shortcut around understanding.

  • Deep familiarity with exchange mechanics: order books, market making dynamics, margin and collateral management, position limits, and liquidation.

  • Working knowledge of CFTC regulations for designated contract markets, including reporting requirements, capital rules, and conduct standards.

  • Ability to operate without a large team behind you. You can scope a problem, build a solution, and defend your assumptions to stakeholders who will push back.

  • (Plus) Experience with guarantee fund design or default waterfall mechanics at a clearing organization.

  • (Plus) Background in prediction markets, crypto derivatives, or other non-traditional asset classes where standard risk frameworks needed to be adapted.

  • (Plus) Prior experience standing up a risk function or platform from scratch, not just inheriting one.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary & equity

  • Unlimited PTO

  • Full Health, Vision, & Dental coverage

  • 401k match

  • Hardware setup: new MacBook Pro, big display, & accessories

Pay Transparency

Base salary range: $100,000 to $150,000 annually, plus equity and benefits.

This range reflects a good-faith estimate for this position. Experience levels vary widely within a title here, so please reach out even if your expectations fall outside it. We're always happy to chat.

title: Manager, Account Management
description:
About Warp

Warp is the AI-native Employee Management Platform for ambitious companies. Our platform includes HRIS, payroll, IT, benefits, tax compliance, and more - all built from scratch on an AI-native architecture from day 1.

Warp embeds itself into every part of a company's people operating layer, we process over half a billion $ annually in payroll, on track to grow to $2B.


Legacy vendors in our space built their businesses by profiting from complexity. Warp is built from day one for AI to be the primary operator, not a feature. Every advance in LLM capability widens our lead.


We hire people who ship constantly, own outcomes, and care about craft. If you want to build something that automates an entire category of core work, not just another point solution, this is the place.

We've raised over $85M from top investors like Ashton Kutcher/Sound Ventures, Y Combinator, founders of Dropbox, Replit, SV Angel, and Homebrew Capital. Built by an obsessive team from MIT, Ramp, Brex, Google, Dropbox, Apple, and more.

About The Role

We're hiring a Manager of Account Management to lead and scale a team of Account Managers responsible for retention and expansion across our customer base. You'll coach your team to run a disciplined, consultative motion - from health monitoring through QBRs to signed expansion contracts - while owning the operational rigor (forecasting, pipeline hygiene, coaching cadence) that turns individual performance into a predictable, repeatable team result. You'll report to the Head of Customer Success and play a key role in building out Warp's Account Management function as it scales.

What You'll Do

  • Own team-level retention and expansion targets, translate company NRR goals into individual quotas and coach the team to hit them

  • Recruit, hire, and ramp new Account Managers as the team scales

  • Run a consistent coaching cadence (deal reviews, call shadowing, QBR prep) to raise the floor and ceiling of team performance

  • Maintain forecasting rigor across the team's book of business

  • Partner with RevOps/Sales leadership to refine segmentation, territory assignment, and health-scoring models

  • Spot systemic churn patterns across the team's portfolio and drive proactive intervention playbooks, not just deal-by-deal firefighting

  • Document the SOPs, templates, and processes the team runs on (QBR structure, renewal motion, expansion methodology)

  • Design a distinct motion for smaller or early-stage accounts

  • Collaborate with Support, Product, and Engineering to escalate and resolve complex customer issues, and represent the voice of the customer in roadmap discussions

  • Partner with Sales and Activations leadership for a seamless handoff and shared account strategy from close through onboarding into steady-state management

What You Need

  • Minimum 4-5 years of B2B account management, customer success, or sales experience, including at least 2-3 years directly managing a quota-carrying team

  • Proven track record of leading a team to consistently meet or exceed retention and expansion targets

  • Strong coaching instincts and ability to diagnose why a rep is underperforming (skill, activity, or account quality) and correct it

  • Experience building or significantly improving account management processes, playbooks, or tooling from the ground up

  • Comfort with forecasting and reporting rigor; fluency with a modern CS/sales stack (e.g., Salesforce, Metabase, Pylon, Linear or equivalent)

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills

  • High adaptability and comfort with the pace and ambiguity of an early-stage startup

Nice to Have

  • Experience managing account managers who serve early-stage startup or high-growth B2B SaaS customers

  • Background scaling an Account Management function through a period of rapid headcount growth

  • Experience designing compensation structures, quota frameworks, or account segmentation/tiering models

Benefits at Warp:

  • 100% Health Coverage: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans for you and your dependents.

  • 401(k) Matching: Start investing in your future from day one.

  • Unlimited PTO: We offer flexible PTO, meaning you’re trusted to take the time you need to recharge while balancing your responsibilities and team commitments.

  • Commuter Benefits: Pre-tax commuter benefits for your daily trip to our NYC office.

  • Catered Lunch Daily: Great food, every day, on us. No meal prep, no decision fatigue.

  • Quarterly Offsites: Beautiful locations to connect as a team. Past locations include Spain and Catskills.

Warp is based in New York City, and most of our team works together in-office 5x per week. Please refer to the top of this page for this position's hiring location and working model.

title: Staff Data Scientist, Growth
description:
At Shakepay, we’re on a mission to usher in the Bitcoin golden age. We’re reimagining financial services to give every Canadian their fair shake.

Our culture is built around doing work that matters, winning as a team, and celebrating success. If you're the kind of person who values growth, shipping fast, and sharing your ideas openly with a group of like-minded people, come and build with us!

About Shakepay

Since 2015, we've been on a mission to help Canadians build long-term wealth through bitcoin. Over the past few years, we've expanded beyond buying and selling bitcoin to offer a growing suite of everyday financial products - including the Shakepay Card, direct deposit, bill payments and Interac e-Transfer - making it easier to earn, save and use bitcoin every day. Today, more than 1.5 million Canadians use Shakepay to grow their bitcoin savings and take control of their financial future as we continue to push the boundaries of what modern financial services can look like.

We’re regulated as an investment dealer across all Canadian provinces and territories, and backed by renowned venture capitalists with a funding of $44M. We have a passionate, loyal, and growing community, and we’re looking for people who want to help us build something truly special.

Staff Data Scientist, Growth

We’re looking for an experienced Data Scientist to join one of our cross-functional squads at Shakepay. You’ll work closely with engineering and design, while also partnering across marketing, finance, and operations to help us identify growth opportunities and make smarter decisions across the business.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in fast-moving environments, enjoys operating with high autonomy, and can turn ambiguous problems into measurable impact. You’ll combine experimentation, statistical rigor, business intuition, and product thinking to influence how we grow, retain, and better serve millions of Canadians.

What you’ll be doing

  • Partner closely with engineers and designers across our product squads to improve acquisition, activation, retention, monetization, and customer experience
  • Collaborate with marketing, finance, and operations teams to uncover growth opportunities and drive better business decisions
  • Champion and evangelize experimentation and decision frameworks that  help us ship and iterate quickly with confidence
  • Define KPIs and success metrics that  help teams stay aligned around measurable outcomes
  • Use statistical analysis, forecasting, causal inference, and machine learning techniques to better understand user behavior and business performance
  • Identify high-leverage opportunities proactively through deep analysis of user journeys, lifecycle behavior, conversion funnels, and financial performance
  • Help shape squad and company priorities by bringing data-informed perspectives on impact, tradeoffs, and ROI
  • Build dashboards, models, and self-serve tools that improve visibility into growth and business performance across the organization
  • Collaborate with the broader data team to maintain a shared and consistent data layer that serves our stakeholders and internal agents
  • Foster a culture of experimentation, curiosity, and evidence-based decision-making across Shakepay

Who we’re looking for

  • 8+ years of experience in data science, growth analytics, experimentation, or related roles in high-growth environments
  • Strong proficiency in SQL and Python
  • Deep understanding of experimentation, causal inference, statistical analysis, forecasting, and KPI design
  • Strong product and business intuition, with the ability to connect user behavior to company outcomes
  • Experience working cross-functionally with teams such as marketing, finance, operations, or product
  • Comfortable operating autonomously and driving ambiguous projects from idea to execution
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to influence decisions through data and clear reasoning
  • A demonstrated ability to manage and deliver on multiple projects with high attention to detail
  • Curiosity, speed, and a bias toward action in fast-moving environments
  • Solid understanding of dashboarding and data visualization tools
  • Willingness to learn and grow in a fast-paced environment

Bonus points

  • Experience in startup or high-growth consumer environments
  • Experience with experimentation and product analytics platforms such as Posthog, Statsig, Amplitude
  • Experience working with dbt, Snowflake, and modern data stacks
  • Experience with lifecycle marketing, customer segmentation, or growth modeling
  • Existing Shakepay customer and/or familiarity with the product
  • Interest and enthusiasm for the possibilities enabled by Bitcoin and non-sovereign money

Why join us?

  • Help shape the future of money: Be part of a team that's revolutionizing financial services in Canada, one sat at a time.
  • Impact millions: As cryptocurrency continues to gain traction, our potential for growth is massive. You can help us bring Shakepay and Bitcoin to all Canadians.
  • Grow your career: We’re growing, and so can you! We have programs in place to encourage continuous learning, growth, and development.
  • Ideas, not titles: We want the best ideas to make their way through, no matter where they come from.

Perks and benefits

  • 🤝 Be an owner - Every employee has stock options as part of their total compensation 
  • 🥅 Reach your goals - Yearly salary assessments 
  • 🦷 Health & wellness :  Access to comprehensive health and dental coverage, including health and wellness spending accounts. 
  • 🌎 Remote-friendly: Work from anywhere in Canada, with optional access to our office spaces in Montreal and Toronto.
  • 🆙 Level Up: A $2,000 annual budget for courses, certifications, and training to support your career growth.
  • 🌴 Time off: 20 days of vacation per year. And if you use all your vacation, we give you a $1,000 bonus.
  • 🐣 Parental leave: Enjoy a parental leave top up to 100% of your salary for 18 weeks.
  • 🙌 Have fun together: quarterly team-specific or company-wide offsite to connect with each other  

The base salary range for this position is $200,000 - $250,000 CAD. Base pay may vary based on factors such as years of experience, skills and qualifications. Additionally, employees are eligible for equity,  pay increases based on performance, benefits including health and dental care, and paid time off.

We understand that potential can be just as valuable as experience. If you're eager to learn, grow, and contribute to the mission but worry that you may not have the “right” experience, we still want you to apply. We encourage applications from everyone, regardless of background and life experience. We’re firm believers that a little bit of slope makes up for a lot of y-intercept.

We use technology, including artificial intelligence (AI), to support certain parts of our hiring process. This can include tools that assist with scheduling, application review, candidate communications, and generating interview notes, guides, or summaries so our team can stay focused on the conversation. All hiring decisions are made by our hiring team.

Fluency in English is required due to the percentage of English-speaking customers and the nature of our platform, which is available to all Canadians.

title: Full-Stack Software Engineer - Growth
description:
About Ondo

Capital markets are moving onchain. Ondo Finance is building the products and infrastructure that will bring them there.

We create institutional-grade, blockchain-enabled investment products and services, including tokenized treasuries, tokenized stocks and ETFs, and new trading experiences built for global, always-on markets. We are the category leader by AUM, well-capitalized, and backed by investors including Founders Fund, Coinbase Ventures, Pantera Capital, and Tiger Global.

The underlying financial infrastructure is complex. We believe the product experience should not be.

About the Web team

The Web team builds the product layer that makes Ondo's financial infrastructure accessible. We own the experiences through which users onboard, establish eligibility, move money, mint and redeem Ondo Stocks, manage portfolios, and use products across multiple blockchains.

We are a small team of exceptional engineers with broad ownership and a high bar for craft, judgment, and execution. We turn complexity across compliance systems, backend services, smart contracts, and external partners into products that feel clear and dependable.

Engineering on this team is distinguished by:

  • Product taste. We simplify complex financial workflows without hiding the details that matter.
  • End-to-end ownership. Engineers shape, build, launch, and improve the product.
  • Speed with confidence. We scope sharply, move quickly, and hold a high quality bar.
  • Security and correctness. Access control, auditability, privacy, and failure behavior are design constraints from the start.
  • High agency and low ego. We act without waiting, invite direct critique, and make the team better.

About the role

As a Full-Stack Engineer focused on Growth, you will design the foundations of how users discover, understand, adopt, and return to Ondo's products. You will own the systems and product experiences that turn user insight into measurable growth across acquisition, activation, engagement, and retention.

Your scope spans the full growth loop—from public websites and user-facing product journeys to experimentation, analytics, content systems, backend workflows, and third-party platforms. You will set technical direction, define the measurement foundations, and evolve these systems as our products, markets, and scale change.

This is a foundational ownership role for a senior engineer. You will turn ambiguous growth opportunities into clear hypotheses, durable architecture, and polished product experiences. You will partner closely with Product, Design, Marketing, Data, and Engineering while owning the judgment: where friction matters, what to build, how to measure it, and when the evidence calls for a different direction.

The goal is not experiment volume. It is to understand users better than anyone else and turn that understanding into durable product improvements and measurable business impact.

What you'll do

  • Own the growth engineering strategy across discovery, acquisition, activation, engagement, and retention—from identifying the highest-leverage opportunities through technical design, launch, measurement, and iteration.
  • Design and evolve the foundations for experimentation, event instrumentation, attribution, funnel analysis, content, and lifecycle experiences so the team can move quickly and trust what it learns.
  • Build polished user-facing experiences and the backend systems, data models, APIs, webhooks, and third-party integrations behind them.
  • Work directly with users and product data to identify friction, form clear hypotheses, and make disciplined product and technical bets.
  • Turn validated learning into durable product capabilities and measurable business impact—not one-off experiments.
  • Partner with Product, Design, Marketing, and Data to lead launches, localization, and new ways to grow adoption across Ondo's products.
  • Improve organic discovery and conversion through technical SEO and AEO, performance, structured content, and clear user journeys.
  • Raise the level of the team through clear writing, thoughtful code review, strong operational ownership, and effective use of modern AI engineering tools.

What you bring

  • 4+ years of experience building and operating production full-stack applications with React, Next.js, and TypeScript.
  • Experience driving measurable acquisition, activation, engagement, or retention outcomes through growth engineering, product-led growth, consumer product, ecommerce, or similarly data-informed product work.
  • Experience building and operating serverless systems on AWS, including Lambda and adjacent services such as API Gateway, EventBridge, or SQS.
  • Strong experience using BigQuery and product analytics data to model funnels, investigate user behavior, and measure product and business impact.
  • Strong fundamentals in API and data-model design, relational databases, event-driven systems, event instrumentation, experimentation, testing, and observability.
  • A record of owning product work end to end—not only implementing experiments or specifications handed to you.
  • Product taste: you can find the simplest experience that solves the user's problem without ignoring the complexity or edge cases underneath it.
  • Data fluency and intellectual honesty. You can define useful metrics, distinguish signal from noise, and change direction when the evidence challenges your hypothesis.
  • The ability to communicate clearly, learn unfamiliar domains quickly, and create alignment across engineering, product, design, marketing, and data partners.
  • High agency and low ego. You move important work forward, invite strong critique, and care more about the outcome than whose idea wins.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience building fintech, trading, crypto-native, or other high-consideration products where earning user trust is essential.
  • Experience with lifecycle marketing, CRM, CMS, experimentation, localization, or analytics platforms.
  • Familiarity with AEO, structured content, international SEO, and growth across multiple regions or languages.
  • Experience applying AI to prototyping, personalization, analytics, content operations, or other growth workflows.

We do not expect every strong candidate to arrive with deep crypto or every growth specialty listed above. We do expect curiosity, strong product and engineering fundamentals, and the ability to turn learning into shipped improvements quickly.

What we offer

  • Challenging, high-impact work helping define how a global audience discovers and adopts a new category of financial products.
  • Competitive compensation including salary, future token rights, and/or equity, according to your preferences.
  • Full medical, vision, and dental benefits, plus a flexible vacation policy.
  • A remote-first environment with meaningful autonomy and influence over product and technical direction.
  • Exceptional colleagues from Goldman Sachs, BlackRock, Two Sigma, Bridgewater, SpaceX, AWS, Meta, Google, McKinsey, Coinbase, Circle, and Uniswap.
  • Backing from leading crypto experts and investors, including Pantera Capital, Founders Fund, and Coinbase Ventures.

About the role

As a Full-Stack Engineer focused on Compliance, you will design the foundations of Ondo's onboarding and compliance platform. You will own the systems that determine how users establish eligibility, move through KYC/KYB and compliance review, and how Operations and Compliance teams investigate and resolve cases.

Your scope spans the full workflow—from the user-facing onboarding experience to the internal tools, decision logic, data models, and third-party integrations behind it. You will set technical direction, define system boundaries and invariants, and evolve the platform as our products, policies, and scale change.

This is a foundational ownership role for a senior engineer. You will turn ambiguous policy and operational requirements into precise product behavior and durable architecture. You will partner closely with Compliance, Legal, Risk, Operations, Product, and Design while owning the engineering judgment: what must be true, how the system can fail, and how it remains secure, explainable, and resilient in production.

We are looking for an engineer who sees the whole system, anticipates what comes next, and raises the standard for critical product infrastructure.

What you'll do

  • Own compliance-focused product areas from problem definition and architecture through implementation, launch, production operation, and iteration.
  • Build clear, maintainable interfaces along with the APIs, data models, workflows, and integrations that make them work.
  • Turn complex regulatory and operational requirements into intuitive, testable product behavior for customers and internal users.
  • Integrate third-party APIs and webhooks from identity, sanctions, blockchain analytics, fraud, and case-management providers while maintaining strong data quality, privacy, observability, and auditability.
  • Design for real-world failure modes, including delayed and reordered vendor events, manual review, partial outages, retries, and conflicting state across systems.
  • Work directly with Compliance, Legal, Risk, Operations, Product, Design, and users to understand the domain and make sound product and technical tradeoffs.
  • Apply AI and machine learning where they can safely reduce manual work or improve decision support, with appropriate security, human review, explainability, and audit trails.
  • Raise the level of the team through clear design work, thoughtful code review, strong operational ownership, and effective use of modern AI engineering tools.

What you bring

  • 4+ years of experience building and operating production full-stack applications with React, Next.js, Node.js, and TypeScript.
  • Strong fundamentals in API and data-model design, relational databases, distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, testing, observability, and third-party integrations.
  • Hands-on experience building KYC/KYB, identity verification, onboarding, or similarly sensitive workflows, with a strong understanding of access controls, data protection, auditability, and secure system design.
  • A record of owning complex product work end to end—not only implementing requirements handed to you.
  • Product and technical judgment: you can translate ambiguous policy into precise system behavior, identify consequential edge cases, and make pragmatic tradeoffs without compromising critical controls.
  • High standards for security, correctness, reliability, usability, and maintainability.
  • The ability to communicate clearly, learn unfamiliar domains quickly, and create alignment across technical, legal, compliance, and operational partners.
  • High agency and low ego. You move important work forward, invite strong critique, surface risk early, and care more about getting the system right than being right.

Preferred qualifications

  • Familiarity with financial-crime controls and frameworks such as BSA/AML, OFAC, FinCEN, KYC/CDD, SEC, or FATF.
  • Experience building fintech, payments, trading, crypto, or other products where correctness, trust, and regulatory obligations are essential.
  • Experience with systems that combine offchain identity and compliance data with onchain activity.
  • Experience supporting audits, regulatory examinations, control testing, or compliance reporting.
  • Experience applying AI or machine learning to regulated operational workflows.

We do not expect every strong candidate to know every framework or arrive with deep crypto experience. We do expect curiosity, sound engineering judgment, respect for the domain, and the ability to become effective in unfamiliar regulatory and technical terrain quickly.

What we offer

  • Challenging, high-impact work building the trust and control layer for a new category of financial infrastructure.
  • Competitive compensation including salary, future token rights, and/or equity, according to your preferences.
  • Full medical, vision, and dental benefits, plus a flexible vacation policy.
  • A remote-first environment with meaningful autonomy and influence over product and technical direction.
  • Exceptional colleagues from Goldman Sachs, BlackRock, Two Sigma, Bridgewater, SpaceX, AWS, Meta, Google, McKinsey, Coinbase, Circle, and Uniswap.
  • Backing from leading crypto experts and investors, including Pantera Capital, Founders Fund, and Coinbase Ventures.

title: Senior Accountant, Financial Operations
description:
Who We Are

The Solana Foundation is a non-profit based in Zug, Switzerland, dedicated to the adoption, decentralization, and security of the Solana network. Solana is a high performance blockchain that can deliver a fast and friendly user experience, without sacrificing security. The Solana Foundation is working to realize a world where individuals own their data, use permissionless networks, and transfer information and value freely around the world. We are looking for talented people who are willing to jump right in and use their expertise to help the ecosystem build.


The Opportunity

Solana Foundation is seeking a Senior Accountant to help develop the accounting function across the Foundation and its wholly owned US subsidiary, SF Operations Inc.

This is an operations-first accounting role. Reporting directly to the Controller, you own the day-to-day machinery of how money moves through the organization — how bills get paid, how cash comes in, how spend is controlled, and how all of it lands accurately in the ledger across two entities and two accounting standards.

The first six months are systems work: onboarding a new expense management and bill pay platform, integrating an agentic procurement system, and automating accounts receivable. From there the role expands across the wider function. You will be designing process architecture, not inheriting it, which means the person who fits this seat is as comfortable rebuilding a workflow as closing a month.

To be successful in this role

You will:

  • Own Procure-to-Pay and Order-to-Cash end to end — run AP and AR as processes, not queues. Find the bottlenecks, propose the fix, and implement it. Take responsibility for cycle times, accuracy, and the vendor and customer experience on both sides of the ledger.

  • Build the finance tech stack alongside the Controller — lead the onboarding of a new expense management and bill pay platform, integrate agentic procurement, and automate AR. Evaluate what should be a tool, what should be an automation, and what still needs a human. Own the implementations through to adoption.

  • Control company spend — manage corporate cards and the expense programme, review employee and company spending, and make policy real through process rather than reminders.

  • Keep the general ledger clean across both entities — ensure all financial information is accurately reflected in the GL in compliance with the appropriate GAAP standards for our Swiss and US based entities.

  • Own reconciliations, onchain and off — prepare and lead balance sheet and asset reconciliations, including bank transactions and onchain wallet activity.

  • Report the numbers — prepare and support month-end close, financial reporting, budget vs actual, and ad hoc analysis for the Finance team and the wider business.

  • Close control gaps before they cost something — monitor processes, procedures, and controls for record keeping accuracy, and proactively identify weaknesses and build the controls around them.

Who you are:

  • A qualified accountant with 3–5 years across public and industry — a mix of public accounting firm and relevant industry experience, with an emphasis on accounting, financial management, and financial reporting. Certified Public Accountant. FinTech experience is a strong plus; blockchain more so.

  • Systems-fluent, not just systems-tolerant — hands-on with Xero or a comparable platform such as QuickBooks. Comfortable in Airtable and other automation-friendly databases. You have opinions about how tools should fit together and you have built those integrations yourself.

  • Comfortable working with AI and agentic systems — you are nimble inside an evolving accounting tech stack, and you can lead a tooling project rather than wait for one to be handed to you.

  • Onchain literate — familiar with blockchain, and the digital asset space, and unfazed by reconciling wallet activity alongside bank statements.

  • Built for startup pace — you have worked in a fast-moving start-up or at a company that scaled quickly, and you know how to hold accuracy steady while everything around it changes.

  • Detail-obsessed and analytical — strong problem-solving instincts, and the kind of attention to detail that catches the thing nobody was looking for.

title: Creative Strategist
description:
Department: Marketing / Growth

Reports to: Head of Marketing

The Role, In One Line

We're hiring someone who doesn't ask "what creative piece should I make?".

They ask "how do I make people care about this?"

This is the person who turns a complex, often unsexy product into a story people understand, a campaign people remember, and creative that moves real growth metrics, not just engagement vanity numbers.

What This Role Is Not


This role gets misread often:

  • It's not a Designer role. You won't be pushing pixels in Figma all day.

  • It's not a Copywriter role. You won't just be writing headlines for someone else's idea.

  • It's not a Brand Strategist role. You're not building 40-page brand guideline decks.

This is a hybrid role for someone equally comfortable:

  • Digging into user behavior and funnel data

  • Translating positioning into an idea people actually feel

  • Writing the concept

  • Directing how it looks and moves

  • Shaping how it shows up across a GTM campaign, end to end

Why This Role Matters for Grvt

Grvt isn't trying to out-market the incumbents by playing their game. We're a challenger brand, and challengers who play it safe don't get remembered. We've already proven the market believes in us: our TGE was a success, and the trust and capital that came with it isn't a finish line, but a runway. Now the job is to convert that momentum into global product adoption, fast, without losing the edge that got us here.

That means we can't afford "the typical marketing", the safe positioning decks, the generic launch templates, the content that looks like everyone else's roadmap slide with our logo on it.

This role exists because Grvt's next chapter isn't just "get more visible", but, to "get more visible in a way that compounds into the business numbers," globally, and fast.

What You'll Do


1. Campaign Concepts

  • Work with product marketing to develop the core creative idea behind product GTM strat and launches, feature drops, and growth campaigns.

  • Infuse the thinking behind why this idea will land with this audience, into the strategy/creative.

  • Turn positioning and messaging frameworks into concepts that are simple, sharp, and repeatable across channels.

  • Pressure-test concepts against user behavior and funnel data before they go into production. Not just "is this a cool idea" but "will this idea change behavior."

2. Creative Direction

  • Set the visual direction for campaigns across mood, tone, art direction briefs and partner closely with designers/illustrators/agencies to bring it to life.

  • Ensure every visual choice ladders back to the strategic idea, not just aesthetic trend-chasing.

  • Conceptualize motion and video concepts from short-form social edits to product demo reels to launch films with a bias toward ideas that work with a fast scroll-thumb, not against it.

3. Launch Themes

  • Work with marketing to develop the "big idea" that a product or feature launch is built around. The theme that ties together the landing page, the ads, the emails, the social posts, and the sales enablement into one coherent story.

  • Work backward from business goals (adoption, activation, revenue) to figure out what story will actually move those numbers.

What Success Looks Like

  • Launch campaigns where the idea is what people remember, not just "the company posted something."

  • A growing library of hooks, formats, and concepts that the team can learn from and reuse.

  • Leadership sees creative as a growth lever in this org, not a "make it pretty" function, and you're a big reason why.

Required:

  • A track record of concepts you've developed that shipped and drove a measurable result

  • Comfortable reading performance data (CTR, conversion, retention, engagement) and using it to inform creative decisions

  • Strong creative<> business instincts

  • A real point of view on visual and motion direction

  • Deep, current fluency in social and cultural trends

  • Experience working cross-functionally with Product, Product Marketing, Design, and Growth/Performance teams.

title: Head of Marketing (Director)
description:
About Keyrock

Since 2017, Keyrock has been a change-maker in digital assets. We're a global, remote-first team of 200+ people across 40+ nationalities, with hubs in Brussels, London, Paris and New York.

We provide liquidity across 80+ centralized and decentralized exchanges - a position cemented by our Series C, led by SC Ventures. Today we run a full spectrum of capital markets businesses across centralized and on-chain venues: market making, high-frequency trading, options, OTC, DeFi trading desks, advisory, and asset management.

We're building toward the agentic investment banking capabilities for the era of digital finance. A proprietary agentic layer runs the mechanics of the market, so our people can focus on the work code cannot do: the deal, the relationship, and the judgement.

 

We're not just envisioning the future of finance - we're building it.

The Opportunity

We are hiring a Head of Marketing to take full ownership of our marketing strategy, rebrand Keyrock and reposition us as the market evolves from crypto-native to institutional, merging with traditional finance.

This is not a maintenance role. It is a transformation mandate with full discretionary decision-making on how to implement our commercial strategy. You will work as a close strategic partner to the CCO, operating almost as co-marketeers.

The team is lean by design: 2-3 direct reports plus heavy use of AI and agentic tooling. We are looking for someone who inspires and sets direction, not someone who runs campaigns. Operational execution will increasingly be handled by AI agents.

What You Will Do

  • Own and execute the complete rebrand and repositioning of Keyrock in the market

  • Define and drive the marketing strategy across institutional and crypto-native audiences

  • Build a premium, forward-looking brand identity. Think distinctive, audacious, credible to both institutional allocators and crypto-native operators

  • Push information into the market in ways that make people pay attention and take Keyrock seriously

  • Partner closely with the CCO and commercial team to drive measurable commercial impact

  • Build and lead a small, high-impact team augmented by AI tooling

  • Shape how Keyrock is perceived as the industry converges with traditional finance

Who You Are

  • Crypto-native. You have been through market cycles. You understand blockchain technology deeply but you are pragmatic, not ideological. You know this is not a binary world.

  • A brand-builder, not an ops person. You are inspiring, not operational. You set direction, tone and creative vision.

  • An exceptional communicator. You can face institutional allocators who care about regulation and licensing, and crypto-native counterparties who value speed and edge. You switch between both with ease.

  • Confident and assertive. You project authority. You bring conviction and directness - you challenge constructively and don't default to consensus. You bring edge, energy and a slightly audacious style.

  • Human-centric. You connect with people, build followership and bring teams along.

  • Detail-oriented. Despite the strategic focus, you sweat the details on brand consistency, messaging precision and design quality.

  • A challenger mindset. You dare to think differently, question the status quo and push things forward through constructive tension.

Our Recruitment Philosophy

We look for self-aware candidates who bring both the core skills required for the role and a deep alignment with our performance principles. We seek fiercely passionate, mission-driven people who communicate with purpose and practice proactive ownership. The perfect fit? A crypto enthusiast who prioritizes mission over ego, maintains a commercial mindset, and delivers long-term value through pragmatic flexibility.

Experience and Background

Required

  • Significant experience in marketing leadership at a crypto or digital-asset firm

  • Deep understanding of the crypto market, its participants and its culture

  • Track record of building or transforming a brand in a fast-moving, commercially-driven environment

  • Strong communication skills Exceptional fluency in English, both written and spoken.

  • Based in or closely aligned with the CET time zone.

Preferred

  • Experience positioning a firm through a TradFi/crypto convergence narrative

  • Exposure to publicly listed or IPO-track companies

  • Familiarity with EU regulatory environment (MiCA) and how it shapes marketing and financial promotions

  • Experience working with or building AI-augmented marketing functions

Why Keyrock

  • Step-up opportunity. Own the function globally, report directly to the CCO, shape the brand from scratch.

  • Transformation moment. Keyrock is pivoting from appreciated-but-underrated to a firm that commands respect. This is a before-and-after career story.

  • Commercial partnership. Not a siloed marketing role. Deeply embedded in commercial strategy with commission upside.

  • Lean and AI-augmented. Small team, big impact. No bureaucratic bloat. Use agents and tools to move fast.

  • Global footprint. Offices across EU, UK, US and Switzerland. International exposure from day one.

  • Competitive offer. A competitive compensation package, attractive global benefits, and a performance-based variable.

  • Annual Team Retreats. A yearly offsite dedicated to strategy, celebration of our wins and fun team activities

title: Risk Control Analyst, Card & ATO Risk
description:
Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem behind the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users. We are trusted by 300+ million people in 100+ countries for our industry-leading security, user fund transparency, trading engine speed, deep liquidity, and an unmatched portfolio of digital-asset products. Binance offerings range from trading and finance to education, research, payments, institutional services, Web3 features, and more. We leverage the power of digital assets and blockchain to build an inclusive financial ecosystem to advance the freedom of money and improve financial access for people around the world.

Role Overview
We are seeking a Risk Control Analyst to join our risk team, focusing on Card (issuer side) risk management and ATO (Account Takeover) risk strategy. This role will work closely with business stakeholders, payment teams, and internal risk engineering to design, deploy, and maintain risk control strategies across card and ATO domains.

Responsibilities:

    Card Risk Control (Issuer Side)
  • Serve as the primary risk point of contact for card issuer side risk matters, including BIN card fraud, transaction monitoring, and card lifecycle risk controls
  • Collaborate with payment and card business teams to gather requirements, propose risk control measures, and drive end-to-end implementation
  • Design and deploy risk rules and strategies for card-related scenarios, including card opening, credit limit adjustments, transaction authorization, and dispute/chargeback handling
  • Monitor card risk metrics, conduct post-event analysis, and continuously optimize control effectiveness
  • Evaluate third-party card risk vendors and solutions; drive integration where valuable
    • ATO & Risk Strategy
  • Design and deploy ATO risk control strategies, including risk analysis, feature extraction, rule/strategy deployment, and control flow design
  • Build and refine ATO detection and prevention pipelines across login, device, transaction, and account-change scenarios
  • Leverage risk signals (device, IP, behavioral, biometric) to construct multi-layered defense chains
  • Analyze attack patterns and emerging threats; translate insights into actionable detection rules and mitigation strategies
    • General
  • Document risk control designs, decision logs, and post-incident reviews
  • Work with data and engineering teams to implement and tune risk models and rules
  • Participate in cross-functional projects spanning payment, compliance, and product teams

Requirements:

    Essential
  • 3+ years of experience in risk control, fraud prevention, or a related analytical role
  • Hands-on experience designing and deploying risk rules/strategies in a real-time production environment
  • Strong analytical skills: ability to extract risk features from data, build detection logic, and measure control effectiveness
  • Solid understanding of risk control frameworks, including rule-based systems, scoring models, and layered defense design
  • Proficiency in SQL and data analysis tools; comfortable working with large datasets
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills — ability to translate business needs into risk control requirements and drive cross-team execution
  • Experience using AI tools in day-to-day work, e.g., leveraging AI to analyze risk issues, automate and optimize rules, screen data, or accelerate investigation workflows

    • Preferred
  • Experience in Card risk control on the issuer side (BIN management, authorization risk, 3DS, card fraud detection)
  • Experience with ATO, account fraud, or identity risk domains
  • Experience working with third-party risk vendors (e.g., face verification, device fingerprinting, fraud scoring)
  • Knowledge of regulatory and compliance considerations in card and fintech risk
  • Bilingual English/Mandarin is required to effectively coordinate with overseas partners and stakeholders.
Why Binance
• Shape the future with the world’s leading blockchain ecosystem
• Collaborate with world-class talent in a user-centric global organization with a flat structure
• Tackle unique, fast-paced projects with autonomy in an innovative environment
• Thrive in a results-driven workplace with opportunities for career growth and continuous learning
• Competitive salary and company benefits
• Work-from-home arrangement (the arrangement may vary depending on the work nature of the business team)

title: Senior Tax Associate, Transfer Pricing
description:
The F&A team comprises multiple functions from Financials Control & Business Performance Management, Procurement, Digital Transformation, Tax, Treasury and Operations. The Transfer Pricing Senior Associate will assist with the company’s transfer pricing policies and documentation, implementing intercompany transactions, Local File/Master File preparation, and Country-by-Country Reporting (CbCR).   • Perform financial analyses and benchmarking to support transfer pricing positions and engage with external advisors to deliver projects.
  • Collaborate with accounting, legal, treasury, and business units to align TP workstreams with other business functions.
  • Assist in tax and financial audits, preparing responses and documentation as needed.
  • Streamline processes and leverage tax, accounting and AI technology for efficiency in data collection and reporting.

  • 4+ years in transfer pricing or tax, including 2+ years in-house or Big 4/consulting; fintech/tech experience a plus.
  • Deep knowledge of OECD guidelines, Local File/Master File, BEPS Pillar 2 and CbCR.
  • Ability to adapt and take a hands-on approach to operational transfer pricing.
  • Proficient in financial modeling, data analysis, and experience with tools such as Bloomberg or RoyaltyRange.
  • Advanced Excel skills; ERP (e.g., SAP, Oracle) and tax software experience preferred.
  • Strong communication and organizational skills, demonstrating resourcefulness and ability to drive workstreams to completion.
  • Independent and team-oriented, thriving in a fast-paced environment.
