title: Technical Program Manager (Operational Readiness) (Data Centers)
description:
Who We Are:

Galaxy Digital Inc. (Nasdaq: GLXY) is a global leader in digital assets and data center infrastructure, growing the economy that runs on code. Galaxy delivers the onchain infrastructure that connects institutions to digital assets, including trading, advisory, asset management, staking, self-custody, and tokenization. Galaxy also develops and operates data center infrastructure to power AI and HPC workloads. Anchored by its Helios campus in Texas, Galaxy is building a multi-gigawatt pipeline of more than 5.7 GW of potential capacity, positioning it among the largest and fastest-growing data center developers in North America.

The Company is headquartered in New York City, with offices across North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.

Additional information about Galaxy's businesses and products is available on www.galaxy.com.

What We Value:

We are a diverse team of free thinkers, and fast movers united to help investors and creators energize the global economy. We are looking for individuals who thrive in a culture of builders and overachievers and embrace high performance, transparent feedback, and a mission-first approach. Our culture shapes our way of working and gets us where we want to be.

  • Seek Excellence.
  • Be Selective To Be Effective.
  • Be Highly Aligned, Loosely Coupled.
  • Disagree Transparently.
  • Encourage Independent Decision-Making.
  • Build Dream Teams.

Who You Are:

The Technical Program Manager (TPM) is the operational readiness execution lead for each data center campus, owning the site-level workstream from early design coordination through final turnover. The TPM translates the VP of Operational Readiness's standards and frameworks into site-level execution, serving as the primary operations representative across Construction, Engineering, EHS, PMO, Commissioning agents, 3PDC operators, and tenants. Managing multiple sites concurrently across varying stages of development, the TPM ensures operational requirements are embedded early and carried through to a clean, accountable handoff. In close partnership with the Technical Operations Manager (TOM) and Technical Operations Engineer (TOE), the TPM validates 3PDC operator readiness, drives punch list items through completion, and executes a deliberate transfer of ownership to the TOM before transitioning to the next site in the portfolio.

What You'll Do:

 Operational Readiness & Design Coordination

  • Represent Operations as the primary site-level stakeholder during design and pre-construction phases, ensuring operational requirements, maintainability, and Galaxy's operating standards are reflected in project deliverables
  • Partner with Engineering & Operations Reliability and Construction teams to identify and resolve design gaps that could impact operational performance or safety post-turnover
  • Ensure that the site as built aligns with the operating model Galaxy intends to execute under, surfacing discrepancies early and driving resolution through the appropriate channels
  • Maintain visibility into project schedules and proactively surface risks to operational readiness timelines to the VP of Operational Readiness

Commissioning Oversight

  • Serve as Operations' site-level representative throughout the commissioning process, ensuring systems are commissioned in alignment with the technical standards set by Engineering & Operations Reliability
  • Coordinate between Commissioning agents, Engineering, Construction, and 3PDC operators to align on scope, sequencing, and acceptance criteria
  • Validate that commissioning outcomes meet the technical and operational thresholds required for turnover
  • Maintain commissioning records that support audit readiness and serve as reference documentation for the TOM post-handoff

3PDC Operator Readiness & Turnover

  • Work alongside the TOM and TOE to assess and validate 3PDC operator readiness ahead of turnover milestones — including procedure readiness, staffing, training records, and site familiarization
  • Ensure operators have the documentation, qualifications, and site-specific knowledge required to assume operational responsibility at RFS
  • Own the punch list process through final item completion, ensuring all outstanding items are resolved and formally accepted before turnover is executed
  • Execute a structured, documented handoff to the TOM upon turnover completion and disengage to focus on the next site in the portfolio

Cross-Functional Program Management

  • Serve as the primary operations liaison across all project stakeholders, maintaining alignment and accountability across PMO, Construction, Engineering, EHS, Commissioning agents, 3PDC operators, and tenants
  • Maintain a clear and current picture of each site's readiness status across all workstreams and communicate progress, risks, and decisions to the VP of Operational Readiness
  • Partner with PMO to ensure operational milestones are integrated into the master project schedule and tracked to completion
  • Drive the resolution of cross-functional dependencies that could impact readiness timelines or turnover quality

EHS & Compliance Integration

  • Ensure EHS requirements are accounted for throughout commissioning and turnover activities in coordination with the EHS team
  • Validate that site conditions, operator practices, and life-safety systems meet applicable standards prior to turnover
  • Ensure regulatory and compliance documentation is complete, accurate, and transferable to the TOM at handoff

Tenant Coordination

  • Where applicable, engage with tenants and their representatives throughout the commissioning and turnover process to ensure alignment on timelines, access, and operational expectations
  • Serve as the operational point of contact for tenant-facing questions and commitments during the pre-turnover phase, coordinating with the TOM on items that will carry forward post-handoff

What We’re Looking For:

  • 8+ years of experience in data center operations, commissioning, or critical facilities program management
  • Demonstrated experience managing complex, cross-functional programs in mission-critical environments
  • Strong technical foundation in electrical, mechanical, and controls systems common to data center environments
  • Experience owning commissioning and turnover processes in a structured, milestone-driven environment
  • Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent sites and stakeholder relationships without loss of detail or accountability
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to translate technical complexity for diverse audiences across organizational levels

Bonus Points:

  • Prior experience in hyperscale or large-scale data center environments
  • Familiarity with OSHA, NFPA, NETA, and relevant IEC/IEEE standards
  • Experience working within or alongside a formal PMO structure
  • Background in construction management, critical systems commissioning, or facilities engineering
  • Military, utility, or industrial operations background

What We Offer (Helios):

  • Competitive base salary and discretionary bonus
  • Paid Time Off
  • Company-paid Holidays (14)
  • Company-paid health and protective benefits for employees, partners, and other dependents
  • 3% 401(k) company contribution
  • Generous paid Parental Leave
  • Free coaching and counseling sessions through Headspace
  • Free breakfast and lunch daily
  • Smart, entrepreneurial, and fun colleagues in Employee Resource Groups

*Benefits may vary depending on location.

Apply now and join us as we grow the economy that runs on code. 

The base salary ranges included below will be commensurate with candidate experience, expertise and local market. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors, including candidate experience and expertise. At Galaxy, we maintain a total compensation philosophy which consists of a competitive base salary, annual bonus, and equity incentives.

Galaxy respects diversity and seeks to provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and job applicants for employment without regard to actual or perceived age, race, color, creed, religion, sex or gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, lactation and related medical conditions), gender identity or gender expression (including transgender status), sexual orientation, marital or partnership or caregiver status, ancestry, national origin, citizenship status, disability, military or veteran status, protected medical condition as defined by applicable state or local law, genetic information or predisposing genetic characteristic, or other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws and ordinances.

We will endeavor to make a reasonable accommodation to the known limitations of a qualified applicant with a disability unless the accommodation would impose an undue hardship on the operation of our business. If you believe you require such assistance to complete the application process or to participate in an interview, please contact careers@galaxy.com.

title: Customer Activation | Partnerships
description:
About Ramp

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

About the Role

Customer Activation Managers on the Partnerships team own the activation and early growth of Ramp’s partner-referred customers. As an early member of the team, you will have the opportunity to help build and refine the Partner Success program and define the implementation motion to drive activation and expansion.

What You'll Do

Partner Relationship Management

  • Build and maintain strong, long-term relationships with key partners segments, including Accounting, Private Equity, and Venture Capital

  • Serve as the trusted advisor and advocate for partners, understanding their business models, goals, and challenges.

Drive Partner Enablement and Customer Activation

  • Develop and deliver partner onboarding and education on the full range of integration and configuration options for Ramp’s suite of products

  • Work with partners and their customers to drive efficient, thorough, and complete onboarding at scale

What You Need

  • Minimum 3 years of experience in customer success, partnerships, account management, or product operations experience

  • Familiarity with partner ecosystem operations

  • Exceptional project management and time management

  • Excellent verbal and written communication

  • Experience working with technical counterparts in Product and Engineering to share feedback, troubleshoot, and ideate workarounds as needed

  • Desire to learn our product inside out. Understand why Ramp was built the way it was and know how to communicate this effectively

  • Proven track record of exceeding quota and/or outperforming key target metrics

  • Ability to anticipate customer needs and position product solutions accordingly

  • High adaptability and ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment

Nice to Haves

  • Experience with accounting partners, Private Equity, and/ or Venture Capital

  • Experience contributing to the development and growth of new teams

  • Familiarity with accounting software, including QuickBooks Online, NetSuite, Sage, and Microsoft Dynamics

  • Experience with financial services sales

  • Experience at a high-growth startup

Benefits available to all full-time Ramp employees (Global)

  • Flexible PTO

  • Centralized home-office equipment ordering

  • Health and wellness stipend

  • Budget for intra-office travel

  • Weekly coffee stipend

United States

  • 100% medical, dental & vision insurance coverage for you, with partial coverage for dependents

  • One Medical annual membership

  • 401(k), including employer match on contributions made while employed by Ramp

  • Fertility HRA (up to $10,000 per year)

  • Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay

  • Pet insurance

  • In-office perks: lunch, snacks, drinks, and more

  • Relocation expense coverage to NYC or SF (if needed)

Canada

  • Group medical, dental, and vision coverage through Sun Life

  • Life, AD&D, and disability coverage

  • Fertility drug coverage (up to $4,000 lifetime)

  • Group Retirement Plan with employer match (RRSP + DPSP)

  • Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay, with additional time available at reduced pay

  • Employee Assistance Program and virtual care through Lumino Health

United Kingdom

  • Private medical insurance through Freedom Elite

  • Virtual GP and at-home care via eMed x Livi

  • Workplace pension through Penfold, with salary sacrifice option

  • Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay with additional time available at reduced pay

Referral Instructions

If you are being referred for the role, please contact that person to apply on your behalf.

 

Other notices

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

 

Beware of recruiting scams: Ramp will only contact you through official @Ramp.com email addresses and will never ask for payment or sensitive personal information during the hiring process.

 

Ramp Applicant Privacy Notice

title: Senior Treasury Manager
description:
About Polymarket

Polymarket is the world's largest prediction market platform. We enable individuals to express views on real-world events by trading on outcomes across politics, economics, sports, culture, and current affairs. Built as a peer-to-peer marketplace with no centralized "house," Polymarket aggregates diverse opinions into transparent, market-based probabilities that reflect collective expectations about the future.

We're growing fast — both in terms of volume ($21B traded in 2025) and adoption as an alternative news source. Our ambition is to become a ubiquitous beacon of truth in global media and we need your help adding fuel to the fire.

About the Role

Polymarket is hiring a Senior Treasury Manager to own the day-to-day treasury function across our regulated entities — a DCM and DCO registered with the CFTC. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role for someone who has managed liquidity, banking relationships, and settlement in a regulated financial environment and wants to help build a treasury operation from the ground up.

You'll safeguard member and customer funds, manage the movement of fiat and stablecoin across our platform, and partner closely with Compliance, Legal, Product, Payments, and our regulators to ensure we always meet DCM/DCO financial resource and segregation requirements.

What You'll Do

  • Own daily cash and liquidity management across bank accounts, custodians, and settlement rails, maintaining accurate real-time visibility into fiat and stablecoin balances

  • Safeguard customer and member funds in accordance with CFTC segregation and DCO financial resource requirements, including daily reconciliation and maintenance of segregated and secured accounts

  • Manage settlement, margin, and collateral flows between the exchange, clearinghouse, members, and banking partners, ensuring funds are available to meet obligations without exception

  • Build and maintain cash-flow forecasting models to support liquidity planning, capital adequacy, and regulatory financial resource calculations

  • Own banking and custodial relationships — account opening, KYC/onboarding, service negotiation, and escalation — across traditional banks, fintechs, and digital-asset custodians

  • Partner with Compliance and Legal to prepare and support regulatory filings, financial resource reports, and examinations, and respond to regulator and auditor requests

  • Design, document, and enforce treasury controls, policies, and procedures, including approval workflows, segregation of duties, and fraud-prevention controls over payment operations

  • Manage FX exposure and short-term investment of eligible funds within approved policy and regulatory constraints

  • Partner with Engineering and Finance Ops to build tooling for reconciliation, treasury reporting, and payment operations at scale

  • Support month-end close, audit, and financial reporting through accurate treasury reconciliations and documentation

What We're Looking For

  • 7–10+ years of progressive treasury experience, ideally within an exchange, clearinghouse, broker-dealer, FCM, bank, or regulated fintech/digital-asset platform

  • Deep, hands-on knowledge of cash management, liquidity forecasting, settlement, and banking operations, with a track record of managing significant daily flows

  • Strong understanding of the regulatory environment governing customer funds — CFTC segregation rules, DCM/DCO financial resource requirements, or comparable frameworks

  • Demonstrated ability to build treasury processes, controls, and reporting from an early stage rather than simply operating an established function

  • Comfort operating across both traditional finance and digital assets, including familiarity with stablecoins, custody, and on-chain settlement

  • Meticulous attention to detail and a control mindset — you treat the safeguarding of customer funds as non-negotiable

  • Excellent partner to Compliance, Legal, and external regulators and auditors; able to translate treasury operations into clear regulatory narratives

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or related field

  • (Plus) CTP, CFA, MBA, or CPA

  • (Plus) Prior experience standing up or operating treasury at a newly regulated DCM, DCO, or exchange

  • (Plus) Experience with treasury management systems, ERP integrations, and reconciliation automation

  • (Plus) Familiarity with prediction markets, derivatives, or event-contract products

Benefits

  • Competitive salary & equity

  • Unlimited PTO

  • Full Health, Vision, & Dental coverage

  • 401k match

  • Hardware setup: new MacBook Pro, big display, & accessories

Pay Transparency

Base salary range: $200,000 to $275,000 annually, plus equity and benefits.

This range reflects a good-faith estimate for this position. Experience levels vary widely within a title here, so please reach out even if your expectations fall outside it. We're always happy to chat.

title: Deal Desk Manager (Fixed-Term)
description:
The Deal Desk Manager is a multifaceted strategic and operational advisor to our most complex and highest growth region within our Deal Desk Function. They will work very closely with our Revenue Operations, Finance, Legal, Product and Marketing teams to provide strategic quoting and deal structuring support to the US and Global Sales Team.

Important notes: This is a fixed-term opportunity for 3 months with an option to extend. While this opportunity is remote, we are prioritizing candidates who reside in CST and EST time zones.

In one year you’ll know you were successful if…

  • You’ve led Deal Desk coverage for sales to Crypto exchanges, financial technology (“fintech”) and/or payment solutions customers and support sales goals, materially de‑risking coverage during high volume and high stress deal strategy

  • You’ve driven data‑backed analytics and pricing frameworks that have shifted approvals and pricing from intuition to objective guardrails and precedent.

  • You have been the go‑to commercialization partner for Legal, Product, Services, and Finance on non‑standard SKUs and new offerings within both SaaS and on-prem environments turning ambiguous edge cases into repeatable processes.

  • You have demonstrated clear leadership capability through mentorship, enablement, and conflict‑resolution maturity, particularly in leading team member onboarding and embodying Chainalysis leadership principles such as Coach & Empower and Strong Convictions, Loosely Held.

  • You’ve developed in-depth knowledge of Chainalysis licensing and pricing models to provide deal structuring and quoting support to our global sales teams

  • You’ve become the expert creative problem solver who finds a way to meet customers’ needs while adhering to our company’s overall strategy

  • You perform price / discount realization analysis, combined with relevant deal context, and present executive level summaries with actionable recommendations to key business approvers

  • You provide both tactical and strategic guidance to our Sales teams by coaching on contract objection-handling techniques, alternative contract options, and best practices to help close deals

  • You function as point of contact and subject matter expert / project manager for Sales on deal pricing matters and questions related to common customer requests regarding deviations from Chainalysis standard operational processes, infosec standards, and SLA/engineering positions.

  • You look for opportunities to create meaningful partnerships with the field and other stakeholders (enablement, training, QBR participation, etc.)

  • You’ve built analytics, KPIs and business processes relevant to pricing, and use performance insights to drive improvements and share key learnings with executive-level leadership

  • You partner with regional leadership to prioritize and organize projects and deals for critical deadlines at customer and for month-end, quarter-end, and year-end

  • You collaborate with the Sales Enablement team to create training content for your region to ensure Sales is informed on new products, best practices and regular updates to policies, etc.

  • You create, maintain and innovate with respect to an ongoing knowledgebase of common issues arising during deal cycles.

  • You establish key plays for the Deal Desk team and ensure they are enabled to be the most creative and effective they can be.

A background like this helps:

  • Strong experience within a Deal Desk role for 5-7 years, but also including related processes such as sales operations & enablement, finance, and/or legal, with specific experience around deal structuring/quoting complex SaaS transactions for a fast-growing multinational company

  • Analytical mindset and recognized competency for in depth analysis and modeling

  • Leader in key stakeholder activities assigned from cross-functional projects or programs, including the gathering, analyzing, prioritization, and complexity categorization of business requirements

  • Solid understanding of the Quote to Order stages within the Lead to Cash lifecycle with Salesforce CRMs

  • Working knowledge with revenue recognition (GAAP, ASC 606)

  • Salesforce, Salesforce CPQ is required

  • Experience leading a team is preferred, with extensive experience in one-on-one mentoring and coaching sessions with team members of all levels.

  • Must be comfortable representing the company to customers in negotiations and resolving customer satisfaction issues

  • Advanced written, verbal, and interpersonal skills in order to effectively communicate policies and procedures to all levels of staff and management, particularly the ability to explain complex concepts clearly and concisely across all levels of the organization

  • Excellent collaboration, reinforces alignment with business partners and managers.

  • Excellent planning, time management, communication, decision making, presentation, organization, and interpersonal skills.Strong attention to detail, quantitative and communication skills

  • Ability to work in a fast paced, high pressure environment and jump in on operational troubleshooting often and as needed

  • Strong Google Suite/Microsoft Suite skills

AI at Chainalysis
AI is not a feature at Chainalysis - it is a new way of working. One that turns instructions into work done, and helps us move faster than the threats we're built to counter, and we expect our employees to take ownership of the output and ensure quality. As the world's most trusted blockchain analytics platform, Chainalysis sits at a rare intersection of proprietary data, regulatory relationships and crypto expertise that makes it uniquely placed to shape and lead the next era of AI-driven intelligence - and we expect everyone here, regardless of role, to be an active part of it.

AI fluency is tied directly to how we measure performance and how we plan to win. There is no substitute for your own curiosity. We provide the tools, workflows, and space to experiment - but the expectation is that you develop these capabilities yourself, bring ideas, and collaborate across teams to reinvent the way work gets done. We are not using AI to do less. We are using it to do what was never possible before.

About Chainalysis

Chainalysis is the blockchain data platform, making it easy to connect the movement of digital assets to real-world services. Powered by deep blockchain data and AI, organizations can investigate illicit activity, manage risk exposure, and develop innovative market solutions built on the industry's most trusted blockchain intelligence. Our mission is to build trust in blockchains, blending safety and security with an unwavering commitment to growth and innovation.

You belong here. 

At Chainalysis, we believe that diversity of experience and thought makes us stronger. With both customers and employees around the world, we are committed to ensuring our team reflects the unique communities around us. We’re ensuring we keep learning by committing to continually revisit and reevaluate our diversity culture.

We encourage applicants across any race, ethnicity, gender/gender expression, age, spirituality, ability, experience and more. If you need any accommodations to make our interview process more accessible to you due to a disability, don't hesitate to let us know. You can learn more here. We can’t wait to meet you.

title: Business Development Representative | Ontario, Canada
description:
About Ramp

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

About the role

As a Business Development Representative in our Toronto office, you will be focused on building Ramp’s presence in the Canadian market. In this high-velocity, high-impact outbound role, you will create qualified opportunities for Ramp’s Account Executives and bring in high-quality pipeline.

Our sales organization is looking for someone who is hungry, highly coachable, self-motivated and has a natural inclination for selling – a builder who can perform in ambiguity. As part of our early-stage team, you’ll act as the initial point of contact in prospecting and qualifying leads. If you’re eager to make an impact, embrace challenges and are passionate about playing a key role in defining Ramp’s presence in Canada and accelerating growth in this new market, this role is for you.

What you’ll do

  • Source new business across Canada through outbound prospecting and outreach

  • Identify the right finance, operations, and executive stakeholders within target accounts.

  • Execute thoughtful, personalized multi-channel outbound campaigns

  • Run confident cold calls and consultative discovery

  • Clearly articulate and tailor Ramp’s value to prospective customers

  • Handle objections with curiosity, composure, and persistence.

  • Maintain accurate activity, account, contact, and opportunity data in Salesforce.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally on feedback, competitive insights, local-market learnings

What you need

  • AI fluency as a daily habit. Ramp is a builder culture: if you don't instinctively reach for AI before doing things manually, this role will be a hard adjustment.

  • Grit, ownership, and resourcefulness

  • Strong written and verbal communication

  • Strong research, organization, follow-through, and attention to detail

  • Dedication to consistent self-improvement

  • Self-starter with a high sense of urgency

  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment

  • Ability to work 3x a week in Ramp’s Toronto office

  • Experience exceeding quota in a B2B SDR/BDR or other outbound sales role.

  • Experience selling B2B software, financial services, fintech, or to finance/exec teams.

  • Experience with Salesforce, Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, Outreach.

  • Familiarity with the Canadian business or fintech landscape.

  • Centralized home-office equipment ordering

  • Health and wellness stipend

  • Budget for intra-office travel

  • Weekly coffee stipend

title: Government Relations Professional
description:
ABOUT US

Localcoin, founded in 2017 with headquarters in Toronto, is on a mission to simplify the process and experience of buying or selling digital currencies globally. We envision bringing digital currency to the mainstream financial market through partnerships with leading corporate and franchised retail spaces. With terminals across Canada, Poland and the APAC region, including Australia, Hong Kong, and New Zealand, Localcoin is now the fastest growing Bitcoin ATM operator in the world.

At its core, Localcoin believes that everyone should be able to own cryptocurrency and have a deep understanding of blockchain technology. As a member of our rapidly growing team, you'll join a talented, dynamic group of team members who will encourage you to learn, grow, and thrive in your career every step of the way.

If you're a self-starter looking to hone your skills in a scale up environment that fosters innovation, transparency, and team connectivity, we look forward to hearing from you!

 

THE ROLE

Hourly Range: $45 - $80

The Government Relations Professional will be responsible for supporting Localcoin’s engagement with federal and provincial and international government stakeholders, monitoring relevant policy and regulatory developments, and helping position the company as a trusted participant in the digital asset and fintech ecosystem.

This role is ideal for someone with strong federal government relations experience, excellent communication skills, and the ability to navigate complex regulatory and political environments.

Reporting directly to the Chief Compliance Officer, this part-time position is based in Canada and requires approximately 20 hours per week. The role is likely to include occasional travel within Canada and internationally, including Australia, Europe and expansion countries, to support Localcoin's government relations, regulatory engagement, and business priorities. 

 

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING 

  • Build and maintain relationships with government officials, regulators, industry associations, and other key stakeholders.
  • Monitor legislative, regulatory, and policy changes affecting cryptocurrency, fintech, payments, AML, privacy, and financial services, and share updates with internal teams.
  • Work closely with Legal, Compliance, Product, and Operations to support regulatory initiatives and ensure business readiness.
  • Coordinate with external legal counsel and government relations firms across Localcoin's operating regions on government relations activities and regulatory matters.
  • Review draft legislation and provide feedback to internal teams on potential business impacts.
  • Prepare briefing notes, presentations, consultation responses, correspondence, and other government relations materials.
  • Represent Localcoin in meetings with government officials, regulators, industry groups, and external partners.
  • Coordinate with government agencies on licensing, compliance, consultations, and regulatory inquiries.
  • Identify opportunities for Localcoin to participate in government consultations, industry forums, and advocacy initiatives.
  • Support regulatory or government-related issues as they arise, including stepping in during urgent or crisis situations.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR 

  • Extensive experience in federal government relations, public affairs, or lobbying, with an established network of government and regulatory contacts across Canada. 
  • Experience working with provincial governments, particularly in Ontario, British Columbia, and Alberta, is considered a strong asset. 
  • Strong understanding of Canadian government processes, legislative procedures, and stakeholder engagement strategies.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare briefing notes, policy materials, and executive updates.
  • Strong judgment, discretion, and ability to operate in a fast-moving, regulated environment.
  • Comfortable working independently in a part-time capacity while staying closely aligned with internal stakeholders.
  • Ability to travel occasionally, both within Canada and internationally.

NICE TO HAVES

  • Experience in fintech, financial services, payments, cryptocurrency, AML, compliance, or regulated industries is an asset. 
  • Existing network of federal and/or provincial government contacts.
  • Experience working with regulators or industry associations.
  • International government relations or regulatory experience, particularly across jurisdictions such as the European Union and Australia, is considered a strong asset. 
  • Proficiency in French or other languages.


WHAT YOU’LL LOVE ABOUT US

  • Competitive Salary– We value and reward our team members.
  • Impactful Work – Play a key role in a growing company and make a real difference.
  • Great Place to Work® Certified – Proudly recognized for our positive workplace culture and employee experience 3 years in a row. 

JOIN OUR INCLUSIVE TEAM

Localcoin is committed to building an inclusive, accessible, and equitable workplace. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and do not discriminate based on race, ancestry, place of origin, color, ethnic origin, citizenship, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, marital status, family status, or disability.

If you require accommodation at any stage of the recruitment process, please notify the Talent team or email careers@localcoinatm.com.

Applicants must be legally eligible to work in Canada. At this time, we are not able to provide visa sponsorship.

AI DISCLOSURE STATEMENT

We want to share that we may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help screen and assess applications. While technology helps us stay organized and efficient, every hiring decision at Localcoin is made by real people who care about finding the best addition to our team. These tools are used to support our process—not to replace the human judgment and connection that are core to our culture.

title: Senior Manager, Enterprise Payments
description:
Interested in working on cutting-edge blockchain technology and creating equitable access to the global financial system? Since 2014, the mission-driven team at the Stellar Development Foundation (SDF) has helped fuel the tremendous growth of the Stellar blockchain network, an open-source platform that operates at high-scale today. Developers and companies around the world build on it, and the SDF team is expanding to support the rapidly growing and changing Stellar ecosystem.

We are looking for a seasoned Senior Manager, Enterprise Payments BD to drive our growth in active accounts and reaffirm Stellar’s position as the leading blockchain for payments. The candidate will also play a crucial role in cross functionally integrating RWA and Defi opportunities into their book of business. Core areas are around building out Stellar’s payments and stablecoin ecosystem, growing wallets at a global scale, growing into new verticals, and where relevant; working cross functionally with the RWA and Defi Stellar teams to create holistic deals. This person will support the broader partnership team and company objectives, and will be the owner of primary OKRs focused on account growth and payment volume.

Responsibilities:

  • Executing on, and contributing to the continued refinement of the Payments Strategy, driving Monthly Active Account volume on Stellar. This includes growing strategies such as: (1) B2B2B and B2B2C payouts and commerce, (2) Global Marketplace, (3) Payment Service Providers, and (4) Neobanks

  • Developing a priority target list and ensuring execution against primary targets

  • Managing key strategic relationships with key accounts

  • Business development work related to our core priorities on expanding DeFi, increasing monthly addresses, and driving asset tokenization, in coordination with Leads of each partnership vertical to drive relevant outcomes. These include surfacing opportunities based on Stellar’s needs, as well as helping to close deals brought by other members of BD and SDF.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Business or a related field

  • 8+ years of relevant experience with a proven track record of success in business development, with significant experience in global payment processing, fintech, or blockchain/crypto-related roles.

  • Existing relationships within the Enterprise, Fintech, Payments, and Crypto ecosystem, particularly with a focus on payments, RWA, and decentralized finance.

  • Crypto Knowledge: Strong understanding of crypto payment systems, including experience working with cryptocurrency exchanges, blockchain technology, and digital asset payments.

  • Technically proficient, with a deep understanding of payment flow of funds, and the ability for blockchain to enhance them, with a focus on understanding global and local payments across different regions

  • Sales/Commercial Leadership: Proven ability to independently develop, structure/negotiate, and close opportunities

  • Strategic Thinker: Experience in developing and executing go-to-market strategies, identifying new business opportunities, and managing complex sales cycles.

  • Industry Expertise: Experience working with Enterprises, financial institutions, crypto companies, payment providers, or fintech startups.

  • Excellent interpersonal skills, with the ability to develop and maintain professional relationships with a network of senior-level professionals, as well as sound judgment, poise in professional settings, and self-awareness.

  • Self starter with an entrepreneurial drive.

  • Communication & Negotiation Skills: Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build strong relationships and negotiate high-stakes deals.

  • The ability to travel as needed, with frequent representation of Stellar at regional/global meetings and conferences.

Bonus Points if you have:

  • Non Payments Experience: Tradfi institutional knowledge related to legal, regulatory, economic market structures in multiple geographies as it relates to asset classes such as Payments, VC, PE, Fintech, and Defi

  • Language: Is fluent in any of the following, Portuguese, Spanish, or Mandarin

We offer competitive pay with a base salary range for this position of $145,000 - $195,000 depending on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and location. In addition, we offer lumen-denominated grants along with the following perks and benefits:

USA Benefits/Perks:

  • Competitive health, dental & vision coverage with most plans covered at 100% for the employee + any dependents

  • Flexible time off + 15 company holidays including a company-wide holiday break

  • Up to 12 weeks of paid parental leave for both non-birthing and birthing parents, as well as up to 14 weeks of paid pregnancy leave for birthing parents

  • Gym reimbursement ($80 per month)

  • Life & ADD (up to $50K)

  • Short & Long term disability

  • 401K with 4% match

  • Health & Dependent Care FSA Accounts

  • Commuter benefits with $250/month employer contribution

  • Health Savings Account (HSA) with monthly employer contribution

  • Family building benefits through Kindbody

  • Wellbeing benefits (One Medical, Rightway, Headspace)

  • L&D budget of $1,500/year

  • Daily lunch and snacks in office

  • Company retreats

#LI-Hybrid

About Stellar

Stellar is more than a blockchain. Powered by a decentralized, fast, scalable, and uniquely sustainable network made for financial products and services and a thriving and passionate ecosystem that includes a non-profit organization driven by a mission, Stellar is paving the path to unlock the world’s economic potential through blockchain technology. Built with speed and low costs in mind, the Stellar network provides builders and financial institutions worldwide a platform to issue assets, and to send and convert currencies in real time creating real world utility. Founded in 2014, the Stellar Development Foundation (SDF) supports the continued development and growth of the Stellar network and also serves the ecosystem of NGOs, corporations, universities, small businesses, governments, and solo entrepreneurs building on the Stellar network through tooling, funding and strategic collaborations. Together, Stellar is where blockchain meets the real world.

About the Stellar Development Foundation

The Stellar Development Foundation (SDF) is a non-profit organization focused on working with and supporting change-makers to create equitable access to the global financial system through blockchain technology. SDF provides grants, investments, funding, and other awards to builders and organizations. SDF also develops resources and tooling on the Stellar network to help unlock real world utility. As a nonprofit foundation, SDF puts the health of the Stellar network and the Stellar ecosystem and its mission above all else.

We look forward to hearing from you!

Privacy Policy

By submitting your application, you are agreeing to our use and processing of your data in accordance with our Privacy Policy.

SDF is committed to diversity in its workforce and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. SDF does not make hiring or employment decisions on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, sex, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, citizenship, or any other basis protected by applicable local, state or federal law.

title: Senior Corporate Security Engineer
description:
Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. 

Robinhood's Enterprise Security team is at the forefront of AI security, designing safety guardrails for cutting-edge AI and driving modern enterprise-wide security tooling standards. As a Senior Corporate Security Engineer on our Corporate Systems team, you will operate at the center of our enterprise security infrastructure, maintaining the control plane for user-facing security tooling and building innovative solutions that keep our employees and platform secure!

In this role, you will combine security engineering, systems administration, and hands-on AI agent development to drive key automation and safety initiatives. Joining a lean, high-impact team, you will have high visibility and direct empowerment to take strategic initiative, solve complex technical challenges, and shape Robinhood's AI security posture.

This role is based in our Menlo Park or Bellevue office(s), with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. 

 

What you’ll do

  • Build, maintain, and evolve enterprise security tools that power key user-facing security flows, including endpoint security, login/authentication, and security telemetry.
  • Secure AI interactions across the company by designing safety guardrails and integrating agentic tools into enterprise workflows.
  • Automate evidence-gathering processes for Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) and internal/external regulatory audits.
  • Support enterprise vulnerability management programs and maintain operational resilience and uptime across core systems.
  • Tackle evolving enterprise security challenges, such as protecting against active persistent threats (APTs) and securing the digital footprint of our executives.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Security Operations, GRC, Legal, and IT engineering partners to maintain a seamless, high-trust security environment.

What you bring

  • 5+ years of professional experience in information security, combining security engineering, IT systems administration, and enterprise infrastructure.
  • Proven experience in one or more of the following: managing and securing modern identity systems (e.g., Okta), or deep experience blending security engineering with systems/infrastructure engineering. (We're hiring for two closely related roles on this team — identity platform depth is a strong plus for one, broader security+ systems generalist range for the other.)
  • Exposure to or hands-on experience with AI tools and agent workflows (e.g., OpenAI, Claude, Cursor, or custom API integrations).
  • Practical experience working within cloud environments (specifically Google Cloud Platform) and modern software development processes.
  • Broad security generalist skill set, including device compliance enforcement, binary/plugin/extension evaluation, behavior tracing, vulnerability management, and security policy enforcement.
  • Strong ownership mentality with an adaptable "builder" mindset, capable of driving automation and technical initiatives independently.

What we offer

  • Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career.
  • Performance-driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching.
  • Best-in-class benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents.
  • Lifestyle wallet — a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more.
  • Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits.
  • Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more!
  • Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces.

In addition to the base pay range listed below, this role is also eligible for bonus opportunities + equity + benefits.

title: Lifecycle Director
description:
About Polymarket

Polymarket is the world's largest prediction market platform. We enable individuals to express views on real-world events by trading on outcomes across politics, economics, sports, culture, and current affairs. Built as a peer-to-peer marketplace with no centralized "house," Polymarket aggregates diverse opinions into transparent, market-based probabilities that reflect collective expectations about the future.

We're growing fast, both in terms of volume ($21B traded in 2025) and adoption as an alternative news source. Our ambition is to become a ubiquitous beacon of truth in global media and we need your help adding fuel to the fire.

About the Role

The Growth team at Polymarket is building out a Customer Marketing function from the ground up, and lifecycle is central to that bet. We're not filling a coordinator seat. We're hiring a Lifecycle Director who will own the customer journey end-to-end, set the strategy, define the roadmap, and be accountable for the commercial outcomes that come out of it. You'll report directly to the Head of Customer Marketing and sit peer-level to other lifecycle owners on the team.

The assignment will be scoped to your strengths and where the business needs the most lift at the time of hire, across acquisition and onboarding to retention and reactivation. Either way, the mandate is the same: translate commercial goals into a lifecycle communication and engagement strategy that moves real metrics. You'll direct shared campaign and execution resources, partner with data and martech, and own the results narrative for your area.

This hire matters because lifecycle at Polymarket is still early. There's real opportunity to build something that doesn't exist yet, define the playbook, prove what works, and set the foundation for a team that scales with it. If you want ownership over a meaningful piece of a fast-growing consumer product with a clear line of sight from your work to revenue, this is the role.

What You'll Do

  • Own the strategic roadmap for an assigned lifecycle stage, from goal-setting to execution oversight to results, with clear KPIs and a results narrative you write and defend.

  • Design customer journeys, messaging strategy, and engagement cadence across email, push, and SMS, iterating based on performance data and user behavior.

  • Brief and prioritize shared campaign execution resources against lifecycle goals, holding the team accountable to timelines and quality without direct management authority.

  • Partner with data and martech teams to instrument flows, validate test setups, and ensure you have clean measurement in place before campaigns go live.

  • Build a structured test-and-learn program for your lifecycle stage, with clear baselines, documented hypotheses, and a repeatable cadence that compounds over time.

  • Pull and analyze performance data regularly, connecting lifecycle metrics directly to retention curves, reactivation revenue, and LTV impact, not just open rates.

  • Develop a scalable playbook for your area that documents what works and sets the foundation for a dedicated execution hire as the team grows.

What We're Looking For

  • 5 or more years in CRM, lifecycle, or retention marketing, with direct ownership of a customer lifecycle stage and measurable commercial outcomes you can speak to specifically.

  • Demonstrated ability to connect lifecycle tactics to business outcomes. You think in terms of retention curves, reactivation revenue, and LTV, and you can show where you moved those numbers.

  • Experience directing execution talent in a shared or matrixed environment. You know how to brief, prioritize, and hold martech, data, and creative teams accountable without a direct reporting line.

  • A track record of structured experimentation. You build test-and-learn programs with clear baselines and hypotheses, not one-off A/B tests run when the timing felt right.

  • Strong written communication skills. You can write a clear strategy doc, a crisp creative brief, and a results narrative that tells a story without burying the point.

  • (Plus) Background building lifecycle programs at a high-growth consumer product, ideally one with a transactional or trading mechanic.

  • (Plus) Hands-on familiarity with Braze or a comparable ESP, and working knowledge of Hightouch or a similar customer data platform.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary & equity

  • Unlimited PTO

  • Full Health, Vision, & Dental coverage

  • 401k match

  • Hardware setup: new MacBook Pro, big display, & accessories

Pay Transparency

Base salary range: $175,000 to $225,000 annually, plus equity and benefits.

This range reflects a good-faith estimate for this position. Experience levels vary widely within a title here, so please reach out even if your expectations fall outside it. We're always happy to chat.

title: Offline Media Specialist
description:
About Polymarket

Polymarket is the world's largest prediction market platform. We enable individuals to express views on real-world events by trading on outcomes across politics, economics, sports, culture, and current affairs. Built as a peer-to-peer marketplace with no centralized "house," Polymarket aggregates diverse opinions into transparent, market-based probabilities that reflect collective expectations about the future.

We're growing fast, both in terms of volume ($21B traded in 2025) and adoption as an alternative news source. Our ambition is to become a ubiquitous beacon of truth in global media and we need your help adding fuel to the fire.

About the Role

Polymarket's marketing team is scaling its offline media presence across Video, Audio, OOH, and beyond. The strategy is set. Now we need someone to help execute it without anything falling through the cracks. This Offline Specialist role sits at the center of that execution, working directly with the head of offline media to make sure every campaign runs on time, stays within budget, and hits our marketing KPIs.

Day to day, you'll own the operational layer of offline media: coordinating with vendors, keeping budgets accurate, trafficking creative assets, and tracking deliverables across every active campaign. You'll be the first to catch a pacing issue before it becomes a budget problem and the person vendors hear from most. The hiring manager handles strategic direction. You handle everything required to bring that strategy to life.

This is a high-ownership role for someone who takes real pride in operational precision. You won't be handed a playbook. You'll help build and maintain the systems that keep the team running. As you grow into the role, you'll be pulled into negotiation conversations and higher-level budget discussions, taking on more strategic responsibility over time.

What You'll Do

  • Coordinate vendor logistics across Video, Audio, OOH, and Direct Mail campaigns, managing timelines, specs, and deliverables from kickoff to completion.

  • Own budget tracking across all offline channels, maintaining accurate pacing data and flagging discrepancies before they escalate.

  • Traffic creative assets to vendors, confirm receipt, and verify that materials meet channel-specific specs and go-live deadlines.

  • Manage day-to-day vendor communications, keeping external partners accountable and escalating key decisions to the hiring manager with full context.

  • Compile and organize campaign performance data across offline channels, supporting measurement and attribution reporting.

  • Maintain detailed records of campaign status, budget activity, and vendor commitments so the team always has a clear picture of where things stand.

  • Support negotiation conversations and higher-level budget discussions as you grow into the role and take on greater strategic ownership.

What We're Looking For

  • 1 to 2 years of hands-on experience in offline marketing, with direct activation experience across at least two of the following: Video, Audio, and OOH.

  • Proven track record managing campaign budgets and pacing, including catching and resolving discrepancies before they become larger problems.

  • Prior experience owning day-to-day vendor relationships in a professional setting, not just supporting them.

  • Solid understanding of offline measurement and attribution methods, including how traditional media spend connects to outcomes like acquisition and brand lift.

  • Strong organizational skills across the board: notetaking, creative trafficking, time management, and prioritization when deadlines compete.

  • (Plus) Experience in the prediction markets or online gaming industry, or at minimum, a highly regulated industry such as financial services.

  • (Plus) Agency-side background in offline or traditional media.

  • (Plus) Familiarity with creative trafficking tools and workflows.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary & equity

  • Unlimited PTO

  • Full Health, Vision, & Dental coverage

  • 401k match

  • Hardware setup: new MacBook Pro, big display, & accessories

Pay Transparency

Base salary range: $125,000 to $150,000 annually, plus equity and benefits.

This range reflects a good-faith estimate for this position. Experience levels vary widely within a title here, so please reach out even if your expectations fall outside it. We're always happy to chat.

title: Head of Talent
description:
Head of Talent

Own Your Intelligence

Prime Intellect is building the open superintelligence stack: the infrastructure frontier AI labs build internally, made available to every ambitious AI team.

Our platform, Lab, unifies compute, environments, evaluations, secure sandboxes, high-performance training, and deployment into one full-stack system for post-training at frontier scale - from SFT and RL to tool use, agent workflows, and continuously improving production models. We are building open frontier AI: open-source models trained end to end for long-horizon tasks like autonomous research, and the full-stack platform our own research team uses to build them. The next generation of AI companies, enterprises, and research teams do not just need more GPUs. They need the ability to turn their own workflows, tools, data, and feedback loops into superintelligence they own.

Prime Intellect has raised $150M in total funding from Founders Fund, Radical Ventures, NVIDIA, and exceptional AI, infrastructure, and enterprise operators — including Andrej Karpathy, Dwarkesh Patel, and leaders and founders from Ramp, Perplexity, Harvey, Mercor, Zapier, Datadog, Cognition, OpenAI, Thinking Machines, Together AI, SemiAnalysis, LangChain, Browserbase, Cloudflare, Sierra, Databricks, Airbnb, OpenRouter, Standard Intelligence, Fleet, Core Auto, and more.

Role Impact

Talent is the single highest-leverage input at Prime Intellect. Every frontier researcher, systems engineer, and operator we hire compounds directly into what the open ecosystem can build. This role owns that compounding.

As Head of Talent, you will own recruiting end-to-end as we scale from ~40 to ~100 people over the next twelve months, weighted heavily toward frontier research and infrastructure engineering — the two most competitive talent markets in tech. You will personally run our most important searches, source candidates who are not on the market, and close them against offers from the largest labs.

Beyond individual hires, you will define how Prime Intellect recruits at scale: building the sourcing engine, closing playbooks, interview architecture, and compensation frameworks that let us maintain an exceptionally high bar while moving faster than incumbents. This is a founding recruiting leader role reporting directly to the founders, with full ownership of the function, meaningful equity, and a direct line into every strategic hiring decision.

What You'll Do

Own the Highest-Priority Searches

  • Personally run our most important searches across research, infrastructure, and leadership hires

  • Source candidates directly — through your own network, cold outreach, and targeted campaigns — for roles where inbound alone will never surface the right person

  • Close candidates against competing offers from frontier labs, hyperscalers, and top AI startups

  • Serve as a trusted partner to the founders and hiring managers on candidate strategy, leveling, and offer construction

Build the Sourcing & Closing Engine

  • Design and run the sourcing motion for frontier research talent (labs, PhD programs, top open-source contributors) and elite systems engineering talent (distributed systems, GPU infrastructure, ML systems)

  • Build closing playbooks that reflect what actually moves technical candidates: research autonomy, compute access, publication norms, equity, and mission

  • Stand up the tooling, data, and pipeline visibility we need to run 60+ hires per year without dropping quality

  • Define and enforce the hiring bar across the company as we scale

Systems, Team & Operational Scale

  • Hire and lead a small recruiting team over time (sourcers, coordinators, and eventually recruiters), staying deeply hands-on yourself

  • Build interview architecture — rubrics, calibration, debriefs, decision-making — that produces consistent hiring outcomes as more people participate

  • Own recruiting operations, candidate experience, and reporting end-to-end

  • Partner with finance and the founders on compensation philosophy, leveling, and equity strategy as we grow

Requirements

  • 5+ years of technical recruiting experience, with meaningful time at a frontier AI lab, top AI startup, or elite technical company

  • Direct experience recruiting ML researchers, frontier research talent, or elite systems / distributed engineers — not just "technical roles" broadly

  • Proven ability to source and close candidates who are not actively looking, against competing offers from top labs

  • Track record of personally owning senior and hard-to-fill searches end-to-end

  • Comfort operating as a player-coach: running your own searches while building the systems and eventually the team underneath you

  • Strong judgment on candidate quality and leveling; willingness to hold a high bar under pressure

  • High ownership, direct communication, and appetite for working closely with founders on the most consequential decisions in the company

  • Energized by building a recruiting function from the ground up in a fast-moving environment

Nice-to-Haves

  • Prior experience as a founding recruiter, Head of Recruiting, or senior recruiting lead at a fast-growing technical company

  • Existing network in the frontier AI research or GPU / ML infrastructure community

  • Experience closing candidates against top AI lab offers

  • Familiarity with open-source ecosystems and the researchers and engineers who lead them

  • Background scaling recruiting operations, tooling, and interview systems at a rapidly growing company

What We Offer

  • $250-300k+ cash compensation + meaningful equity

  • Flexible work environment

  • Visa sponsorship and relocation support

  • Professional development budget

  • Team off-sites and conference attendance

title: Stock Plan Administrator
description:
Blockchain is connecting the world to the future of finance. As the most trusted and fastest-growing global crypto company, it helps millions of people worldwide safely access cryptocurrency. Since its inception in 2011, Blockchain has earned the trust of over 90 million wallet holders and more than 40 million verified users, facilitating over $1 trillion in crypto transactions.

As we prepare for our next phase of growth, including a potential transition from a private to a public company, we are seeking an experienced Stock Plan Administrator to manage our global equity programs. This is a critical role responsible for ensuring the accuracy, compliance, and scalability of our stock administration function during a pivotal time for the company. You will be a key member of the Legal and Finance teams, supporting our employees and stakeholders through this exciting evolution.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Manage the day-to-day administration of the company’s global equity plan (stock options, RSUs, etc.) currently on the Carta platform.
  • Process all equity-related transactions, including new grants, exercises, cancellations, and vesting events, ensuring accuracy and timeliness.
  • Lead the preparation and execution of all equity administration aspects related to the company’s transition to a public entity.
  • Develop and implement public company processes, including trading window administration, pre-clearance procedures, and support for 10b5-1 trading plans.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for employees, executives, and other stakeholders for all questions related to equity awards and company policies.
  • Collaborate with Legal, HR, and Finance teams to ensure seamless data flow for payroll, tax withholding, accounting (ASC 718), and financial reporting.
  • Prepare and reconcile equity data for internal and external reporting, including support for public filings (e.g., S-1, 10-K, Proxy Statements) and Section 16 reporting.
  • Partner with our transfer agent, outside counsel, and other vendors to build and maintain a robust public company stock administration infrastructure.
  • Develop and deliver educational materials and communications to help employees understand the value of their equity.
  • Ensure compliance with all applicable securities laws and regulations, both domestically and internationally.

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • A minimum of 5-8 years of direct experience in stock plan administration.
  • Crucial: Experience managing equity plans through a company’s transition from private to public (IPO, SPAC, or direct listing).
  • Deep expertise with equity administration platforms, particularly Carta.
  • Strong knowledge of public company equity administration, including SEC regulations, Section 16 filings, Rule 144, and 10b5-1 plans.
  • Familiarity with the accounting (ASC 718) and tax implications of equity compensation plans.
  • Proven ability to work cross-functionally with Legal, HR, and Finance in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
  • Exceptional attention to detail, organizational skills, and ability to manage sensitive data with the highest degree of integrity and confidentiality.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with a demonstrated ability to explain complex concepts to employees at all levels.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets for reporting and analysis.
  • Certified Equity Professional (CEP) designation is strongly preferred.

COMPENSATION & PERKS

  • Full-time salary based on experience and meaningful equity in an industry-leading company
  • Hybrid model (remote & on-site setup is mandatory) 
  • Unlimited vacation policy; work hard and take time when you need it
  • Apple equipment
  • The opportunity to be a key player and build your career at a rapidly expanding, global technology company in an emerging field
  • Flexible work culture  

Blockchain is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sex, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law. This policy applies to all employment practices within our organization, including hiring, recruiting, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, leave of absence, and apprenticeship. Blockchain makes hiring decisions based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs at the time.

You may contact our Data Protection Officer by email at dpo@blockchain.com. Your personal data will be processed for the purposes of managing Controller’s recruitment related activities, which include setting up and conducting interviews and tests for applicants, evaluating and assessing the results thereto, and as is otherwise needed in the recruitment and hiring processes. Such processing is legally permissible under Art. 6(1)(f) of Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (General Data Protection Regulation) as necessary for the purposes of the legitimate interests pursued by the Controller, which are the solicitation, evaluation, and selection of applicants for employment.

Your personal data will be shared with Greenhouse Software, Inc., a cloud services provider located in the United States of America and engaged by Controller to help manage its recruitment and hiring process on Controller’s behalf.  Accordingly, if you are located outside of the United States, your personal data will be transferred to the United States once you submit it through this site. Because the European Union Commission has determined that United States data privacy laws do not ensure an adequate level of protection for personal data collected from EU data subjects, the transfer will be subject to appropriate additional safeguards under the standard contractual clauses. 

Your personal data will be retained by Controller as long as Controller determines it is necessary to evaluate your application for employment.  Under the GDPR, you have the right to request access to your personal data, to request that your personal data be rectified or erased, and to request that processing of your personal data be restricted. You also have the right to data portability. In addition, you may lodge a complaint with an EU supervisory authority.

title: Recruiting Coordinator (Contract)

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

title: Prime Client Services Associate
description:
BitGo is the leading infrastructure provider of digital asset solutions, delivering custody, wallets, staking, trading, financing, and settlement services from regulated cold storage. Since our founding in 2013, we have focused on enabling our clients to securely navigate the digital asset space. With a global presence and multiple Trust companies, BitGo serves thousands of institutions, including many of the industry's top brands, exchanges, and platforms, and millions of retail investors worldwide. As the operational backbone of the digital economy, BitGo handles a significant portion of Bitcoin network transactions and is the largest independent digital asset custodian, and staking provider, in the world. For more information, visit www.bitgo.com.

BitGo is the leader in digital asset financial services, providing institutional investors with liquidity, custody, and security solutions. Founded in 2013, BitGo pioneered the multi-signature wallet and is the first digital asset company to focus exclusively on serving institutional clients.  Active in both centralized and decentralized finance, BitGo offers market leading trading, lending, and borrowing services through its prime brokerage services and acts as the custodian for WBTC, the leading global stablecoin for Bitcoin. In 2020, BitGo launched BitGo Portfolio and Tax, providing clients with a full-stack solution for digital assets. In 2018, it launched BitGo Trust Company, the first qualified custodian purpose-built for storing digital assets. BitGo processes approximately 20% of all global Bitcoin transactions, and supports over 600 coins and tokens. BitGo provides the security and operational backbone for more than 1500 institutional clients in 50 countries, including many regulated entities and the world’s top cryptocurrency exchanges and platforms.  BitGo is backed by Goldman Sachs, Craft Ventures, Digital Currency Group, DRW, Galaxy Digital Ventures, Redpoint Ventures, and Valor Equity Partners.

The BitGo Prime team is a dynamic, high performing group that provides critical operational service to our institutional trading, lending, and borrowing clients in partnership with our Trust custody and compliance entity; global account managers and salespeople; and finance and accounting. Our extended unit consists of a diverse group of trading, lending, and KYC/AML professionals with extensive backgrounds in traditional and crypto-finance, including front, middle, and back office.

The Prime Client Services Associate will be responsible for managing business operations for BitGo Prime’s digital asset trading and financing services.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Manage BitGo Prime’s trade and settlement workflows including trade entry, asset transfers, reporting and reconciliation. 
  • Collaborate with Prime’s business team to maintain optimal funding across various trading venues
  • First line of support for trading or financing operations related enquiries
  • Lead process improvements, identify gaps, recommend improvements and automation
  • Support testing efforts for all enhancements of proprietary systems
  • Produce daily, weekly and monthly reporting for internal and external stakeholders
  • Assist the Sales and Client Services team with on-boarding new counterparties
  • Identifying operational risks, introduce operational controls and document policies & procedures
  • Collaborate closely with the product/engineering team to improve our products and services
  • Develop and maintain relationships with clients, exchanges, liquidity providers and third party providers
  • Stay up to date about market trends, opportunities, risks and new projects, with a passion for the digital asset industry

SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

BitGo is looking for people who are passionate about their craft, take full ownership for their work and projects, and believe in transparent and collaborative culture with the goal of making BitGo successful.

  • Incredible attention to detail and organizational skills
  • Able to effectively interact with others in a pleasant, professional manner
  • Strong analytical skills and ability to understand assets flows and procedures
  • Must have previous middle or back-office experience in a financial services Trading, stock loan, FX experience is a plus.
  • Experience managing and interacting with clients is a plus
  • Comfortably manage competing priorities in a fast-moving, dynamic start-up environment
  • Hands-on Excel or Google Sheets experience; macro programming exposure is a plus
  • Genuine interest in financial services and cryptocurrency; crypto experience professionally or personally is a plus
  • Bachelor's degree from an accredited university, or equivalent experience

description:
