With a sleek mobile-first app and a passionate community, we’re redefining how people interact with news, probabilities, and financial markets.  

The Role

We’re seeking a Business Operations Manager or Director, based on experience, to own, and scale OG Broker’s B2B client onboarding, contract listing, and partnership operations. This high-impact role sits at the intersection of commercial, legal, compliance, product, and technology, ensuring institutional clients move efficiently from signed agreement to successful launch.

You’ll lead institutional client onboarding, strengthen and automate operational workflows, and serve as a trusted strategic partner to B2B clients. The ideal candidate is comfortable solving ambiguous problems, pushing back with judgment and diplomacy, and driving measurable process improvements across a highly regulated business.

Responsibilities

    What You'll Do

  • Own end-to-end B2B client onboarding, from initial engagement and contract execution through technical integration, operational readiness, and go-live.
  • Serve as the primary operational point of contact for institutional clients, including brokers, FCMs, introducing brokers, and other market participants.
  • Coordinate contract listing, account setup, credentialing, and related operational processes in partnership with legal, compliance, product, and technology, to deliver a seamless and scalable client experience.
  • Identify onboarding bottlenecks, design pragmatic solutions, and drive execution from recommendation through implementation.
  • Develop and maintain operational playbooks, process documentation, SLAs, escalation paths, and client readiness materials.
  • Track and report onboarding pipeline status, client health, operational risks, and KPIs to leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Represent OG Broker in client-facing discussions, including navigating negotiations, resolving issues, and prioritizing conversations with sound judgement and credibility. Build strong client relationships, anticipate operational risks, and resolve issues before they escalate.
  • Lead cross-functional special projects that do not sit neatly within one function, translating business objectives into clear project plans, milestones, owners, and deliverables.

Preferred Experience

  • Valid NFA Series 3 license required (or ability to successfully obtain within 90 days of start date).
  • 5+ years of experience in business operations, client onboarding, implementation, or strategic operations, ideally within fintech, regulated financial markets, derivatives, exchanges, or clearing.
  • Experience at a top-tier management consultancy is a huge plus. We value candidates who can diagnose problems, structure ambiguity, and redesign systems rather than simply execute tasks.
  • Implementation consulting or enterprise client launch experience, ideally leading complex  multi-stakeholder rollouts, for institutional clients is a strong plus.
  • Direct exposure to institutional clients is required.
  • Experience with CFTC-regulated entities, including CME , derivatives exchanges, clearing houses, futures commission merchants (FCMs), introducing brokers, swap dealers or other comparable regulated market structures is highly valued.
  • Deep knowledge of prediction market contracts, UpDown options, Strike Options, margined derivatives, perpetuals, or similar products across multiple asset classes is a strong plus.
  • Fintech experience is required, ideally at a high growth or category leading fintech operator. Crypto or digital assets experience is welcome and viewed favorably.

Preferred Skills

  • Exceptional stakeholder management, with the ability to align cross-functional teams, manage competing priorities, and create accountability without formal authority
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the presence to represent Nadex credibly with sophisticated institutional clients
  • Analytically rigorous and systems-oriented, with a strong ability to identify root causes, build frameworks, and design scalable operating models
  • Strong project management discipline, including clear ownership, milestone tracking, risk identification, blocker escalation, and follow-through
  • Sound business judgment and the ability to push back strategically while preserving client relationships and protecting the business
  • Agentic workflow management experience is a strong plus, including the ability to translate complex business processes into modular, step-by-step workflows where specialized agents or tools can coordinate, review, and hand off work autonomously
  • Continuous improvement mindset; you are energized by making complex processes clearer, faster, and more reliable
  • Collaborative, direct, low-ego, and highly accountable
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-moving, lean environment where you may need to build the playbook while executing
  • Chicago-based or able to work a hybrid schedule with regular presence in the Chicago office

title: Director of AML & Virtual Asset Compliance
description:
About the Company

Born from groundbreaking research at Columbia University and Yale University, CertiK is a leading Web3 security company focused on securing blockchain protocols, smart contracts, and decentralized applications through cutting-edge security research, formal verification, and AI-powered technology. Founded in 2017 and headquartered in New York City, CertiK provides end-to-end security solutions including smart contract audits, penetration testing, on-chain monitoring, incident response, and compliance services for some of the largest projects in the digital asset ecosystem. Today, CertiK supports thousands of enterprise clients and Web3 projects globally, with a distributed international team spanning North America, Asia, and Europe. The company is backed by leading investors including Coatue, Goldman Sachs, Insight Partners, and Sequoia Capital, and has been recognized by organizations such as the World Economic Forum and CB Insights for its contributions to blockchain security innovation.

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced compliance leader to help shape and expand our work across anti money laundering, virtual asset compliance, and blockchain risk management.

This role is designed for someone who can bridge the gap between traditional finance compliance officers and crypto AML product development, with a strong focus on client-facing product discovery.

You will serve as a senior subject matter expert on AML and virtual asset compliance, working directly with financial institutions and VASPs to understand their compliance workflows and needs, translate those needs into actionable product requirements, and help strengthen CertiK’s compliance capabilities and products.

About You

You are a practical and commercially minded compliance leader with deep experience in AML, financial crime, and virtual assets.

You have direct experience as a compliance officer, MLRO, or equivalent within a financial institution and understand how traditional finance compliance teams operate. You are comfortable sitting with clients to understand their workflows, pain points, and product needs, and can move from “client said this” to prioritized, actionable product requirements that product and engineering teams can execute.

You understand how strong compliance programs, credible risk controls, and effective blockchain analytics can support responsible business growth.

Responsibilities

  • Build and improve AML frameworks, virtual asset compliance strategy, sanctions, risk assessments, transaction monitoring, and investigation processes.
  • Advise financial institutions and VASPs on virtual asset compliance, regulatory expectations, and blockchain related financial crime risks.
  • Work directly with clients, especially traditional finance compliance teams, to understand their workflows, pain points, and product needs.
  • Translate client needs into prioritized, actionable product requirements that product and engineering teams can execute.
  • Monitor regulatory developments and translate them into practical compliance guidance and product requirements.
  • Where applicable, serve as MLRO or support the designated MLRO on suspicious activity reviews and regulatory reporting.
  • Partner with product, engineering, business development teams, regulators, law enforcement, and other industry stakeholders.

Requirements

  • Direct experience as a compliance officer, MLRO, Chief Compliance Officer, Head of Financial Crime, or equivalent at a financial institution, preferably in Hong Kong, Singapore, or the broader APAC region.
  • Experience across both traditional financial institutions and the virtual asset industry.
  • Proven client-facing product discovery experience, particularly working with compliance teams to understand their needs and translate them into clear product requirements.
  • Strong knowledge of AML, financial crime, sanctions, transaction monitoring, regulatory compliance and reporting, and virtual asset financial crime risks.
  • Hands on experience with blockchain analytics, KYT, wallet screening, or similar on-chain compliance tools and processes.
  • Strong communication skills and CAMS or an equivalent AML qualification.

Bonus Points

  • Experience owning the AML program of a regulated entity, VASP licensing, regulatory examinations, or remediation.
  • Established relationships across regulators, law enforcement, banks, exchanges, or the virtual asset industry.
The expected annual base salary range for this position in the United States is $150,000 to $220,000. Compensation for candidates outside the United States will be determined based on location, experience, and qualifications.

title: Senior Customer Activation Manager | Scaled
description:
About Ramp

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

About the Role

Customer Success Managers at Ramp drive value for customers and revenue for the business by ensuring fast, effective onboarding and activation of newly closed customers. As a Senior Scaled CSM, you’ll play a critical role in delivering high-quality outcomes at scale while helping shape the processes, playbooks, and customer strategy that fuel Ramp’s growth.

You’ll own a high-volume portfolio of micro-SMB and micro-MM customers, balancing efficiency and personalization through strong judgment, structured execution, and thoughtful use of scalable motions. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in fast-paced environments, operates with high ownership, and consistently drives customer outcomes.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the end-to-end onboarding and activation of a large portfolio of micro-SMB and micro-MM customers, driving customers to full Ramp adoption within 60 days through efficient, scalable motions.

  • Lead onboarding with strong executive presence, setting clear agendas, controlling call flow, and driving as much progress as possible in minimal touchpoints.

  • Ensure fast, thorough, and complete implementation by educating customers on Ramp functionality, best practices, and the “why” behind key workflows.

  • Confidently navigate and position Ramp’s full product suite, including Cards, Bill Pay, Travel, Treasury, and Accounting integrations, tailoring recommendations to customer workflows and business goals.

  • Deeply understand customer workflows, pain points, and blockers, and problem-solve alongside Product, Engineering, and Support when needed.

  • Drive revenue by minimizing implementation delays and reinforcing the value of Ramp as a core financial operating system.

  • Use customer data, usage signals, and patterns to prioritize outreach, identify risk, and intervene proactively.

  • Balance implementation work, follow-ups, proactive outreach, and group onboarding while maintaining a high bar for quality.

  • Partner closely with Product to surface customer feedback, identify trends, and influence roadmap priorities.

  • Identify opportunities to automate, standardize, and improve onboarding processes, contributing to playbooks, enablement materials, and scalable best practices.

  • Act as a multiplier for the team by sharing insights, patterns, and coaching peers through examples and collaboration.

  • Help maintain an industry-leading customer experience while operating at high volume and pace.

What You’ll Need

  • 5+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, Sales, or a related customer-facing role in B2B SaaS.

  • Proven success managing a high-volume book of business while consistently driving customer outcomes.

  • Strong executive presence with the ability to lead confident, structured customer conversations and handle objections effectively.

  • Experience balancing scale and personalization through group onboarding, automation, and targeted 1:1 engagement.

  • Comfort working cross-functionally with Product and Engineering to share feedback, troubleshoot issues, and ideate solutions.

  • Data-informed mindset with experience using metrics and signals to guide decisions and assess risk.

  • Proven track record of meeting or exceeding key performance metrics in fast-paced environments.

  • High adaptability and comfort navigating ambiguity in a scaling organization.

  • Strong curiosity about product design and the ability to communicate why Ramp works the way it does.

Nice to Haves

  • Bachelor’s degree from an accredited university.

  • Experience with accounting or ERP systems such as NetSuite, QuickBooks, Xero, or Sage.

  • Background in financial services, fintech, or payments.

  • Experience at a high-growth startup or in a scaled Customer Success organization.

  • Prior experience contributing to enablement materials, playbooks, or process improvements.

Benefits available to all full-time Ramp employees (Global)

  • Flexible PTO

  • Centralized home-office equipment ordering

  • Health and wellness stipend

  • Budget for intra-office travel

  • Weekly coffee stipend

United States

  • 100% medical, dental & vision insurance coverage for you, with partial coverage for dependents

  • One Medical annual membership

  • 401(k), including employer match on contributions made while employed by Ramp

  • Fertility HRA (up to $10,000 per year)

  • Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay

  • Pet insurance

  • In-office perks: lunch, snacks, drinks, and more

  • Relocation expense coverage to NYC or SF (if needed)

Canada

  • Group medical, dental, and vision coverage through Sun Life

  • Life, AD&D, and disability coverage

  • Fertility drug coverage (up to $4,000 lifetime)

  • Group Retirement Plan with employer match (RRSP + DPSP)

  • Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay, with additional time available at reduced pay

  • Employee Assistance Program and virtual care through Lumino Health

United Kingdom

  • Private medical insurance through Freedom Elite

  • Virtual GP and at-home care via eMed x Livi

  • Workplace pension through Penfold, with salary sacrifice option

  • Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay with additional time available at reduced pay

title: Site Logistics & Materials Associate - Onsite: Corpus Christi, TX
description:
ABOUT HUT 8

Imagine the ultimate destination for those who want to work at the cutting edge of technology, energy, and infrastructure. Hut 8 is on a mission to build and operate some of the world’s largest data centers for next-generation computing workloads, including AI, Colocation, Cloud, and Bitcoin Mining. We are proud to offer interesting and challenging opportunities for individuals who want to build teams, solve problems, and make an impact from day one. If you’re an ambitious individual looking for a career that is as rewarding as it is challenging, you’ve come to the right place.

ABOUT THE ROLE

The Site Logistics & Materials Coordinator is the site-level execution arm of Supply Chain. You'll make sure materials and equipment arrive on time, in good condition, and in the quantities expected — and that they're stored in compliance with warranty and vendor specifications when they can't go straight onto the pad as construction is ready. Day to day, you'll maintain a real-time log of equipment delivered by OEMs, perform weekly physical audits against system records to ensure nothing is lost or duplicated, and work with category management and vendors to resolve delivery issues, shortages, damaged shipments, and documentation gaps. You're the person who protects the project schedule and asset value by keeping tight control over everything that crosses the site gate.

ABOUT YOU

  • You have 3+ years in site logistics, materials management, warehousing, or construction supply chain — ideally on large industrial, energy, or data center projects
  • You know receiving and inventory control cold: cycle counts, reconciliations, and keeping the system of record matched to what's physically in the yard
  • You understand how OEM equipment (transformers, switchgear, generators, long-lead mechanical/electrical) needs to be handled and stored, and what improper storage does to a warranty
  • You're comfortable in an ERP or inventory system and disciplined about documentation — BOLs, packing lists, condition photos, certifications
  • You communicate directly and push issues to resolution the same day, whether with a freight carrier, a vendor, or category management
  • You're happy working outdoors on an active construction site and walking the laydown yard daily; forklift/telehandler certification is a plus

ABOUT THE WORK ENVIRONMENT

This role is 100% on-site at our River Bend data center campus in Corpus Christi, TX. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

WHAT MAKES HUT 8 A GREAT PLACE TO WORK

Hut 8 offers a benefits and wellness program that includes medical, dental, vision, life, and short-term and long-term disability insurance, as well as paid time off. We are proud to invest in building the best team in the industry. At all levels of the organization, we are driven by an entrepreneurial spirit, radical transparency, and relentless growth mentality.

At Hut 8, you will have the opportunity to:

▶ Work with bright, driven peers from a range of educational and professional backgrounds including software development, energy, engineering, entrepreneurship, investment banking, private equity, and management consulting

title: Country Manager and Wealth Lead, Singapore
description:
Blockchain is connecting the world to the future of finance. As the most trusted and fastest-growing global crypto company, it helps millions of people worldwide safely access cryptocurrency. Since its inception in 2011, Blockchain has earned the trust of over 90 million wallet holders and more than 40 million verified users, facilitating over $1 trillion in crypto transactions.

We are looking for a highly entrepreneurial, commercial, and execution-oriented Country Manager for Singapore to lead and accelerate our growth in the market.

This person will own the Singapore growth agenda, with a particular focus on expanding our wealth and High-Net-Worth Individual (HNWI) segment, growing our retail user base, strengthening our local brand presence, and building deep relationships with our most valuable clients.

We are looking for someone who is crypto-native, understands the local digital asset ecosystem, and has strong experience working at a leading crypto company. You should understand the needs and expectations of sophisticated crypto users and HNWI clients and be able to translate that knowledge into local growth.

This is a highly hands-on role. You will be expected to move seamlessly between setting market strategy, developing HNWI relationships, building local KOL and content programs, executing partnerships, and personally driving events and on-the-ground activations.

Given the profile of our target clients and partners, professional fluency in both English and Mandarin is required.

You will be the voice of the Singapore market internally, working closely with central growth, product, marketing, and commercial teams to ensure our global initiatives translate into meaningful local growth.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

Own Singapore Growth

  • Develop and execute the growth strategy for Singapore, with a particular focus on the wealth and HNWI segment.
  • Grow the local retail user base while building a strong and sustainable pipeline of HNWI and high-value clients.
  • Identify, test, and scale the most effective acquisition and engagement channels, including content, KOLs, partnerships, product-led growth, referrals, communities, events, and on-the-ground activations.
  • Develop initiatives specifically designed to attract and convert sophisticated crypto investors and high-value users.
  • Take ownership of local growth targets and continuously optimize initiatives based on measurable commercial outcomes.

Build the HNWI Franchise

  • Develop and nurture trusted relationships with HNWIs, sophisticated investors, crypto-native clients, and other top-tier users in Singapore.
  • Proactively source, engage, and convert new high-value clients through personal networks, referrals, events, partnerships, communities, and targeted acquisition strategies.
  • Build a deep understanding of client needs, behaviours, portfolio considerations, pain points, and expectations.
  • Serve as the internal champion for Singapore’s HNWI clients, ensuring their feedback and needs are represented across the company.
  • Work with product and central teams to turn client insights into new products, features, services, and commercial opportunities.
  • Build trusted relationships with both English- and Mandarin-speaking clients and stakeholders.

Drive Local Brand & Market Presence

  • Own and execute our Singapore events, activations, content, KOL, and community strategy.
  • Build relationships with relevant crypto KOLs, creators, communities, founders, investors, partners, and ecosystem participants.
  • Identify local conversations and market trends where we should have a meaningful presence.
  • Develop locally relevant content and campaigns that strengthen our positioning with both retail and HNWI audiences.
  • Personally drive execution where required—from identifying the opportunity and developing the concept to being on-site and ensuring the activation delivers results.
  • Consistently create opportunities to engage, acquire, and convert new top clients.

Localize & Execute Global Campaigns

  • Partner closely with central growth, marketing, product, commercial, and other teams to deploy global campaigns effectively in Singapore.
  • Localize central initiatives to ensure the messaging, channels, partnerships, content, and execution resonate with the Singapore market.
  • Surface local market intelligence, competitor developments, crypto trends, client feedback, and commercial opportunities to central teams.
  • Coordinate cross-functionally to remove blockers and ensure Singapore initiatives are executed quickly and effectively.

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • Strong experience working at a crypto or digital asset company is required, ideally in a growth, country management, commercial, wealth, VIP, institutional, partnerships, or senior client-facing role.
  • Deep understanding of the crypto industry, digital asset products, customer behaviours, and competitive landscape.
  • Demonstrated ability to acquire, manage, and build trusted relationships with HNWI and high-value clients, ideally within crypto.
  • Professional fluency in both English and Mandarin is required, including the ability to conduct sophisticated commercial and client conversations in Mandarin.
  • Strong understanding of the Singapore market and the local crypto and wealth ecosystem.
  • Existing relationships across Singapore's HNWI, crypto, investor, KOL, community, or broader wealth ecosystem are highly advantageous.
  • Proven ability to drive growth through a combination of content, KOLs, partnerships, communities, events, referrals, product-led growth, and direct relationship building.
  • Highly commercial and outcome-oriented, with a strong instinct for identifying opportunities and converting them into measurable growth.
  • Exceptional relationship-building skills and the ability to develop credibility quickly with sophisticated and high-value clients.
  • Comfortable operating both strategically and tactically—you can develop the market strategy and then personally execute the event, partnership, campaign, or client meeting required to make it happen.
  • High ownership, speed, resourcefulness, and bias toward action.
  • Strong cross-functional skills and the ability to work effectively with globally distributed central teams.

COMPENSATION & PERKS

  • Full-time salary based on experience and meaningful equity in an industry-leading company
  • Role based in our Singapore office, with a mandatory in-office presence four days per week
  • Work from Anywhere Policy: You can work remotely from anywhere in the world for up to 20 days per year.
  • Budgets for learning & professional development 
  • Unlimited vacation policy; work hard and take time when you need it
  • Apple equipment
  • The opportunity to be a key player and build your career at a rapidly expanding, global technology company in an emerging field
  • Flexible work culture  

Blockchain is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sex, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law. This policy applies to all employment practices within our organization, including hiring, recruiting, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, leave of absence, and apprenticeship. Blockchain makes hiring decisions based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs at the time.

You may contact our Data Protection Officer by email at dpo@blockchain.com. Your personal data will be processed for the purposes of managing Controller’s recruitment related activities, which include setting up and conducting interviews and tests for applicants, evaluating and assessing the results thereto, and as is otherwise needed in the recruitment and hiring processes. Such processing is legally permissible under Art. 6(1)(f) of Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (General Data Protection Regulation) as necessary for the purposes of the legitimate interests pursued by the Controller, which are the solicitation, evaluation, and selection of applicants for employment.

Your personal data will be shared with Greenhouse Software, Inc., a cloud services provider located in the United States of America and engaged by Controller to help manage its recruitment and hiring process on Controller’s behalf.  Accordingly, if you are located outside of the United States, your personal data will be transferred to the United States once you submit it through this site. Because the European Union Commission has determined that United States data privacy laws do not ensure an adequate level of protection for personal data collected from EU data subjects, the transfer will be subject to appropriate additional safeguards under the standard contractual clauses. 

Your personal data will be retained by Controller as long as Controller determines it is necessary to evaluate your application for employment.  Under the GDPR, you have the right to request access to your personal data, to request that your personal data be rectified or erased, and to request that processing of your personal data be restricted. title: Forward Deployed Engineer / AI Engineer BR
description:
Na Toku, estamos construindo uma plataforma de agentes conversacionais para resolver problemas complexos de cobrança dos nossos clientes.
Buscamos FDEs / AI Engineers com mentalidade de founders: pessoas capazes de entender um problema real, construir um MVP funcional em poucas semanas e validá-lo diretamente com o cliente antes de escalar a solução.

Esse papel combina três dimensões muito relevantes: engenharia de software, pensamento de produto e proximidade com clientes. Queremos trabalhar com pessoas que curtam construir produtos do zero, que saibam priorizar com critério diante de mudanças e não tenham medo de experimentar para validar uma solução em questão de semanas.

O que te espera?

  • Reunir-se periodicamente com clientes para entender seus processos, identificar oportunidades e traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções tecnológicas.

  • Projetar, desenvolver e iterar MVPs de agentes conversacionais utilizando tecnologias de IA, validando hipóteses com clientes em ciclos curtos.

  • Construir software sustentável e escalável sobre uma plataforma comum que permita suportar múltiplas soluções conversacionais.

  • Colaborar de perto com Engenharia, Produto e outros Product Engineers para definir a melhor estratégia técnica e funcional para cada solução.

  • Tomar decisões técnicas considerando os trade-offs entre velocidade de execução, escalabilidade e manutenibilidade.

  • Participar ativamente de revisões de código, design de arquitetura e melhoria contínua das práticas de engenharia do time.

O que buscamos em você?

  1. 4 a 6 anos de experiência como Software Engineer, participando ativamente no design, desenvolvimento e deploy de produtos de software.

  2. Experiência construindo produtos ou plataformas B2B/B2C de alta escala, utilizadas por um alto volume de usuários ou transações.

  3. Experiência participando ativamente na definição de funcionalidades e/ou trabalhando de perto com times de Produto em contextos ágeis.

  4. Experiência comprovável projetando soluções escaláveis e tomando decisões técnicas considerando trade-offs entre velocidade, manutenibilidade e escalabilidade.

  5. Excelentes habilidades de comunicação para interagir tanto com perfis técnicos quanto com clientes.

  6. Capacidade de atuar em contextos ambíguos, priorizar com autonomia e transformar problemas abertos em soluções concretas.

  7. Motivação para construir produtos impulsionados por IA.

  8. Domínio do idioma espanhol (nível intermediário/avançado ou fluente), com capacidade para participar de reuniões e se comunicar com a equipe de forma clara.

  9. Disponibilidade para atuar em modelo híbrido (50%), com atuação presencial em nosso escritório de São Paulo.

Diferenciais:

  1. Experiência desenvolvendo produtos baseados em LLMs, agentes conversacionais ou sistemas de IA.

  2. Ter participado da construção de produtos desde etapas iniciais (0 → 1).

  3. Experiência realizando discoveries com clientes ou participando de conversas de produto.

  4. Experiência em startups de alto crescimento ou empresas de tecnologia com produtos de grande escala.

  5. Experiência em sistemas distribuídos, APIs, arquiteturas cloud ou plataformas de alta disponibilidade.

  6. Experiência trabalhando com metodologias ágeis e/ou com times multidisciplinares.

Gostamos de trabalhar com pessoas curiosas, que aprendem rápido, tomam iniciativa e curtem construir soluções que geram impacto de forma ágil. Se você se identifica com essa forma de trabalhar, estamos te esperando!

title: Product Counsel
description:
About MoonPay

MoonPay is for builders with something to prove.

This isn't a "work on cool crypto stuff" company. It's a high-standards, high-velocity, high-accountability company building the operating system for value movement. If the internet moves information, we move value: crypto, stablecoins, tokenized assets, and whatever comes next. Four offerings make that real: fund, tokenize, trade, and spend. 30M+ customers and 500+ ecosystem partners run on us. Licensed in the U.S. Regulated across the UK, EU, Canada, and Australia.

AI is the default operating mode here. It's woven into every role, and we expect you to use it daily. It handles the manual work so you can deliver on what actually matters.

You'll thrive here if outcomes excite you more than process, if impact motivates you more than titles, and if you want hard problems, real ownership, and teammates who love winning, building, and doing it together.

The bar is high. The pace is real. We're building for what's next, for humans and agents.

Recent recognition:


Forbes' America's Best Startup Employers 2026 .
2nd in Crypto Services on Fortune's inaugural Crypto 100
The Sunday Times Best Places to Work two years running

Research has shown that women are less likely than men to apply for this role if they do not have experience in 100% of these areas. Please know that this list is indicative, and that we would still love to hear from you even if you feel that you are only a 75% match. Skills can be learned, diversity cannot.


About the Opportunity ✍️

MoonPay is looking for a Product Counsel to be the dedicated legal partner for MoonPay's expanding product suite. This is a rare, high-impact role covering two interconnected mandates: our DeFi products - DEX routing and aggregation, non-custodial wallet infrastructure, and AI-powered agent integrations - and our regulated crypto asset services, including crypto-asset exchange services, digital asset custody, stablecoin issuance, and stablecoin card services.

You will work closely with product, compliance, and regulatory strategy - advising on new features from whiteboard to launch, navigating the complex interface between MoonPay’s regulated entity footprint and decentralized protocol integrations, and building the legal frameworks that allow our teams to move fast without breaking things. 

This role demands genuine fluency across both worlds. You will be expected to develop well-reasoned, risk-calibrated views quickly, communicate them clearly, and be a true thought partner to engineering and product - not just a gatekeeper.

What you will do…

Product legal coverage

  • Serve as a primary legal partner for MoonPay's DeFi product teams, providing full product lifecycle counselling from ideation through development, launch, and iteration.

  • Advise on the legal and regulatory characterisation of DEX routing, smart order routing, and aggregation features across multiple chains and jurisdictions — including analysis of SEC, CFTC, and FinCEN frameworks.

  • Provide legal coverage for MoonPay's non-custodial wallet products, including MPC key management architecture, chain abstraction, self-custody user flows, and associated consumer protection obligations.

  • Advise on AI agent and autonomous payment integrations — including the legal treatment of agentic transaction flows, user authorisation frameworks, and the evolving regulatory landscape for AI-driven financial services.

  • Provide product legal support for the launch of digital asset services by our regulated entities — working alongside entity-specific regulatory counsel to ensure that new product features are scoped and built consistently with the licensing conditions in each market.

Regulatory navigation

  • Navigate the interface between MoonPay's licensed regulated entities — including our US money transmission licenses and NYDFS BitLicense and trust company charter — and non-custodial and decentralized product features.

  • Support business lines with products and services regulated by the Fed, OCC, SEC, CFTC, CFPB, and potentially other federal regulatory bodies, and how those products and services interact with MoonPay’s suite of decentralized products

  • Monitor and assess regulatory developments across key jurisdictions as they apply to MoonPay’s suite of products, and translate these into actionable product guidance.

  • Partner with Regulatory Affairs and contribute to MoonPay's regulatory strategy on emerging product areas, including engagement with external counsel and regulatory stakeholders where relevant.

  • Advise on the regulatory characterisation of new products, services, and asset types, as well as other regulated activities as MoonPay’s product suite expands, including analysis of whether new products require licensing modifications or new applications in existing or new jurisdictions.

Commercial and operational

  • Draft, review, and negotiate a wide range of commercial agreements supporting MoonPay’si product development: protocol integration agreements, API and SDK licences, routing and liquidity provider arrangements, and partnership documentation.

  • Advise on and draft terms of service, user disclosures, and consumer protection documentation for DeFi-facing product features.

  • Develop scalable legal review frameworks and playbooks that enable the product and compliance teams to self-serve on routine product questions.

  • Work cross-functionally with Legal, Compliance, Risk, Regulatory Affairs, and Engineering to build the internal knowledge and process infrastructure needed to support a rapidly expanding DeFi product portfolio.

About You 🙋

What you will need…

  • JD (or equivalent) and active bar membership in at least one jurisdiction.

  • 6+ years of legal experience, including meaningful in-house experience at a crypto, DeFi, fintech, or regulated financial services company.

  • Deep, working understanding of DeFi: how DEXs and AMMs operate, what smart order routing involves, how non-custodial wallets and MPC key management work, and how smart contracts are used in protocol integrations.

  • Solid grounding in the US regulatory frameworks most relevant to DeFi products: FinCEN money transmission and MSB analysis, SEC securities regulation, CFTC commodity derivatives regulation, and NYDFS requirements for licensed entities.

  • Experience providing product lifecycle legal advice directly to engineering and product teams 

  • Excellent communications skills — the ability to deliver crisp, practical legal advice and synthesise complex regulatory constructs succinctly, especially where the law is unsettled or its application to novel technology is unclear.

  • High comfort with legal ambiguity, risk-adjusted thinking, and fast-paced environments where the right answer is not always obvious.

What would be great…

  • Experience advising on MPC, threshold signature schemes, or other non-custodial key management architectures.

  • Familiarity with AI agent architectures and the legal frameworks emerging around autonomous financial transactions.

  • Experience with on-chain protocol governance, smart contract audit processes, or open-source software licensing in a crypto context.

  • Familiarity with crypto asset custody regulation and card program legal frameworks.

  • Exposure to prediction markets, on-chain derivatives, or structured DeFi products (e.g., Polymarket, Hyperliquid, GMX, or comparable protocols).

  • Experience supporting the launch of novel regulated financial services, including licensing strategy, product scoping for regulatory compliance, and ongoing licence condition management.

  • Prior experience drafting or advising on protocol integration agreements, liquidity provider arrangements, or similar DeFi commercial documentation.

Research has shown that women are less likely than men to apply for this role if they do not have experience in 100% of these areas. Please know that this list is indicative, and that we would still love to hear from you even if you feel that you are only a 75% match. Skills can be learnt, diversity cannot.

Please let us know if you require any accommodations for the interview process, and we'll do our best to provide assistance.

Salary Range: $210,000 - $270,000 USD

Benefits & Perks 💡

  • 💰 Competitive salary package

  • 🤝 Equity package: financial freedom starts with our employees, so all employees have ownership at MoonPay

  • 📈 Pay-for-performance equity bonus: those who drive outsized outcomes receive outsized rewards

  • 🚀 Moonshot award: we honor exceptional impact. 10 employees twice a year, each earning a $250,000 equity grant

  • 📊Pension: employer contributions from day one

  • 🎁Employee referral program: refer great people, earn 10K in USDC

  • 🏝 Flexible Time Off: choose when to work and when to switch off

  • 🎂 Birthday leave: take the day off to celebrate you

  • 🍼 Enhanced parental leave: more time with family, no second thought

  • 🌍 Hybrid working schedule: work fully remotely or from your nearest Moonbase

  • 🚆 Commuter benefits: public transport to and from the office

  • 🩺 Private healthcare benefits: to protect you and your loved ones

  • 🧘 Wellhub wellness membership: access to gyms, studios, classes, and wellness apps in one membership

  • 🤖 Unlimited enterprise access to the latest AI tools: Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini and whatever's next

  • 🍱 Lunch credit: meals covered on the days you're in the office

  • 🪑 Home office setup allowance: build the home office of your dreams

  • 👛 Remote working allowance: those working fully remotely get a little extra for utilities

  • 🌕 Monthly product budget and zero-fee crypto transactions

  • 📚 $1,000 Annual training budget: we support your learning journey

  • 🎯 High Potential Program: structured development, mentorship, and stretch opportunities

  • ✈️ Regular remote company offsites: high-impact in-person sessions and hackathons

  • 🚲 (Ireland) Cycle to Work scheme: tax-efficient bike, gear, and safety kit

  • 🔌 (UK) EV Salary Sacrifice: lease an electric vehicle through pre-tax salary

Binance Acceleration Program - Product Data Analyst
description:
Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem behind the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users. Binance is trusted by more than 320 million people in 100+ countries for its industry-leading security, transparency, trading engine speed, protections for investors, and unmatched portfolio of digital asset products and offerings from trading and finance to education, research, social good, payments, institutional services, and Web3 features. Binance is devoted to building an inclusive crypto ecosystem to increase the freedom of money and financial access for people around the world with crypto as the fundamental means.
 
About Binance Accelerator Program
Binance Accelerator Program (BAP) is a 3-6 month internship program designed for Early Career talent to have firsthand experience in the rapidly expanding digital assets space. You will be given the opportunity to develop your skills at Binance and understand what it’s like to work at the world's leading blockchain ecosystem. As part of your internship in the BAP, there will also be opportunities for networking and development, which will expand your professional network and build transferable skills to propel you forward in your career. Learn about the BAP Program HERE.
 
Who may apply
Current university students and recent graduates.
*Terms of employment / engagement shall be subject to contract and local applicable laws
 

We are looking for a motivated Product Data Analyst Intern to join our Product DA team. You will work alongside senior analysts on real product analytics projects — including conversion funnel analysis, A/B experiment evaluation, and dashboard building. This is a hands-on role where you'll gain exposure to product strategy, experiment-driven decision making, and large-scale data infrastructure.

Responsibilities:

  • Assist in building and analyzing user conversion funnels, identifying drop-off points and improvement opportunities
  • Support A/B experiment evaluation: pull experiment data, validate cohort allocation (sanity checks), calculate uplift metrics, and summarize results
  • Build and maintain dashboards for key product metrics (CTR, conversion rate, UV/PV)
  • Respond to product team ad-hoc data requests — user segmentation, feature adoption tracking, campaign performance analysis
  • Write and maintain SQL queries for scheduled data pipelines; assist in data quality monitoring
  • Translate data findings into clear summaries and visualizations for product teams

Requirements:

     
  • Currently pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor's/Master's degree in a quantitative discipline (Statistics, Computer Science, Economics, Data Science, or related field)
  • Internship experience in product analytics or related data analysis roles preferred
  • A natural curiosity to identify, investigate and explain trends and patterns in data
  • Bilingual English/Mandarin is required to be able to coordinate with overseas partners and stakeholders.
  • Understanding of A/B testing fundamentals (hypothesis testing, p-value, confidence intervals)
  • Strong logical thinking, attention to detail, and ability to work independently
  • Fast learner with curiosity about product strategy and user behavior
  • Competency in one or more of the following:
  • SQL (able to write complex queries with CTEs, window functions, subqueries)
  • Programming (Python/R for data manipulation)
  • A data visualization tool (e.g. DataWind, Tableau, PowerBI)

Nice to Have

  • Experience with event tracking / behavioral analytics (Sensors, Mixpanel, GA)
  • Familiarity with Airflow or data scheduling tools
  • Interest in crypto/fintech industry
  • Prior experience with large-scale data (Hive/Spark environment)
Why Binance
• Shape the future with the world’s leading blockchain ecosystem
• Collaborate with world-class talent in a user-centric global organization with a flat structure
• Tackle unique, fast-paced projects with autonomy in an innovative environment
• Thrive in a results-driven workplace with opportunities for career growth and continuous learning
• Competitive salary and company benefits
• Work-from-home arrangement (the arrangement may vary depending on the work nature of the business team)

title: Junior Videographer & Editor
description:
Who we are 

We simplify wealth creation. Founded in 2014 in Vienna, Austria by Eric Demuth, Paul Klanschek and Christian Trummer, we’re here to help people trust themselves enough to build their financial freedom — for now and the future. Our user-friendly, trade-everything platform empowers both first-time investors and seasoned experts to invest in the cryptocurrencies, crypto indices, stocks*, precious metals and commodities* they want — with any sized budget, 24/7. Our global team works across different cultures and time zones, bringing our products to more than 7 million customers, making us one of Europe’s safest and most secure platforms that powers modern investing.

 

Headquartered in Austria but operating across Europe, our products are built by fast-moving, talented, “roll-up-your-sleeves-and-make-it-happen” kind of people. It’s these diverse perspectives and innovative minds operating as ONE TEAM that keep Bitpanda at the cutting edge of our industry. So if you’re someone who thinks big, moves fast and wants to make an impact right from day one, then get ready to join our industry-changing team. Let’s go!

 

Your mission
As part of the Social Media team, your mission is to create high-quality, social-first video content that brings Bitpanda’s brand, products, campaigns, and events to life across our channels. You combine strong camera skills, editing craft, and a good understanding of social media formats to produce content that feels premium, engaging, and platform-native.

 

Who you are

  • You have strong hands-on experience with camera operation and understand both the technical and creative side of shooting content – from studio setups to event coverage.

  • You are confident working with Adobe Premiere Pro and have a strong understanding of editing for social-first formats and short-form storytelling.

  • You ideally have basic to intermediate skills in Adobe After Effects and are comfortable creating simple animations and motion graphics.

  • You are interested in social media, digital culture, finance, and emerging technologies, & understand what makes content work across platforms like Instagram, TikTok, YT etc

  • You already have experience working with AI-powered creative tools and are able to generate AI-supported video assets and visuals as part of modern content production workflows.

 

What you'll do

  • Shoot and edit high-quality social-first video content for Bitpanda’s social media channels, campaigns, studio productions, and events. You'll also support the creation of internal video content.

  • Operate camera setups independently in both studio and live environments, ensuring strong visual quality and storytelling.

  • Edit engaging short-form content optimized for social platforms, with a strong focus on pacing, hooks, and audience retention.

  • Support the creation of motion graphics, animations, and AI-supported creative assets where relevant.

  • Collaborate closely with the Creative team, especially Concept and Design, to develop visually strong, premium content formats that align with the Bitpanda brand.

 

What’s in it for you

  • Flexibility to work where you thrive – Enjoy the freedom of our Hybrid working model, combining onsite collaboration and remote work, with an additional 25 days per year to work from a city or country of your choice.
  • Reward for your impact – Receive a competitive total compensation package aligned with Bitpanda’s pay-for-impact policy, including participation in our stock option plan.
  • Support for your mental wellbeing – Access confidential coaching, counselling, and mental health resources whenever you need them through OpenUP.
  • Time to recharge – On top of your standard annual leave, prioritise your wellbeing in 2027 with 3 additional days of paid time off to rest, reset, and recharge, available once you’ve been with us for 6 months.
  • Continuous learning and growth – Grow your skills and stay ahead in your career with unlimited access to Udemy’s library of online courses at your own pace.
  • Exclusive perks and rewards – Enjoy discounts, rewards, and perks from partners worldwide across lifestyle, wellness, tech, and travel.
  • Support during life milestones – Take advantage of up to 8 additional weeks of gender-neutral new parent leave to welcome and bond with your new addition to the family.
  • Fuel and focus on-site – Pandas in Vienna, Bucharest, Barcelona, and Berlin can enjoy free onsite dining, with freshly prepared lunches and snacks to keep you fueled and focused all day long.
  • Recognition for your contributions – Celebrate milestones and achievements with recognition and rewards for your Tenure at Bitpanda.
  • Show your Bitpanda pride – Access exclusive Bitpanda-branded merchandise and gear to represent.
  • Connect and celebrate with your team – Join unforgettable company events, from our Winter Party in Vienna to gatherings worldwide, fostering fun, connection, and celebration

       .…and even more location-specific benefits designed to make life at Bitpanda even more rewarding wherever you are.

 

Above all, you will have the opportunity to learn and grow as part of Bitpanda’s incredible journey towards being Europe’s future #1 investment platform.

Bitpanda is committed to fostering a fair and equal environment based on trust and mutual respect. We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace is paramount to our success and we are committed to building a team that represents a wide variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.
* These benefits may be adjusted at Bitpanda’s discretion and do not apply to our internships and exceptions to our Hybrid Working policy apply to teams with shift schedules or for folks whose roles require them to be in-office (think: Workplaces team or IT).

description:

We are trusted by 300+ million people in 100+ countries for our industry-leading security, user fund transparency, trading engine speed, deep liquidity, and an unmatched portfolio of digital-asset products. Binance offerings range from trading and finance to education, research, payments, institutional services, Web3 features, and more. We leverage the power of digital assets and blockchain to build an inclusive financial ecosystem to advance the freedom of money and improve financial access for people around the world.

We are looking for a Senior Product Data Analyst to join the Product DA team, partnering closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and Business stakeholders to drive data-informed product decisions. You will own end-to-end analytics for product strategy — from defining metrics and designing experiments to delivering actionable insights that directly impact user conversion, engagement, and business growth.

Responsibilities:

  • Work across all aspects of product data — from data engineering to building sophisticated dashboards, experiment frameworks and predictive models — in support of user growth and product strategy
  • Analyze and interpret large (PB-scale) volumes of user behavioral, transactional, and operational data using proprietary and open source data tools, platforms and analytical toolkits
  • Design and evaluate A/B experiments end-to-end: hypothesis formulation, experiment design, statistical analysis (significance testing, uplift calculation), and actionable recommendations
  • Define and maintain core product metrics hierarchy (CTR, conversion rate, retention, etc.), set OKR targets, and continuously evaluate performance
  • Translate complex findings into simple visualizations and recommendations for execution by product, operational teams and executives

title: Manager, Finance – Crypto Accounting
description:
Animoca Brands Corporation Limited (ACN: 122 921 813) is a Web3 leader that leverages tokenization and blockchain to deliver digital property rights to consumers, helping to establish the open metaverse and its associated network effects. Animoca Brands realizes its mission via three integrated business pillars: operating Web3 businesses to advance blockchain adoption with native projects such as Moca Network, Anichess, The Sandbox, Open Campus, NEOM Web3 initiatives, and a regulated stablecoin project in partnership with Standard Chartered and HKT; providing digital asset advisory services including tokenomics advisory, liquidity provisioning, and institutional research to help external Web3 projects grow; and investment management, with a portfolio of investments in over 540 companies including industry leaders Pudgy Penguins, Yuga Labs, Axie Infinity, Polygon, Consensys, Magic Eden, OpenSea, Dapper Labs, YGG, and many others.

About the Role:

We are seeking a Finance Manager with strong accounting fundamentals and hands-on experience in crypto/blockchain transactions. This is an execution-focused role: you will process, reconcile, and report on digital asset activity, and provide day-to-day finance support as we build out our Web3 operations.

You will work closely with senior finance stakeholders on crypto accounting processes and system implementations, applying IFRS to a fast-evolving digital asset environment.

Responsibilities:

  • Perform reconciliations of digital asset holdings and transactions, including transaction matching, wallet-to-ledger reconciliation, and resolution of reconciling items.
  • Prepare and post journal entries for crypto transactions (token receipts, swaps, staking rewards, gas fees, DeFi yield, impairment) in accordance with IFRS.
  • Deliver ad hoc financial statements (income statement, balance sheet) for crypto-native entities, built from the ground up.
  • Prepare digital asset schedules, accruals, and supporting documentation for monthly, quarterly, and annual close.
  • Streamline and optimise the month-end close process, improving efficiency and strengthening internal controls.
  • Support crypto accounting system implementation by testing configurations, validating data migration, and documenting process workflows.
  • Work with Product, Legal, and Operations to understand crypto transaction flows and translate them into finance-ready processes.
  • Respond to audit requests and prepare supporting documentation for crypto-related balances and transactions.
  • Stay current on regulatory, tax, and IFRS developments affecting crypto.

Requirements:

  • Professional certification (e.g., CPA, ACCA, CFA) or equivalent.
  • Solid understanding of IFRS accounting principles, practices, and regulations relevant to crypto assets.
  • Working knowledge of crypto transaction flows, wallets, exchanges, and DeFi protocols.
  • Strong Excel/reconciliation skills and comfort working with large volumes of transactional data.
  • Experience supporting finance/ERP or crypto accounting system implementations (testing, data validation, documentation).
  • Detail-oriented and proactive in identifying and resolving discrepancies.
  • Clear communicator, able to explain crypto concepts to non-technical finance colleagues.
  • Collaborative team player, comfortable working independently and navigating ambiguity.
  • Experience with data analytics tools (e.g., SQL and Python) to support data extraction and analysis.
  • Prior experience in a crypto-native company, Web3 project, or digital asset finance team is preferred.

title: Head of Engineering
description:
About Coinflow

Coinflow is the next-generation payment service provider revolutionizing global financial infrastructure with stablecoins, AI-driven fraud prevention, and instant settlement. Coinflow enables businesses to grow faster with instant settlement, fraud & chargeback indemnity, global pay-ins, multi-currency FX, and unified payouts. Founded in 2023, the company serves marketplaces, fintechs, remittance providers, gaming platforms, and ecommerce merchants worldwide.

Since our seed round in 2024, we’ve achieved 23x revenue growth and scaled to multi-billion-dollar annual transaction volume. In response to this growth, Coinflow announced a $25M Series A in October 2025—led by Pantera Capital, CMT Digital, Coinbase Ventures, Jump Crypto, and Reciprocal Ventures—accelerating our mission to power the world’s fastest-moving businesses with innovative, reliable global payments.

Coinflow is proudly headquartered in Chicago, IL. Learn more at coinflow.cash.

Role Overview

Coinflow is seeking a Head of Engineering to lead our engineering team and take ownership of day-to-day engineering, including prioritization, delivery, technical direction, and team health, that currently runs through the CTO. Coinflow is white-label payments infrastructure: card acquiring, payin/payout across numerous methods, hosted and embedded checkout, and merchant onboarding, operating in a heavily regulated environment where the bar for correctness, security, and reliability is high and non-negotiable.

This is a player-coach role, not a hands-off management job. You'll be in the codebase shipping real work on critical payment paths while building and leading the team. You own the team's deliverables — when something is late, broken, or unclear, it's yours to drive to done.

The first 6-12 months: this role is built around a handoff. Early on, you'll work closely with the CTO and ship alongside the team to earn context and trust. As you prove out judgment and delivery, more of the day-to-day — planning, technical decisions, team ownership — shifts to you. Success looks like the team running confidently under you while the CTO steps back from operational engineering.

Key Responsibilities

In the trenches (player)

  • Write, review, and ship production code on critical payment paths — you stay hands-on

  • Debug the hard stuff: production incidents, reliability gaps, performance and correctness issues

  • Set the technical direction and make the architecture calls that matter

  • Raise the engineering bar through code review, standards, and example

Leading the team (coach)

  • Own delivery — break work down, sequence it, and make sure it lands

  • Mentor every engineer on the team, from senior to junior, leveling people up rather than just directing them

  • Manage and grow the engineers: 1:1s, feedback, performance, hiring, and the occasional hard conversation

  • Own the process — clear requirements before work hits engineering, real ownership per project (DRI), and a feedback loop that catches problems early

  • Be the point of accountability for the team's output to the founders

  • Report to the CTO on personnel matters — performance, team health, and people decisions run through you and surface to the CTO directly

Required Qualifications

  • Senior engineering leader who is still a strong, current IC — able to hold your own in the codebase, not just review it

  • Track record owning delivery for a team: shipping real product, on a real cadence, with real accountability

  • Experience building process without bureaucracy — you know the difference between rigor and overhead

  • Comfortable in our stack: TypeScript/Node (Express, React), MongoDB, ClickHouse, Redis/queues

  • High bar for reliability, security, and correctness — you've operated where mistakes cost money

  • Direct communicator — you write things down and don't hide bad news

Preferred Qualifications

  • Payments experience (acquiring, card networks, ACH, chargebacks, PCI)

  • Stablecoin or blockchain infrastructure experience (Solana programs, EVM smart contracts, on-chain settlement)

  • Experience working in a regulated, compliance-forward environment

  • Early-stage startup experience

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation including base salary, performance bonus, and meaningful ownership

  • Opportunity to own engineering delivery and team leadership at a rapidly scaling fintech company

  • Collaborative and innovative work environment with world-class investors

  • Direct impact on core product and company trajectory during a hyper growth phase

The base salary range for this role is $220,000 - $275,000 USD. The actual base salary offered depends on a variety of factors, including but not limited to experience, education, skills, qualifications and business needs.

In addition, the employee who fills this role will be eligible for an equity grant, allowing you to share in the long-term success of the company. You will also have access to a wide array of benefits, including health and wellness benefits, 401(k) savings plan, and flexible time off.

Join the team rewriting how money moves worldwide—and become a driving force in the $194 trillion cross-border payments market.

title: Sr. Insider & Data Risk Analyst
description:
Who We Are:

Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.

Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. This includes broker-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts.

Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it.

Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.

Our Team Members:

We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!

We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

Your Role

As Senior Insider & Data Risk Analyst, you will own insider risk investigations and help mature Alpaca's Insider Risk Management Program and Data Loss Prevention capabilities. You will triage and investigate signals across people, devices, identity, and data movement, apply risk tiering and escalation standards, and partner with People/HR, Legal, Compliance, Engineering, and IT on sensitive cases involving departures, policy violations, and data misuse.

 

This role sits at the intersection of insider risk, data protection, privacy, and financial services. Reporting to the Cyber GRC Lead, you will serve as Security's escalation point for insider and data loss cases affecting trading systems, customer data, and proprietary information. This is a practical senior individual contributor role for someone experienced, discreet, and highly organized who can own investigation workflows, translate risk into clear language for leadership, and build durable programs and processes. Prior experience in a regulated or financial services environment is a strong plus.

 

Things You Get To Do

  • Own insider risk investigations from triage through closure, including case timelines, containment, escalation, and documented determinations and lessons learned
  • Mature Alpaca's Insider Risk Management Program, including case management processes, risk tiering, and repeatable workflows
  • Operate and tune Data Loss Prevention tooling across multiple environments and endpoints, refining rulesets to improve signal and reduce false positives
  • Mature data classification and align DLP controls to sensitivity levels
  • Investigate potential data exfiltration, misuse, and policy violations; build and tune detections and monitoring
  • Investigate misuse and exfiltration risk across source code, Google, AWS, Azure, third party apps, Slack, and trading and platform system access
  • Partner with People/HR, Legal, Compliance, and IT on sensitive cases (departures, policy violations, data mishandling) with discretion and care
  • Assess risk from unauthorized AI/agentic tooling and sensitive data exposure through approved and unsanctioned AI tooling
  • Leverage Agentic AI to continue maturation of Insider risk program
  • Lead insider and data risk assessments and maintain risk registers 
  • Support internal and external audits and regulatory requirements 
  • Contribute insider risk and data handling content to the security awareness and training program
  • Serve as the insider risk escalation point for the Security team and mentor others on investigations and casework
  • Monitor developments in insider risk, data protection, privacy, and financial services regulation.

 

Who You Are (Must Haves)

  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail; comfortable in a fast paced, high demand, distributed environment
  • 4+ years in insider risk, DLP operations, digital forensics, or security investigations, including hands on case management on sensitive personnel matters
  • Hands on experience leading investigations and case management with discretion, integrity, and sound judgment on sensitive personnel matters
  • Hands-on experience operating DLP in SaaS and endpoint environments and tuning rules to improve signal quality
  • Experience with workflow automation, AI, or SOAR platforms for alert triage and case orchestration
  • Solid understanding of data classification and data governance
  • Working knowledge of SIEM and log analysis (e.g., ELK/Elastic, Splunk) to support investigations
  • Familiarity with frameworks such as NIST CSF, ISO 27001, SOC 2, and privacy regulations (GDPR, APPI)
  • Strong written communication, able to draft clear investigation reports, case documentation, and executive summaries
  • High integrity and discretion when handling confidential and sensitive information
  • Ability to work across People/HR, Legal, Compliance, Engineering, and IT

 

Who You Might Be (Nice to Haves)

  • Academic background, personal interest, or real world experience in fintech, financial services, or trading platforms
  • Digital forensics or eDiscovery experience
  • Experience with UEBA or insider risk detection platforms
  • Scripting or automation for detections and data analysis (e.g., Python, SQL)
  • Experience with major cloud platforms
  • Experience supporting or observing SOC 2, ISO 27001, or regulatory audits
  • Certifications such as GCFA, GCFE, CISSP, CISM, CIPP, CFE, or similar
  • Interest in AI related data risk (e.g., data exposure through AI tools) and using AI tooling to work more efficiently
  • Familiarity with financial services regulatory expectations (e.g., SEC/FINRA, broker dealer controls) and multi jurisdiction privacy requirements
  • Experience in security operations or incident response

How We Take Care of You:

  • Competitive Salary & Stock Options
  • Health Benefits
  • New Hire Home-Office Setup: One-time USD $500
  • Monthly Stipend: USD $150 per month via a Brex Card

Alpaca is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to pursuing and hiring a diverse workforce.

title: Senior Crypto Threat Analyst - Terrorism
description:
Do you want to be at the forefront of combating crypto-enabled terrorism financing? Are you excited about leading the intelligence research that helps financial institutions and governments disrupt illicit financial networks? Are you looking for a values-led company that trusts you to own your domain and make a real impact?

The impact you will have:

As a key contributor to our global intelligence team, you will act as a CTF Subject Matter Expert, leading complex, in-depth investigations into the use of cryptoassets by terrorist actors and facilitation networks. You will validate exposure and attribution confidence, improve workflows, and translate findings into actionable intelligence outputs.

Your work will directly enhance Elliptic’s industry-leading intelligence dataset and product capabilities, helping our private and public-sector customers and partners strengthen CTF controls, manage risk, and take defensible decisions. Your insights will inform strategic client conversations, shape impactful research and publications, and reinforce Elliptic’s reputation as a trusted authority in the crypto and financial intelligence space. Your expertise will play a vital role in advancing financial integrity on a truly global scale.

What you will do:

  • Lead CTF-focused research and investigations into cryptoasset activity linked to terrorist organisations, facilitators, propaganda and fundraising ecosystems, and operational support networks including identifying typologies

  • Build and maintain a comprehensive picture of evolving CTF trends and ensure Elliptic’s intelligence reflects the full range of terrorist actors and facilitators using crypto

  • Work across multiple jurisdictions and designation regimes (e.g., UN, US, UK, EU and relevant domestic CT frameworks), ensuring our intelligence outputs align to different legal definitions, evidentiary expectations, and customer obligations.

  • Collaborate with the global intelligence team to identify and integrate new entities, wallet clusters, and illicit behaviors into Elliptic’s dataset, keeping it robust, actionable, and defensible.

  • Represent Elliptic’s CTF intelligence capabilities in client briefings, training sessions, and industry forums, communicating complex findings clearly to audiences including compliance teams, regulators, and public-sector partners.

  • Support public-sector partners, where appropriate, with intelligence that assists disruption of facilitation networks in the digital asset ecosystem.

What you will achieve in the first 6 months:

  • Contribute new entities and wallet clusters to Elliptic's intelligence dataset, deepening the CTF picture our customers rely on.

  • Convert investigative findings into scalable outputs such as typologies and detection logic that strengthen how our customers detect and act on terrorist financing risk.

  • Represent Elliptic's CTF expertise directly with customers and public-sector partners through briefings, training, or industry forums.

You will be a great fit here if you:

  • Thrive with high autonomy and minimal oversight

  • Are highly curious and driven to uncover hidden patterns and connections others overlook

  • Bring deep experience in intelligence analysis and managing uncertainty

  • Are an experienced OSINT researcher comfortable navigating multiple languages and jurisdictions

  • Have proven expertise or a strong interest in counter-terrorism financing

  • Combine initiative and collaboration with sharp analytical and research skills

  • Communicate clearly, whether briefing or producing rigorous, evidence-led reports

  • Work effectively with global teams and stakeholders at all levels

Our ideal candidate has:
